definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at or to a higher place or position than something/somebody
examples: The water came above our knees.
We were flying above the clouds.
the people in the apartment above mine
A captain in the navy ranks above a captain in the army.
They finished the year six places above their local rivals.
definitions.definition_vi: tại hoặc đến một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cao hơn cái gì đó/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: more than something; greater in number, level or age than somebody/something
examples: Inflation is above 6%.
Temperatures have been above average.
We cannot accept children above the age of 10.
definitions.definition_vi: hơn một cái gì đó; lớn hơn về số lượng, trình độ hoặc tuổi tác hơn ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: of greater importance or of higher quality than somebody/something
examples: I rate her above most other players of her age.
definitions.definition_vi: có tầm quan trọng lớn hơn hoặc có chất lượng cao hơn ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: too good or too honest to do something
examples: She's not above lying when it suits her.

definitions.definition_vi: quá tốt hoặc quá trung thực để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: louder or clearer than another sound
examples: I couldn't hear her above the noise of the traffic.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: most important of all; especially
examples: Above all, keep in touch.
definitions.definition_vi: quan trọng nhất trong tất cả; đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: having too high an opinion of yourself
definitions.definition_vi: có quan điểm quá cao về bản thân

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: in addition to something
examples: There are other factors over and above those we have discussed.
definitions.definition_vi: ngoài cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1

absolute confidence/trust/silence/truth

Clean water is an absolute necessity.
Around them the darkness was absolute, the silence oppressive.
definitions.definition_vi: tổng thể và đầy đủ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used, especially in spoken English, to give emphasis to what you are saying
examples: We must keep costs to an absolute minimum.
This room is an absolute disgrace.
They're talking absolute nonsense.
He must earn an absolute fortune.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: definite and without any doubt
examples: There was no absolute proof.
He taught us that the laws of physics were absolute.

definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn và không có nghi ngờ gì

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: (of a legal decision) final
examples: SEE ALSO decree absolute

definitions.definition_vi: (của một quyết định pháp lý) cuối cùng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not limited in any way
examples: absolute power/authority
an absolute ruler/monarchy (= one with no limit to their power)
definitions.definition_vi: không bị giới hạn dưới bất kỳ hình thức nào

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: existing or measured independently and not in relation to something else
examples: COMPARE relative

Beauty cannot be measured by any absolute standard.
definitions.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc được đo lường độc lập và không liên quan đến cái gì khác

definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ ngớ ngẩn; không logic và hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 2

examples: He has a good sense of the absurd.
definitions.definition_vi: những điều đó hoặc có vẻ là vô lý

a police/military academy
definitions.definition_vi: một trường học hoặc cao đẳng để đào tạo đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition_vi: một trường học ở Anh độc lập với sự kiểm soát của chính quyền địa phươngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.definition_vi: đi du lịch hoặc đi đâu đó với ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to happen or appear with something else
examples: Shouts of protest accompanied this announcement.
strong winds accompanied by heavy rain
The text is accompanied by a series of stunning photographs.
Tax cuts have been accompanied by massive increases in public expenditure.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc xuất hiện với cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to play a musical instrument, especially a piano, while somebody else sings or plays the main tune
examples: The singer was accompanied on the piano by her sister.
definitions.definition_vi: chơi một nhạc cụ, đặc biệt là piano, trong khi người khác hát hoặc chơi giai điệu chính

definitions.definition: the fact of being responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to gradually get more and more of something over a period of time

By investing wisely she accumulated a fortune.
We have accumulated a great amount of evidence.
definitions.definition_vi: dần dần có được ngày càng nhiều thứ gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to gradually increase in number or quantity over a period of time
examples: SYNONYM build up
Debts began to accumulate.
Dust and dirt soon accumulate if a house is not cleaned regularly.
definitions.definition_vi: tăng dần về số lượng hoặc số lượng trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time
examples: SYNONYM attain
He had finally achieved success.
They have both achieved great results
She has worked hard to achieve her goal.
to achieve an objective/aim
They could not achieve their target of less than 3% inflation.
The firm has achieved the status of undisputed market leader.
Course objectives were achieved through a range of activities.
definitions.definition_vi: thành công trong việc đạt được một mục tiêu, địa vị hoặc tiêu chuẩn cụ thể, đặc biệt bằng cách nỗ lực trong một thời gian dài

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to succeed in doing something or causing something to happen
examples: SYNONYM accomplish
I haven't achieved very much today.
All you've achieved is to upset my parents.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be successful
examples: SEE ALSO overachieve
Their background gives them little chance of achieving at school.
These students need to achieve academically in order to enter the labour market.
definitions.definition_vi: để thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a chemical, usually a liquid, that contains hydrogen and has a pH of less than seven. The hydrogen can be replaced by a metal to form a salt. Acids usually have a bitter sharp taste and can often burn holes in or damage things they touch.
examples: COMPARE alkali
The acid burned a hole in her coat.
Stomach acids can break down the poison.
You will need a special chemical to neutralize the acid.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a powerful illegal drug that affects people’s minds and makes them see and hear things that are not really there
examples: SYNONYM LSD
They smoke joints and drop acid.
He described the music as ‘Brahms on acid’.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại ma túy bất hợp pháp cực mạnh ảnh hưởng đến tâm trí con người và khiến họ nhìn và nghe thấy những thứ không thực sự có ở đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to accept that something is true

to openly/publicly/readily acknowledge something
He does not acknowledge that he has done anything wrong.
It is generally acknowledged to be true.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to accept that somebody/something has a particular authority or status
examples: SYNONYM recognize
The country acknowledged his claim to the throne.
The peace settlement effectively acknowledged the country's independence.

He is widely acknowledged to be the best player in the world.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có quyền lực hoặc địa vị cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to tell somebody that you have received something that they sent to you
examples: All applications will be acknowledged.
Please acknowledge receipt of this letter.
definitions.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn đã nhận được thứ gì đó họ gửi cho bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to show that you have noticed somebody/something by smiling, waving, etc.
examples: I was standing right next to her, but she didn't even acknowledge me.
He waved, acknowledging the applause.
definitions.definition_vi: để thể hiện rằng bạn đã chú ý đến ai đó/cái gì đó bằng cách mỉm cười, vẫy tay, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to publicly express thanks for help you have been given
examples: I gratefully acknowledge financial support from several local businesses.
He is always ready to acknowledge his debt to his teachers.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of getting something, especially knowledge, a skill, etc.
examples: theories of child language acquisition
definitions.definition_vi: hành động đạt được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là kiến ​​thức, kỹ năng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that somebody buys to add to what they already own, usually something valuable

definitions.definition_vi: thứ mà ai đó mua để bổ sung vào những gì họ đã sở hữu, thường là thứ gì đó có giá trị

a stage/film/movie actor
a Hollywood actor

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a participant in an action or process

people with no fixed address (= with no permanent home)

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: một bài phát biểu trang trọng được thực hiện trước khán giả

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: Middle English (as a verb in the senses ‘set upright’ and ‘guide, direct’, hence ‘write directions for delivery on’ and ‘direct spoken words to’): from Old French, based on Latin ad- ‘towards’ + directus past participle of dirigere, from di- ‘distinctly’ or de- ‘down’ + regere ‘put straight’. definitions.definition_vi: tiêu đề chính xác, v.v. để sử dụng khi bạn nói chuyện với ai đóWord Origin

training that is adequate to meet the future needs of industry
definitions.definition_vi: đủ về số lượng hoặc đủ tốt về chất lượng cho một mục đích hoặc nhu cầu cụ thể

definitions.definition: to stick to something

definitions.definition_vi: dính vào cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small change made to something in order to correct or improve it

definitions.definition_vi: một thay đổi nhỏ được thực hiện đối với một cái gì đó để sửa chữa hoặc cải thiện nó

definitions.definition: a change in the way a person behaves or thinks
examples: She went through a period of emotional adjustment after her marriage broke up.

definitions.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi trong cách một người hành xử hoặc suy nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of accepting somebody into an institution, organization, etc.; the right to enter a place or to join an institution or organization

countries applying for admission to the European Union

examples: He is a thief by his own admission (= he has admitted it).

definitions.definition_vi: một tuyên bố trong đó ai đó thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng, đặc biệt là điều gì đó sai hoặc xấu mà họ đã làm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the amount of money that you pay to go into a building or to an event
examples: SEE ALSO general admission
admission charges/prices
£5 admission
What's the admission?
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền bạn phải trả để đi vào một tòa nhà hoặc một sự kiện

definitions.definition: to take somebody else’s child into your family and become its legal parent(s)

a campaign to encourage childless couples to adopt
to adopt a child

definitions.definition_vi: nhận con của người khác vào gia đình bạn và trở thành cha mẹ hợp pháp của nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to start to use a particular method or to show a particular attitude towards somebody/something
examples: All three teams adopted different approaches to the problem.

to adopt an attitude/stance/position
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu sử dụng một phương pháp cụ thể hoặc thể hiện thái độ cụ thể đối với ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: chính thức chấp nhận một đề nghị hoặc chính sách bằng cách bỏ phiếu

definitions.definition_vi: để chọn một cái tên mới, một quốc gia, một phong tục, v.v. và bắt đầu sử dụng nó làm của riêng bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to use a particular manner, way of speaking, expression, etc.

definitions.definition_vi: để sử dụng một cách cụ thể, cách nói, cách diễn đạt, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.definition_vi: bây giờ, trong thế giới hiện đại

definitions.definition: the process of giving birth to a baby before it is fully developed and able to survive
examples: SYNONYM miscarriage
Higher amounts of caffeine may be associated with increased rates of abortion and low birthweight.
definitions.definition_vi: quá trình sinh ra một đứa trẻ trước khi nó được phát triển đầy đủ và có khả năng sống sót

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not in a place because of illness, etc.
examples: OPPOSITE present
He was absent from work for two weeks.
Local people were conspicuously absent from the meeting.
definitions.definition_vi: không ở một nơi vì bệnh tật, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not present in something
examples: OPPOSITE present
Love was totally absent from his childhood.
definitions.definition_vi: không có mặt trong cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: showing that you are not really looking at or thinking about what is happening around you
examples: SEE ALSO absently
an absent expression
definitions.definition_vi: cho thấy rằng bạn không thực sự nhìn hoặc suy nghĩ về những gì đang xảy ra xung quanh bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that something is completely true
examples: You're absolutely right.
He made it absolutely clear.
I'm not absolutely certain I posted it.
Are you absolutely sure?
Training is absolutely essential in this business.
Don't delay for longer than absolutely necessary.
The place was absolutely packed.
It was absolutely pouring with rain.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một cái gì đó là hoàn toàn đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something negative
examples: That man does absolutely no work!
There's absolutely nothing more the doctors can do.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một cái gì đó tiêu cực

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used with adjectives or verbs that express strong feelings or extreme qualities to mean ‘extremely’
examples: absolutely delighted/thrilled
We were absolutely devastated at the news.
I absolutely love strawberries.
She absolutely adores you.
absolutely fantastic/amazing
He's an absolutely brilliant cook.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng với tính từ hoặc động từ thể hiện cảm xúc mạnh mẽ hoặc phẩm chất cực đoan có nghĩa là 'cực kỳ'

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that you agree with somebody, or to give somebody permission to do something
examples: ‘They could have told us, couldn't they?’ ‘Absolutely!’
‘Can we leave a little early?’ ‘Absolutely!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đồng ý với ai đó hoặc cho phép ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that you strongly disagree with somebody, or to refuse permission
examples: ‘Was it any good?’ ‘No, absolutely not.’
‘Can I stay up late?’ ‘Absolutely not!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn hoàn toàn không đồng ý với ai đó hoặc từ chối sự cho phép

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: not considered in relation to other things
examples: White-collar crime increased both absolutely and in comparison with other categories.
definitions.definition_vi: không được xem xét trong mối quan hệ với những thứ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to take in a liquid, gas or other substance from the surface or space around
examples: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
Let the rice cook until it has absorbed all the water.
The cream is easily absorbed into the skin.
definitions.definition_vi: để lấy chất lỏng, khí hoặc chất khác từ bề mặt hoặc không gian xung quanh

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take in and keep heat, light, energy, sound, etc. instead of reflecting it
examples: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
definitions.definition_vi: hấp thụ và giữ nhiệt, ánh sáng, năng lượng, âm thanh, v.v. thay vì phản chiếu nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to reduce the effect of a physical impact or movement
examples: SEE ALSO shock absorber
This tennis racket absorbs shock on impact.
The bats have graphite shafts that absorb the vibration.
definitions.definition_vi: để giảm tác động của một tác động vật lý hoặc chuyển động

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to take something into the mind and learn or understand it
examples: SYNONYM take in
It's a lot of information to absorb all at once.
It took me several days to absorb the fact of her death.
They spent a week in Paris just absorbing the atmosphere.
definitions.definition_vi: ghi nhớ điều gì đó và học hỏi hoặc hiểu nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to interest somebody very much so that they pay no attention to anything else
examples: SYNONYM engross
This work had absorbed him for several years.
His work absorbed him completely.
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó quan tâm nhiều đến mức họ không chú ý đến bất cứ điều gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to make something smaller become part of something larger
examples: The country simply cannot absorb this influx of refugees.
The surrounding small towns have been absorbed into the city.
These committees were gradually absorbed into the local government machine.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó nhỏ hơn trở thành một phần của cái gì đó lớn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to use up a large supply of something, especially money or time
examples: The new proposals would absorb $80 billion of the federal budget.
My work absorbs a great deal of my time.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng hết một lượng lớn thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là tiền bạc hoặc thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to deal with changes, effects, costs, etc.
examples: The company is unable to absorb such huge losses.
definitions.definition_vi: để đối phó với những thay đổi, tác động, chi phí, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a large quantity that is more than enough
examples: The brochure promised beautiful walks with an abundance of wildlife.
The country has an abundance of natural resources.
We were amazed by the sheer abundance of food.
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn là quá đủ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: in large quantities
examples: Fruit and vegetables grew in abundance on the island.
Exotic plants grew there in great abundance.
definitions.definition_vi: với số lượng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities
examples: high/low academic standards
She had a brilliant academic career.
one of this country's most prestigious academic institutions
improving the academic achievement of all students
The university is renowned throughout the world for its academic excellence.
academic research/researchers
We are deeply committed to safeguarding academic freedom.
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với giáo dục, đặc biệt là học tập ở các trường phổ thông và đại học

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: involving a lot of reading and studying rather than practical or technical skills
examples: a mixture of vocational and academic courses
people whose skills are practical rather than academic
academic qualifications/subjects
definitions.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc đọc và nghiên cứu nhiều hơn là các kỹ năng thực tế hoặc kỹ thuật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: good at subjects involving a lot of reading and studying
examples: She wasn't very academic and hated school.
definitions.definition_vi: giỏi các môn liên quan đến việc đọc và học nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not connected to a real or practical situation and therefore not important
examples: It's a purely academic question.
The whole thing's academic now—we can't win anyway.
Most of his questions were of an academic nature.
definitions.definition_vi: không kết nối với một tình huống thực tế hoặc thực tế và do đó không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a way of pronouncing the words of a language that shows which country, area or social class a person comes from; how well somebody pronounces a particular language
examples: COMPARE dialect
a northern/Dublin/Scottish accent
a strong/broad accent (= one that is easy to notice)
She spoke English with an accent.
The Americans had learned Korean and spoke with a good accent.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách phát âm các từ của một ngôn ngữ cho biết một người đến từ quốc gia, khu vực hoặc tầng lớp xã hội nào; ai đó phát âm một ngôn ngữ cụ thể tốt như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the emphasis that you should give to part of a word when saying it
examples: SYNONYM stress
In ‘today’ the accent is on the second syllable.
definitions.definition_vi: sự nhấn mạnh mà bạn nên dành cho một phần của từ khi nói nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a mark on a letter to show that it should be pronounced in a particular way
examples: SEE ALSO acute accent
Canapé has an accent on the ‘e’.
definitions.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu trên một chữ cái để cho thấy rằng nó nên được phát âm theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a special importance that is given to something
examples: SYNONYM emphasis
In all our products the accent is on quality.
definitions.definition_vi: một tầm quan trọng đặc biệt được trao cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.
examples: OPPOSITE refuse1
He asked me to marry him and I accepted.
Please accept our sincere apologies.
It was pouring with rain so I accepted his offer of a lift.
I am unfortunately unable to accept your kind invitation.
The board of directors accepted our proposal.
She's decided not to accept the job.
Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
He is charged with accepting bribes from a firm of suppliers.
She said she'd accept $15 for it.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng nhận một cái gì đó được cung cấp; để nói 'có' với một lời đề nghị, lời mời, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to agree to or approve of something
examples: OPPOSITE reject
They accepted the court's decision.
The judge refused to accept his evidence.
He accepted all the changes we proposed.
Are you willing to accept the challenge?
She won't accept advice from anyone.
My article has been accepted for publication.
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý hoặc chấp thuận một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to take payment in a particular form
examples: This machine only accepts coins.
Credit cards are widely accepted.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận thanh toán dưới một hình thức cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to admit that you are responsible or to blame for something
examples: He accepts full responsibility for what happened.
You have to accept the consequences of your actions.
definitions.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng bạn phải chịu trách nhiệm hoặc đổ lỗi cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to continue in a difficult situation without complaining, because you realize that you cannot change it
examples: You just have to accept the fact that we're never going to be rich.
to be willing/prepared to accept something
Nothing will change as long as the workers continue to accept these appalling conditions.
They accept the risks as part of the job.
He just refused to accept that his father was no longer there.
definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục trong một tình huống khó khăn mà không phàn nàn, bởi vì bạn nhận ra rằng bạn không thể thay đổi nó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to make somebody feel welcome and part of a group
examples: OPPOSITE reject
It may take years to be completely accepted by the local community.
She had never been accepted into what was essentially a man's world.
He never really accepted her as his own child.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy được chào đón và là một phần của một nhóm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to believe that something is true
examples: I don't accept his version of events.
Can we accept his account as the true version?
I accept that this will not be popular.
I am not prepared to accept that this decision is final.
It is generally accepted that people are motivated by success.
Their workforce is widely accepted to have the best conditions in Europe.
definitions.definition_vi: để tin rằng điều gì đó là sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to allow somebody to join an organization, attend an institution, use a service, etc.
examples: OPPOSITE reject
The college he applied to has accepted him.
She was disappointed not to be accepted into the club.
The landlord was willing to accept us as tenants.
She was accepted to study music.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó tham gia một tổ chức, tham dự một tổ chức, sử dụng một dịch vụ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: agreed or approved of by most people in a society
examples: Children must learn socially acceptable behaviour.
It is perfectly acceptable for you as an employee to say no.
definitions.definition_vi: được hầu hết mọi người trong xã hội đồng ý hoặc chấp thuận

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: that somebody agrees is of a good enough standard or allowed
examples: For this course a pass in English at grade B is acceptable.
Air pollution in the city had reached four times the acceptable levels.
We want a political solution that is acceptable to all parties.
It is possible to find a solution that is acceptable to both sides.
definitions.definition_vi: mà ai đó đồng ý là có tiêu chuẩn đủ tốt hoặc được phép

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: not very good but good enough
examples: OPPOSITE unacceptable
The food was acceptable, but no more.
Inspectors found that teaching standards were acceptable, but could be improved.
definitions.definition_vi: không tốt lắm nhưng đủ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage
examples: a car/road/traffic accident
He was killed in an accident.
One in seven accidents is caused by sleepy drivers.
The accident happened at 3 p.m.
to have an accident
a serious/minor accident
a fatal accident (= in which somebody is killed)
Every year in the United Kingdom more than 4 000 people die in accidents in the home.
a climbing/riding accident
Take out accident insurance before you go on your trip.
I didn't mean to break it—it was an accident.
Their boat sank in a freak accident.
His son died in a tragic cycling accident.
There are a number of accident blackspots (= places where lots of accidents happen) on that road.
We don't know the cause of the accident.
He was badly injured in a motorcycle accident.
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện khó chịu, đặc biệt là trong xe, xảy ra bất ngờ và gây thương tích hoặc hư hỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that happens unexpectedly and is not planned in advance
examples: Their early arrival was just an accident.
It is no accident that men fill most of the top jobs in nursing.
an accident of birth/fate/history (= describing facts and events that are due to chance or circumstances)
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó xảy ra bất ngờ và không được lên kế hoạch trước

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave
examples: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.
definitions.definition_vi: một vật hoặc một người rất có khả năng gây nguy hiểm hoặc một vấn đề trong tương lai vì tình trạng hiện tại hoặc cách họ cư xử

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: people say accidents will happen to tell somebody who has had an accident, for example breaking something, that it does not matter and they should not worry
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người nói tai nạn sẽ xảy ra để nói với ai đó đã gặp tai nạn, chẳng hạn như làm vỡ cái gì đó, rằng điều đó không quan trọng và họ không nên lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in a way that is not planned or organized
examples: OPPOSITE deliberately
We met by accident at the airport.
Helen got into acting purely by accident.
It happened, whether by accident or design, that Steve and I were the last two people to leave.
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách không có kế hoạch hoặc tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a series of unpleasant events caused by bad luck
examples: The whole affair has been a chapter of accidents from start to finish.
definitions.definition_vi: một loạt các sự kiện khó chịu gây ra bởi sự xui xẻo

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: by chance; in a way that was not planned
examples: As I turned around, I accidentally hit him in the face.
The damage couldn't have been caused accidentally.
definitions.definition_vi: tình cờ; theo cách không được lên kế hoạch

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit
examples: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
The aircraft is capable of accommodating 28 passengers.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó một căn phòng hoặc nơi để ngủ, sống hoặc ngồi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to provide enough space for somebody/something
examples: The garage can accommodate three cars.
The old town hall now accommodates a Folk Museum.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp đủ không gian cho ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to consider something such as somebody’s opinion or a fact and be influenced by it when you are deciding what to do or explaining something
examples: Our proposal tries to accommodate the special needs of minority groups.
She modified her views so as to accommodate the objections of American feminists.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét điều gì đó chẳng hạn như ý kiến ​​của ai đó hoặc một sự thật và bị ảnh hưởng bởi nó khi bạn đang quyết định phải làm gì hoặc giải thích điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to help somebody by doing what they want
examples: SYNONYM oblige
I have accommodated the press a great deal, giving numerous interviews.
I’m sure the bank will be able to accommodate you.
definitions.definition_vi: giúp đỡ ai đó bằng cách làm những gì họ muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to change your behaviour so that you can deal with a new situation better
examples: I needed to accommodate to the new schedule.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hành vi của bạn để bạn có thể đối phó với một tình huống mới tốt hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO bank account
I don't have a bank account.
I paid the money into my savings account.
a joint account (= one in the name of more than one person)
With internet banking you can manage your account online.
Do you have an account with us?
He opened an account at a bank in Germany.
Interest will be paid monthly into the account holder's current account.
What's your account number please?
definitions.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp của ai đó với ngân hàng, v.v. để giữ tiền ở đó, rút ​​một ít ra, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an arrangement that somebody has with a company that allows them to use the internet, send and receive messages by email, social media, etc.
examples: an email/a Twitter account
Millions of accounts have been hacked.
definitions.definition_vi: một sự sắp xếp mà ai đó có với một công ty cho phép họ sử dụng internet, gửi và nhận tin nhắn qua email, phương tiện truyền thông xã hội, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a written or spoken description of something that has happened
examples: an eyewitness account (= a description given by somebody who saw what happened)
a first-hand/personal/first-person account
Can you give us an account of what happened?
The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.
definitions.definition_vi: một mô tả bằng văn bản hoặc nói về một cái gì đó đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an explanation or a description of an idea, a theory or a process
examples: the Biblical account of the creation of the world
definitions.definition_vi: một lời giải thích hoặc mô tả về một ý tưởng, một lý thuyết hoặc một quá trình

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a written record of money that is owed to a business and of money that has been paid by it
examples: SEE ALSO expense account
to do the accounts
to keep the accounts up to date
the accounts department
She works in Accounts (= the accounts department).
definitions.definition_vi: một bản ghi chép bằng văn bản về số tiền mà một doanh nghiệp nợ và số tiền mà doanh nghiệp đó đã trả

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: an arrangement with a shop or business to pay bills for goods or services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month
examples: SEE ALSO charge account
Put it on my account please.
We have accounts with most of our suppliers.
Log in to your account to see how much you have spent.
definitions.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận với một cửa hàng hoặc doanh nghiệp để thanh toán hóa đơn cho hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ sau đó, ví dụ như với số tiền đều đặn hàng tháng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a bill for goods or services provided over a period
examples: Departing guests should settle their accounts at the office.
It is best to settle the account each month.
definitions.definition_vi: hóa đơn cho hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ được cung cấp trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a regular customer
examples: The agency has lost several of its most important accounts.
definitions.definition_vi: một khách hàng thường xuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a description of an event that gives you all the details in the order in which they happen
examples: He insisted on giving us a blow-by-blow account of what had happened.
definitions.definition_vi: mô tả về một sự kiện cung cấp cho bạn tất cả các chi tiết theo thứ tự chúng xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: according to what other people say
examples: I've never been there, but it's a lovely place, by all accounts.
definitions.definition_vi: theo những gì người khác nói

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: according to what you say yourself
examples: By his own account he had an unhappy childhood.

definitions.definition_vi: một điều mà ai đó đã thực hiện thành công, đặc biệt là bằng cách sử dụng nỗ lực và kỹ năng của mình

definitions.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.definition_vi: phần thưởng mà bạn có thể kiếm được trong một số trò chơi điện tử bằng cách hoàn thành thử thách hoặc cấp độ

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: đạt được điều gì đó bằng nỗ lực, khả năng hoặc hành vi của chính bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2

Property acquired through crime will be confiscated.

How did the gallery come to acquire so many Picassos?
I've suddenly acquired a stepbrother.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được một cái gì đó bằng cách mua hoặc được cho nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a thing that you do not like much at first but gradually learn to like

definitions.definition_vi: thứ mà lúc đầu bạn không thích lắm nhưng dần dần bạn sẽ thích

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to do something for a particular purpose or in order to deal with a situation

By acting quickly doctors saved her life.
The government was criticized for failing to act decisively.
Initial reports indicated he acted alone.
He claims he acted in self-defence.
We acted in good faith (= believing that we were doing the right thing).
They are acting out of self-interest.
She was not acting for personal gain.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể hoặc để giải quyết một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to behave in a particular way
examples: The man was seen acting suspiciously.
I think that most employers act responsibly in these situations.
Decide what your priorities are and act accordingly (= in an appropriate way).
Stop acting like spoilt children!
She was acting as if she'd seen a ghost.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to perform a part in a play or film
examples: Have you ever acted?
He just can't act.
Most of the cast act well.
The play was well acted.
Who's acting the part of Hamlet?
She is acting the role of Juliet.
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện một phần trong một vở kịch hoặc bộ phim

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to pretend by your behaviour to be a particular type of person
examples: SEE ALSO play-act
He's been acting the devoted husband all day.
I decided to act dumb.
to act weird/strange/normal/stupid
He acts all macho, but he’s a real softie underneath.
definitions.definition_vi: giả vờ bằng hành vi của bạn là một loại người cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to perform a particular role or function
examples: She acted as an adviser to the committee.
Can you act as interpreter?
We hope this sentence will act as a deterrent to others.
Culture can act as a powerful catalyst for urban regeneration.
The council is only really acting as an agent.
hormones in the brain that act like natural painkillers
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện một vai trò hoặc chức năng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to have an effect on something
examples: Alcohol acts quickly on the brain.
It took a few minutes for the drug to act.
definitions.definition_vi: có tác dụng lên cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to behave in a stupid way in order to make people laugh, especially in a way that may also annoy them
examples: Quit playing the fool and get some work done!
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử một cách ngu ngốc để làm cho mọi người cười, đặc biệt là theo cách mà cũng có thể làm phiền họ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to behave in a way that is suitable for somebody of your age and not as though you were much younger
examples: Isn’t it time you started acting your age?
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách phù hợp với ai đó ở độ tuổi của bạn chứ không phải như thể bạn trẻ hơn nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do
examples: She was acting as if she owned the place.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử một cách rất tự tin làm phiền người khác, ví dụ bằng cách nói cho họ biết phải làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation

It's amazing how soon you adapt.
The organisms were forced to adapt in order to survive.
Some animals have a remarkable ability to adapt to changing environments.
A large organization can be slow to adapt to change
The company was able to adapt to the conditions and enhance its position.
We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
It took him a while to adapt himself to his new surroundings.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hành vi của bạn để giải quyết thành công hơn với một tình huống mới

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to change something in order to make it suitable for a new use or situation
examples: SYNONYM modify
These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.
The classroom has been specially adapted to take wheelchairs.
Most of these tools have been specially adapted for use by disabled people.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi cái gì đó để làm cho nó phù hợp với mục đích sử dụng hoặc tình huống mới

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to change a book or play so that it can be made into a play, film, television drama, etc.
examples: Three of her novels have been adapted for television.
The radio play had been adapted from a novel.
They have adapted her original novel beautifully.
It was adapted for the screen from his original play.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi một cuốn sách hoặc vở kịch để nó có thể được dựng thành một vở kịch, một bộ phim, một vở kịch truyền hình, v.v..

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: more than was first mentioned or is usual

additional resources/funds/security/funding/costs

He provided additional information about this incident.
definitions.definition_vi: nhiều hơn lần đầu tiên được đề cập hoặc như thường lệ

definitions.label: Meaning 1

Her work was much admired by critics.
You have to admire the way he handled the situation.
Actually, I greatly admire and respect him.
The school is widely admired for its excellent teaching.
I don't agree with her, but I admire her for sticking to her principles.
definitions.definition_vi: tôn trọng ai đó vì những gì họ đã làm hoặc tôn trọng phẩm chất của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to look at something and think that it is attractive and/or impressive

I've just been admiring your new car.
Let’s just sit and admire the view.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn vào cái gì đó và nghĩ rằng nó hấp dẫn và/hoặc ấn tượng

‘I'm very nervous,’ she admitted reluctantly.
Don't be afraid to admit to your mistakes.
She admits to being strict with her children.
He admitted all his mistakes.
She stubbornly refuses to admit the truth.

I hate to admit it, but I think he is right.
Admit it! You were terrified!
I'm almost ashamed to admit it, but I watch this show.

You must admit that it all sounds very strange.
She readily admits mistakes were made.
I couldn't admit to my parents that I was finding the course difficult.

The appointment is now generally admitted to have been a mistake.
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý, thường là miễn cưỡng, rằng điều gì đó là đúng

definitions.definition: to say that you have done something wrong or illegal

He refused to admit to the other charges.
She admitted to having stolen the car.
She admitted theft.
He refused to admit his guilt.
The hospital has admitted liability for the accident.
She admitted having driven the car without insurance.
definitions.definition_vi: để nói rằng bạn đã làm điều gì đó sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to allow somebody/something to enter a place
examples: Each ticket admits one adult.
You will not be admitted to the theatre after the performance has started.
The narrow windows admit little light into the room.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép ai/cái gì đó vào một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to allow somebody to become a member of a club, a school or an organization
examples: The society admits all US citizens over 21.
Women were only admitted into the club last year.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó trở thành thành viên của câu lạc bộ, trường học hoặc tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to take somebody to a hospital or other institution where they can receive special care
examples: Two crash victims were admitted to the local hospital.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa ai đó đến bệnh viện hoặc cơ quan khác nơi họ có thể được chăm sóc đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to accept that evidence is legally valid and can be presented in court
examples: Judge Neilson refused to admit the evidence because it had been illegally obtained.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận rằng bằng chứng đó có giá trị pháp lý và có thể được trình bày trước tòa

definitions.definition: progress or a development in a particular activity or area of understanding
examples: We live in an age of rapid technological advance.

recent advances in medical science
major advances in the field of physics
an advance on the existing techniques
an advance towards a better understanding of God
definitions.definition_vi: tiến bộ hoặc sự phát triển trong một hoạt động hoặc lĩnh vực hiểu biết cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the forward movement of a group of people, especially armed forces
examples: We feared that an advance on the capital would soon follow.
enemy advances
definitions.definition_vi: sự chuyển động về phía trước của một nhóm người, đặc biệt là lực lượng vũ trang

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: money paid for work before it has been done or money paid earlier than expected
examples: They offered an advance of £5 000 after the signing of the contract.
The bank will give you an advance of 95% of the purchase price.
She asked for an advance on her salary.
definitions.definition_vi: tiền được trả cho công việc trước khi nó được hoàn thành hoặc tiền được trả sớm hơn dự kiến

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: attempts to start a sexual relationship with somebody
examples: He had made advances to one of his students.

definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: an increase in the price or value of something
examples: Share prices showed significant advances.
definitions.definition_vi: sự gia tăng giá hoặc giá trị của một cái gì đó

The fee is payable in advance.

definitions.definition_vi: trước thời điểm dự kiến; trước khi điều gì đó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: more developed than somebody/something else
examples: Galileo's ideas were well in advance of the age in which he lived.
definitions.definition_vi: phát triển hơn ai/cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: events that are of public interest or political importance
examples: SEE ALSO current affairs
world/international affairs
an expert on foreign affairs (= political events in other countries)
We are expecting a statement from the home affairs (= political events in your own country) spokesman.
internal/external affairs
affairs of state
definitions.definition_vi: sự kiện được công chúng quan tâm hoặc có tầm quan trọng về mặt chính trị

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an event that people are talking about or describing in a particular way
examples: The newspapers exaggerated the whole affair wildly.
She wanted the celebration to be a simple family affair.
Many people have criticized the way the government handled the affair.
The Whitewater affair was the biggest scandal of the decade.
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện mà mọi người đang nói đến hoặc mô tả một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a sexual relationship between two people, usually when one or both of them are already in a relationship with somebody else
examples: SEE ALSO love affair

an extramarital affair

definitions.definition_vi: mối quan hệ tình dục giữa hai người, thường là khi một hoặc cả hai người đã có quan hệ tình dục với người khác

examples: She manages the family's financial affairs.

definitions.definition_vi: các vấn đề liên quan đến hoạt động kinh doanh tư nhân và tình hình tài chính của một người

definitions.definition: a thing that somebody is responsible for (and that other people should not be interested in)

definitions.definition_vi: một việc mà ai đó chịu trách nhiệm (và những người khác không nên quan tâm)

examples: Her hat was an amazing affair with feathers and a huge brim.
definitions.definition_vi: một đối tượng đó là bất thường hoặc khó mô tả

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a situation
examples: This state of affairs can no longer be ignored.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: later than something; following something in time
examples: We'll leave after lunch.

Not long after that he resigned.

definitions.definition_vi: muộn hơn cái gì đó; theo kịp cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: next to and following somebody/something in order or importance
examples: Your name comes after mine in the list.
He's the tallest, after Richard.
After you (= Please go first).
After you with the paper (= Can I have it next?).
definitions.definition_vi: bên cạnh và theo sau ai/cái gì theo thứ tự hoặc tầm quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: behind somebody when they have left; following somebody
examples: Shut the door after you.
I'm always having to clean up after the children (= clean the place after they have left it dirty and untidy).
He ran after her with the book.
She was left staring after him.
definitions.definition_vi: đằng sau ai đó khi họ đã rời đi; theo dõi ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: in contrast to something
examples: It was pleasantly cool in the house after the sticky heat outside.
definitions.definition_vi: trái ngược với cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: as a result of or because of something that has happened
examples: I'll never forgive him after what he said.
definitions.definition_vi: là kết quả của hoặc vì điều gì đó đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: despite something; although something has happened
examples: I can't believe she'd do that, not after all I've done for her.
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp điều gì đó; mặc dù có chuyện gì đó đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to show that something happens many times or continuously
examples: SEE ALSO one after another/the other

I've told you time after time not to do that.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó xảy ra nhiều lần hoặc liên tục

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: trying to find or catch somebody/something
examples: The police are after him.
He's after a job at our place.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng tìm hoặc bắt ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: about somebody/something
examples: She asked after you (= how you were).
definitions.definition_vi: về ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: in the style of somebody/something; following the example of somebody/something
examples: a painting after Goya
We named the baby ‘Ena’ after her grandmother.
definitions.definition_vi: theo phong cách của ai đó/cái gì đó; noi gương ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: happening or done later than the time or event mentioned
examples: after-hours drinking (= after closing time)
an after-school club
after-dinner mints
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc thực hiện muộn hơn thời gian hoặc sự kiện được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: despite what has been said or expected
examples: So you made it after all!
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp những gì đã được nói hoặc mong đợi

definitions.definition: used when you are explaining something, or giving a reason

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang giải thích điều gì đó hoặc đưa ra lý do

definitions.definition_vi: sẽ sớm làm điều gì đó; có ý định làm điều gì đó sớm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to change something slightly so that it is in the correct relationship to something else
examples: Domestic prices have been aligned with those in world markets.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi cái gì đó một chút để nó có mối quan hệ đúng đắn với cái gì đó khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to state something as a fact but without giving proof
examples: The prosecution alleges (that) she was driving carelessly.
It is alleged that he mistreated the prisoners.
He is alleged to have mistreated the prisoners.
This procedure should be followed in cases where dishonesty has been alleged.
definitions.definition_vi: tuyên bố điều gì đó như một sự thật nhưng không đưa ra bằng chứng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: expressed as though something is a fact but without giving any proof
examples: crimes allegedly committed during the war
definitions.definition_vi: được bày tỏ như thể điều gì đó là sự thật nhưng không đưa ra bất kỳ bằng chứng nào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to give something officially to somebody/something for a particular purpose
examples: A large sum has been allocated for buying new books for the library.
They intend to allocate more places to mature students this year.
More resources are being allocated to the project.
The project is being allocated more resources.
Millions have been allocated to improve students' performance.
definitions.definition_vi: trao cái gì đó một cách chính thức cho ai đó/cái gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an amount of money, space, etc. that is given to somebody for a particular purpose
examples: We have spent our entire allocation for the year.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền, không gian, vv được trao cho ai đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of giving something to somebody for a particular purpose
examples: the allocation of food to those who need it most
definitions.definition_vi: hành động đưa cái gì đó cho ai đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done
examples: PAST TENSE, PAST PARTICIPLE OF allow
His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
He allowed his mind to wander.
The law allowed companies to dismiss workers without any reason.
He is not allowed to stay out late.
Students are only allowed to use the equipment under supervision.
This research must be allowed to continue.
He refused to allow himself to be kept quiet.
She won't allow herself to be dictated to.
Eating is not allowed in the classrooms.
He received the maximum sentence allowed by law.
We do not allow eating in the classrooms.
definitions.definition_vi: để ai/cái gì làm gì đó; để cho một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to let somebody have something
examples: You're allowed an hour to complete the test.
I'm not allowed visitors.
I allow myself a treat now and then.
I sometimes allow myself the luxury of a cigar.
definitions.definition_vi: để ai đó có cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to let somebody/something go into, through, out of, etc. a place
examples: No dogs allowed (= you cannot bring them in).
The prisoners are allowed out of their cells for two hours a day.
They weren't allowed into the country.
He was knocking at the door waiting to be allowed in.
You won't be allowed up (= out of bed) for several days.
The crowd parted to allow her through.
definitions.definition_vi: để ai/cái gì đi vào, xuyên qua, ra khỏi, v.v. một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to make something possible
examples: A ramp allows easy access for wheelchairs.
The system allows people the opportunity to browse a wide selection of books.
The new technology allows users to choose exactly what they watch and when.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to make sure that you have enough of something for a particular purpose
examples: How much time would you allow for the trip?
You need to allow three metres of fabric for the dress.
definitions.definition_vi: để đảm bảo rằng bạn có đủ thứ gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to accept or admit something; to agree that something is true or correct
examples: COMPARE disallow
The judge allowed my claim.
(= in a court of law) ‘Objection!’ ‘I'll allow it.’
He refuses to allow that such a situation could arise.
She was very helpful when my mother was ill—I'll allow you that.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận hoặc thừa nhận một cái gì đó; đồng ý rằng cái gì đó là đúng hoặc đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to offer help politely
examples: ‘Allow me,’ he said, taking the tray from her.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đề nghị giúp đỡ một cách lịch sự

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely
examples: HOMOPHONES AT reign
The designer was given free rein.
The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.
definitions.definition_vi: trao cho ai đó quyền tự do hành động hoàn toàn; để cho phép một cảm giác được thể hiện một cách tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an amount of money that is given to somebody regularly or for a particular purpose
examples: SEE ALSO Attendance Allowance
an allowance of $20 a day
a clothing/living/travel allowance
Do you get an allowance for clothing?
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền được trao cho ai đó thường xuyên hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the amount of something that is allowed in a particular situation
examples: a baggage allowance of 20 kilos
Roman soldiers received a salt allowance, called salarium, the origin of the word salary.
The recommended daily allowance of vitamin C is 60–90 milligrams.
definitions.definition_vi: số lượng của một cái gì đó được phép trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a small amount of money that parents give their children, usually every week or every month
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền nhỏ mà cha mẹ cho con cái họ, thường là hàng tuần hoặc hàng tháng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an amount of money that can be earned or received before you start paying tax
examples: personal tax allowances
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền có thể kiếm được hoặc nhận được trước khi bạn bắt đầu nộp thuế

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to consider something, for example when you are making a decision or planning something
examples: The budget made allowance for inflation.
The plan makes no allowance for people working at different rates.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét điều gì đó, ví dụ khi bạn đang đưa ra quyết định hoặc lên kế hoạch cho điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to allow somebody to behave in a way that you would not usually accept, because of a problem or because there is a special reason
examples: You have to make allowances for him because he’s tired.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó cư xử theo cách mà bạn thường không chấp nhận, vì một vấn đề hoặc vì một lý do đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: without any other people
examples: Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
She did not want to be alone with him.
He was afraid of being alone with his thoughts.
He lives alone.
She was sitting all alone in the hall.
Finally the two of us were alone together.
I don't like going out alone at night.
definitions.definition_vi: không có người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: without the help of other people or things
examples: SEE ALSO stand-alone
It's hard bringing up children alone.
The assassin said he had acted alone.
definitions.definition_vi: không có sự giúp đỡ của người khác hoặc đồ vật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: lonely and unhappy or without any friends
examples: Carol felt all alone in the world.
I've been so alone since you went away.
definitions.definition_vi: cô đơn và bất hạnh hoặc không có bạn bè

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to show that the person or thing mentioned is the only one
examples: You can't blame anyone else; you alone made the decision.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một danh từ hoặc đại từ để chỉ ra rằng người hoặc vật được đề cập là duy nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to emphasize one particular thing
examples: The shoes alone cost £200.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng sau danh từ hoặc đại từ để nhấn mạnh một điều cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to do something without help from anyone
examples: Andrew decided to go it alone and start his own business.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của bất cứ ai

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to stop annoying somebody or trying to get their attention
examples: She's asked to be left alone but the press photographers follow her everywhere.
Don't touch me! Leave me alone!
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng làm phiền ai đó hoặc cố gắng thu hút sự chú ý của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to stop touching, changing, or moving something
examples: I've told you before—leave my things alone!
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng chạm vào, thay đổi hoặc di chuyển một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used after a statement to emphasize that because the first thing is not true or possible, the next thing cannot be true or possible either
examples: There isn't enough room for us, let alone any guests.
I didn’t have any clothes, let alone a passport.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một câu phát biểu để nhấn mạnh rằng vì điều đầu tiên không đúng hoặc không thể xảy ra nên điều tiếp theo cũng không thể đúng hoặc không thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be independent or not connected with other people, organizations or ideas
examples: These islands are too small to stand alone as independent states.
The problems that research is designed to solve do not stand alone, but are part of a wider context.
definitions.definition_vi: độc lập hoặc không kết nối với những người, tổ chức hoặc ý tưởng khác

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be not near other objects or buildings
examples: The arch once stood alone at the entrance to the castle.
definitions.definition_vi: không ở gần các đồ vật hoặc tòa nhà khác

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation
examples: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn sẽ phải đợi một thời gian để biết kết quả của một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in addition; too
examples: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.
rubella, also known as German measles
I didn't like it that much. Also, it was much too expensive.
Jake's father had also been a doctor (= both Jake and his father were doctors).
She was not only intelligent but also very musical.
He also recently said that he would be leaving at the end of the year.
I probably also have a copy of the list.
definitions.definition_vi: Ngoài ra; cũng vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used for introducing a statement that makes the main statement in a sentence seem surprising
examples: SYNONYM though
Although the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
Although small, the kitchen is well designed.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một tuyên bố làm cho tuyên bố chính trong câu có vẻ đáng ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to mean ‘but’ or ‘however’ when you are commenting on a statement
examples: I felt he was wrong, although I didn't say so at the time.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng với nghĩa là ‘nhưng’ hoặc ‘tuy nhiên’ khi bạn bình luận về một câu phát biểu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: (used to emphasize something) completely; in every way
examples: The train went slower and slower until it stopped altogether.
I don't altogether agree with you.
I am not altogether happy (= I am very unhappy) about the decision.
It was an altogether different situation.
I’m not altogether convinced, I’m afraid.
definitions.definition_vi: (dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó) hoàn toàn; bằng mọi cách

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to give a total number or amount
examples: You owe me £68 altogether.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một tổng số hoặc số tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to introduce a summary when you have mentioned a number of different things
examples: The food was good and we loved the music. Altogether it was a great evening.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một bản tóm tắt khi bạn đã đề cập đến một số điều khác nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: doing something for pleasure or interest, not as a job
examples: an amateur photographer
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó vì niềm vui hoặc sự quan tâm, không phải như một công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: done for pleasure, not as a job
examples: amateur athletics
definitions.definition_vi: làm vì niềm vui chứ không phải vì công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: not done or made well or with skill
examples: The performance sounded very amateur, I’m afraid.
definitions.definition_vi: không được thực hiện hoặc làm tốt hoặc có kỹ năng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an official who lives in a foreign country as the senior representative there of his or her own country
examples: the British Ambassador to Italy/in Rome
a former ambassador to the UN
definitions.definition_vi: một quan chức sống ở nước ngoài với tư cách là đại diện cấp cao của đất nước mình

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who represents or promotes a particular activity
examples: SEE ALSO brand ambassador
The best ambassadors for the sport are the players.
definitions.definition_vi: một người đại diện hoặc thúc đẩy một hoạt động cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small change or improvement that is made to a document or proposed new law; the process of changing a document or proposed new law
examples: to introduce/propose/table an amendment (= to suggest it)
Parliament passed the bill without further amendment.
She made several minor amendments to her essay.
definitions.definition_vi: một thay đổi hoặc cải tiến nhỏ được thực hiện đối với một tài liệu hoặc luật mới được đề xuất; quá trình thay đổi một tài liệu hoặc luật mới được đề xuất

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a statement of a change to the Constitution of the US
examples: SEE ALSO Eighteenth Amendment
The 19th Amendment gave women the right to vote.
definitions.definition_vi: tuyên bố về sự thay đổi Hiến pháp Hoa Kỳ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past
examples: OPPOSITE modern
Archaeologists are excavating the ruined temples of this ancient civilization.
ancient Greece/Egypt/Rome
the ancient city of Petra
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc về một thời kỳ lịch sử cách đây hàng nghìn năm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: very old; having existed for a very long time
examples: an ancient oak tree
ancient traditions/culture
the ancient Japanese art of origami
He's ancient—he must be at least fifty!
definitions.definition_vi: rất cũ; đã tồn tại trong một thời gian rất dài

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the people who lived in ancient times, especially the Egyptians, Greeks and RomansWord Origin
examples: late Middle English: from Old French ancien, based on Latin ante ‘before’.
definitions.definition_vi: những người sống ở thời cổ đại, đặc biệt là người Ai Cập, Hy Lạp và La MãNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a spirit who is believed to be a servant of God, and is sent by God to deliver a message or perform a task. Angels are often shown dressed in white, with wings.
examples: SEE ALSO guardian angel
definitions.definition_vi: một linh hồn được cho là tôi tớ của Chúa và được Chúa phái đến để đưa ra một thông điệp hoặc thực hiện một nhiệm vụ. Các thiên thần thường xuất hiện trong trang phục màu trắng, có cánh.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who is very good and kind; a child who behaves well
examples: John is no angel, believe me (= he does not behave well).
Mary’s children are little angels.
I could hardly see Lisa in the role of ministering angel.
definitions.definition_vi: một người rất tốt và tốt bụng; một đứa trẻ cư xử tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used when you are talking to somebody and you are grateful to them
examples: Thanks Dad, you're an angel.
Be an angel and make me a cup of coffee.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nói chuyện với ai đó và bạn biết ơn họ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person who supports a business by investing money in it, especially somebody who supports a new small business with their own money
examples: When will the angels get their money back?
They started the business with the help of $2 million supplied by angel investors.
definitions.definition_vi: người hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp bằng cách đầu tư tiền vào đó, đặc biệt là người hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp nhỏ mới bằng tiền của chính họ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doingWord Origin
examples: Old English engel, ultimately via ecclesiastical Latin from Greek angelos ‘messenger’; superseded in Middle English by forms from Old French angele.
definitions.definition_vi: những người có ít kinh nghiệm cố gắng làm những việc khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm mà những người có kinh nghiệm hơn sẽ không cân nhắc làmWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the strong feeling that you have when something has happened that you think is bad and unfair
examples: She had to find a way to express her pent-up anger.
The plan provoked anger among local residents.
the growing anger and frustration of young unemployed people
Jan slammed her fist on the desk in anger.
He was filled with anger at the way he had been treated.
There is much anger over plans to close the hospital.
Local people are seething with anger about the decision.
There is widespread anger at the government following yesterday's announcement.
I feel no anger towards him, only pity.
The people are taking to the streets to vent their anger against the prime minister.
a course in anger management (= controlling your feelings of anger)
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác mạnh mẽ mà bạn có khi có điều gì đó xảy ra mà bạn cho là tồi tệ và không công bằng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: slightly angry
examples: SYNONYM irritated
He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.
I was a little annoyed about the whole thing.
I was a bit annoyed with him.
I was annoyed with myself for giving in so easily.
I bet she was annoyed at having to write it out again.
I was annoyed that they hadn't turned up.
He was annoyed to find himself going red.
definitions.definition_vi: hơi tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: making somebody feel slightly angry
examples: SYNONYM irritating
This interruption is very annoying.
Her most annoying habit was eating with her mouth open.
It's incredibly annoying, but that's life.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hơi tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: once a year
examples: The exhibition is held annually.
definitions.definition_vi: mỗi năm một lần

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: one more; an extra thing or person
examples: COMPARE other
Would you like another drink?
‘Finished?’ ‘No, I've got another three questions to do.’
We've still got another (= a further) forty miles to go.
‘It's a bill.’ ‘Oh no, not another!’
I got another of those calls yesterday.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái nữa; một điều hoặc một người bổ sung

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: different; a different person or thing
examples: Let's do it another time.
We can try that—but whether it'll work is another matter.
The room's too small. Let's see if they've got another one.
I don't like this room. I'm going to ask for another.
definitions.definition_vi: khác biệt; một người hoặc vật khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or thing of a very similar type
examples: She's going to be another Madonna (= as famous as her).
There'll never be another like him.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật thuộc loại rất giống nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used when you are referring to various types of a thing, without saying exactly what you mean
examples: We've all got problems of one kind or another.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang đề cập đến nhiều loại sự vật khác nhau mà không nói chính xác ý bạn là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: first one person or thing, and then another, and then another, up to any number or amount
examples: The bills kept coming in, one after another.
definitions.definition_vi: đầu tiên là một người hoặc vật, sau đó là người hoặc vật khác, sau đó là người hoặc vật khác, cho đến bất kỳ số lượng hoặc số lượng nào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: something that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation
examples: SEE ALSO rejoin2
I rang the bell, but there was no answer.
Can't you give me a definitive answer?
The short answer is no.
The simple answer is that we don't know.
a question and answer session
I can't easily give an answer to your question.
Have you had an answer to your letter?
She had no answer to the accusations.
As if in answer to our prayers, she offered to lend us £10 000.
You're not going to get an answer from me!
The report does not provide answers as to why the tragedy occurred.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó bạn nói, viết hoặc làm để phản ứng với một câu hỏi hoặc tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that you write or say in reply to a question in a test, an exam, an exercise, etc.; the correct reply to a question in a test, etc.
examples: the correct/right answer
Write your answers on the sheet provided.
Do you know the answer (= the right one) to question 12?
The answers are at the back of the book.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó mà bạn viết hoặc nói để trả lời một câu hỏi trong bài kiểm tra, bài kiểm tra, bài tập, v.v.; câu trả lời đúng cho một câu hỏi trong bài kiểm tra, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a solution to a problem
examples: There is no easy answer.
The answer is simple.
This could be the answer to all our problems.
There are more questions than answers on the issue of our ageing population.
This may not be the answer for everyone.
She has spent her life looking for answers.
The obvious answer would be to cancel the party.
