definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: any vehicle that can fly and carry goods or passengers
examples: SEE ALSO anti-aircraft
fighter/transport/military aircraft
The aircraft was flown by a young American pilot.
We operate a fleet of six aircraft.
The systems are built for jet aircraft.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ phương tiện nào có thể bay và chở hàng hóa hoặc hành khách

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a place where planes land and take off and that has buildings for passengers to wait in
examples: Gatwick Airport
She arrived at Sao Paulo international airport on Friday to begin her journey.
He landed at Heathrow airport this morning.
waiting in the airport lounge/terminal
Passengers were banned from taking hand luggage through airport security.
definitions.definition_vi: nơi máy bay hạ cánh và cất cánh và có các tòa nhà để hành khách chờ đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to describe novels that are popular and easy to read, often bought by people at airports
examples: an airport novel/thriller
airport fiction
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả những cuốn tiểu thuyết phổ biến và dễ đọc, thường được mọi người mua ở sân bay

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a loud noise or a signal that warns people of danger or of a problem
examples: SEE ALSO false alarm
She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).
I hammered on all the doors to raise the alarm.
By the time the alarm was raised the intruders had escaped.
definitions.definition_vi: một tiếng động lớn hoặc một tín hiệu cảnh báo mọi người về mối nguy hiểm hoặc một vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a device that warns people of a particular danger, or that a particular person is in danger
examples: SEE ALSO burglar alarm
a burglar/fire/smoke alarm
The cat set off the alarm (= made it start ringing).
A car alarm went off in the middle of the night (= started ringing).
Carry a personal alarm with you.
Install an alarm system and learn how to use it.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị cảnh báo mọi người về một mối nguy hiểm cụ thể, hoặc một người cụ thể đang gặp nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a ringing sound or a tune played by a clock or your phone after you have set it to play at a particular time to wake you up
examples: The alarm went off at 7 o'clock.
I set my alarm for 6.30.
definitions.definition_vi: tiếng chuông hoặc giai điệu do đồng hồ hoặc điện thoại của bạn phát ra sau khi bạn cài đặt nó phát vào một thời điểm cụ thể để đánh thức bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: fear and worry that somebody feels when something dangerous or unpleasant might happen
examples: What have you done?’ Ellie cried in alarm.
I felt a growing sense of alarm when he did not return that night.
The doctor said there was no cause for alarm.
definitions.definition_vi: sự sợ hãi và lo lắng của ai đó khi điều gì đó nguy hiểm hoặc khó chịu có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: if you say that alarm bells are ringing, you mean that people are starting to feel worried and to suspect that something is wrong
examples: The government’s proposal has set alarm bells ringing for people on low incomes.
definitions.definition_vi: Nếu bạn nói rằng chuông báo động đang reo lên, bạn có nghĩa là mọi người đang bắt đầu cảm thấy lo lắng và nghi ngờ có điều gì đó không ổn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a book in which you keep photographs, stamps, etc.
examples: a photo album
an online album (= a website where you can store and view photographs)
I keep the photographs in an album.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách trong đó bạn lưu giữ những bức ảnh, con tem, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a collection of pieces of music released as a single item, usually on the internet or on a CD
examples: COMPARE single
They recently released their debut album.
It's the singer's first solo album.
The band have recorded four studio albums.
an online album (= an album that you can listen to on the internet)
her favourite song/track on the album
an album cover
He performed tracks from his new album.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các bản nhạc được phát hành dưới dạng một bản duy nhất, thường là trên internet hoặc trên đĩa CD

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: arrangement in a straight line
examples: the alignment of the sun, moon and earth at a particular time
A bone in my spine was out of alignment.
The door needs to be in alignment with the frame before you start work on it.
definitions.definition_vi: sắp xếp theo đường thẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: political support given to one country or group by another
examples: Japan’s alignment with the West
definitions.definition_vi: hỗ trợ chính trị được trao cho một quốc gia hoặc nhóm bởi một quốc gia khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the whole number of
examples: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
Cars were coming from all directions (= every direction).
All the people you invited are coming.
All my plants have died.
All five men are hard workers.
definitions.definition_vi: toàn bộ số lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the whole amount of
examples: All wood tends to shrink.
You've had all the fun and I've had all the hard work.
All this mail must be answered.
He has lost all his money.
definitions.definition_vi: toàn bộ số tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used with singular nouns showing something has been happening for a whole period of time
examples: He's worked hard all year.
She was unemployed for all that time.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ số ít để chỉ điều gì đó đã xảy ra trong suốt một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the greatest possible
examples: In all honesty (= being as honest as I can), I can't agree.
definitions.definition_vi: lớn nhất có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: consisting or appearing to consist of one thing only
examples: The magazine was all advertisements.
She was all smiles (= smiling a lot).
definitions.definition_vi: bao gồm hoặc dường như chỉ bao gồm một điều

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: any whatever
examples: He denied all knowledge of the crime.
definitions.definition_vi: bất cứ điều gì

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: and other similar things
examples: I'm bored by history—dates and battles and all that stuff.
definitions.definition_vi: và những thứ tương tự khác

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: despite
examples: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
definitions.definition_vi: cho dù

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say that something is not important or of no interest or value to you/somebody
examples: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
You can do what you like, for all I care.
For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng hoặc không có giá trị hay sự quan tâm đối với bạn/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: not particularly good, well, etc.
examples: He doesn't sing all that well.
definitions.definition_vi: không đặc biệt tốt, à, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: not as much as has been suggested
examples: They're not as rich as all that.
We didn't play particularly well, but we didn't do as badly as all that.
definitions.definition_vi: không nhiều như đã được đề xuất

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to express anger
examples: I've locked myself out. Of all the stupid things to do!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used to express surprise because somebody/something seems the least likely person, example, etc.
examples: I didn't think you, of all people, would become a vegetarian.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên vì ai đó/thứ gì đó dường như ít có khả năng xảy ra nhất, ví dụ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: in or from all directions; everywhere
examples: We realized we were surrounded on all sides.
Disaster threatens on every side.
She was bombarded with questions from all sides.
definitions.definition_vi: trong hoặc từ mọi hướng; ở khắp mọi nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a country that has agreed to help and support another country, especially in case of a war
examples: our European/NATO allies
a loyal ally of the United States
Portugal is a traditional ally of England.
definitions.definition_vi: một quốc gia đã đồng ý giúp đỡ và hỗ trợ một quốc gia khác, đặc biệt là trong trường hợp có chiến tranh

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who helps and supports somebody who is in a difficult situation, especially a politician
examples: a close ally and friend of the prime minister
her most powerful political ally
His sister was his ally against their grandparents.
definitions.definition_vi: người giúp đỡ và hỗ trợ ai đó đang ở trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn, đặc biệt là một chính trị gia

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the group of countries including the UK and the US that fought together in the First and Second World Wars
examples: the Western Allies
definitions.definition_vi: nhóm các quốc gia bao gồm Anh và Mỹ đã cùng nhau chiến đấu trong Thế chiến thứ nhất và thứ hai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not quite
examples: SYNONYM nearly
I like almost all of them.
They'll eat almost anything.
Almost no one (= hardly anyone) believed him.
The castle is almost entirely surrounded by water.
It's a mistake they almost always make.
The painting is almost certainly a forgery.
Her handwriting is almost impossible to read.
The team faces almost certain defeat in today's match.
The workforce has almost doubled in the past ten years.
I almost forgot your birthday.
Housing has become almost as big a problem as education.
The story seems almost too strange to be true.
definitions.definition_vi: không hẳn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to become different; to make somebody/something different
examples: Prices did not alter significantly during 2019.
He had altered so much I scarcely recognized him.
His actions that day altered my perception of him.
The landscape has been radically altered by changes in the climate.
He has the power to fundamentally alter the course of history.
She didn't alter her behaviour in any way.
Nothing can alter the fact that we are to blame.
The recipe has been altered to suit American tastes.
Fame hasn't really altered her.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên khác biệt; làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó khác đi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make changes to a piece of clothing so that it will fit you better
examples: We can have the dress altered to fit you.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi một bộ quần áo để nó phù hợp với bạn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a thing that you can choose to do or have out of two or more possibilities
examples: The car is too expensive so we're trying to find a cheaper alternative.
There is a vegetarian alternative on the menu every day.
We had no alternative but to fire Gibson.
to offer/provide an alternative
Does this offer a viable alternative to the existing system?
Fruit juice is provided as an alternative to alcoholic drinks.
This treatment is the only alternative for some patients.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều mà bạn có thể chọn làm hoặc có trong số hai hoặc nhiều khả năng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at all times; on every occasion
examples: There's almost always somebody at home in the evenings.
Always lock your car.
She always arrives at 7.30.
The children always seem to be hungry.
Success seems always to be out of reach.
Your ideas are always welcome.
It's not always easy to do the right thing.
We're not always this busy!
definitions.definition_vi: mọi lúc; vào mọi dịp

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: for a long time; since you can remember
examples: Pat has always loved gardening.
This is the way we've always done it.
This painting is very good—Ellie always was very good at art (= so it is not very surprising).
Did you always want to be an actor?
definitions.definition_vi: trong một thời gian dài; vì bạn có thể nhớ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: for all future time
examples: I'll always love you.
definitions.definition_vi: cho tất cả thời gian trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: if you say a person is always doing something, or something is always happening, you mean that they do it, or it happens, very often, and that this is annoying
examples: She's always criticizing me.
That phone's always ringing.
Why are you always complaining about my cooking?
definitions.definition_vi: Nếu bạn nói một người luôn làm điều gì đó, hoặc điều gì đó luôn xảy ra, bạn có nghĩa là họ làm việc đó hoặc việc đó xảy ra rất thường xuyên và điều này thật khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to suggest a possible course of action
examples: If it doesn't fit, you can always take it back.
If he can't help, there's always John.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề xuất một quá trình hành động có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: as usually happens or is expected
examples: SYNONYM as usual
As always, Polly was late for school.
definitions.definition_vi: như thường xảy ra hoặc được mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody cannot change
examples: Once an actor, always an actor.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng ai đó không thể thay đổi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: something that you want to do or achieve very much
examples: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.
His burning ambition was to study medicine.
political/artistic/career ambitions
At last he had realized his life's ambition.
He had only one ambition in life.
the country's nuclear ambitions (= plans to develop nuclear weapons)
She never achieved her ambition of becoming a famous writer.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mà bạn muốn làm hoặc đạt được rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the desire or strength of mind to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
examples: She was driven by personal ambition.
She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of ambition.
definitions.definition_vi: mong muốn hoặc sức mạnh của tâm trí để thành công, giàu có, quyền lực, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
examples: a fiercely ambitious young manager
They were very ambitious for their children (= they wanted them to be successful).
definitions.definition_vi: quyết tâm thành công, giàu có, quyền lực, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed
examples: the government’s ambitious plans for social reform
Jogging every morning? That’s very ambitious, isn’t it?
Several interns will be working on three ambitious new projects.
definitions.definition_vi: cần rất nhiều nỗ lực, tiền bạc hoặc thời gian để thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a quantity of something
examples: I was amazed at the amount he could eat.
Mix the colours in equal amounts.
an amount of money/information/work/time
A certain amount of time has already been spent on the project.
The server is designed to store huge amounts of data.
Try to reduce the amount of energy and water you use at home.
Faculty should increase the amount and quality of feedback they provide.
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sum of money
examples: Everyone has paid the same amount.
You will receive a bill for the full amount.
The insurance company will refund any amount due to you.
Small amounts will be paid in cash.
You must pay back the full amount that you owe.
definitions.definition_vi: một khoản tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a large quantity of something
examples: There's been any amount of research into the subject.
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used for saying that something will have no effect
examples: No amount of encouragement would make him jump into the pool.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một cái gì đó sẽ không có hiệu lực

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
examples: SYNONYM forebear
His ancestors had come to America from Ireland.
definitions.definition_vi: một người trong gia đình bạn đã sống cách đây rất lâu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an animal that lived in the past that a modern animal has developed from
examples: a reptile that was the common ancestor of lizards and turtles
definitions.definition_vi: một loài động vật sống trong quá khứ mà một loài động vật hiện đại đã phát triển từ đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an early form of a machine that later became more developed
examples: SYNONYM forerunner
The ancestor of the modern bicycle was called a penny-farthing.
definitions.definition_vi: một dạng máy ban đầu, sau này được phát triển hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: also; in addition to
examples: bread and butter
a table, two chairs and a desk
Sue and I left early.
Do it slowly and carefully.
Can he read and write?
I cooked lunch. And I made a cake. (= you are emphasizing how much you have done)
definitions.definition_vi: Mà còn; ngoài ra còn có

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: then; following this
examples: She came in and took her coat off.
definitions.definition_vi: sau đó; theo dõi cái này

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used before a verb instead of to, to show purpose
examples: Go and get me a pen please.
I'll come and see you soon.
We stopped and bought some bread.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trước động từ thay vì to, để thể hiện mục đích

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to introduce a comment or a question
examples: ‘We talked for hours.’ ‘And what did you decide?’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một nhận xét hoặc một câu hỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: as a result
examples: Miss another class and you'll fail.
definitions.definition_vi: kết quả là

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: added to
examples: SYNONYM plus1
5 and 5 makes 10.
What's 47 and 16?
definitions.definition_vi: thêm vào

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used between repeated words to show that something is repeated or continuing
examples: He tried and tried but without success.
The pain got worse and worse.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng giữa các từ lặp đi lặp lại để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó được lặp đi lặp lại hoặc tiếp tục

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used between repeated words to show that there are important differences between things or people of the same kind
examples: I like city life but there are cities and cities.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng giữa các từ lặp đi lặp lại để chỉ ra rằng có những khác biệt quan trọng giữa sự vật hoặc con người cùng loại

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the joint connecting the foot to the leg; the narrow part of the leg just above the ankle joint
examples: to sprain/break/twist your ankle
She suffered a serious ankle injury in training.
to have a broken/twisted/fractured/sprained ankle
ankle boots (= that cover the ankle)
We found ourselves ankle-deep in water (= the water came up to our ankles).
My ankles have swollen.
The injury required surgery on his right ankle.
He will wear an electronic ankle bracelet, which allows police to track him.
definitions.definition_vi: khớp nối bàn chân với cẳng chân; phần hẹp của chân ngay phía trên khớp mắt cá chân

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: happening or done once every year
examples: an annual meeting/event/report/conference
The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.
Funding will be awarded on an annual basis.
She organized this year's annual Christmas dinner dance.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc thực hiện mỗi năm một lần

definitions.definition: used instead of somebody in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
examples: Is there anybody who can help me?
Anybody can use the pool—you don't need to be a member.
She wasn't anybody before she got that job.
definitions.definition_vi: được dùng thay cho someone trong câu phủ định và trong câu hỏi sau if/whether và sau các động từ như ngăn chặn, cấm, tránh, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: any person at all; it does not matter who
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ người nào cả; không quan trọng là ai

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an important person
definitions.definition_vi: một người quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
examples: I can't see it anywhere.
Did you go anywhere interesting?
Many of these animals are not found anywhere else.
He's never been anywhere outside Britain.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trong câu phủ định và câu hỏi thay vì ở đâu đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: in, at or to any place, when it does not matter where
examples: Put the box down anywhere.
An accident can happen anywhere.
I could go anywhere in the world.
definitions.definition_vi: ở, tại hoặc tới bất kỳ nơi nào, khi việc ở đâu không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to indicate a range
examples: They cost anywhere from £100 to £500.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một phạm vi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: far from; not at all
examples: The job doesn't pay anywhere near enough for me.
definitions.definition_vi: xa khỏi; không có gì

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: far from; not at all
examples: The job doesn't pay anywhere near enough for me.
Older cars are nowhere near as fuel-efficient as modern cars.
definitions.definition_vi: xa khỏi; không có gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a piece of software that you can download to a device such as a smartphone or tablet, for example to look up information or to play a game
examples: SEE ALSO in-app
You first need to install the app on your device.
to download/launch an app
to build/develop an app
Have you got the dictionary app on your phone?
Gaming today is all about mobile app downloads.
app developers
The app is available on/in the app store.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần mềm mà bạn có thể tải xuống thiết bị như điện thoại thông minh hoặc máy tính bảng, chẳng hạn như để tra cứu thông tin hoặc chơi trò chơi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a program designed to do a particular job; a piece of software
examples: SEE ALSO killer app
a database app
definitions.definition_vi: một chương trình được thiết kế để thực hiện một công việc cụ thể; một phần mềm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: according to what you have heard or read; according to the way something appears
examples: Apparently they are getting divorced soon.
I thought she had retired, but apparently she hasn't.
He paused, apparently lost in thought.
The government was apparently unaware of the magnitude of the crisis.
The security forces were apparently taken by surprise.
definitions.definition_vi: theo những gì bạn đã nghe hoặc đọc; theo cách một cái gì đó xuất hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a deeply felt request for money, help or information that is needed immediately, especially one made by a charity or by the police
examples: to launch a TV appeal for donations to the charity
He made an emotional appeal to voters.
Police are making a fresh appeal to the public for any information that may help them.
The police made an appeal to the public to remain calm.
There was a look of silent appeal on his face.
definitions.definition_vi: một yêu cầu sâu sắc về tiền bạc, sự giúp đỡ hoặc thông tin cần thiết ngay lập tức, đặc biệt là yêu cầu của tổ chức từ thiện hoặc cảnh sát

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a quality that makes somebody/something attractive or interesting
examples: SEE ALSO sex appeal
mass/wide/popular/broad/universal appeal
The Beatles have never really lost their appeal.
The prospect of living in a city holds little appeal for me.
definitions.definition_vi: một phẩm chất làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó hấp dẫn hoặc thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a formal request to a court or to somebody in authority for a judgement or a decision to be changed
examples: SEE ALSO court of appeal
to lodge an appeal
to file an appeal
an appeal court/judge
an appeals court/judge
They have launched appeals against their convictions.
an appeal against the 3-match ban
an appeal against a decision/sentence/order/ruling
The court dismissed his appeal against the refusal of his asylum claim.
The case was upheld on appeal.
The verdict was later overturned on appeal.
You have the right of appeal to the Constitutional Court.
definitions.definition_vi: một yêu cầu chính thức tới tòa án hoặc người có thẩm quyền về việc thay đổi bản án hoặc quyết định

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an indirect suggestion that any good, fair or reasonable person would act in a particular way
examples: I relied on an appeal to his finer feelings.
an appeal to reason
definitions.definition_vi: một gợi ý gián tiếp rằng bất kỳ người tốt, công bằng hoặc hợp lý nào sẽ hành động theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to start to be seen
examples: Three days later a rash appeared.
Symptoms usually start appearing within two to three days.
A cat suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
Smoke appeared on the horizon.
A bus appeared around the corner.
Posters for the gig appeared all over town.
New shoots are just appearing at the base of the plant.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu được nhìn thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to begin to exist or be known or used for the first time
examples: Scientists are unsure when the virus first appeared.
His work began to appear on the scene in the 1960s.
When did mammals appear on the earth?
This problem first appeared in the inner cities.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu tồn tại hoặc được biết đến hoặc sử dụng lần đầu tiên

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to give the impression of being or doing something
examples: SYNONYM seem
She didn't appear at all surprised at the news.
Everything appeared normal at first.
It now appears likely that the school will be closed down.
It appears unlikely that interest rates will fall further.
He appears a perfectly normal person.
The couple appeared to have nothing in common.
The video appears to show a car driving through the wall of a house.
She appeared to be in her late thirties.
They appeared not to know what was happening.
There appears to have been a mistake.
It appears that there has been a mistake.
It would appear that this was a major problem.
The sunset made it appear as if the sea was made of gold.
definitions.definition_vi: để tạo ấn tượng về việc đang hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be published or broadcast
examples: His new book will be appearing in the spring.
It was too late to prevent the story from appearing in the national newspapers.
These allegations appear in a forthcoming documentary.
definitions.definition_vi: được xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to take part in a film, play, television programme, etc.
examples: He has appeared in over 60 movies.
She regularly appears on TV.
She is currently appearing as Juliet at the Liverpool Playhouse.
definitions.definition_vi: tham gia vào một bộ phim, vở kịch, chương trình truyền hình, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to arrive at a place
examples: By ten o'clock Lee still hadn't appeared.
A man appeared at the door and asked to see her.
definitions.definition_vi: đến một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to be written or mentioned somewhere
examples: Your name will appear at the front of the book.
definitions.definition_vi: được viết hoặc đề cập ở đâu đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be present in court in order to give evidence or answer a charge
examples: A man will appear in court today charged with the murder.
She is expected to appear at Dumfries Sheriff Court on Monday.
She appeared on six charges of theft.
They will appear before magistrates tomorrow.
He has been asked to appear as a witness for the defence.
They had all appeared before the court several times.
definitions.definition_vi: có mặt tại tòa án để đưa ra bằng chứng hoặc trả lời một lời buộc tội

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to act as somebody’s lawyer in court
examples: COMPARE disappear
James Gilbert is the lawyer appearing for the defendant.
definitions.definition_vi: đóng vai trò là luật sư của ai đó tại tòa án

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be

She had never been greatly concerned about her appearance.
The dog was similar in general appearance to a spaniel.
He gave every appearance of (= seemed very much to be) enjoying himself.
Judging by appearances can be misleading.
To all appearances (= as far as people could tell) he was dead.
definitions.definition_vi: cách mà ai đó/cái gì đó nhìn bề ngoài; ai đó/cái gì đó dường như là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the fact of somebody/something arriving, especially when it is not expected
examples: The sudden appearance of a security guard caused them to drop the money and run.
I don't want to go to the party, but I suppose I'd better put in an appearance (= go there for a short time).
definitions.definition_vi: thực tế là ai đó/cái gì đó đang đến, đặc biệt là khi nó không được mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the moment at which something begins to exist or starts to be seen or used
examples: the early appearance of daffodils in spring
the appearance of organic vegetables in the supermarkets
definitions.definition_vi: thời điểm mà một cái gì đó bắt đầu tồn tại hoặc bắt đầu được nhìn thấy hoặc sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an act of appearing in public, especially as a performer, politician, etc., or in court
examples: The Dutch player will make his first appearance for Liverpool this Saturday.

the defendant’s appearance in court
a court appearance
his appearance before the committee/inquiry
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động xuất hiện trước công chúng, đặc biệt là với tư cách là một nghệ sĩ biểu diễn, chính trị gia, v.v., hoặc tại tòa án

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: an act of being published or broadcast
examples: the appearance of claims about the minister’s private life in the press
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động được xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

definitions.label: Meaning 6

examples: When she lost all her money she was determined to keep up appearances.
definitions.definition_vi: che giấu sự thật về một tình huống xấu và giả vờ rằng mọi thứ đang diễn ra tốt đẹp

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who makes a formal request for something (= applies for it), especially for a job, a place at a college or university, etc.
examples: There were over 500 applicants for the job.

definitions.definition_vi: một người đưa ra yêu cầu chính thức cho một cái gì đó (= áp dụng cho nó), đặc biệt là cho một công việc, một vị trí tại trường cao đẳng hoặc đại học, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work
examples: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
to book/make/keep an appointment
Do you have an appointment?

an appointment book
an appointment with my agent/doctor/specialist/consultant
an appointment for a blood test
She made an appointment for her son to see the doctor.
definitions.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp chính thức để gặp hoặc thăm ai đó vào một thời điểm cụ thể, đặc biệt vì lý do liên quan đến công việc của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of choosing a person for a job or position of responsibility; the fact of being chosen for a job, etc.
examples: They announced the appointments of key security officials.
the appointment of a new captain for the England team
her recent appointment to the post
his appointment as principal
appointments and dismissals
definitions.definition_vi: hành động lựa chọn một người cho một công việc hoặc vị trí trách nhiệm; thực tế là được chọn cho một công việc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a job or position of responsibility
examples: a permanent/first appointment
The department wished him success in his new appointment as sales manager.
I would like to congratulate you on your appointment.
definitions.definition_vi: một công việc hoặc vị trí trách nhiệm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person chosen for a job or position of responsibility
examples: Government ministers and other political appointments are frequently replaced.
definitions.definition_vi: một người được chọn cho một công việc hoặc vị trí trách nhiệm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task
examples: She took the wrong approach in her dealings with them.
It was time to take a different approach.
an alternative/innovative approach
a traditional/similar approach
The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.

a variety of approaches for the treatment of depression

definitions.label: Meaning 2

examples: She hadn't heard his approach and jumped as the door opened.

definitions.label: Meaning 3

examples: The club has made an approach to a local company for sponsorship.

definitions.label: Meaning 5

a new approach road to the port

definitions.definition_vi: một con đường, con đường, vv dẫn đến một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 6

examples: to begin the final approach to the runway

definitions.definition_vi: một phần của chuyến bay của máy bay ngay trước khi hạ cánh

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.definition_vi: một thứ giống như một cái gì đó khác được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances
examples: OPPOSITE inappropriate
an appropriate response/measure/method

Please debit my Mastercard/Visa/American Express card (delete as appropriate) (= cross out the options that do not apply).

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: dường như không dựa trên một lý do, hệ thống hoặc kế hoạch nào và đôi khi có vẻ không công bằng

She touched him gently on the arm.

He has a tattoo on his upper right arm.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai phần dài nhô ra từ đỉnh cơ thể và nối vai với tay

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: một phần của một mảnh quần áo che cánh tay

the research arm of the company

definitions.definition_vi: một bộ phận của một tổ chức lớn liên quan đến một hoạt động cụ thể

definitions.definition_vi: rất dài

definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn chào đón ai đó với vòng tay rộng mở, bạn sẽ vô cùng hạnh phúc và hài lòng khi gặp họ.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: involving the use of weapons
examples: OPPOSITE unarmed
an armed robbery
an international armed conflict (= a war)
Guerrillas have pledged to intensify the armed struggle against the new government.
definitions.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc sử dụng vũ khí

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: carrying a weapon, especially a gun
examples: OPPOSITE unarmed
The man is armed and dangerous.
armed guards/police
Police were heavily armed.
He was armed with a rifle.
He chased an armed robber away from his store.
definitions.definition_vi: mang theo vũ khí, đặc biệt là súng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: knowing something or carrying something that you need in order to help you to perform a task
examples: He was armed with all the facts.
I sat down by the lake armed with a pair of binoculars.
definitions.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó hoặc mang theo thứ gì đó mà bạn cần để giúp bạn thực hiện một nhiệm vụ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: having many weapons
definitions.definition_vi: có nhiều vũ khí

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: if the police arrest somebody, the person is taken to a police station and kept there because the police believe they may be guilty of a crime
examples: A man has been arrested in connection with the robbery.
A local man has since been arrested on suspicion of murder.
Police arrested three suspects.
He was arrested on corruption charges.
She was arrested and charged with arson.
She was arrested for drug-related offences.
You could get arrested for doing that.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu cảnh sát bắt giữ ai đó, người đó sẽ được đưa đến đồn cảnh sát và giữ ở đó vì cảnh sát tin rằng họ có thể phạm tội

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to stop a process or a development
examples: They failed to arrest the company's decline.
definitions.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn một quá trình hoặc một sự phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to make somebody notice something and pay attention to it
examples: An unusual noise arrested his attention.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó chú ý đến điều gì đó và chú ý đến nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: if somebody arrests, their heart stops beating
examples: He arrested on the way to the hospital.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu ai đó bắt giữ, tim họ sẽ ngừng đập

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey
examples: I'll wait until they arrive.
I was pleased to hear you arrived home safely.
to arrive early/late for a meeting
She'll arrive in New York at noon.
The train arrived at the station 20 minutes late.
We didn't arrive back at the hotel until very late.
By the time I arrived on the scene, it was all over.
Pupils may be newly arrived in Britain, with little or no English.
A police officer arrived just in time to see the burglars walking out of the building.
They arrived too late to take any action.
The police arrived to arrest him.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được đến một nơi, đặc biệt là ở phần cuối của một cuộc hành trình

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be brought to somebody
examples: A letter arrived for you this morning.
Send your application to arrive by 31 October.
We waited an hour for our lunch to arrive.
The new product will arrive on supermarket shelves (= be available) early next year.
definitions.definition_vi: được mang đến cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to happen or to come, especially when you have been waiting for it
examples: The wedding day finally arrived.
The baby arrived (= was born) early.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc sắp đến, đặc biệt là khi bạn đang chờ đợi nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: somebody has become successful
examples: He knew he had arrived when he was shortlisted for the Man Booker prize.
The lad has arrived as a Premiership goalkeeper.
definitions.definition_vi: ai đó đã trở nên thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a thin stick with a sharp point at one end, which is shot from a bow
examples: a bow and arrow
to fire/shoot an arrow
The road continues as straight as an arrow.
definitions.definition_vi: một cây gậy mỏng có một đầu nhọn được bắn ra từ một cây cung

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a mark or sign like an arrow (➞), used to show direction or position
examples: Follow the arrows.
Use the arrow keys to move the cursor.
definitions.definition_vi: dấu hiệu hoặc dấu hiệu như mũi tên (➞), dùng để chỉ hướng hoặc vị trí

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings
examples: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
a graphic artist
a make-up artist
He became a full-time artist in 1929.
In Paris she met a group of young artists: poets, film-makers and painters.
This is an artist's impression of the new stadium.
Whoever made this cake is a real artist.
definitions.definition_vi: người tạo ra tác phẩm nghệ thuật, đặc biệt là tranh vẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who is a professional singer, dancer, actor, etc.
examples: a recording/solo artist
Among the artistes appearing on our show tonight we have…
He was a true artiste: sensitive, dramatic and tragic.
definitions.definition_vi: một người là ca sĩ, vũ công, diễn viên chuyên nghiệp, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else
examples: They were all dressed as clowns.
The bomb was disguised as a package.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó có vẻ giống ai đó/cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to describe the fact that somebody/something has a particular job or function
examples: She works as a courier.
Treat me as a friend.
I respect him as a doctor.
You can use that glass as a vase.
The news came as a shock.
She had been there often as a child (= when she was a child).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả sự thật rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có một công việc hoặc chức năng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered
examples: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.
The exhibition will focus on various aspects of life and culture in the Middle East.
the most important aspect of the debate
She felt she had looked at the problem from every aspect.
This was one aspect of her character he hadn't seen before.
We have worked very hard on certain aspects of our game.
The consultancy gives advice to manufacturers on the health and safety aspects of their products.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể của một tình huống, một ý tưởng, một vấn đề, v.v.; một cách mà nó có thể được xem xét

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the appearance of a place, a situation or a person
examples: Events began to take on a more sinister aspect.
the dirty and seedy aspect of the bar
definitions.definition_vi: sự xuất hiện của một địa điểm, một tình huống hoặc một người

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the direction in which a building, window, piece of land, etc. faces; the side of a building that faces a particular direction
examples: SYNONYM orientation
Our room had a western aspect.
The southern aspect of the school was dominated by the mountain.
definitions.definition_vi: hướng mà một tòa nhà, cửa sổ, mảnh đất, v.v. hướng về phía đó; phía của một tòa nhà hướng về một hướng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the form of a verb that shows, for example, whether the action happens once or repeatedly, is completed or still continuing
examples: SEE ALSO perfect (7)
definitions.definition_vi: dạng của một động từ cho thấy, ví dụ, hành động xảy ra một lần hay lặp đi lặp lại, đã hoàn thành hay vẫn đang tiếp tục

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the crime of attacking somebody physically
examples: SEE ALSO indecent assault
Both men were charged with assault.
sexual assaults
A significant number of indecent assaults on women go unreported.
definitions.definition_vi: tội tấn công ai đó về mặt thể xác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of attacking a building, an area, etc. in order to take control of it
examples: SYNONYM attack
An assault on the capital was launched in the early hours of the morning.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động tấn công một tòa nhà, một khu vực, v.v. để chiếm quyền kiểm soát nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of trying to achieve something that is difficult or dangerous
examples: The government has mounted a new assault on unemployment.
a two-year legal assault on alleged tax fraud
Three people died during an assault on the mountain (= while trying to climb it).
definitions.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an act of criticizing somebody/something severely
examples: SYNONYM attack
The suggested closures came under assault from all parties.
The paper's assault on the president was totally unjustified.
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động chỉ trích ai/cái gì một cách gay gắt

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: an act that threatens to harm somebody physically, whether or not actual harm is doneWord Origin
examples: Middle English: from Old French asaut (noun), assauter (verb), based on Latin ad- ‘to’ + saltare, frequentative of salire ‘to leap’. Compare with assail.
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động đe dọa gây tổn hại về thể chất cho ai đó, cho dù có thực hiện tổn hại thực sự hay không. Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group
examples: All the students were asked to assemble in the main hall.
She then addressed the assembled company (= all the people there).
to assemble evidence/data
The manager has assembled a world-class team.
He tried to assemble his thoughts.
definitions.definition_vi: đến với nhau như một nhóm; để mang mọi người hoặc những thứ lại với nhau như một nhóm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to fit together all the separate parts of something, for example a piece of furniture
examples: OPPOSITE disassemble
The shelves are easy to assemble.
definitions.definition_vi: để phù hợp với nhau tất cả các bộ phận riêng biệt của một cái gì đó, ví dụ như một mảnh đồ nội thất

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country
examples: state/legislative/federal/local assemblies
Power has been handed over to provincial and regional assemblies.
The national assembly has voted to adopt the budget.
the California Assembly
the UN General Assembly
assembly elections
an elected assembly
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người được bầu để gặp nhau thường xuyên và đưa ra quyết định hoặc luật pháp cho một khu vực hoặc quốc gia cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the meeting together of a group of people for a particular purpose; a group of people who meet together for a particular purpose
examples: They were fighting for freedom of speech and freedom of assembly.
He was to address a public assembly on the issue.
an assembly point (= a place where people have been asked to meet)
definitions.definition_vi: cuộc gặp gỡ của một nhóm người vì một mục đích cụ thể; một nhóm người gặp nhau vì một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a meeting of the teachers and students in a school, usually at the start of the day, to give information, discuss school events or say prayers together
examples: The deputy head was taking (= leading) school assembly that day.
definitions.definition_vi: cuộc họp giữa giáo viên và học sinh trong trường, thường là vào đầu ngày, để cung cấp thông tin, thảo luận về các sự kiện của trường hoặc cùng nhau cầu nguyện

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the process of putting together the parts of something such as a vehicle or piece of furniture
examples: Putting the bookcase together should be a simple assembly job.
a car assembly plant
the correct assembly of the parts
definitions.definition_vi: quá trình lắp ráp các bộ phận của một cái gì đó như một chiếc xe hoặc một món đồ nội thất

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to state clearly and definitely that something is true
examples: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
The report asserts confidently that the industry will grow.
She continued to assert her innocence.
The German Chancellor was anxious to assert her government's commitment to European unity.
‘That is wrong,’ he asserted.
It is commonly asserted that older people prefer to receive care from family members.
definitions.definition_vi: để tuyên bố rõ ràng và chắc chắn rằng một cái gì đó là sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to behave in a confident and determined way so that other people pay attention to your opinions
examples: You’re too timid—you must try to assert yourself more.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử một cách tự tin và quyết đoán để người khác chú ý đến ý kiến ​​của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to make other people recognize your right or authority to do something, by behaving in a determined and confident way
examples: to assert your independence/rights
I was determined to assert my authority from the beginning.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho người khác nhận ra quyền hoặc thẩm quyền của bạn để làm điều gì đó, bằng cách cư xử một cách kiên quyết và tự tin

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to start to have an effect
examples: Good sense asserted itself.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu có tác dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something
examples: Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.
to assess a patient’s needs
It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.
Interviews allow you to assess the suitability of candidates.
She engaged a safety consultant to assess the risks.
Quality of life was assessed using a questionnaire.
The young men were assessed as either safe or unsafe drivers.
I'd assess your chances as low.
The committee assesses whether a building is worth preserving.
We are trying to assess how well the system works.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa ra phán xét về bản chất hoặc phẩm chất của ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to calculate the amount or value of something
examples: They have assessed the amount of compensation to be paid.
Damage to the building was assessed at £40 000.
definitions.definition_vi: để tính toán số lượng hoặc giá trị của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully
examples: SYNONYM evaluation
a detailed assessment of the risks involved
An adequate environmental impact assessment was not carried out on the bypass project.
We conducted the initial assessments defining the scope of work.
The city hired them to do a structural assessment of the damage.
his assessment of the situation
definitions.definition_vi: một ý kiến ​​hoặc một đánh giá về ai đó/điều gì đó đã được suy nghĩ rất kỹ lưỡng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of judging or forming an opinion about somebody/something
examples: Objective assessment of the severity of the problem was difficult.
Needs assessment is crucial if the hospital is to deliver effective healthcare.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động đánh giá hoặc hình thành quan điểm về ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the process of testing students and making a judgement about their knowledge, ability or progress
examples: SEE ALSO continuous assessment
written exams and other forms of assessment
definitions.definition_vi: quá trình kiểm tra học sinh và đưa ra đánh giá về kiến ​​thức, khả năng hoặc sự tiến bộ của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an amount that has been calculated and that must be paid
examples: a tax assessment
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền đã được tính toán và phải được thanh toán

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it
examples: It is reasonable to assume (that) the economy will continue to improve.
It's probably safe to assume (that) we'll be hearing more about this story.
Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.
She would, he assumed, be home at the usual time.
It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work.
Don't always assume the worst (= that something bad has happened).
In this example we have assumed a unit price of $10.
I had assumed him to be a Belgian.
definitions.definition_vi: nghĩ hoặc chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng nhưng không có bằng chứng về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take or begin to have power or responsibility
examples: Rebel forces have assumed control of the capital.
The court assumed responsibility for the girl's welfare.
Goodman will assume the role of president.
Lynch assumed office in April.
definitions.definition_vi: để mất hoặc bắt đầu có quyền lực hoặc trách nhiệm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to begin to have a particular quality or appearance
examples: SYNONYM take on
This matter has assumed considerable importance.
In the story the god assumes the form of an eagle.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu có một chất lượng hoặc diện mạo cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality
examples: SYNONYM put on
He assumed an air of concern.
He had assumed a stage Southern accent.
definitions.definition_vi: giả vờ có một cảm giác hoặc phẩm chất cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it
examples: SYNONYM guarantee
They called for assurances that the government is committed to its education policy.
Unemployment seems to be rising, despite repeated assurances to the contrary.
definitions.definition_vi: một tuyên bố rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, đặc biệt khi có nghi ngờ về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: belief in your own abilities or strengths
examples: SYNONYM confidence
There was an air of easy assurance about him.
It was good to see some of her old assurance coming back.
definitions.definition_vi: niềm tin vào khả năng hoặc sức mạnh của chính bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a type of insurance in which money is paid out when somebody dies or after an agreed period of time
examples: a life assurance company
We bought a life assurance policy.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại bảo hiểm trong đó tiền được trả khi ai đó chết hoặc sau một khoảng thời gian đã thỏa thuận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to say where something/somebody is or where something happens
examples: at the corner of the street
We changed at Crewe.
They arrived late at the airport.
At the roundabout take the third exit.
I'll be at home all morning.
She's at Tom's (= at Tom's house).
I met her at the hospital.
How many people were there at the concert?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói cái gì/ai đó ở đâu hoặc cái gì đó xảy ra ở đâu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say where somebody works or studies
examples: He's been at the bank longer than anyone else.
She's at Yale (= Yale University).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói nơi ai đó làm việc hoặc học tập

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to say when something happens
examples: We left at 2 o'clock.
at the end of the week
We woke at dawn.
I didn't know at the time of writing (= when I wrote).
At night you can see the stars.
What are you doing at the weekend?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói khi điều gì đó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to state the age at which somebody does something
examples: She got married at 25.
He left school at the age of 16.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ độ tuổi mà ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in the direction of or towards somebody/something
examples: What are you looking at?
He pointed a gun at her.
Somebody threw paint at the prime minister.
definitions.definition_vi: theo hướng hoặc hướng về ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used after a verb to show that somebody tries to do something, or partly does something, but does not succeed or complete it
examples: He clutched wildly at the rope as he fell.
She nibbled at a sandwich (= ate only small bits of it).
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một động từ để chỉ ra rằng ai đó cố gắng làm điều gì đó hoặc làm một phần điều gì đó nhưng không thành công hoặc hoàn thành nó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used with adjectives to show how well somebody does something
examples: I'm good at French.
She's hopeless at managing people.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với tính từ để chỉ ra ai đó làm việc gì đó tốt như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to show a rate, speed, etc.
examples: He was driving at 70 mph.
The noise came at two-minute intervals (= once every two minutes).
Prices start at $1 000.
The book retails at £19.95.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hiển thị tốc độ, tốc độ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to state the distance away from something
examples: I held it at arm's length.
Can you read a car number plate at fifty metres?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ khoảng cách từ một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used to show the situation somebody/something is in, what somebody is doing or what is happening
examples: The country is now at war.
I felt at a disadvantage.
I think Mr Harris is at lunch.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ tình huống của ai đó/cái gì đó, ai đó đang làm gì hoặc chuyện gì đang xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody/something is as good, bad, etc. as they can be
examples: This was Osaka at her best.
