definitions.definition_vi: một miếng kim loại hoặc nhựa nhỏ, có thiết kế hoặc dòng chữ trên đó, mà một người đeo hoặc mang theo để thể hiện rằng họ thuộc về một tổ chức, hỗ trợ điều gì đó, đã đạt được điều gì đó, có một cấp bậc cụ thể, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a piece of material that you sew onto clothes as part of a uniform
examples: the school badge
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh vật liệu mà bạn may vào quần áo như một phần của đồng phục

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a symbol of a particular quality or status
examples: His gun was a badge of power for him.
Her badge of office, a large gold key, hung around her neck.
He saw his injuries as a badge of honour.
definitions.definition_vi: một biểu tượng của một chất lượng hoặc trạng thái cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: money that somebody agrees to pay if a person accused of a crime does not appear at their trial. When bail has been arranged, the accused person is allowed to go free until the trial.
examples: Can anyone put up bail for you?
She was released on £2 000 bail.
Bail was set at $1 million.
The judge granted/refused bail.
He committed another offence while he was out on bail (= after bail had been agreed).
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền mà ai đó đồng ý trả nếu một người bị buộc tội không xuất hiện tại phiên tòa của họ. Khi đã thu xếp tại ngoại, bị cáo được phép tự do cho đến khi xét xử.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: either of the two small pieces of wood on top of each set of three wooden posts (called stumps)
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai miếng gỗ nhỏ phía trên mỗi bộ ba cột gỗ (gọi là gốc cây)

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to fail to appear at your trial after you have paid money to be allowed to go free until the trial
examples: He skipped bail and went on the run for two weeks.
definitions.definition_vi: không có mặt tại phiên tòa sau khi bạn đã trả tiền để được phép tự do cho đến phiên tòa

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a situation in which different things exist in equal, correct or good amounts
examples: SEE ALSO work-life balance
This newspaper maintains a good balance in its presentation of different opinions.
Tourists often disturb the delicate balance of nature on the island.
His wife's death disturbed the balance of his mind.
Try to keep a balance between work and relaxation.
It is important to keep the different aspects of your life in balance.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống trong đó những thứ khác nhau tồn tại với số lượng bằng nhau, chính xác hoặc tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the ability to keep steady with an equal amount of weight on each side of the body
examples: Athletes need a good sense of balance.
I struggled to keep my balance on my new skates.
She cycled round the corner, lost her balance and fell off.
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng giữ ổn định với trọng lượng bằng nhau ở mỗi bên cơ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the amount that is left after taking numbers or money away from a total
examples: to check your bank balance (= to find out how much money there is in your account)
Consider a balance transfer to a credit card with a lower rate of interest (= = moving the amount owed from one card to another).
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền còn lại sau khi lấy số hoặc tiền ra khỏi tổng số

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an amount of money still owed after some payment has been made
examples: The balance of $500 must be paid within 90 days.
I'll pay the balance later.
The final balance is due six weeks before departure.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền vẫn còn nợ sau khi đã thực hiện một số khoản thanh toán

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the largest part of a group or an amount; the position of advantage or attention
examples: The balance of opinion was that work was more important than leisure.
The balance has now shifted from the unions to employers.
definitions.definition_vi: phần lớn nhất của một nhóm hoặc một lượng; vị trí lợi thế hoặc sự chú ý

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: an instrument for weighing things, with a bar that is supported in the middle and has dishes hanging from each end
definitions.definition_vi: một dụng cụ để cân đồ vật, có một thanh đỡ ở giữa và có các đĩa treo ở mỗi đầu

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: (considering) the evidence on both sides of an argument, to find the most likely reason for or result of something
examples: The balance of evidence suggests the Liberal party's decline began before the First World War.
The coroner thought that on the balance of probabilities, the pilot had suffered a stroke just before the crash.
definitions.definition_vi: (xem xét) bằng chứng của cả hai phía của một lập luận, để tìm ra lý do hoặc kết quả có khả năng xảy ra nhất của điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: if the future of something/somebody, or the result of something is/hangs in the balance, it is not certain
examples: The long-term future of the space programme hangs in the balance.
Tom’s life hung in the balance for two weeks as he lay in a coma.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu tương lai của cái gì/ai đó, hoặc kết quả của cái gì đó bị/treo trong thế cân bằng thì điều đó không chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to make somebody unsteady and in danger of falling
examples: I was thrown off balance by the sudden gust of wind.
The sudden movement threw him off balance.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó không vững và có nguy cơ bị ngã

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to make somebody surprised and no longer calm
examples: The senator was clearly caught off balance by the unexpected question.
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó ngạc nhiên và không còn bình tĩnh nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: after considering all the information
examples: On balance, the company has had a successful year.
definitions.definition_vi: sau khi xem xét tất cả các thông tin

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to make a situation equal or fair again
examples: For years poorer children have had to put up with a lower quality education, and now is the time to redress the balance.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một tình huống bình đẳng hoặc công bằng một lần nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to manage to find a way of being fair to two things that are opposed to each other; to find an acceptable position that is between two things
examples: We need to strike a balance between these conflicting interests.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng tìm ra cách công bằng cho hai điều đối lập nhau; để tìm một vị trí chấp nhận được đó là giữa hai điều

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to affect the result of something in one way rather than another
examples: In an interview, smart presentation can tip the balance in your favour.
New evidence tipped the balance against the prosecution.
definitions.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến kết quả của một cái gì đó theo cách này chứ không phải cách khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a style of dancing that tells a dramatic story with music but no talking or singing
examples: She wants to be a ballet dancer.
ballet shoes
definitions.definition_vi: một kiểu nhảy kể một câu chuyện đầy kịch tính bằng âm nhạc nhưng không nói chuyện hay ca hát

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a story or work of art performed by a group of ballet dancers
examples: ‘Swan Lake’ is one of the great classical ballets.
definitions.definition_vi: một câu chuyện hoặc tác phẩm nghệ thuật được thực hiện bởi một nhóm vũ công ba lê

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a group of dancers who work and perform ballet together
examples: members of the Royal Ballet
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm vũ công làm việc và biểu diễn múa ba lê cùng nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small bag made of very thin rubber that becomes larger and rounder when you fill it with air or gas. Balloons are brightly coloured and used as decorations or toys.
examples: COMPARE trial balloon
to blow up/burst/pop a balloon
My balloon has burst!
A thousand balloons were released to mark the event.
They tied the balloons to the back of the car.
helium balloons for the children's party
definitions.definition_vi: một túi nhỏ làm bằng cao su rất mỏng sẽ trở nên to hơn và tròn hơn khi bạn đổ đầy không khí hoặc ga vào. Bóng bay có màu sắc rực rỡ và được dùng làm đồ trang trí hoặc đồ chơi.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a large balloon made of strong material that is filled with hot air or gas to make it rise in the air, usually carrying a basket for passengers
examples: We went up in a balloon.
She crossed the Atlantic in a hot-air balloon.
definitions.definition_vi: một quả bóng lớn làm bằng vật liệu chắc chắn chứa đầy không khí nóng hoặc khí đốt để bay lên không trung, thường mang theo một chiếc giỏ cho hành khách

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be very unsuccessful; to not be accepted by people
examples: My suggestion went down like a lead balloon.
definitions.definition_vi: rất không thành công; không được mọi người chấp nhận

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: when the trouble that you are expecting begins
examples: We have to get out of here before the balloon goes up!
definitions.definition_vi: khi rắc rối mà bạn mong đợi bắt đầu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an act of coming or being brought to a place
examples: OPPOSITE departure (1)
We apologize for the late arrival of the train.
the arrival of the mail in the morning
Our estimated time of arrival is 7.15.
I need to check our arrival time.
Guests receive dinner on arrival at the hotel
She was declared dead on arrival at the hospital.
There are 120 arrivals and departures every day.
daily arrivals of refugees
They are eagerly awaiting the arrival of their new computer.
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động đến hoặc được đưa đến một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the part of an airport that you go through when you arrive on a plane
examples: COMPARE departures
I made my way through arrivals.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của sân bay mà bạn đi qua khi lên máy bay

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or thing that comes to a place
examples: The first arrivals at the concert got the best seats.
early/late/new arrivals
We're expecting a new arrival (= a baby) in the family soon.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật đến một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the time when a new technology or idea is introduced
examples: the arrival of pay TV
definitions.definition_vi: thời điểm một công nghệ hoặc ý tưởng mới được giới thiệu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: (of an accident victim or other patient) already dead when arriving at a hospital
examples: She was pronounced dead on arrival.
He didn’t even make it to hospital: DOA.
Many of the casualties were dead on arrival.
definitions.definition_vi: (của nạn nhân tai nạn hoặc bệnh nhân khác) đã chết khi đến bệnh viện

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: very unlikely to be successful; not working when it is delivered
examples: The bill was dead on arrival in the Senate.
The software was DOA.
definitions.definition_vi: rất khó có thể thành công; không hoạt động khi nó được giao

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture
examples: SEE ALSO clip art
modern/contemporary art
an art critic/historian/lover
Can we call television art?
stolen works of art
Her performance displayed great art.
American art
It's a very beautiful piece of art.
definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng trí tưởng tượng để thể hiện ý tưởng hoặc cảm xúc, đặc biệt là trong hội họa, vẽ hoặc điêu khắc

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: examples of objects such as paintings, drawings or sculptures
examples: an art gallery/exhibition
a collection of art and antiques
definitions.definition_vi: ví dụ về các đồ vật như tranh vẽ, bản vẽ hoặc tác phẩm điêu khắc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the skill of creating objects such as paintings and drawings, especially when you study it
examples: She's good at art and design.
He has a master's degree in fine art.
an art teacher/student/college/class
definitions.definition_vi: kỹ năng tạo ra các đồ vật như tranh vẽ, đặc biệt là khi bạn nghiên cứu nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: art, music, theatre, literature, etc. when you think of them as a group
examples: SEE ALSO performing arts
lottery funding for the arts
What is the relationship between the visual arts and music?
definitions.definition_vi: nghệ thuật, âm nhạc, sân khấu, văn học, v.v. khi bạn coi chúng như một nhóm

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a type of visual or performing art
examples: an exhibition of Peruvian arts and crafts
Dance is a very theatrical art.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại hình nghệ thuật thị giác hoặc biểu diễn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the subjects you can study at school or university that are not sciences, such as languages, history or literature
examples: COMPARE science
an arts degree
definitions.definition_vi: các môn học bạn có thể học ở trường phổ thông hoặc đại học không phải là khoa học, chẳng hạn như ngôn ngữ, lịch sử hoặc văn học

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: an ability or a skill that you can develop with training and practice
examples: a therapist trained in the art of healing
I've never mastered the art of making bread.
Letter-writing is a lost art nowadays.
Appearing confident at interviews is quite an art (= rather difficult).
definitions.definition_vi: một khả năng hoặc một kỹ năng mà bạn có thể phát triển với đào tạo và thực hành

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to learn to do something well and efficiently
examples: I spend so much time travelling that I've got packing down to a fine art.
definitions.definition_vi: học cách làm điều gì đó tốt và hiệu quả

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words
examples: She struggled to articulate her thoughts.
It is the school’s duty to articulate its practices to parents.
definitions.definition_vi: để bày tỏ hoặc giải thích những suy nghĩ hoặc cảm xúc của bạn một cách rõ ràng bằng lời nói

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to speak, pronounce or play something in a clear way
examples: He was too drunk to articulate properly.
Every note was carefully articulated.
She spoke slowly, articulating each word clearly.
definitions.definition_vi: nói, phát âm hoặc chơi cái gì đó một cách rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be related to something so that together the two parts form a whole
examples: These courses are designed to articulate with university degrees.
definitions.definition_vi: có liên quan đến một cái gì đó để hai phần cùng nhau tạo thành một tổng thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be joined to something else by a joint, so that movement is possible; to join something in this way
examples: bones that articulate with others
a robot with articulated limbs
definitions.definition_vi: được nối với vật khác bằng khớp, để có thể chuyển động được; tham gia một cái gì đó theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with art or artists
examples: the artistic works of the period
a work of great artistic merit
an artistic temperament (= behaviour thought to be typical of artists, musicians, etc.)
Love is a time-honoured subject of literary and artistic expression.
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với nghệ thuật hoặc nghệ sĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: showing a natural skill or pleasure in art, especially being able to paint or draw well
examples: artistic abilities/achievements/skills/talent
She comes from a very artistic family.
definitions.definition_vi: thể hiện một kỹ năng tự nhiên hoặc niềm vui trong nghệ thuật, đặc biệt là có thể vẽ hoặc vẽ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: done with skill and imagination; attractive or beautiful
examples: an artistic arrangement of dried flowers
The decor inside the house was very artistic.
definitions.definition_vi: được thực hiện bằng kỹ năng và trí tưởng tượng; hấp dẫn hay xinh đẹp

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
definitions.definition_vi: quyền tự do của các nghệ sĩ hoặc nhà văn trong việc thay đổi sự thật để làm cho một câu chuyện, bức tranh, v.v. trở nên thú vị hoặc đẹp đẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else
examples: They were all dressed as clowns.
The bomb was disguised as a package.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó có vẻ giống ai đó/cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to describe the fact that somebody/something has a particular job or function
examples: She works as a courier.
Treat me as a friend.
I respect him as a doctor.
You can use that glass as a vase.
The news came as a shock.
She had been there often as a child (= when she was a child).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả sự thật rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có một công việc hoặc chức năng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information
examples: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
He asked about her family.
Can I ask a question?
Did you ask the price?
You do what I tell you to, no questions asked.
There are three important questions to ask.
frequently asked questions
‘Where are you going?’ she asked.
‘Are you sure?’ he asked her.
She asked the students their names.
I often get asked that!
I had to ask myself some very difficult questions.
I'd like to ask you a few questions.
Why does everyone keep asking me that?
The interviewer asked me about my future plans.
When specifically asked about the report, she indicated she had not read it.
He asked where I lived.
I had to ask the teacher what to do next.
I was asked if/whether I could drive.
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó dưới dạng câu hỏi, để lấy thông tin

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to tell somebody that you would like them to do something or that you would like something to happen
examples: Anyone with information is asked to contact the police.
Parents with young children are asked to attend this meeting.
They were politely asked to leave the shop.
Eric asked me to marry him.
All the students were asked to complete a questionnaire.
I asked whether they could change my ticket.
She asked me if I would give her English lessons.
She asked that she be kept informed of developments.
She asked that she should be kept informed.
If you ask her nicely, she'll give you a hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn muốn họ làm điều gì đó hoặc bạn muốn điều gì đó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to say that you would like somebody to give you something
examples: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
I am writing to ask for some information about courses.
to ask for a job/a drink/an explanation
Did your friend ask for permission to use the image?
Why don't you ask his advice?
Why don't you ask him for his advice?
Can I ask a favour of you?
Can I ask you a favour?
definitions.definition_vi: để nói rằng bạn muốn ai đó cho bạn một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to request permission to do something
examples: I immediately asked to speak to a supervisor.
I asked to see the manager.
Did you ask to use the car?
I'll ask if it's all right to park here.
She asked her boss whether she could have the day off.
definitions.definition_vi: yêu cầu sự cho phép để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to invite somebody
examples: They've asked me to dinner.
Thank you so much for asking me.
I didn't ask them in (= to come into the house).
We must ask the neighbours round (= to our house).
She's asked him to come to the party.
definitions.definition_vi: mời ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to request a particular amount of money for something that you are selling
examples: He's asking £2 000 for the car.
How much were they asking for their house?
definitions.definition_vi: để yêu cầu một số tiền cụ thể cho một cái gì đó mà bạn đang bán

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to expect or demand something
examples: I know I'm asking a great deal.
You're asking too much of him.
I know it's asking a lot to expect them to win again.
definitions.definition_vi: mong đợi hoặc yêu cầu một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to deserve something bad that happens to you or that somebody does to you
examples: ‘You shouldn’t have said that to her.’ ‘Well, she asked for it!’
definitions.definition_vi: xứng đáng với điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra với bạn hoặc ai đó làm với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to behave in a way that is very likely to result in trouble
examples: He was asking for trouble when he insulted their country.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách rất có thể dẫn đến rắc rối

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: if you say don’t ask to somebody, you mean that you do not want to reply to their question, because it would be difficult to explain, embarrassing, etc.
examples: ‘And what did he do then?’ ‘Don’t ask!’
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói đừng hỏi ai đó, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không muốn trả lời câu hỏi của họ, bởi vì điều đó sẽ khó giải thích, gây bối rối, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: if you say don’t ask me, you mean that you do not know the answer to a question and are annoyed you have been asked
examples: ‘What will the meeting be about?’ ‘Don’t ask me.’
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói đừng hỏi tôi, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi và cảm thấy khó chịu vì đã bị hỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: if you can have something for the asking, it is very easy for you to get it if you ask for it
examples: The job is yours for the asking.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn có thể có được thứ gì đó để xin thì bạn sẽ rất dễ dàng có được nó nếu bạn yêu cầu

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: if you say I ask you, you are expressing shock, anger or a strong feeling of dislike about something/somebody
examples: He told me I had to work late on Friday night. I ask you!
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói tôi hỏi bạn, bạn đang thể hiện sự sốc, tức giận hoặc cảm giác không thích điều gì đó/ai đó

definitions.definition_vi: dùng sau động từ để nói rằng việc gì đó được thực hiện liên tục hoặc tốn nhiều công sức

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.definition_vi: cho đến khi biến mất hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.definition_vi: tại sân hoặc sân vận động của đối phương

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that you would like to be rid of somebody/something
examples: Away with all these rules and regulations!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn muốn loại bỏ ai/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to help somebody have a fresh, lively state of mind again

definitions.definition_vi: giúp ai đó có lại tinh thần sảng khoái, sảng khoái

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to dance for the whole evening or night
definitions.definition_vi: khiêu vũ suốt buổi tối hoặc cả đêm

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: by a very great amount

definitions.definition_vi: với số lượng rất lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: immediately; without delay

I told him right off what I thought of him.
definitions.definition_vi: ngay lập tức; không chậm trễ

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: immediately; without delay
examples: SYNONYM at once
I'll do it straight away.
definitions.definition_vi: ngay lập tức; không chậm trễ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: very bad or unpleasant

to look/feel awful (= to look/feel ill)

The awful thing is, it was my fault.

It's awful, isn't it?
The weather last summer was awful.
definitions.definition_vi: rất tệ hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: that shocks people very much

the awful horrors of war
It was only later that we learned the awful truth.
definitions.definition_vi: điều đó khiến mọi người rất sốc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something, especially that there is a large amount or too much of something

There's not an awful lot of room.
I feel an awful lot better than I did yesterday.
I had an awful job persuading him to come (= it was very difficult).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó, đặc biệt là có một lượng lớn hoặc quá nhiều thứ gì đó

He kicked the ball straight into the back of the net.
The man was refusing to go to the back of the queue.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the part of a piece of paper, etc. that is on the opposite side to the one that has information or the most important information on it
examples: Take a card and write your name on the back.
He scribbled some figures on the back of an envelope.
definitions.definition_vi: phần của một tờ giấy, v.v... nằm ở phía đối diện với phần có thông tin hoặc thông tin quan trọng nhất trên đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5

The answer key is in the back of the book.

definitions.definition_vi: vài trang cuối cùng của một cuốn sách, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the part of a chair, etc. against which you lean your back
definitions.definition_vi: phần của một chiếc ghế, v.v... mà bạn tựa lưng vào đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả đồ nội thất có loại mặt sau được đề cập

definitions.definition_vi: một cầu thủ có vai trò chính là bảo vệ khung thành của đội mình

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: khi ai đó quay lưng lại thì họ không có mặt và không thể thấy chuyện gì đang xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: một nơi cách xa những ngôi nhà, thị trấn khác, v.v.

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói về việc lập kế hoạch hoặc tính toán một việc gì đó một cách không chi tiết, chính xác hoặc đầy đủ

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: if two people stand or sit back to back, they stand or sit with their backs facing or touching each other
examples: SEE ALSO back-to-back

definitions.definition_vi: nếu hai người đứng hoặc ngồi quay lưng lại nhau là họ đứng hoặc ngồi quay lưng vào nhau hoặc chạm vào nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: if two or more things happen back to back, they happen one after the other
examples: The team had to play three games back to back.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu hai hoặc nhiều sự việc xảy ra liên tiếp thì chúng xảy ra lần lượt

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: if you put on a piece of clothing back to front, you make a mistake and put the back where the front should be
examples: COMPARE inside out
I think you've got that sweater on back to front.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn mặc một bộ quần áo ngược về phía trước, bạn đã phạm sai lầm và đặt phần sau vào đúng vị trí phía trước

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be happy that you will not have to deal with or see somebody/something again because you do not like them or it
examples: Was I pleased to see the back of her!
I can’t wait to see the back of that old car.
definitions.definition_vi: vui mừng vì bạn sẽ không phải đối mặt hoặc gặp lại ai đó/điều gì đó vì bạn không thích họ hoặc điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: without somebody’s knowledge or permission
examples: COMPARE to somebody’s face
Have you been talking about me behind my back?
They went ahead and sold it behind my back.
People say bad things about him behind his back, but never to his face.
definitions.definition_vi: mà không có sự cho phép hoặc biết của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to keep asking or telling somebody to do something that they do not want to do, in a way that they find annoying
examples: He’s still on my back about that money I borrowed.
definitions.definition_vi: liên tục yêu cầu hoặc bảo ai đó làm điều gì đó mà họ không muốn làm theo cách khiến họ cảm thấy khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to finish the largest or most important part of a task
examples: I want to break the back of this translation before the weekend.
definitions.definition_vi: để hoàn thành phần lớn nhất hoặc quan trọng nhất của một nhiệm vụ

definitions.label: Meaning 20

examples: Get everything in writing in order to cover your back.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận ra rằng sau này bạn có thể bị đổ lỗi hoặc bị chỉ trích vì điều gì đó và hành động để tránh điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to annoy somebody
examples: That sort of attitude really gets my back up!
definitions.definition_vi: làm phiền ai đó

definitions.definition: to stop annoying somebody, for example by criticizing them, or asking them to do something
examples: Just get off my back, will you!
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng làm phiền ai đó, ví dụ bằng cách chỉ trích họ hoặc yêu cầu họ làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to protect and support somebody
examples: Don't worry, I've got your back.
I’m loyal and I’ve got your back.
definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ và hỗ trợ ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to be in a difficult situation in which you are forced to do something but are unable to make the choices that you would like
examples: We had our backs to the wall with no choice but to sell.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong một tình huống khó khăn mà bạn buộc phải làm điều gì đó nhưng không thể đưa ra những lựa chọn mà bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
examples: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận thức được mọi thứ đang xảy ra xung quanh bạn, ngay cả những thứ dường như khó hoặc không thể nhìn thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to be very familiar with somebody/something
examples: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
definitions.definition_vi: rất quen thuộc với ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
definitions.definition_vi: sự việc cuối cùng trong một chuỗi sự kiện tồi tệ, v.v. khiến bạn không thể chấp nhận một tình huống nào nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to do something that will cause problems for you in the future
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó sẽ gây rắc rối cho bạn trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: immediately after something
examples: They come into this game off the back of a 1–0 defeat to Chelsea.
definitions.definition_vi: ngay sau cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: as a result of an achievement or a success
examples: The profits growth came on the back of a 26 per cent rise in sales.
definitions.definition_vi: là kết quả của một thành tích hoặc thành công

examples: She's been flat on her back for over a week now.

definitions.definition_vi: trên giường vì bạn bị ốm

definitions.definition: praise or approval for something that you have done well
examples: He deserves a pat on the back for all his hard work.
Give yourself a pat on the back!
definitions.definition_vi: khen ngợi hoặc tán thành điều gì đó bạn đã làm tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 34
definitions.definition: to praise somebody or yourself for doing something well
definitions.definition_vi: khen ngợi ai đó hoặc chính bạn vì đã làm tốt điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 35
definitions.definition: to try to forget about something unpleasant
examples: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng quên đi điều gì đó khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 36
definitions.definition: to use a lot of effort and energy on a particular task
definitions.definition_vi: để sử dụng rất nhiều nỗ lực và năng lượng vào một nhiệm vụ cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 37
definitions.definition: anything that somebody has, including the things they really need themselves, that somebody else takes from them or they are willing to give
examples: He was the type of person who would give you the shirt off his back.
definitions.definition_vi: bất cứ thứ gì mà ai đó có, kể cả những thứ họ thực sự cần, mà người khác lấy đi của họ hoặc họ sẵn sàng cho đi

definitions.label: Meaning 38
definitions.definition: an act that harms somebody, done by a person they thought was a friend
examples: Her refusal to support his campaign was a real stab in the back.

definitions.label: Meaning 39
definitions.definition: to do or say something that harms somebody who trusts you
examples: SYNONYM betray
definitions.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó gây tổn hại cho người tin tưởng bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 40
definitions.definition: to turn so that you are facing in the opposite direction
definitions.definition_vi: quay mặt về hướng ngược lại

definitions.label: Meaning 41

examples: When on stage, try not to turn your back on the audience.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển sao cho bạn đang đứng hoặc ngồi quay lưng về phía ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.definition: to reject somebody/something that you have previously been connected with

definitions.definition_vi: từ chối ai/cái gì mà trước đây bạn đã kết nối

definitions.label: Meaning 43
definitions.definition: to protect yourself against danger
examples: She'd better watch her back if she wants to hold onto the top job.
definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ bản thân trước nguy hiểm

definitions.definition: used to say that something, especially criticism, has no effect on somebody/something
examples: I can't tell my son what to do; it's water off a duck's back with him.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó, đặc biệt là sự chỉ trích, không có tác dụng gì với ai/cái gì

definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện nhiều hành động hơn mức thực sự cần thiết để đảm bảo rằng điều gì đó thành công hoặc hoạt động như bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to have already achieved or obtained something
examples: She already has a couple of good wins under her belt.
definitions.definition_vi: đã đạt được hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to spend less money because there is less available
examples: With price increases on most goods, everyone is having to tighten their belt.
There is a need for further belt-tightening.
definitions.definition_vi: tiêu ít tiền hơn vì có ít tiền hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: something that can be measured and used as a standard that other things can be compared with
examples: Tests at the age of seven provide a benchmark against which the child's progress at school can be measured.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó có thể được đo lường và sử dụng như một tiêu chuẩn mà những thứ khác có thể so sánh được

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction
examples: He bent and kissed her.
The doctor told me to avoid bending and stretching.
fields of poppies bending in the wind
She suddenly bent over, clutching her stomach.
His dark head bent over her.
She bent forward to pick up the newspaper.
Slowly bend from the waist and bring your head down to your knees.
Keep your feet apart, and bend at the waist
He bent his head and kissed her.
She bent her head towards him.
She was bent over her desk writing a letter.
definitions.definition_vi: nghiêng, hoặc làm cho cái gì đó nghiêng, theo một hướng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: if you bend your arm, leg, etc. or if it bends, you move it so that it is no longer straight
examples: Bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lie flat and let your knees bend.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn uốn cong cánh tay, chân, v.v. hoặc nếu nó uốn cong, bạn di chuyển nó để nó không còn thẳng nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to force something that was straight into an angle or a curve
examples: Mark the pipe where you want to bend it.
The knives were bent out of shape.
He bent the wire into the shape of a square.
definitions.definition_vi: ép cái gì đó thẳng vào một góc hoặc một đường cong

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to change direction to form a curve or an angle; to make something change direction in this way
examples: The road bent sharply to the right.
Glass and water both bend light.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hướng để tạo thành một đường cong hoặc một góc; làm cho cái gì đó thay đổi hướng theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to talk to somebody a lot about something, especially about a problem that you have
definitions.definition_vi: nói chuyện với ai đó rất nhiều về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là về một vấn đề mà bạn gặp phải

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to think very hard about or put a lot of effort into one particular thing
examples: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ rất kỹ hoặc đặt nhiều nỗ lực vào một điều cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to make a great effort, especially in order to be helpful or fair
examples: I've bent over backwards to help him.
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện một nỗ lực lớn, đặc biệt là để được hữu ích hoặc công bằng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to change the rules to suit a particular person or situation
examples: Couldn't they just bend the rules and let us in without a ticket?
definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi các quy tắc cho phù hợp với một người cụ thể hoặc tình hình

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to say something that is not completely true
examples: I wasn’t exactly lying when I said I hadn’t seen her—I was just bending the truth a little.
definitions.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó không hoàn toàn đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: if you ask for something on bended knee(s), you ask for it in a very anxious and/or humble way (= showing you think you are less important than the person you are asking)
examples: I’d go down on bended knee if I thought she’d change her mind.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn yêu cầu điều gì đó với tư thế quỳ gối, bạn yêu cầu điều đó một cách rất lo lắng và/hoặc khiêm tốn (= cho thấy bạn nghĩ bạn kém quan trọng hơn người bạn đang hỏi)

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who gains as a result of something
examples: Who will be the main beneficiary of the cuts in income tax?
definitions.definition_vi: một người đạt được như là kết quả của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who receives money or property when somebody dies
examples: She was the sole beneficiary of her father’s will.
definitions.definition_vi: người nhận tiền hoặc tài sản khi ai đó chết

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in addition to somebody/something; apart from somebody/something
examples: We have lots of things in common besides music.
Besides working as a doctor, he also writes novels in his spare time.
I've got no family besides my parents.
I’ve got plenty of other things to do besides talking to you.
definitions.definition_vi: ngoài ai đó/cái gì đó; ngoài ai/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: of the most excellent type or quality
examples: That's the best movie I've ever seen!
He wrote his best songs before he was 25.
She was one of the best tennis players of her generation.
Is that your best suit?
They've been best friends (= closest friends) since they were children.
the company’s best-ever results
We want the kids to have the best possible education.
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc loại hoặc chất lượng tuyệt vời nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: giving most pleasure; happiest
examples: Those were the best years of my life.
definitions.definition_vi: mang lại niềm vui nhất; hạnh phúc nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: most suitable or appropriate
examples: What's the best way to cook steak?
He's the best man for the job.
The best thing to do would be to apologize.
It's best if you go now.
I'm not in the best position to advise you.
Owen judged it best to make no reply.
definitions.definition_vi: phù hợp nhất hoặc thích hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result
examples: SEE ALSO betting
You have to be over 16 to bet.
I wouldn't bet on them winning the next election.
Not many people are betting against France retaining their title.
He likes betting on horses and watching table tennis.
He bet $2 000 on the final score of the game.
You shouldn't praise a gambler for betting his life savings if he wins.
She bet me £20 (that) I wouldn't do it.
I bet her (that) the Democrats would not win.
He bet ten dollars (that) he could write a complete story in just six words.
definitions.definition_vi: mạo hiểm tiền bạc trong một cuộc đua hoặc một sự kiện bằng cách cố gắng dự đoán kết quả

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say that you are almost certain that something is true or that something will happen
examples: I bet (that) we’re too late.
You can bet (that) the moment I sit down, the phone will ring.
I'm willing to bet (that) the analysts will be wrong.
I’ll bet you (that) he knows all about it.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn gần như chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to risk everything you have on an investment, a bet, etc.
examples: The company bet the farm on the new marketing model, only to find that it wasn’t successful.
definitions.definition_vi: mạo hiểm mọi thứ bạn có khi đầu tư, đặt cược, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to show that you can understand what somebody is feeling, describing, etc.
examples: ‘I nearly died when he told me.’ ‘I bet!’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn có thể hiểu những gì ai đó đang cảm thấy, mô tả, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody that you do not believe what they have just said
examples: ‘I'm going to tell her what I think of her.’ ‘Yeah, I bet!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn không tin những gì họ vừa nói

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to say that you do not think that something is very likely
examples: ‘She'll soon get used to the idea.’ ‘I wouldn't bet on it.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn không nghĩ rằng điều gì đó rất có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used instead of ‘yes’ to emphasize that somebody has guessed something correctly or made a good suggestion
examples: ‘Are you nervous?’ ‘You bet!’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng thay vì 'có' để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó đã đoán đúng điều gì đó hoặc đưa ra gợi ý hay

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to say that you are certain that something will happen
examples: You can bet your bottom dollar that he'll be late.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.
examples: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
I sat down between Jo and Diana.
Switzerland lies between France, Germany, Austria and Italy.
The paper had fallen down between the desk and the wall.
My job is somewhere between a secretary and a personal assistant.
definitions.definition_vi: trong hoặc vào không gian ngăn cách hai hoặc nhiều điểm, đồ vật, con người, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: in the period of time that separates two days, years, events, etc.
examples: It's cheaper between 6 p.m. and 8 a.m.
Don't eat between meals.
Children must attend school between the ages of 5 and 16.
Many changes took place between the two world wars.
definitions.definition_vi: trong khoảng thời gian ngăn cách hai ngày, năm, sự kiện, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: at some point along a scale from one amount, weight, distance, etc. to another
examples: It weighed between nine and ten kilos.
The temperature remained between 25°C and 30°C all week.
definitions.definition_vi: tại một số điểm dọc theo thang đo từ số lượng, trọng lượng, khoảng cách, v.v. này đến một điểm khác

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: separating one place from another
examples: the border between Sweden and Norway
definitions.definition_vi: ngăn cách nơi này với nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: from one place to another
examples: We fly between Rome and Paris twice daily.
definitions.definition_vi: từ nơi này đến nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show a connection or relationship
examples: a difference/distinction/contrast between two things
a link between unemployment and crime
There's a lot of bad feeling between them.
I had to choose between the two jobs.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hiển thị một kết nối hoặc mối quan hệ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: shared by two or more people or things
examples: We ate a pizza between us.
This is just between you and me/between ourselves (= it is a secret).
definitions.definition_vi: được chia sẻ bởi hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc vật

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: by putting together the efforts or actions of two or more people or groups
examples: We ought to be able to manage it between us.
China and India between them account for a third of the world's population.
definitions.definition_vi: bằng cách tập hợp những nỗ lực hoặc hành động của hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc nhóm

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to show that several activities are involved
examples: Between working full-time and taking care of the kids, he didn't have much time for hobbies.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một số hoạt động có liên quan

She spent the day riding her bicycle around the lake.
a bicycle helmet/wheel
definitions.definition_vi: một phương tiện giao thông đường bộ có hai bánh mà bạn lái bằng cách đẩy bàn đạp bằng chân

definitions.definition: a document that shows how much you owe somebody for goods or services
examples: the phone/electricity/gas bill
He is facing a huge tax bill.
She always pays her bills on time.
We ran up a massive hotel bill.
I’ll be sending you the bill for the dry-cleaning!
The bills are piling up (= there are more and more that have still not been paid).
definitions.definition_vi: một tài liệu cho thấy số tiền bạn nợ ai đó về hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay for the food and drinks that you have had in a restaurant
examples: Let's ask for the bill.
Could we have the bill, please?
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh giấy cho thấy số tiền bạn phải trả cho đồ ăn và đồ uống mà bạn đã dùng ở nhà hàng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a piece of paper money
examples: a ten-dollar bill
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh tiền giấy

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a written suggestion for a new law that is presented to a country’s parliament so that its members can discuss it
examples: SEE ALSO Act of Parliament
to introduce/approve/oppose a bill
Congress passed the energy bill last month.
Republicans said they would support the bill.
the Education Reform Bill
definitions.definition_vi: một đề nghị bằng văn bản về một luật mới được trình lên quốc hội của một quốc gia để các thành viên của quốc gia đó có thể thảo luận về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a programme of entertainment at a theatre, etc.
examples: a horror double bill (= two horror films shown one after the other)
Topping the bill (= the most important performer) is violinist Joshua Bell.
Mozart is on the bill this evening.
definitions.definition_vi: một chương trình giải trí tại nhà hát, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a notice in a public place to advertise an event
examples: SYNONYM poster
Post no bills (= a notice warning people not to stick bills in a particular place).
definitions.definition_vi: một thông báo ở nơi công cộng để quảng cáo một sự kiện

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the hard pointed or curved outer part of a bird’s mouth
examples: SYNONYM beak
definitions.definition_vi: phần bên ngoài nhọn hoặc cong của miệng chim

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: having the type of bill mentioned
examples: long-billed waders
definitions.definition_vi: có loại hóa đơn được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: the stiff front part of a cap that sticks out above your eyes
definitions.definition_vi: phần cứng phía trước của chiếc mũ nhô ra phía trên mắt bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: a report that says somebody is healthy or that something is in good condition
examples: Doctors gave him a clean bill of health after a series of tests and examinations.
The building was given a clean bill of health by the surveyor.
definitions.definition_vi: một báo cáo nói rằng ai đó khỏe mạnh hoặc một cái gì đó đang trong tình trạng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be what is needed in a particular situation or for a particular purpose
examples: On paper, several of the applicants fit the bill.
definitions.definition_vi: là những gì cần thiết trong một tình huống cụ thể hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be responsible for paying the cost of something

definitions.definition_vi: đánh bại hoặc làm tốt hơn ai đó trong một hoạt động mà họ đã chọn hoặc trong hoạt động mà họ nghĩ rằng họ mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to think very hard about something for a long time
examples: I’ve been beating my brains out all weekend to get this script written.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ rất kỹ về điều gì đó trong một thời gian dài

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to show that you feel sorry about something that you have done, especially in public and in an exaggerated way
definitions.definition_vi: để cho thấy rằng bạn cảm thấy tiếc về điều gì đó mà bạn đã làm, đặc biệt là ở nơi công cộng và một cách cường điệu

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to finish a task, race, etc. before a particular time
examples: The player beat the clock and set a new record.
definitions.definition_vi: để hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ, cuộc đua, vv trước một thời gian cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to hit somebody very hard several times and hurt them very much
examples: Get out or I’ll beat the living daylights out of you!
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai đó rất mạnh nhiều lần và làm họ tổn thương rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to waste your effort by trying to do something that is no longer possible
definitions.definition_vi: lãng phí nỗ lực của bạn bằng cách cố gắng làm điều gì đó không còn có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to speak with enthusiasm in support of somebody/something
examples: She’s really banging the drum for the new system.
definitions.definition_vi: nói với sự nhiệt tình để ủng hộ ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to hit somebody/something very hard
examples: He was a dirty player and loved to kick hell out of the opposition.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai/cái gì rất mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 21

definitions.definition_vi: rời đi ngay lập tức

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: if a lot of people beat a path to somebody’s door, they are all interested in something that person has to sell, or can do or tell them
examples: Top theatrical agents are beating a path to the teenager's door.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu nhiều người đến gõ cửa nhà ai đó, họ đều quan tâm đến thứ mà người đó phải bán hoặc có thể làm hoặc nói với họ

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to escape without being punished
definitions.definition_vi: trốn thoát mà không bị trừng phạt

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to go away or back quickly, especially to avoid something unpleasant
examples: I decided to beat a hasty retreat.
definitions.definition_vi: đi xa hoặc quay lại nhanh chóng, đặc biệt là để tránh điều gì đó khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to mark or follow the rhythm of music, by waving a stick, tapping your foot (= hitting it against the floor), etc.
examples: She beat time with her fingers.
definitions.definition_vi: để đánh dấu hoặc theo nhịp điệu của âm nhạc, bằng cách vẫy một cây gậy, gõ nhẹ bàn chân của bạn (= đập nó xuống sàn), v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to get or do something before somebody else can
definitions.definition_vi: để có được hoặc làm điều gì đó trước khi người khác có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: (to hit somebody until they are) covered with bruises (= blue, brown or purple marks on the body)
definitions.definition_vi: (đánh ai đó cho đến khi họ) đầy vết bầm tím (= vết xanh, nâu hoặc tím trên cơ thể)

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: used to express surprise or anger
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên hoặc tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: if you cannot defeat somebody or be as successful as they are, then it is more sensible to join them in what they are doing and perhaps get some advantage for yourself by doing so
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn không thể đánh bại ai đó hoặc thành công như họ, thì sẽ hợp lý hơn nếu bạn tham gia cùng họ vào những gì họ đang làm và có thể bạn sẽ nhận được một số lợi thế cho mình khi làm như vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: far away from other people, houses, etc.
examples: They live miles off the beaten track.
definitions.definition_vi: xa người khác, nhà cửa, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: a fact, an argument, etc. that is used in order to blame or punish somebody
definitions.definition_vi: một thực tế, một lập luận, vv được sử dụng để đổ lỗi hoặc trừng phạt ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 32
definitions.definition: to be difficult to beat

definitions.definition_vi: rất khó để đánh bại

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: for the reason that
examples: I did it because he told me to.
Just because I don't complain, people think I'm satisfied.
Because it was so late, he found it unacceptable to send them all away.
definitions.definition_vi: vì lý do đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to start to be something

The bill will become law next year.

How can I become a member of the society?
She’s studying to become a teacher.
His job has become his whole life.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu trở thành một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be suitable for somebody
examples: Such behaviour did not become her.
definitions.definition_vi: phù hợp với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: để trông hấp dẫn đối với ai đó

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để hỏi chuyện gì đã xảy ra hoặc chuyện gì sẽ xảy ra với ai/cái gì

definitions.definition: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting (= touch your skin and make you feel a sharp pain).Bees live in large groups and make honey (= a sweet sticky substance that is good to eat).
examples: SEE ALSO beehive

a swarm of bees
a bee sting
definitions.definition_vi: một loài côn trùng bay màu đen và màu vàng có thể chích (= chạm vào da của bạn và khiến bạn cảm thấy đau nhói). Ong sống theo nhóm lớn và tạo ra mật ong (= một chất dính ngọt rất ngon để ăn).

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a meeting in a group where people combine work, competition and pleasure
examples: SEE ALSO spelling bee
a sewing bee
definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc họp trong một nhóm nơi mọi người kết hợp công việc, cạnh tranh và niềm vui

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: very busy
definitions.definition_vi: rất bận rộn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an excellent person or thing

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật xuất sắc

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the basic facts about sex, especially as told to children
definitions.definition_vi: những sự thật cơ bản về tình dục, đặc biệt là những điều được dạy cho trẻ em

definitions.definition: to think or talk about something all the time and to think that it is very important

definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc nói về điều gì đó mọi lúc và nghĩ rằng nó rất quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: earlier than somebody/something

the day before yesterday

We'll know before long (= soon).

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody/something is ahead of somebody/something in an order or arrangement
examples: Your name is before mine on the list.

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đang đối mặt với ai đó trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in the presence of somebody who is listening, watching, etc.

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã thuộc về quá khứ của ai đó

definitions.definition_vi: sự tồn tại

definitions.label: Meaning 2

a strange being from another planet

definitions.definition_vi: một sinh vật sống

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: tâm trí của bạn và tất cả cảm xúc của bạn

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh việc làm điều gì đó dễ dàng như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: including everything
examples: He sold the business lock, stock and barrel.
definitions.definition_vi: bao gồm tất cả mọi thứ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: (to put/have somebody) in a situation in which they must accept or do what you want
examples: They've got us over a barrel. Either we agree to their terms or we lose the money.
definitions.definition_vi: (đặt/đưa ai đó) vào tình huống mà họ phải chấp nhận hoặc làm điều bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to have to use things or people that are not the best or most suitable because the ones that were the best or most suitable are no longer availableWord Origin
examples: Middle English: from Old French baril, from medieval Latin barriclus ‘small cask’.
definitions.definition_vi: phải sử dụng những thứ hoặc những người không phải là tốt nhất hoặc phù hợp nhất bởi vì những thứ tốt nhất hoặc phù hợp nhất không còn nữa.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an object like a fence that prevents people from moving forward from one place to another
examples: SEE ALSO crash barrier
The crowd had to stand behind barriers.
Concrete barriers were erected around the site.
The crowd managed to break through the barriers and get onto the pitch.
definitions.definition_vi: một vật thể giống như một hàng rào ngăn cản mọi người di chuyển từ nơi này sang nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a gate at a car park or railway station that controls when you may go through by being raised or lowered
examples: Scan your ticket at the barrier and it will automatically lift.
There was a slow trickle of people through the barriers.
She got her luggage stuck in the automatic barrier.
definitions.definition_vi: cổng tại bãi đỗ xe hoặc nhà ga kiểm soát thời điểm bạn có thể đi qua bằng cách nâng lên hoặc hạ xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a problem, rule or situation that prevents somebody from doing something, or that makes something impossible
examples: the removal of trade barriers
to overcome/break down barriers
the language barrier (= when people cannot communicate because they do not speak the same language)
Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier to success.
The old laws created barriers to free trade.
The country has removed barriers against imports.
definitions.definition_vi: một vấn đề, quy tắc hoặc tình huống ngăn cản ai đó làm điều gì đó hoặc khiến điều gì đó không thể thực hiện được

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: something that exists between one thing or person and another and keeps them separate
examples: SEE ALSO species barrier
The Yangtze River is a natural barrier to the north-east.
There was no real barrier between reality and fantasy in his mind.
The cream acts as a protective barrier against sun damage.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó tồn tại giữa một vật hoặc người này và vật khác và giữ chúng tách biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a particular amount, level or number that it is difficult to get past
examples: SEE ALSO sound barrier
the first player whose earnings passed the $10 million barrier
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng, mức độ hoặc con số cụ thể mà rất khó để vượt qua

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: if one thing is based on another, it uses it or is developed from it
examples: The movie is based on a real-life incident.
The report is based on figures from six different European cities.
The novels are all loosely based on the author's life.
Their research was based largely on anecdotal evidence.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một thứ dựa trên một thứ khác, nó sẽ sử dụng nó hoặc được phát triển từ nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: if a person or business is based in a particular place, that is where they live or work, or where the work of the business is done
examples: We're based in Chicago.
a Chicago-based company
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một người hoặc doanh nghiệp có trụ sở tại một địa điểm cụ thể, đó là nơi họ sống hoặc làm việc hoặc nơi thực hiện công việc của doanh nghiệp

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: containing something as an important part or feature
examples: lead-based paints
a class-based society
the importance of evidence-based decision-making
definitions.definition_vi: chứa một cái gì đó như một phần hoặc tính năng quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a room or rooms in a building, partly or completely below the level of the ground
examples: SEE ALSO bargain basement
Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.
a basement flat/apartment
She lives in a two-room basement flat.
definitions.definition_vi: một hoặc nhiều phòng trong tòa nhà nằm dưới mặt đất một phần hoặc hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a room in which there is a bath, a washbasin and often a toilet
examples: Go and wash your hands in the bathroom.
The master bedroom also has an en suite bathroom.
The family bathroom has a washbasin, toilet, and bath with shower attachment.
She stared at herself in the bathroom mirror.
definitions.definition_vi: một căn phòng có bồn tắm, chậu rửa và thường là nhà vệ sinh

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a room in which there is a toilet, a sink and sometimes a bath or shower
examples: I have to go to the bathroom (= use the toilet).
Where's the bathroom? (= for example in a restaurant)
We were allowed to stop occasionally for bathroom breaks.
Bill asked if he could use the bathroom.
definitions.definition_vi: một căn phòng trong đó có một nhà vệ sinh, bồn rửa và đôi khi là bồn tắm hoặc vòi hoa sen

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant
examples: SYNONYM stand
The pain was almost more than he could bear.
She bore it all with her usual patience.
She couldn't bear the thought of losing him.
I can't bear having cats in the house.
He can't bear being laughed at.
He can't bear to be laughed at.
I can hardly bear to think about it.
How can you bear to eat that stuff?
I can't bear you doing that.
definitions.definition_vi: để có thể chấp nhận và đối phó với một cái gì đó khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take responsibility for something
examples: She bore the responsibility for most of the changes.
Do parents have to bear the whole cost of tuition fees?
In the end it's consumers who bear the burden of higher prices.
You shouldn't have to bear the blame for other people's mistakes.
You must bear at least some responsibility for what has happened.
definitions.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to support the weight of somebody/something
examples: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
definitions.definition_vi: đỡ sức nặng của ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to show something; to carry something so that it can be seen
examples: The document bore her signature.
He was badly wounded in the war and still bears the scars.
She bears little resemblance to (= is not much like) her mother.
The title of the essay bore little relation to (= was not much connected with) the contents.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị một cái gì đó; mang theo một cái gì đó để nó có thể được nhìn thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to not be suitable for something
examples: Her later work does not bear comparison with her earlier novels (= because it is not nearly as good).
The plan won't bear close inspection (= it will be found to be unacceptable when carefully examined).
The joke doesn't bear repeating (= because it is not funny or may offend people).
His sufferings don't bear thinking about (= because they are so terrible).
definitions.definition_vi: không phù hợp với cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to have a feeling, especially a negative feeling
examples: He bears no resentment towards them.
He's borne a grudge against me ever since that day.
He's borne me a grudge ever since that day.
She bore him no ill will.
definitions.definition_vi: có một cảm giác, đặc biệt là một cảm giác tiêu cực

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to have a particular name
examples: a family that bore an ancient and honoured name
definitions.definition_vi: có một cái tên cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to carry somebody/something, especially while moving
examples: three kings bearing gifts
definitions.definition_vi: mang theo ai/cái gì, đặc biệt là khi di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to move, behave or act in a particular way
examples: He bears himself (= stands, walks, etc.) proudly, like a soldier.
She bore herself with dignity throughout the funeral.
definitions.definition_vi: để di chuyển, cư xử hoặc hành động một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to give birth to a child
examples: She was not able to bear children.
She had borne him six sons.
definitions.definition_vi: sinh con

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to produce flowers or fruit
examples: These trees take a long time to bear fruit.
definitions.definition_vi: để sản xuất hoa hoặc quả

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to go or turn in the direction mentioned
examples: When you get to the fork in the road, bear right.
definitions.definition_vi: đi hoặc rẽ theo hướng đã đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be a soldier; to fight
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một người lính; chiến đấu

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to have a successful result
definitions.definition_vi: để có một kết quả thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to be a cause of difficulty or worry to somebody
examples: Taxation bears heavily on us all.
The burden of the tax bore most heavily on the poor.
definitions.definition_vi: là nguyên nhân gây khó khăn hoặc lo lắng cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to remember somebody/something; to remember or consider that…
examples: You don't have to do anything about it now… just bear it in mind.
definitions.definition_vi: nhớ ai đó/cái gì đó; để nhớ hoặc xem xét điều đó…

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to receive the main force of something unpleasant
examples: Schools will bear the brunt of cuts in government spending.
definitions.definition_vi: để nhận được lực lượng chính của một cái gì đó khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to provide evidence of the truth of something
examples: The crowd of mourners at his funeral bore witness to the great affection in which he was held.
The ancient temples bear silent witness to the passing dynasties.
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp bằng chứng về sự thật của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to be realized by somebody, especially after a period of time
examples: It was gradually borne in on us that defeat was inevitable.
definitions.definition_vi: được ai đó nhận ra, đặc biệt là sau một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to use energy, pressure, influence, etc. to try to achieve something or make somebody do something
examples: We must bring all our energies to bear upon the task.
Pressure was brought to bear on us to finish the work on time.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng năng lượng, áp lực, ảnh hưởng, v.v. để cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó hoặc khiến ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to accept pain or bad luck without complaining
examples: There's nothing we can do about it. We'll just have to grin and bear it.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận nỗi đau hay vận rủi mà không phàn nàn

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to have a difficult problem that makes you worried or unhappy but that you have to deal with
examples: We all have our crosses to bear.
definitions.definition_vi: gặp phải một vấn đề khó khăn khiến bạn lo lắng hoặc không vui nhưng bạn phải giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a piece of furniture for sleeping on
examples: SEE ALSO airbed
a single/double bed
She lay on the bed (= on top of the covers).
He lay in bed (= under the covers).
I'm tired—I'm going to bed.
I'll just put the kids to bed.
It's time for bed (= time to go to sleep).
He likes to have a mug of cocoa before bed (= before going to bed).
to get into/out of bed
to make the bed (= arrange the covers in a tidy way)
Could you give me a bed for the night (= somewhere to sleep)?
There's a shortage of hospital beds (= not enough room for patients to be admitted).
He has been confined to bed with flu for the past couple of days.
Having breakfast in bed is a rare treat.
I ran and hid under a bed.
She came over and sat at the foot (= bottom) of the bed.
definitions.definition_vi: một món đồ nội thất để ngủ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the bottom of a river, the sea, etc.
examples: the ocean bed
oyster beds (= an area in the sea where there are many oysters)
definitions.definition_vi: đáy sông, biển, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an area of ground in a garden or park for growing flowers, vegetables, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO raised bed
flower beds
Raised flower beds are ideal for people in wheelchairs.
ornamental beds of roses
definitions.definition_vi: diện tích đất trong vườn hoặc công viên để trồng hoa, rau, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a layer of something that other things lie or rest on
examples: grilled chicken, served on a bed of rice
The blocks should be laid on a bed of concrete.
definitions.definition_vi: một lớp của cái gì đó mà những thứ khác nằm hoặc dựa vào

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a layer of clay, rock, etc. in the ground
examples: SEE ALSO bedrock
definitions.definition_vi: một lớp đất sét, đá, vv trong lòng đất

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: (not) an easy or a pleasant situation
examples: Their life together hasn't exactly been a bed of roses.
definitions.definition_vi: (không) một tình huống dễ dàng hay dễ chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to die because you are old or ill
definitions.definition_vi: chết vì bạn già hoặc bệnh tật

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
definitions.definition_vi: có tâm trạng tồi tệ cả ngày mà không có lý do cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to have sex with somebody
definitions.definition_vi: quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used to refer to sexual activity
examples: What's he like in bed?
I caught them in bed together (= having sex).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ hoạt động tình dục

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to go to bed and stay there because you are ill
definitions.definition_vi: đi ngủ và ở đó vì bạn bị ốm

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to urinate in your bed by accident
examples: It is quite common for small children to wet their beds.
definitions.definition_vi: vô tình đi tiểu trên giường của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: you must accept the results of your actionsWord Origin
examples: Old English bed, bedd (noun), beddian (verb), of Germanic origin; related to Dutch bed and German Bett.
definitions.definition_vi: bạn phải chấp nhận kết quả hành động của mìnhWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be in the right or suitable place
examples: Where do these plates belong (= where are they kept)?
Are you sure these documents belong together?
Several of the points you raise do not belong in this discussion.
A person like that does not belong in teaching.
definitions.definition_vi: ở đúng nơi hoặc nơi thích hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to feel comfortable and happy in a particular situation or with a particular group of people
examples: I don't feel as if I belong here.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy thoải mái và hạnh phúc trong một tình huống cụ thể hoặc với một nhóm người cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at or to a lower level, position or place
examples: They live on the floor below.
I could still see the airport buildings far below.
See below (= at the bottom of the page) for references.
The passengers who felt seasick stayed below (= on a lower deck).
definitions.definition_vi: ở hoặc đến một cấp độ, vị trí hoặc địa điểm thấp hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: at a lower rank
examples: This ruling applies to the ranks of Inspector and below.
definitions.definition_vi: ở cấp độ thấp hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: lower than zero
examples: The thermometer had dropped to a record 40 below (= −40 degrees).
definitions.definition_vi: thấp hơn 0

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not straight
examples: a piece of bent wire
Do this exercise with your knees bent (= not with your legs straight).
The lamp post got bent in the crash.
Lock your elbows in a slightly bent position.
definitions.definition_vi: không thẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not able to stand up straight, usually as a result of being old or ill
examples: a small bent old woman
He was bent double with laughter.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể đứng thẳng, thường là do tuổi già hoặc bệnh tật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: dishonest
definitions.definition_vi: không trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: determined to do something (usually something bad)
examples: SEE ALSO hell-bent
