When you look at their new system, ours seems very old-fashioned by contrast.
Careful contrast of the two plans shows some important differences.
definitions.definition_vi: sự khác biệt giữa hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc nhiều thứ mà bạn có thể thấy rõ khi chúng được so sánh hoặc đặt gần nhau; thực tế so sánh hai hoặc nhiều thứ để chỉ ra sự khác biệt giữa chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is clearly different from somebody/something else
examples: The work you did today is quite a contrast to (= very much better/worse than) what you did last week.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật rõ ràng là khác biệt với ai/cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: differences in colour or in light and dark, used in photographs and paintings to create a special effect
examples: The artist's use of contrast is masterly.
definitions.definition_vi: sự khác biệt về màu sắc hoặc ánh sáng và bóng tối, được sử dụng trong ảnh và tranh vẽ để tạo hiệu ứng đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the amount of difference between light and dark in a photograph or the picture on a television screen
examples: Use this button to adjust the contrast.
definitions.definition_vi: mức độ khác biệt giữa ánh sáng và bóng tối trong một bức ảnh hoặc hình ảnh trên màn hình tivi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
examples: The party expects to gain control of the council in the next election.
Militants have taken control of the town.
The Democrats have lost control of Congress.
A military junta seized control of the country.
The founders eventually regained control of the company.
He defended the tradition of civilian control over the military.
The city is in the control of enemy forces.
The area remains under international control.
definitions.definition_vi: quyền đưa ra quyết định về cách thức điều hành một quốc gia, một khu vực, một tổ chức, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the ability to make somebody/something do what you want
examples: SEE ALSO self-control
The teacher had no control over the children.
He fought hard to retain control over his work.
She struggled to keep control of her voice.
She lost control of her car on the ice.
He got so angry he lost control (= shouted and said or did things he would not normally do).
Owing to circumstances beyond our control, the flight to Rome has been cancelled.
The situation is under control.
The coach made the team work hard on ball control (= in a ball game).
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng khiến ai/cái gì làm điều bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of limiting or managing something; a method of doing this
examples: SEE ALSO birth control
traffic control
talks on arms control
tight controls on government spending
Price controls on food were ended.
exciting advances in the control of malaria
state control of the economy
It was an exercise in damage control (= trying to prevent further damage).
A pest control officer was called in to deal with the rat problem.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động hạn chế hoặc quản lý một cái gì đó; một phương pháp để làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the switches and buttons, etc. that you use to operate a machine or a vehicle
examples: SEE ALSO cruise control
the controls of an aircraft
the control panel
the volume control of a TV
The co-pilot was at the controls when the plane landed.
definitions.definition_vi: các công tắc và nút bấm, v.v. mà bạn sử dụng để vận hành máy móc hoặc phương tiện

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a person, thing or group used as a standard of comparison for checking the results of a scientific experiment; an experiment whose result is known, used for checking working methods
examples: The study showed that women with the disease have had fewer children than the controls.
One group was treated with the new drug, and the control group was given a sugar pill.
definitions.definition_vi: người, vật, nhóm dùng làm tiêu chuẩn so sánh để kiểm tra kết quả thí nghiệm khoa học; một thí nghiệm đã biết kết quả, dùng để kiểm tra phương pháp làm việc

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a place where orders are given or where checks are made; the people who work in this place
examples: SEE ALSO air traffic control
We went through passport control and into the departure lounge.
definitions.definition_vi: nơi đưa ra mệnh lệnh hoặc nơi thực hiện kiểm tra; những người làm việc ở nơi này

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: (on a computer keyboard) a key that you press when you want to perform a particular operation
definitions.definition_vi: (trên bàn phím máy tính) phím mà bạn nhấn khi muốn thực hiện một thao tác cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to direct or manage an organization, an area or a situation
examples: He's reached retiring age, but he's still firmly in control.
There has been some violence after the match, but the police are now in control of the situation.
The elected government is back in control.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ đạo hoặc quản lý một tổ chức, một khu vực hoặc một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be able to organize your life well and keep calm
examples: In spite of all her family problems, she's really in control.
definitions.definition_vi: để có thể tổ chức cuộc sống của bạn tốt và giữ bình tĩnh

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be or become impossible to manage or to control
examples: The children are completely out of control since their father left.
A truck ran out of control on the hill.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên không thể quản lý hoặc kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be being dealt with successfully
examples: Don't worry—everything's under control!
definitions.definition_vi: được giải quyết thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to succeed in dealing with something so that it does not cause any damage or hurt anyone
examples: It took two hours to bring the fire under control.
Please keep your dog under control!
definitions.definition_vi: thành công trong việc giải quyết việc gì đó để nó không gây ra thiệt hại hoặc làm tổn thương ai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for somebody
examples: COMPARE inconvenience
We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
For (the sake of) convenience, the two groups have been treated as one in this report.
The position of the house combines quietness and convenience.
In this resort you can enjoy all the comfort and convenience of modern tourism.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng hữu ích, dễ dàng hoặc phù hợp với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that is useful and can make things easier or quicker to do, or more comfortable
examples: SEE ALSO public convenience
It was a great convenience to have the school so near.
The house had all the modern conveniences (= central heating, etc.) that were unusual at that time.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó hữu ích và có thể làm cho mọi việc được thực hiện dễ dàng hơn, nhanh hơn hoặc thoải mái hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: at a time or a place that is suitable for somebody
examples: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
definitions.definition_vi: tại một thời điểm hoặc một nơi thích hợp cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: as soon as possible
examples: Please contact us at your earliest convenience.
definitions.definition_vi: càng sớm càng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
examples: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
I can't see him now—it isn't convenient.
I'll call back at a more convenient time.
Flying is the most convenient way to travel in such a large country as China.
He used his wife's birthday as a convenient excuse for not going to the meeting.
He said meeting in Adelaide would be convenient for him as well.
When would be convenient for a visit?
It is very convenient to pay by credit card.
It's much more convenient for me to drive there.
You'll find these meals quick and convenient to prepare.
definitions.definition_vi: hữu ích, dễ dàng hoặc nhanh chóng để làm; không gây ra vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: near to a particular place; easy to get to
examples: The office is just five minutes from the station, so it's very convenient.
The house is very convenient for several schools.
The house is quite convenient for the shops.
The hotel is convenient to downtown.
definitions.definition_vi: gần một địa điểm cụ thể; dễ dàng để đến

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: fairly cold; not hot or warm
examples: cool air/water
a cool breeze/drink/climate
Cooler weather is forecast for the weekend.
These plants prefer cooler temperatures.
Let's sit in the shade and keep cool.
The wooden shutters help keep the building cool.
Store lemons in a cool dry place.
definitions.definition_vi: khá lạnh; không nóng hoặc ấm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: helping you keep cool
examples: Wear light, cool clothing but try to avoid shorts.
definitions.definition_vi: giúp bạn luôn mát mẻ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: making you feel pleasantly cool
examples: a room painted in cool greens and blues
definitions.definition_vi: khiến bạn cảm thấy mát mẻ dễ chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to show that you admire or approve of somebody/something because they are/it is fashionable, attractive and often different
examples: Doesn't she look cool in those sunglasses?
He's a really cool guy.
You look pretty cool with that new haircut.
It's a cool movie.
She has lots of cool ideas.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn ngưỡng mộ hoặc tán thành ai/cái gì vì họ/nó hợp thời trang, hấp dẫn và thường khác biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to describe something that you like or enjoy
examples: We had such a cool time with Ed and his friends.
I really hope you can come—it'd be so cool!
It was totally cool to see him in real life.
It's really cool you came back!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một cái gì đó mà bạn thích hoặc tận hưởng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show that you approve of something or agree to a suggestion
examples: We're meeting Jake for lunch and we can go on the yacht in the afternoon.’ ‘Cool!’
Can you come at 10.30 tomorrow?’ ‘That's cool.’
‘Yeah, sure. That sounds cool,’ he replied.
I was surprised that she got the job, but I'm cool with it (= it's not a problem for me).
She's completely cool about what happened.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn chấp nhận một cái gì đó hoặc đồng ý với một đề nghị

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: calm; not excited, angry or emotional
examples: Keep cool!
Just stay cool and don't panic.
She tried to remain cool, calm and collected (= calm).
He has a cool head (= he stays calm in an emergency).
definitions.definition_vi: điềm tĩnh; không vui mừng, tức giận hoặc xúc động

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: not friendly, interested or enthusiastic
examples: They gave the prime minister a cool reception.
Her voice was cool and dismissive.
She was decidedly cool about the proposal.
He has been cool towards me ever since we had that argument.
definitions.definition_vi: không thân thiện, quan tâm hoặc nhiệt tình

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: calm and confident in a way that lacks respect for other people, but makes people admire you even if they don't approve
examples: She just took his keys and walked out with them, cool as you please.
He was a cool customer. No one would think to look for him in a city where he’d been arrested for killing a cop.
definitions.definition_vi: điềm tĩnh và tự tin theo cách thiếu tôn trọng người khác nhưng lại khiến mọi người ngưỡng mộ bạn ngay cả khi họ không tán thành

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used about a sum of money to emphasize how large it is
examples: The car cost a cool thirty thousand.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng về một số tiền để nhấn mạnh mức độ lớn của nó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: very calm and showing control, especially in a difficult situation
examples: George is cool as a cucumber and this should be just another operation for him.
definitions.definition_vi: rất bình tĩnh và thể hiện sự kiểm soát, đặc biệt trong tình huống khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to deal with a situation in a calm way and not show what you are really feeling
examples: I decided to play it cool and act like I had actually forgotten all about it.
definitions.definition_vi: để giải quyết một tình huống một cách bình tĩnh và không thể hiện những gì bạn đang thực sự cảm thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to consider a problem or possibility very carefully and without hurrying
examples: We need to take a long, hard look at all the options.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét một vấn đề hoặc khả năng một cách rất cẩn thận và không vội vàng

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: very fashionable
examples: The assistants look like they're too cool for school.
definitions.definition_vi: rất thời trang

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to deal successfully with something difficult
examples: SYNONYM manage
I got to the stage where I wasn't coping any more.
He wasn't able to cope with the stresses and strains of the job.
Desert plants are adapted to cope with extreme heat.
definitions.definition_vi: để giải quyết thành công một cái gì đó khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a change that makes something more accurate than it was before
examples: I've made a few small corrections to your report.
The paper had to publish a correction to the story.
definitions.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi làm cho một cái gì đó chính xác hơn trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act or process of correcting something
examples: There are some programming errors that need correction.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình sửa chữa một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: punishment
examples: the correction of young offenders
definitions.definition_vi: hình phạt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: willing to use their power to do dishonest or illegal things in return for money or to get an advantage
examples: It was seen as the only way to overthrow a corrupt regime.
They promised to seek out the corrupt officials who had accepted the bribes.
one of the most notoriously corrupt city councils
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng sử dụng quyền lực của mình để làm những việc không trung thực hoặc bất hợp pháp để đổi lấy tiền hoặc để có được lợi thế

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not honest or moral
examples: They had been engaged in corrupt practices.
The whole system is inefficient and corrupt.
definitions.definition_vi: không trung thực hoặc đạo đức

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: containing changes or faults, and no longer in the original state
examples: corrupt software
The file on the disk seems to be corrupt.
definitions.definition_vi: có sự thay đổi hoặc sai sót và không còn ở trạng thái ban đầu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the amount of money that you need in order to buy, make or do something
examples: SEE ALSO low-cost
the high/low cost of housing
A new computer system has been installed at a cost of £80 000.
You could buy a used car at a fraction of the cost of a new one.
We did not even make enough money to cover the cost of the food.
Consumers will have to bear the full cost of these pay increases.
The plan had to be abandoned on grounds of cost.
The total cost to you (= the amount you have to pay) is £3 000.
Energy is a major cost for businesses.
He estimates the cost for this project at $150 000.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền bạn cần để mua, làm hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the total amount of money that needs to be spent by a business
examples: The use of cheap labour helped to keep costs down.
Reducing costs means we can keep prices as low as possible.
We have to find new ways of cutting costs.
The company is focused on lowering its operating costs.
We have had to raise our prices because of rising costs.
Opinion was divided on the potential costs and benefits of the scheme.
definitions.definition_vi: tổng số tiền doanh nghiệp cần chi tiêu

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the effort, loss or damage that is involved in order to do or achieve something
examples: the terrible cost of the war in death and suffering
the environmental cost of nuclear power
She saved him from the fire at the cost of her own life (= she died).
Victory came at a high cost.
They advanced a few hundred metres, but at a heavy cost in life.
He worked non-stop for three months, at considerable cost to his health.
I felt a need to please people, whatever the cost in time and energy.
definitions.definition_vi: nỗ lực, mất mát hoặc thiệt hại có liên quan để làm hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the sum of money that somebody is ordered to pay for lawyers, etc. in a legal case
examples: He was ordered to pay £2 000 costs.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền mà ai đó được lệnh phải trả cho luật sư, v.v. trong một vụ án pháp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: whatever is needed to achieve something
examples: You must stop the press from finding out at all costs.
definitions.definition_vi: bất cứ điều gì cần thiết để đạt được điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: under any circumstances
examples: He is determined to win at any cost.
definitions.definition_vi: trong bất kỳ hoàn cảnh nào

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: for only the amount of money that is needed to make or get something, without any profit being added on
examples: goods sold at cost
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ với số tiền cần thiết để tạo ra hoặc có được thứ gì đó mà không thêm bất kỳ lợi nhuận nào vào

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to feel the bad effects of a mistake, an accident, etc.
examples: The town is now counting the cost of its failure to provide adequate flood protection.
definitions.definition_vi: để cảm thấy những ảnh hưởng xấu của một sai lầm, một tai nạn, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to know something because of something unpleasant that has happened to you
examples: He's a ruthless businessman, as I know to my cost.
definitions.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó vì điều gì đó khó chịu đã xảy ra với bạn

bales of cotton
cotton fields/plantations/plants

the cotton industry
a cotton mill
a pure cotton T-shirt

definitions.definition_vi: một khối vật liệu mềm màu trắng dùng để làm sạch da hoặc vết thương

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a group of people who are elected to govern an area such as a city or county
examples: SEE ALSO band council
a town council
The decision still has to be ratified by the full council.
She's on the local council.
He won a seat on the council in a by-election.
She has served on the council for four years.
a member/meeting of the council
the leader of the council
a council member/leader
a council meeting/chamber
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người được bầu để quản lý một khu vực như thành phố hoặc quận

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the organization that provides services in a city or county, for example education, houses, libraries, etc.
examples: Residents have complained to the council about the noise.
She has been working for the council since March.
Students should apply to their local council for a grant.
council workers/staff/officials/officers
cuts to council services
definitions.definition_vi: tổ chức cung cấp dịch vụ trong thành phố hoặc quận, ví dụ như giáo dục, nhà ở, thư viện, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a group of people chosen to give advice, make rules, do research, provide money, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO the Medical Research Council
the Medical Research Council
In Britain, the Arts Council gives grants to theatres.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người được chọn để đưa ra lời khuyên, đưa ra các quy tắc, nghiên cứu, cung cấp tiền, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: (especially in the past) a formal meeting to discuss what action to take in a particular situation
examples: The king held a council at Nottingham from 14 to 19 October 1330.
definitions.definition_vi: (đặc biệt là trong quá khứ) cuộc họp chính thức để thảo luận về hành động cần thực hiện trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a member of a city or county council
examples: SEE ALSO councilman
Councillor Ann Jones
Talk to your local councillor about the problem.
definitions.definition_vi: một thành viên của hội đồng thành phố hoặc quận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person or thing that has the same position or function as somebody/something else in a different place or situation
examples: COMPARE your opposite number
The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.
The women's shoe, like its male counterpart, is specifically designed for the serious tennis player.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có cùng vị trí hoặc chức năng với ai đó/cái gì khác ở một địa điểm hoặc tình huống khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an area of land that has or used to have its own government and laws
examples: SEE ALSO mother country
European countries
developing countries
It's good to meet people from different parts of the country.
She didn't know what life in a foreign country would be like.
It's the most popular music festival in the country.
House prices are rising across the whole country.
Demonstrations were held in cities around the country.
people from other countries
definitions.definition_vi: một vùng đất có hoặc đã từng có chính quyền và luật pháp riêng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: any area outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, farms, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO up-country
I live in the country.
We spent a pleasant day in the country.
The house is at the end of a narrow country lane.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ khu vực nào bên ngoài thị trấn và thành phố, có cánh đồng, rừng cây, trang trại, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an area of land, especially with particular physical features, suitable for a particular purpose or connected with a particular person or people
examples: SEE ALSO backcountry
The town is surrounded by miles and miles of open country.
This part of Africa is rich farming country.
superb walking country
Explore Thomas Hardy country.
definitions.definition_vi: một diện tích đất, đặc biệt là với các đặc điểm vật lý cụ thể, phù hợp cho một mục đích cụ thể hoặc được kết nối với một người hoặc những người cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the people of a country; the nation as a whole
examples: They have the support of most of the country.
The rich benefited from the reforms, not the country as a whole.
The whole country is depending on you.
definitions.definition_vi: người dân một nước; đất nước nói chung

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a type of popular music in the style of the traditional music of the southern US, with singing and dance tunes played on violin, guitar and banjo
examples: pop, folk and country
definitions.definition_vi: một loại hình âm nhạc đại chúng theo phong cách âm nhạc truyền thống của miền Nam Hoa Kỳ, với các giai điệu ca hát và nhảy múa được chơi trên violin, guitar và banjo

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: directly across fields, etc.; not by a main road
examples: riding across country
definitions.definition_vi: trực tiếp trên các lĩnh vực, v.v.; không bằng đường chính

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to hold an election to choose a new parliament
definitions.definition_vi: tổ chức bầu cử để chọn ra quốc hội mới

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used as a reply when somebody suggests that you should not do something, or when somebody has asked permission or said they are going to do something
examples: It's a free country; I'll say what I like!
Wear what you like. It's a free country.
‘It's a free country!’ he shouted. ‘I can do what I like!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để trả lời khi ai đó gợi ý rằng bạn không nên làm điều gì đó hoặc khi ai đó xin phép hoặc nói rằng họ sẽ làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, etc.
examples: The surrounding countryside is windswept and rocky.
magnificent views over open countryside
the beautiful countryside of Wales
Everyone should enjoy the right of access to the countryside.
the quieter pace of life in the countryside
definitions.definition_vi: đất bên ngoài các thị trấn và thành phố, với những cánh đồng, rừng cây, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: one of a number of areas that some countries are divided into, each with its own local government
examples: SEE ALSO Home Counties
rural counties west of the Mississippi
Oxfordshire and neighbouring counties
the southern/northern counties
Orange County
Originally, county boundaries often followed the course of a river.
the most dangerous stretch of road in the county
Most towns and villages throughout the county have experienced a population increase.
Children from schools across the county will be taking part.
Public meetings are being planned at various locations around the county.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong số các khu vực được chia thành một số quốc gia, mỗi khu vực có chính quyền địa phương riêng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a sudden change of government that is illegal and often violent
examples: SEE ALSO palace coup
He seized power in a military coup in 2008.
to stage/mount a coup
He was sentenced to death for his part in the attempted coup.
a failed/an abortive coup
She lost her position in a boardroom coup (= a sudden change of power among senior managers in a company).
definitions.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi đột ngột của chính phủ đó là bất hợp pháp và thường bạo lực

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the fact of achieving something that was difficult to do
examples: Getting this contract has been quite a coup for us.
He pulled off a major diplomatic coup by winning agreement from all the warring factions on a permanent ceasefire.
definitions.definition_vi: thực tế là đạt được điều gì đó khó thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the ability to do something dangerous, or to face pain or opposition, without showing fear
examples: SYNONYM bravery
He showed great courage and determination.
moral/physical courage
They had the courage to stand up and fight for what they believed in.
He couldn't find the courage to tell his daughters what had happened.
Many said that the women's stories gave them the courage to pursue their goals
I haven't yet plucked up the courage to ask her.
It takes courage to sing in public.
His courage in battle won him a promotion.
She displayed remarkable courage in the face of danger.
I admire your courage in saying what you think.
They fought with courage, but were no match for the enemy.
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng làm điều gì đó nguy hiểm, hoặc đối mặt với nỗi đau hoặc sự chống đối mà không tỏ ra sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be/not be brave enough to do what you feel to be right
examples: You need to have the courage of your convictions.
definitions.definition_vi: đủ/không đủ dũng cảm để làm những gì bạn cho là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to force yourself to be brave enough to do something
examples: I finally screwed up my courage and went to the dentist.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc bản thân phải đủ dũng cảm để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to begin to feel happier and more confident because of something
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu cảm thấy hạnh phúc hơn và tự tin hơn vì điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to make yourself do something that you are afraid of
examples: Taking her courage in both hands, she opened the door and walked in.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc bản thân phải làm điều gì đó mà bạn sợ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to place something over or in front of something in order to hide, protect or decorate it
examples: Cover the chicken loosely with foil.
She covered her face with her hands.
I covered my mouth to stifle a yawn.
He laughed to cover (= hide) his nervousness.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt cái gì đó lên trên hoặc phía trước cái gì đó để che giấu, bảo vệ hoặc trang trí nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to lie or spread over the surface of something
examples: Snow covered the ground.
Much of the country is covered by forest.
Its head, body, and tail are completely covered with brown fur.
His chest was covered in bruises.
definitions.definition_vi: nằm hoặc trải rộng trên bề mặt của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to put or spread a layer of liquid, dust, etc. on somebody/something
examples: The wind blew in from the desert and covered everything with sand.
Soak the dried mushrooms by covering them in boiling water for a few minutes.
The steps were now completely covered with water.
The players were soon covered in mud.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt hoặc trải một lớp chất lỏng, bụi, v.v. lên ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to include something; to deal with something
examples: The lectures covered a lot of ground (= a lot of material, subjects, etc.).
The survey covers all aspects of the business.
The articles cover a wide range of subjects.
Each podcast covers a different topic.
the sales team covering the northern part of the country (= selling to people in that area)
Do the rules cover (= do they apply to) a case like this?
Don't worry. I've got it covered (= I'm dealing with it).
definitions.definition_vi: bao gồm một cái gì đó; để đối phó với một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to be or provide enough money for something
examples: $100 should cover your expenses.
The show barely covered its costs.
Your parents will have to cover your tuition fees.
definitions.definition_vi: được hoặc cung cấp đủ tiền cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to travel the distance mentioned
examples: By sunset we had covered thirty miles.
They walked for a long time and covered a good deal of ground.
definitions.definition_vi: để đi du lịch khoảng cách được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to spread over the area mentioned
examples: The reserve covers an area of some 1 140 square kilometres.
definitions.definition_vi: để trải rộng trên khu vực được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to report on an event for television, a newspaper, etc.; to show an event on television
examples: She's covering the party's annual conference.
The BBC will cover all the major games of the tournament.
The media has consistently refused to cover the story.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa tin về một sự kiện trên truyền hình, báo chí, v.v.; để hiển thị một sự kiện trên truyền hình

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to do somebody’s work or duties while they are away
examples: I'm covering for Jane while she's on leave.
definitions.definition_vi: làm công việc hoặc nhiệm vụ của ai đó khi họ đi vắng

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to invent a lie or an excuse that will stop somebody from getting into trouble
examples: I have to go out for a minute—will you cover for me if anyone asks where I am?
definitions.definition_vi: phát minh ra một lời nói dối hoặc một cái cớ để ngăn chặn ai đó gặp rắc rối

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to protect somebody against loss, injury, etc. by insurance
examples: Are you fully covered for fire and theft?
Does this policy cover my husband to drive?
definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ ai đó chống lại sự mất mát, thương tích, vv bằng bảo hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to take action in order to protect yourself against being blamed for something
examples: Many firms put money aside to cover themselves against possible legal claims.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động để bảo vệ bản thân khỏi bị đổ lỗi cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to protect somebody by threatening to shoot at anyone who tries to attack them
examples: Cover me while I move forward.
The artillery gave us covering fire (= shot to protect us).
definitions.definition_vi: bảo vệ ai đó bằng cách đe dọa bắn vào bất cứ ai cố gắng tấn công họ

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to aim a gun at a place or person so that nobody can escape or shoot
examples: The police covered the exits to the building.
Don't move—we've got you covered!
definitions.definition_vi: nhắm súng vào một nơi hoặc một người để không ai có thể trốn thoát hoặc bắn

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to record a new version of a song that was originally recorded by another band or singer
examples: They've covered an old Rolling Stones number.
definitions.definition_vi: để ghi lại một phiên bản mới của một bài hát ban đầu được ghi lại bởi một ban nhạc hoặc ca sĩ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to consider and deal with all the things that could happen or could be needed when you are arranging something
examples: I am confident this contract covers all the bases.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét và giải quyết tất cả những điều có thể xảy ra hoặc có thể cần thiết khi bạn đang sắp xếp một việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to realize that you may be blamed or criticized for something later and take action to avoid this
examples: Get everything in writing in order to cover your back.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận ra rằng sau này bạn có thể bị đổ lỗi hoặc bị chỉ trích vì điều gì đó và hành động để tránh điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to hide the real situation or facts when these are not good or pleasant
examples: She was dressed in loose comfortable clothes that hid a multitude of sins.
definitions.definition_vi: để che giấu tình hình hoặc sự kiện thực tế khi những điều này không tốt hoặc không dễ chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to try and hide what you have done, because you do not want other people to find out about it
examples: He had attempted to cover his tracks by making her death appear like suicide.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng che giấu việc mình đã làm vì không muốn người khác biết về việc đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the reporting of news and sport in the media
examples: media/newspaper/press coverage
tonight’s live coverage of the hockey game
There was blanket coverage (= reports everywhere) of the royal divorce.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa tin tức và thể thao trên các phương tiện truyền thông

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the range or quality of information that is included in a book or course of study, on television, etc.
examples: magazines with extensive coverage of diet and health topics
The book gives good, general coverage of the subject.
The volume offers incomplete coverage of the history of philosophy.
definitions.definition_vi: phạm vi hoặc chất lượng của thông tin có trong sách hoặc khóa học, trên truyền hình, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the amount of something that something provides; the extent to which something covers an area or a group of people
examples: Immunization coverage against fatal diseases has increased to 99 per cent in some countries.
The service has a coverage of 90 per cent of the UK population.
definitions.definition_vi: số lượng của một cái gì đó mà một cái gì đó cung cấp; mức độ mà một cái gì đó bao gồm một khu vực hoặc một nhóm người

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: protection that an insurance company provides by promising to pay you money if a particular event happens
examples: insurance coverage
Medicaid health coverage for low-income families
definitions.definition_vi: sự bảo vệ mà công ty bảo hiểm cung cấp bằng cách hứa trả tiền cho bạn nếu một sự kiện cụ thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to break without dividing into separate parts; to break something in this way
examples: The ice cracked as I stepped onto it.
He has cracked a bone in his arm.
definitions.definition_vi: phá vỡ mà không chia thành các phần riêng biệt; phá vỡ một cái gì đó theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to break open or into pieces; to break something in this way
examples: A chunk of the cliff had cracked off in a storm.
His face cracked into a smile.
to crack a nut
She cracked an egg into the pan.
definitions.definition_vi: vỡ ra hoặc thành từng mảnh; phá vỡ một cái gì đó theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to hit something/somebody in a short hard manner
examples: I cracked my head on the low ceiling.
He cracked me on the head with a ruler.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh cái gì/ai đó một cách mạnh mẽ trong thời gian ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to make a sharp sound; to make something do this
examples: A shot cracked across the ridge.
He cracked his whip and galloped away.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra âm thanh sắc nét; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: if your voice cracks, it changes in depth, volume, etc. suddenly and in a way that you cannot control
examples: In a voice cracking with emotion, he told us of his son's death.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu giọng nói của bạn bị vỡ, nó sẽ thay đổi độ sâu, âm lượng, v.v. một cách đột ngột và theo cách mà bạn không thể kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to no longer be able to function normally because of pressure
examples: Things are terrible at work and people are cracking under the strain.
They questioned him for days before he cracked.
The old institutions are cracking.
definitions.definition_vi: không còn có thể hoạt động bình thường vì áp lực

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to find the solution to a problem, etc; to find the way to do something difficult
examples: to crack the enemy’s code
After a year in this job I think I've got it cracked!
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm ra giải pháp cho một vấn đề, v.v; tìm ra cách để làm điều gì đó khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to find a way of stopping or defeating a criminal or an enemy
examples: Police have cracked a major drugs ring.
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm cách ngăn chặn hoặc đánh bại một tên tội phạm hoặc kẻ thù

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to open a bottle, especially of wine, and drink it
definitions.definition_vi: mở một chai, đặc biệt là rượu vang, và uống nó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to tell a joke
definitions.definition_vi: kể một câu chuyện cười

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to use your authority or power to make somebody work very hard, usually by treating them in a strict way
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng quyền hạn hoặc quyền lực của bạn để làm cho ai đó làm việc rất chăm chỉ, thường bằng cách đối xử với họ một cách nghiêm khắc

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to make jokes
examples: This entertainer can crack wise with the best of them.
definitions.definition_vi: làm trò đùa

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to begin immediately and work quickly
examples: SYNONYM get going
There's a lot to be done, so let's get cracking.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu ngay lập tức và làm việc nhanh chóng

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: a difficult problem or situation to deal with
definitions.definition_vi: một vấn đề hoặc tình huống khó giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: not as good as people say
examples: He's not nearly such a good writer as he's cracked up to be.
definitions.definition_vi: không tốt như mọi người nói

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to use more force than is necessaryWord Origin
examples: Old English cracian ‘make an explosive noise’; of Germanic origin; related to Dutch kraken and German krachen. Sense (8) of the noun is from Irish craic ‘entertaining conversation’.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng nhiều lực hơn mức cần thiếtNguồn gốc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an activity involving a special skill at making things with your hands
examples: SEE ALSO arts and crafts
traditional crafts like basket-weaving
a craft fair/workshop
definitions.definition_vi: một hoạt động liên quan đến một kỹ năng đặc biệt trong việc làm mọi thứ bằng tay của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: all the skills needed for a particular activity
examples: chefs who learned their craft in top hotels
the writer’s craft
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả các kỹ năng cần thiết cho một hoạt động cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: skill in making people believe what you want them to believe
examples: He knew how to win by craft and diplomacy what he could not gain by force.
definitions.definition_vi: kỹ năng khiến mọi người tin vào điều bạn muốn họ tin

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a boat or ship
examples: SEE ALSO landing craft
Hundreds of small craft bobbed around the liner as it steamed into the harbour.
a landing/pleasure craft
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc thuyền hoặc một con tàu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: an aircraft or spacecraftWord Origin
examples: Old English cræft ‘strength, skill’, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch kracht, German Kraft, and Swedish kraft ‘strength’. Sense (4), originally in the expression small craft ‘small trading vessels’, may be elliptical, referring to vessels requiring a small amount of “craft” or skill to handle, as opposed to large ocean-going ships.
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc máy bay hoặc tàu vũ trụNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an accident in which a vehicle hits something, for example another vehicle, usually causing damage and often injuring or killing the passengers

examples: noun sense 1 Middle English: from Middle Low German or Middle Dutch; related to Dutch dam and German Damm, also to Old English fordemman ‘close up’. noun sense 2 late Middle English (denoting a human mother): alteration of dame.
definitions.definition_vi: một tấm cao su nhỏ dùng để bảo vệ miệng khi quan hệ Nguồn gốc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used as the past tense of ‘can’
examples: She said that she couldn't come.
I couldn't hear what they were saying.
Sorry, I couldn't get any more.
definitions.definition_vi: được dùng ở thì quá khứ của ‘can’

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to ask if you can do something
examples: Could I use your phone, please?
Could we stop by next week?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để hỏi xem bạn có thể làm gì đó không

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to politely ask somebody to do something for you
examples: Could you babysit for us on Friday?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để lịch sự yêu cầu ai đó làm gì cho bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to show that something is or might be possible
examples: I could do it now, if you like.
Don't worry—they could have just forgotten to call.
You couldn't have left it on the bus, could you?
‘Have some more cake.’ ‘Oh, I couldn't, thank you (= I'm too full).’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó là hoặc có thể có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to suggest something
examples: We could write a letter to the director.
You could always try his home number.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để gợi ý điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show that you are annoyed that somebody did not do something
examples: They could have let me know they were going to be late!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn đang khó chịu vì ai đó đã không làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to emphasize how strongly you want to express your feelings
examples: I'm so fed up I could scream!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh mức độ bạn muốn bày tỏ cảm xúc của mình

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to say that you need or would like to have something
examples: I could do with a drink!
Her hair could have done with a wash.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn cần hoặc muốn có một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: professional advice about a problem
examples: The couple decided to go for relationship counselling.
Some groups offer bereavement counselling.
a student counselling service
definitions.definition_vi: lời khuyên chuyên nghiệp về một vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to say numbers in the correct order
examples: Billy can't count yet.
She can count up to 10 in Italian.
to count from 1 to 10
definitions.definition_vi: nói các số theo đúng thứ tự

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to calculate the total number of people, things, etc. in a particular group
examples: They're still counting votes in Texas.
I can't count the number of times I've eaten there (= I've eaten there very many times).
The diet is based on counting calories.
She began to count up how many guests they had to invite.
There are twelve weeks to go, counting from today.
definitions.definition_vi: để tính tổng số người, đồ vật, v.v. trong một nhóm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to include somebody/something when you calculate a total
examples: We have invited 50 people, not counting the children.
The tour guide was sure one person was missing from the group until she realized she had forgotten to count herself.
definitions.definition_vi: bao gồm ai đó/cái gì đó khi bạn tính tổng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be important
examples: SYNONYM matter
It is going to be a close election, so every vote counts.
Every point in this game counts.
With our busy lives today we have less and less time for what really counts.
It's the thought that counts (= used about a small but kind action or gift).
The fact that she had apologized counted for nothing with him.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to be officially accepted; to accept something officially
examples: Don't go over that line or your throw won't count.
The goal wouldn't have counted anyway, because the linesman's flag was up for offside.
The home team's manager protested that the run should count.
Applications received after 1 July will not be counted.
definitions.definition_vi: được chấp nhận chính thức; chấp nhận một cái gì đó một cách chính thức

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to consider somebody/something in a particular way; to be considered in a particular way
examples: For tax purposes that money counts/is counted as income.
I count him among my closest friends.
I count myself lucky to have known him.
She counts herself one of the lucky ones.
I count it a privilege to have served alongside him.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét ai đó/cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể; được xem xét theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that a total is continuing to increase
examples: The movie's ticket sales add up to $39 million, and counting.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng tổng số đang tiếp tục tăng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to say that the total number of somebody/something is very small
examples: She could count on the fingers of one hand the people she actually enjoyed being with.
Although she knew lots of people, she could count her friends on the fingers of one hand.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng tổng số lượng ai đó/cái gì đó rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be grateful for the good things in your life
definitions.definition_vi: biết ơn những điều tốt đẹp trong cuộc sống của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to feel the bad effects of a mistake, an accident, etc.
examples: The town is now counting the cost of its failure to provide adequate flood protection.
definitions.definition_vi: để cảm thấy những ảnh hưởng xấu của một sai lầm, một tai nạn, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to imagine that sheep are jumping over a fence and to count them, as a way of getting to sleep
definitions.definition_vi: tưởng tượng rằng những con cừu đang nhảy qua hàng rào và đếm chúng như một cách để đi vào giấc ngủ

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: you should not be too confident that something will be successful, because something may still go wrong
definitions.definition_vi: bạn không nên quá tự tin rằng điều gì đó sẽ thành công, vì có thể vẫn có điều gì đó không ổn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to say publicly that you support somebody or you agree with something
examples: Everyone needs to stand up and be counted in order to make them see the strength of our conviction.
definitions.definition_vi: nói công khai rằng bạn ủng hộ ai đó hoặc bạn đồng ý với điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: used to say that you do not care how many times something happens
examples: I've seen the film five times, but who's counting?
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng bạn không quan tâm điều gì đó xảy ra bao nhiêu lần

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a long flat surface over which goods are sold or business is done in a shop, bank, etc.
examples: I asked the woman behind the counter if they had any postcards.
definitions.definition_vi: một bề mặt phẳng dài trên đó hàng hóa được bán hoặc kinh doanh được thực hiện trong cửa hàng, ngân hàng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on
examples: She put her bags down on the kitchen counter.
The kitchen had black marble counter tops.
definitions.definition_vi: một bề mặt phẳng trong nhà bếp để chuẩn bị thức ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a small disc used for playing or scoring in some board games
examples: SEE ALSO bargaining counter
definitions.definition_vi: một cái đĩa nhỏ dùng để chơi hoặc ghi điểm trong một số trò chơi trên bàn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an electronic device for counting something
examples: SEE ALSO Geiger counter
The needle on the rev counter soared.
You need to reset the counter.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện tử để đếm một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a person who counts something, for example votes in an election
examples: SEE ALSO bean counter

definitions.definition_vi: một người đếm một cái gì đó, ví dụ như phiếu bầu trong một cuộc bầu cử

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a response to somebody/something that opposes their ideas, position, etc.
examples: The employers' association was seen as a counter to union power.
definitions.definition_vi: một phản ứng đối với ai đó/điều gì đó phản đối ý tưởng, quan điểm của họ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: goods, especially medicines, for sale over the counter can be bought without a prescription (= written permission from a doctor to buy a medicine) or special licence
examples: SEE ALSO over-the-counter
These tablets are available over the counter.
This kind of medication cannot be bought over the counter.
definitions.definition_vi: hàng hóa, đặc biệt là thuốc, bán qua quầy có thể được mua mà không cần toa bác sĩ (= sự cho phép bằng văn bản của bác sĩ để mua thuốc) hoặc giấy phép đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: goods that are bought or sold under the counter are sold secretly and sometimes illegally
examples: SEE ALSO under-the-counter
Pornography may be legally banned but it is still available under the counter.
definitions.definition_vi: hàng hóa được mua hoặc bán tại quầy được bán bí mật và đôi khi trái pháp luật

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject
examples: SEE ALSO access course
a French/chemistry course
He took a course in Russian language and literature.
I want to do a course in art and design.
The department offers short courses in drama, fiction, and poetry.
She teaches a course on internet crime.
My boss has been on a course this week.
You need to go on a management training course.
He has recently completed the five-week course.
The college runs specialist language courses.
I enrolled in a ten-week online course.
definitions.definition_vi: một loạt các bài học hoặc bài giảng về một chủ đề cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a period of study at a college or university that leads to an exam or a qualification
examples: COMPARE programme
What degree course did you choose?
a two-year postgraduate course leading to a master’s degree
He was able to design his own course of study.
definitions.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian học tập tại một trường cao đẳng hoặc đại học dẫn đến một kỳ thi hoặc bằng cấp

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a large area of land that is designed for playing golf on
examples: He set a new course record.
definitions.definition_vi: một vùng đất rộng lớn được thiết kế để chơi gôn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an area of land or water where races are held
examples: SEE ALSO assault course
She was overtaken on the last stretch of the course.
Only ten yachts completed the course.
definitions.definition_vi: diện tích đất hoặc nước nơi các cuộc đua được tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: any of the separate parts of a meal
examples: a four-course dinner
The main course was roast duck.
We had chicken for our main course.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ phần riêng biệt nào của bữa ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a direction or route followed by a ship or an aircraft
examples: He radioed the pilot to change course.
The plane was off course (= not going in the right direction).
We're on course for our destination.
definitions.definition_vi: một hướng hoặc tuyến đường theo sau bởi một con tàu hoặc một chiếc máy bay

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the general direction in which somebody’s ideas or actions are moving or in which things are developing
examples: The president appears likely to change course on some key issues.
The dollar fell sharply for two days, and then reversed course.
Her career followed a similar course to her sister's.
Politicians are often obliged to steer a course between incompatible interests.
definitions.definition_vi: hướng chung trong đó ý tưởng hoặc hành động của ai đó đang di chuyển hoặc trong đó mọi thứ đang phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a way of acting in or dealing with a particular situation
examples: There are various courses open to us.
What course of action would you recommend?
It was the best course of action to take in the circumstances.
The wisest course would be to say nothing.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách hành động trong hoặc đối phó với một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: the way something develops or should develop
examples: This was an event that changed the course of history.
The unexpected course of events aroused considerable alarm.
She repeatedly raised the issue during the course of the campaign.
definitions.definition_vi: cách một cái gì đó phát triển hoặc nên phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the direction a river moves in
examples: The path follows the course of the river.
definitions.definition_vi: hướng một dòng sông di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: a series of medical treatments, tablets, etc.
examples: to prescribe a course of antibiotics
When taking antibiotics it is important to finish the course.
definitions.definition_vi: một loạt các phương pháp điều trị y tế, máy tính bảng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: a continuous layer of brick, stone or other building material in a wall
examples: SEE ALSO damp course
A new damp-proof course could cost £1 000 or more.
definitions.definition_vi: một lớp gạch, đá hoặc vật liệu xây dựng khác liên tục trên tường

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be in a situation that is almost certain to cause an argument
examples: I was on a collision course with my boss over the sales figures.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong một tình huống gần như chắc chắn sẽ gây ra tranh cãi

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to be moving in a direction in which it is likely that you will crash into somebody/something
examples: A giant iceberg was on a collision course with the ship.
definitions.definition_vi: đang di chuyển theo hướng mà có khả năng bạn sẽ đâm vào ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to be just what you would expect to happen or expect somebody to do in a particular situation
examples: SYNONYM norm
Starting early and working long hours is par for the course in this job.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ là những gì bạn mong đợi xảy ra hoặc mong đợi ai đó làm trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: the act of matching people with suitable jobs or tasks
definitions.definition_vi: hành động kết nối mọi người với công việc hoặc nhiệm vụ phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: going through a particular process
examples: The new textbook is in course of preparation.
definitions.definition_vi: trải qua một quá trình cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: during
examples: He's seen many changes in the course of his long life.
The company faces major challenges over the course of the next few years.
definitions.definition_vi: trong lúc

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: when enough time has passed
examples: SYNONYM eventually
It is possible that in the course of time a cure for cancer will be found.
In the course of time, I began to understand.
definitions.definition_vi: khi đã đủ thời gian trôi qua

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: at the right time and not before
examples: Your request will be dealt with in due course.
definitions.definition_vi: vào đúng thời điểm và không phải trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: as things usually happen
examples: SYNONYM normally
In the normal course of things we would not treat her disappearance as suspicious.
In the normal course of events, you should get a reply by Monday.
definitions.definition_vi: như những điều thường xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to allow natural processes to happen, without trying to stop or change them (used especially in the context of illness)
examples: The midwife must judge when to let nature take its course and when to intervene.
When the dog responded so badly to the treatment, we decided to let nature take its course.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép các quá trình tự nhiên xảy ra mà không cố gắng ngăn chặn hoặc thay đổi chúng (đặc biệt được sử dụng trong bối cảnh bệnh tật)

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: (as) the usual and correct thing to do
examples: We always check people's addresses as a matter of course.
definitions.definition_vi: (như) điều thông thường và đúng đắn để làm

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: (to take/find) an acceptable course of action that avoids two extreme positions
definitions.definition_vi: (thực hiện/tìm) một hành động có thể chấp nhận được nhằm tránh hai quan điểm cực đoan

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true or correct
examples: ‘Don't you like my mother?’ ‘Of course I do!’
‘Will you be there?’ ‘Course I will.’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng những gì bạn đang nói là đúng hoặc chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: used as a polite way of giving somebody permission to do something
examples: ‘Can I come, too?’ ‘Course you can.’
‘Can I have one of those pens?’ ‘Of course—help yourself.’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một cách lịch sự để cho phép ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: used as a polite way of agreeing with what somebody has just said
examples: ‘I did all I could to help.’ ‘Of course,’ he murmured gently.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một cách lịch sự để đồng ý với những gì ai đó vừa nói

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: used to show that what you are saying is not surprising or is generally known or accepted
examples: Ben, of course, was the last to arrive.
Of course, there are other ways of doing this.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng những gì bạn đang nói không có gì đáng ngạc nhiên hoặc được biết đến hoặc chấp nhận rộng rãi

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: used to emphasize the fact that you are saying ‘no’
