My brother has a master's degree from Harvard.
She's pursuing a degree in biochemistry.
a four-year degree course
an undergraduate/graduate/doctoral degree
a law/medical degree
definitions.definition_vi: bằng cấp đạt được của những sinh viên hoàn thành thành công khóa học đại học hoặc cao đẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a university or college course, normally lasting three years or more
examples: I'm hoping to do a chemistry degree.
He took a degree in law then joined a law firm.
definitions.definition_vi: một khóa học đại học hoặc cao đẳng, thường kéo dài ba năm hoặc hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a level in a scale of how serious something is
examples: SEE ALSO second-degree
murder in the first degree (= of the most serious kind)
first-degree murder
third-degree (= very serious) burns
definitions.definition_vi: một mức độ trong thang đo mức độ nghiêm trọng của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: slowly and gradually
examples: By degrees their friendship grew into love.
By slow degrees, the company's turnover dwindled to nothing.
definitions.definition_vi: từ từ và dần dần

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: extremely; to an extreme degree
examples: The children tested her patience to the nth degree.
definitions.definition_vi: vô cùng; đến một mức độ cực đoan

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: done on purpose rather than by accident
examples: SYNONYM intentional
a deliberate act of vandalism
The speech was a deliberate attempt to embarrass the government.
a deliberate lie/deception
definitions.definition_vi: được thực hiện có mục đích chứ không phải do vô tình

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: done slowly and carefully
examples: She spoke in a slow and deliberate way.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện chậm rãi và cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a very strong request for something; something that somebody needs
examples: a demand for higher pay
demands that the law on gun ownership should be changed
A federal judge rejected their demands.
The management had no intention of meeting union demands.
definitions.definition_vi: một yêu cầu rất mạnh mẽ cho một cái gì đó; thứ gì đó mà ai đó cần

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: things that somebody/something makes you do, especially things that are difficult, make you tired, worried, etc.
examples: Juggling the demands of work and family is never easy.
She shouldn't always give in to his demands.
As a director he makes huge demands on his actors.
Flying makes enormous demands on pilots.
definitions.definition_vi: những việc mà ai đó/việc gì đó bắt bạn làm, đặc biệt là những việc khó khăn, khiến bạn mệt mỏi, lo lắng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the desire or need of customers for goods or services that they want to buy or use
examples: SEE ALSO print on demand
Demand is exceeding supply.
It is becoming more difficult for us to meet demand.
Consumer demand for organic foods continues to increase rapidly.
We are struggling to satisfy the demand for the product.
We are seeing an increased demand for housing in the area.
increasing/growing/rising demand
to stimulate/boost/increase demand
definitions.definition_vi: mong muốn hoặc nhu cầu của khách hàng về hàng hóa, dịch vụ mà họ muốn mua hoặc sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: because a lot of people have asked for something
examples: By popular demand, the play will run for another week.
definitions.definition_vi: bởi vì rất nhiều người đã yêu cầu một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: wanted by a lot of people
examples: Good secretaries are always in demand.
definitions.definition_vi: được nhiều người mong muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: done or happening whenever somebody asks
examples: SEE ALSO on-demand
Feed the baby on demand.
The service allows you to watch video on demand.
Campaigners insist that abortion should be available on demand.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện hoặc xảy ra bất cứ khi nào ai đó yêu cầu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence
examples: New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.
These paintings demonstrate his extraordinary ability as a portrait painter.
The award demonstrated the importance that local people place on road safety.
This new anthology amply demonstrates the range and vitality of modern Scottish poetry.
This study clearly demonstrates how fishing can affect an ecosystem.
Let me demonstrate to you some of the difficulties we are facing.
The theories were demonstrated to be false.
It has been demonstrated that this drug is effective.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị một cái gì đó rõ ràng bằng cách đưa ra bằng chứng hoặc bằng chứng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to show by your actions that you have a particular quality, feeling or opinion
examples: SYNONYM display
The team demonstrated breathtaking skills.
We want to demonstrate our commitment to human rights.
Students must demonstrate a willingness to work with others.
definitions.definition_vi: để thể hiện bằng hành động của bạn rằng bạn có một phẩm chất, cảm giác hoặc quan điểm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to show and explain how something works or how to do something
examples: Her job involves demonstrating new educational software.
The gallery's experts demonstrated some conservation techniques.
The system was demonstrated to officials from 17 countries.
Let me demonstrate to you how it works.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị và giải thích cách một cái gì đó hoạt động hoặc làm thế nào để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to take part in a public meeting or march (= an organized walk by many people), usually as a protest or to show support for something
examples: Hundreds of protesters demonstrated outside the court.
students demonstrating against the war
Their objective was to demonstrate peacefully for civil rights.
They are demonstrating in support of free higher education.
definitions.definition_vi: tham gia vào một cuộc họp hoặc tuần hành công cộng (= một cuộc đi bộ có tổ chức của nhiều người), thường là để phản đối hoặc thể hiện sự ủng hộ cho điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a statement that something is not true or does not exist; the action of denying something
examples: the prisoner’s repeated denials of the charges against him
The terrorists issued a denial of responsibility for the attack.
There was an official denial that there would be an election before the end of the year.
She shook her head in denial.
definitions.definition_vi: một tuyên bố rằng một cái gì đó là không đúng sự thật hoặc không tồn tại; hành động phủ nhận điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an act of refusing to allow somebody to have something they have a right to expect
examples: Pressure groups have drawn attention to the denial of human rights in some areas.
The advertising ban is a denial of freedom of speech.
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động từ chối cho phép ai đó có được thứ mà họ có quyền mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of refusing to accept that something unpleasant or painful is true
examples: The patient is still in denial.
Some people are in denial about the situation.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động từ chối chấp nhận điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc đau đớn là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person whose job is to take care of people’s teeth
examples: to see/visit/consult your dentist
the dentist's chair/drill
definitions.definition_vi: một người có công việc là chăm sóc răng miệng cho mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a place where a dentist sees patients
examples: I hate going to the dentist.
an appointment at the dentist’s
She couldn’t get treatment because she wasn’t registered with the dentist.
definitions.definition_vi: nơi mà nha sĩ gặp bệnh nhân

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a section of a large organization such as a government, business, university, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO police department
the Department of Health
He is a lecturer in the department of psychology at Trinity College, Dublin.
the Treasury Department
a government/university, etc. department
the marketing/sales, etc. department
The children's department (= in a large store) sells a wide range of good quality clothes.
the English department
She used to work in the IT department.
He later served as head of the art history department.
definitions.definition_vi: một bộ phận của một tổ chức lớn như chính phủ, doanh nghiệp, trường đại học, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be something that somebody is responsible for or knows a lot about
examples: Don't ask me about it—that's her department.
definitions.definition_vi: là cái gì đó mà ai đó chịu trách nhiệm hoặc biết nhiều về

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: in a particular aspect or quality
examples: He doesn't have much going for him in the brains department, to be honest.
Movies lacking in the story department can still succeed.
definitions.definition_vi: ở một khía cạnh hoặc chất lượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of moving soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action
examples: the deployment of peacekeeping forces
troop deployments
definitions.definition_vi: hành động di chuyển binh lính hoặc vũ khí vào vị trí sẵn sàng cho hành động quân sự

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of using something effectively
examples: the deployment of resources/staff
definitions.definition_vi: hành động sử dụng một cái gì đó một cách hiệu quả

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a sum of money that is given as the first part of a larger payment
examples: SYNONYM down payment
They normally ask you to pay $100 (as a) deposit.
All deposits are non-refundable.
We've put down a 5% deposit on the house.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền được đưa ra như là phần đầu tiên của khoản thanh toán lớn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sum of money that is paid by somebody when they rent something and that is returned to them if they do not lose or damage the thing they are renting
examples: SEE ALSO security deposit
to pay a deposit
They'll probably ask you to leave a deposit.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền được ai đó trả khi họ thuê một thứ gì đó và số tiền đó sẽ được trả lại cho họ nếu họ không làm mất hoặc hư hỏng thứ họ đang thuê

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a sum of money that is paid into a bank account
examples: SEE ALSO direct deposit
Deposits can be made at any branch.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền được trả vào tài khoản ngân hàng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: (in the British political system) the amount of money that a candidate in an election to Parliament has to pay, and that is returned if he/she gets enough votes
examples: All the other candidates lost their deposits.
definitions.definition_vi: (trong hệ thống chính trị của Anh) số tiền mà một ứng cử viên trong cuộc bầu cử vào Quốc hội phải trả và số tiền đó sẽ được trả lại nếu người đó nhận đủ số phiếu bầu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a layer of a substance that has formed naturally underground
examples: mineral/gold/coal deposits
definitions.definition_vi: một lớp chất được hình thành tự nhiên dưới lòng đất

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a layer of a substance that has been left somewhere, especially by a river, flood, etc., or is found at the bottom of a liquid
examples: The rain left a deposit of mud on the windows.
fatty deposits in the arteries of the heart
glacial deposits
The floods left a thick deposit of mud over the fields.
definitions.definition_vi: một lớp chất bị bỏ lại ở đâu đó, đặc biệt là do sông, lũ lụt, v.v., hoặc được tìm thấy ở đáy chất lỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: placed in a deposit account
examples: With interest rates so low, there is little point in having cash on deposit.
definitions.definition_vi: được gửi vào tài khoản tiền gửi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a medical condition in which a person feels very sad and anxious and often has physical symptoms such as being unable to sleep, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO postnatal depression
She was diagnosed as having clinical depression.
She suffered from severe depression after losing her job.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình trạng bệnh lý trong đó một người cảm thấy rất buồn và lo lắng và thường có các triệu chứng thực thể như không thể ngủ được, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the state of feeling very sad and without hope
examples: There was a feeling of gloom and depression in the office when the news of the job cuts was announced.
definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái cảm thấy rất buồn và không có hy vọng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a period when there is little economic activity and many people are poor or without jobs
examples: The country was in the grip of (an) economic depression.
the great Depression of the 1930s
He grew up during the Great Depression of the 1930s.
definitions.definition_vi: thời kỳ có ít hoạt động kinh tế và nhiều người nghèo hoặc không có việc làm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a part of a surface that is lower than the parts around it
examples: SYNONYM hollow
Rainwater collects in shallow depressions on the ground.
From the air, the photos show a shallow depression on the planet's surface.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của bề mặt thấp hơn các phần xung quanh nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a weather condition in which the pressure of the air becomes lower, often causing rain
examples: COMPARE anticyclone
an atmospheric depression moving east from the Atlantic
definitions.definition_vi: điều kiện thời tiết trong đó áp suất không khí trở nên thấp hơn, thường gây ra mưa

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something; a particular distance down from the surface of something
examples: What's the depth of the water here?
the depth of a cut/wound/crack
Water was found at a depth of 30 metres.
They dug down to a depth of two metres.
Many dolphins can dive to depths of 200 metres.
The oil well extended several hundreds of feet in depth.
The camera must be strong enough to resist the immense water pressure at depth.
Most earthquakes occur at much shallower depths, usually less than 30 kilometres.
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng cách từ đỉnh hoặc bề mặt tới đáy của một vật nào đó; một khoảng cách cụ thể từ bề mặt của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the distance from the front to the back of something
examples: The depth of the shelves is 30 centimetres.
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng cách từ phía trước đến phía sau của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the strength and power of feelings
examples: the depth of her love
music of great emotional depth
definitions.definition_vi: sức mạnh và sức mạnh của cảm xúc

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: qualities that give somebody/something extra character and make them/it interesting
examples: The separate storylines really add depth and personality to the characters.
This film lacks the complexity or depth of his best movies.
Her paintings reveal hidden depths (= unknown and interesting things about her character).
definitions.definition_vi: những phẩm chất làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó có thêm tính cách và làm cho họ/nó trở nên thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the quality of knowing or understanding a lot of details about something; the ability to provide and explain these details
examples: SEE ALSO in-depth
a writer of great wisdom and depth
His ideas lack depth.
She has the ability to treat big subjects with breadth and depth.
a job that doesn’t require any great depth of knowledge
Younger students cannot be expected to have great depth of understanding.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng biết hoặc hiểu nhiều chi tiết về điều gì đó; khả năng cung cấp và giải thích những chi tiết này

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the deepest, most extreme or serious part of something
examples: the depths of the ocean
to live in the depths of the country (= a long way from a town)
in the depths of winter (= when it is coldest)
She was in the depths of despair.
He gazed into the depths of her eyes.
definitions.definition_vi: phần sâu nhất, cực đoan nhất hoặc nghiêm trọng nhất của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the strength of a colour
examples: Strong light will affect the depth of colour of your carpets and curtains.
definitions.definition_vi: sức mạnh của một màu sắc

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the quality in a work of art or a photograph that makes it appear not to be flat
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng của một tác phẩm nghệ thuật hoặc một bức ảnh khiến nó trông không bằng phẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be in water that is too deep to stand in with your head above water
examples: If you can't swim, don't go out of your depth.
I don't like going out of my depth in the sea.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong nước quá sâu để đứng với đầu trên mặt nước

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be unable to understand something because it is too difficult; to be in a situation that you cannot control
examples: He felt totally out of his depth in his new job.
The writer seems a little out of her depth when dealing with the emotional issue involved.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể hiểu điều gì đó vì nó quá khó; ở trong một tình huống mà bạn không thể kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: in a detailed, careful and complete way
examples: I haven't looked at the report in depth yet.
an in-depth study
I studied phonology in depth at college.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách chi tiết, cẩn thận và đầy đủ

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be or to experience an extreme example of something unpleasant
examples: His latest novel plumbs the depths of horror and violence.
It was at that stage in her life when she plumbed the depths of despair.
The team's poor performances plumbed new depths last night when they lost 10–2.
The story plumbed the depths of tabloid journalism.
definitions.definition_vi: được hoặc trải nghiệm một ví dụ cực đoan về một cái gì đó khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: the quality of being strong because you have a great variety of good people, ideas, etc. that can contribute to the success of something
examples: The French team does not have the strength in depth that the Australians have.
definitions.definition_vi: phẩm chất của sự mạnh mẽ bởi vì bạn có rất nhiều người tốt, ý tưởng, vv có thể góp phần vào sự thành công của một cái gì đó

definitions.definition: to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something
definitions.definition_vi: thu được, nhận được (đặc biệt là lợi ích hoặc niềm vui) từ một cái gì đó
examples: He derived great pleasure from painting.
They derived a lot of benefit from the experience.

definitions.definition: to come or develop from something
definitions.definition_vi: bắt nguồn từ, xuất phát từ (thường dùng ở dạng bị động hoặc đi với từ 'from')
examples: The word 'politics' is derived from a Greek word meaning 'city'.
Many English words derive from Latin.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to come or go down from a higher to a lower level
examples: OPPOSITE ascend
The plane began to descend.
The results, ranked in descending order (= from the highest to the lowest) are as follows…
She descended the stairs slowly.
definitions.definition_vi: đến hoặc đi xuống từ mức cao hơn đến mức thấp hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to slope downwards
examples: OPPOSITE ascend
At this point the path descends steeply.
definitions.definition_vi: dốc xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to arrive and begin to affect somebody/something
examples: SYNONYM fall
Night descends quickly in the tropics.
Calm descended on the crowd.
definitions.definition_vi: đến và bắt đầu ảnh hưởng đến ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an action of coming or going down
examples: OPPOSITE ascent
The plane began its descent to Heathrow.
the country’s swift descent into anarchy
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động đến hoặc đi xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a slope going downwards
examples: OPPOSITE ascent
There is a gradual descent to the sea.
definitions.definition_vi: một con dốc đi xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person’s family origins
examples: SYNONYM ancestry
to be of Scottish descent
He traces his line of descent from the Stuart kings.
definitions.definition_vi: nguồn gốc gia đình của một người

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a piece of writing or speech that says what somebody/something is like; the act of writing or saying in words what somebody/something is like
examples: Follow the link below for a more detailed description.
a brief description of the software
The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.
Police have issued a description of the gunman.
This is a film that defies description (= is difficult or impossible to describe).
the novelist’s powers of description
a personal pain that goes beyond description (= is too great to express in words)
definitions.definition_vi: một đoạn văn hoặc bài phát biểu nói lên ai đó/cái gì đó trông như thế nào; hành động viết hoặc nói bằng lời về ai đó/cái gì đó giống như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: of some, etc. type
examples: In the bay were boats of every description.
There were flying machines of all descriptions whizzing about.
Their money came from trade of some description.
The trunk was full of medals, coins and things of that description.
definitions.definition_vi: của một số, vv loại

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be like a particular person or thing
examples: A child answering the description of the missing boy was found safe and well in London yesterday.
We're all looking for quick, healthy meals, and pasta this fits this description.
definitions.definition_vi: giống như một người hoặc vật cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be too extreme, horrible, etc. to believe/describe
examples: It beggars belief how things could have got this bad.
definitions.definition_vi: quá cực đoan, khủng khiếp, v.v. để tin/mô tả

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand.
examples: the Sahara Desert
Somalia is mostly desert.
They travelled many miles across burning desert sands.
Occasionally, we passed a desert oasis surrounded by small tracts of grass and shrub.
The town has become a cultural desert (= a place without any culture).
definitions.definition_vi: một vùng đất rộng lớn có rất ít nước và rất ít cây trồng trên đó. Nhiều sa mạc được bao phủ bởi cát.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person whose job is to decide how things such as clothes, furniture, tools, etc. will look or work by making drawings, plans or patterns
examples: SEE ALSO interior designer
one of the country's top fashion designers
a graphic/web/game designer
definitions.definition_vi: một người có nhiệm vụ quyết định những thứ như quần áo, đồ nội thất, dụng cụ, v.v. sẽ trông như thế nào hoặc hoạt động như thế nào bằng cách tạo ra các bản vẽ, kế hoạch hoặc mẫu

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition: the general arrangement of the different parts of something that is made, such as a building, book, machine, etc.
examples: The basic design of the car is very similar to that of earlier models.
special new design features
The system has a fundamental design flaw.
The steel frame is left visible and is part of the overall design concept.
The magazine will appear in a new design from next month.
definitions.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp chung của các bộ phận khác nhau của một cái gì đó được tạo ra, chẳng hạn như một tòa nhà, cuốn sách, máy móc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the art or process of deciding how something will look, work, etc. by drawing plans, making computer models, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO interior design
the design and development of new products
I'm doing a course in art and design.
web/set/product design
a specialist in computer-aided design
a design studio
definitions.definition_vi: nghệ thuật hoặc quá trình quyết định một cái gì đó sẽ trông như thế nào, hoạt động như thế nào, v.v. bằng cách vẽ kế hoạch, tạo mô hình máy tính, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a drawing or plan from which something may be made
examples: He has created some new and original designs.
designs for aircraft
definitions.definition_vi: một bản vẽ hoặc kế hoạch mà từ đó một cái gì đó có thể được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an arrangement of lines and shapes as a decoration
examples: SYNONYM pattern
floral/abstract/geometric designs
The tiles come in a huge range of colours and designs.
The building has intricate geometric designs on several of the walls.
definitions.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp các đường nét và hình dạng như một vật trang trí

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a plan or an intention
examples: It happened—whether by accident or design—that the two of them were left alone after all the others had gone.
It is all part of his grand design.
definitions.definition_vi: một kế hoạch hoặc một ý định

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to want to start a sexual relationship with somebody
examples: He was quite aware of her marital designs on him.
definitions.definition_vi: muốn bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to be planning to get something for yourself, often in a way that other people do not approve of
examples: Rumours spread that the Duke had designs on the crown (= wanted to make himself king).
definitions.definition_vi: lên kế hoạch để có được thứ gì đó cho bản thân, thường theo cách mà người khác không chấp nhận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a strong wish to have or do something
examples: He now had enough money to satisfy all his desires.
a strong desire for power/revenge
She has a burning desire to be an artist.
I have no desire (= I do not want) to discuss the matter further.
He has expressed a desire to see you.
his father's desire that he become a lawyer
definitions.definition_vi: một mong muốn mạnh mẽ để có hoặc làm một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a strong wish to have sex with somebody
examples: sexual desire
She felt a surge of love and desire for him.
definitions.definition_vi: mong muốn mạnh mẽ được quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is wished for
examples: When she agreed to marry him, he felt he had achieved his heart's desire.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật được mong muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the state of being kept in a place, especially a prison, and prevented from leaving
examples: They were sentenced to 12 months' detention in a young offender institution.
police powers of arrest and detention
allegations of torture and detention without trial
a detention camp
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng bị giữ ở một nơi, đặc biệt là nhà tù, và bị ngăn cản rời đi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the punishment of being kept at school for a time after other students have gone home
examples: They can’t give me (a) detention for this.
definitions.definition_vi: hình phạt bị giữ lại trường một thời gian sau khi các học sinh khác đã về nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced, stronger, etc.; to make something do this
examples: The child is developing normally.
Some children develop more slowly than others.
Gradually these settlements developed into cities.
Human beings developed from earlier species of animals.
The place has rapidly developed from a small fishing community into a thriving tourist resort.
The aim is to develop your personal skills.
She developed the company from nothing.
The competition helps entrants develop ideas into business concepts.
definitions.definition_vi: dần dần phát triển hoặc trở nên lớn hơn, tiến bộ hơn, mạnh mẽ hơn, v.v.; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to start to have a skill, ability, quality, etc. that becomes better and stronger; to become better and stronger
examples: He's developed a real flair for management.
Their relationship has developed over a number of years.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu có một kỹ năng, khả năng, phẩm chất, v.v. trở nên tốt hơn và mạnh mẽ hơn; để trở nên tốt hơn và mạnh mẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to think of or produce a new idea, product, etc. and make it successful
examples: The company develops and markets new software.
It takes time to develop new technology.
We are developing products for different parts of the industry.
to develop a strategy/system/programme
to develop a method/model/technique
A new type of painkilling drug has recently been developed.
definitions.definition_vi: nghĩ ra hoặc tạo ra một ý tưởng, sản phẩm mới, v.v. và làm cho nó thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to begin to have something such as a disease or a problem; to start to affect somebody/something
examples: She developed lung cancer at the age of sixty.
Her son developed asthma when he was two.
The car developed engine trouble and we had to stop.
If symptoms develop, seek help quickly.
Problems can develop unexpectedly.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu có điều gì đó như bệnh tật hay vấn đề; bắt đầu ảnh hưởng đến ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to start to happen or change, especially in a bad way
examples: A crisis was rapidly developing in the Gulf.
We need more time to see how things develop before we take action.
The conflict quickly developed into full-scale war.
The situation is developing into a crisis.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu xảy ra hoặc thay đổi, đặc biệt là theo chiều hướng xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to build new houses, factories, etc. on an area of land, especially land that was not being used effectively before
examples: The site is being developed by a French company.
definitions.definition_vi: xây dựng nhà ở, nhà máy mới, v.v. trên một diện tích đất, đặc biệt là đất mà trước đây không được sử dụng hiệu quả

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to build or improve a building or other facilities
examples: The company is developing a chain of hotels.
He is enthusiastic about plans to develop the leisure facilities at the site.
definitions.definition_vi: để xây dựng hoặc cải thiện một tòa nhà hoặc các cơ sở khác

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to become economically and socially more advanced
examples: SEE ALSO developed (1)
There have been many attempts to explain why some countries develop whilst others remain in poverty.
China is developing at a pace that is remarkable to behold.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên tiên tiến hơn về mặt kinh tế và xã hội

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to add further explanation or details to an idea, story or musical theme
examples: SYNONYM elaborate (1)
She develops the theme more fully in her later books.
The piano then takes up the melody and develops it.
He began to develop these ideas in a series of paintings.
definitions.definition_vi: để thêm lời giải thích hoặc chi tiết cho một ý tưởng, câu chuyện hoặc chủ đề âm nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to treat film that has been used to take photographs with chemicals so that the pictures can be seen
examples: When Lewis developed the film, he was astonished by what he saw.
definitions.definition_vi: xử lý phim dùng để chụp ảnh bằng hóa chất để có thể nhìn thấy ảnh

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an object or a piece of equipment that has been designed to do a particular job
examples: SEE ALSO intrauterine device
a tracking/recording/listening device
The new devices will be installed at US airports.
electrical labour-saving devices around the home
This device allows deaf people to communicate by typing messages instead of speaking.
definitions.definition_vi: một vật thể hoặc một thiết bị được thiết kế để thực hiện một công việc cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a piece of computer equipment, especially a small one such as a smartphone
examples: SEE ALSO mobile device
You can store thousands of photos on your device.
a portable/wireless device
The waiter takes orders on a hand-held device.
Now connect the device to your computer.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị máy tính, đặc biệt là một thiết bị nhỏ như điện thoại thông minh

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a bomb or weapon that will explode
examples: SEE ALSO IED
A powerful device exploded outside the station.
It was the world's first atomic device.
Two bombers detonated their devices in the busy shopping centre.
The device failed to detonate.
definitions.definition_vi: một quả bom hoặc vũ khí sẽ phát nổ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a method of doing something that produces a particular result or effect
examples: Targeted advertising on social media is very successful as a marketing device.
definitions.definition_vi: một phương pháp làm điều gì đó tạo ra một kết quả hoặc hiệu ứng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a plan or trick that is used to get something that somebody wants
examples: The report was a device used to hide rather than reveal problems.
This device can be seem as somewhat dishonest.
definitions.definition_vi: một kế hoạch hoặc thủ thuật được sử dụng để có được thứ gì đó mà ai đó muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a form of words that is intended to produce a particular effect in speech or writing
examples: a rhetorical device
Metaphor and symbol are literary devices.
definitions.definition_vi: một dạng từ nhằm mục đích tạo ra một hiệu ứng cụ thể trong lời nói hoặc văn bản

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to leave somebody alone to do as they wish, and not tell them what to doWord Origin
examples: Middle English: from Old French devis, based on Latin divis- ‘divided’, from the verb dividere. The original sense was ‘desire or intention’, found now only in leave someone to their own devices (which has become associated with sense (3)).
definitions.definition_vi: để ai đó một mình làm theo ý họ muốn và không bảo họ phải làm gìNguồn gốc từ

definitions.definition: to give most of your time, energy, attention, etc. to somebody/something
definitions.definition_vi: cống hiến, dành trọn (thời gian, sức lực, sự chú ý...) cho ai/cái gì
examples: I could only devote two hours a day to the work.
She devoted herself entirely to her research.

definitions.definition: to use a particular amount of space, time, money, etc. for a particular purpose
definitions.definition_vi: dành riêng (không gian, thời gian, tiền bạc...) cho một mục đích cụ thể
examples: The magazine is devoted entirely to health issues.
A large section of the museum is devoted to modern art.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
examples: The test is used to diagnose a variety of diseases.
The illness was diagnosed as cancer.
He has recently been diagnosed with angina.
I quickly diagnosed the problem as a faulty battery.
He was diagnosed (as) a diabetic when he was 64.
He was diagnosed (a) diabetic.
definitions.definition_vi: để nói chính xác bệnh gì hoặc nguyên nhân của một vấn đề là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to show something using a diagram
examples: The overall structures of these enzymes are diagrammed in Fig 1.
The coach diagrammed defensive plays on his tablet.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị một cái gì đó bằng cách sử dụng một sơ đồ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a clear precious stone of pure carbon, the hardest substance known. Diamonds are used in jewellery and also in industry, especially for cutting glass.
examples: SEE ALSO black diamond
a diamond ring/necklace
She was wearing her diamonds (= jewellery with diamonds in it).
a six carat diamond
a diamond mine
The lights shone like diamonds.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại đá quý trong suốt làm từ carbon nguyên chất, chất cứng nhất được biết đến. Kim cương được sử dụng trong đồ trang sức và cả trong công nghiệp, đặc biệt là để cắt kính.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a shape with four straight sides of equal length and with angles that are not right angles
examples: a sweater with a diamond pattern
The eight vehicles assumed a diamond formation.
definitions.definition_vi: một hình có bốn cạnh thẳng có độ dài bằng nhau và có các góc không vuông

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: one of the four suits (= sets) in a pack of cards. The cards are marked with red diamond shapes.
examples: the ten of diamonds
Diamonds are/is trumps.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong bốn bộ đồ (= bộ) trong một bộ bài. Các thẻ được đánh dấu bằng hình kim cương màu đỏ.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: one card from the suit called diamonds
examples: You must play a diamond if you have one.
definitions.definition_vi: một thẻ từ bộ đồ có tên là kim cương

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the space inside the lines that connect the four bases; also used to mean the whole baseball fieldWord Origin
examples: Middle English: from Old French diamant, from medieval Latin diamas, diamant-, variant of Latin adamans from Greek adamas, adamant-, ‘untameable, invincible’ (later used to denote the hardest metal or stone, hence diamond), from a- ‘not’ + daman ‘to tame’.
definitions.definition_vi: không gian bên trong những đường nối bốn căn cứ; cũng dùng để chỉ toàn bộ sân bóng chàyNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a book in which you can write down the experiences you have each day, your private thoughts, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO journal
Do you keep a diary (= write one regularly)?
Peter began writing his diary in October last year.
the diaries of Samuel Pepys
The writer's letters and diaries are being published next year.
I think I'm going to start an online diary.
a travel/sleep/food diary
‘It's all over,’ he wrote in his diary for April 21.
her diary entry for 9 December 2017
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách trong đó bạn có thể viết ra những trải nghiệm bạn có mỗi ngày, những suy nghĩ riêng tư của bạn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a book or an app with spaces for each day of the year in which you can record things you have to do in the future
examples: I used to keep a desk diary for business appointments.
an appointments diary
I've made a note in my diary.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách hoặc một ứng dụng có khoảng trống cho mỗi ngày trong năm, trong đó bạn có thể ghi lại những việc bạn phải làm trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a book or electronic resource that gives a list of the words of a language in alphabetical order and explains what they mean, or gives a word for them in a foreign language
examples: a Spanish-English dictionary
a slang dictionary
a dictionary of slang
If you don't know the meaning of a word, look it up in the dictionary.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách hoặc tài nguyên điện tử cung cấp danh sách các từ của một ngôn ngữ theo thứ tự bảng chữ cái và giải thích ý nghĩa của chúng hoặc đưa ra một từ cho chúng bằng tiếng nước ngoài

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a book that explains the words that are used in a particular subject
examples: a dictionary of mathematics
I decided to consult a medical dictionary.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách giải thích những từ được sử dụng trong một chủ đề cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a list of words in electronic form, for example stored in a computer’s spellcheckerWord Origin
examples: early 16th cent.: from medieval Latin dictionarium (manuale) or dictionarius (liber) ‘manual or book of words’, from Latin dictio, from dicere ‘to say’.
definitions.definition_vi: danh sách các từ ở dạng điện tử, ví dụ như được lưu trữ trong trình kiểm tra chính tả của máy tính. Word Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to stop living
examples: My father died suddenly at the age of 48.
At least six people have died in the accident.
That plant's going to die if you don't water it!
He later died in hospital.
They died fighting for their country.
She died peacefully after a long illness.
to die with dignity
to die of/from cancer
He was ready to die for his cause.
I'll never forget it to my dying day (= until I die).
I nearly died when I saw him there (= it was very embarrassing).
to die a natural/slow/horrible/violent death
She died young.
At least they died happy.
He died a hero.
He died a poor man.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng sống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to stop existing; to disappear
examples: The old customs are dying.
His secret died with him (= he never told anyone).
The words died on my lips (= I stopped speaking).
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng tồn tại; biến mất

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to stop working
examples: My phone died and I had no way to contact you.
The engine spluttered and died.
My car just died on me.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng làm việc

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to want something or want to do something very much
examples: I'm dying for a glass of water.
I'm dying to know what happened.
definitions.definition_vi: muốn một cái gì đó hoặc muốn làm một cái gì đó rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that you are telling the truth or will do what you promise
examples: I saw him do it—cross my heart.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang nói sự thật hoặc sẽ làm những gì bạn hứa

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to fail completely
examples: The play got terrible reviews and quickly died a death.
definitions.definition_vi: thất bại hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to die because you are old or ill
definitions.definition_vi: chết vì bạn già hoặc bệnh tật

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to find something extremely funny
examples: I nearly died laughing when she said that.
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm một cái gì đó cực kỳ buồn cười

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to die or become ill and fall down in very large numbers
examples: People were dropping like flies in the intense heat.
definitions.definition_vi: chết hoặc bị bệnh và ngã với số lượng rất lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: a situation where you need to act in a very determined way or taking a great risk, because there is no alternative
examples: SEE ALSO do-or-die
At this stage in the competition it's do or die.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn cần phải hành động một cách kiên quyết hoặc phải chịu rủi ro lớn vì không có lựa chọn nào khác

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: do not stop hoping
definitions.definition_vi: đừng ngừng hy vọng

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that things change very slowly
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng mọi thứ thay đổi rất chậm

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: if you think something is to die for, you really want it, and would do anything to get it
examples: She was wearing a dress to die for.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn nghĩ thứ gì đó đáng chết thì bạn thực sự muốn nó và sẽ làm bất cứ điều gì để có được nó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in a different way from somebody/something
examples: OPPOSITE similarly
Boys and girls may behave differently.
He didn't like being treated differently.
What will you do differently next time?
Eddie comes from an older generation that thought differently than we do.
The male bird has a differently shaped head.
definitions.definition_vi: theo một cách khác với ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a situation that makes problems, often one in which you have to make a very difficult choice between things of equal importance
examples: SYNONYM predicament
I could see no way of resolving this moral dilemma.
The digital era brings new ethical dilemmas for journalists.
They were caught in a real dilemma.
She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the offer or not.
the perennial dilemma between work and family commitments
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống gây ra vấn đề, thường là tình huống mà bạn phải đưa ra lựa chọn rất khó khăn giữa những thứ có tầm quan trọng như nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: in a situation in which you have to make a choice between things that are equally unpleasant
examples: The medical profession’s eagerness for scientific advance had impaled it on the horns of a dilemma, forcing an unnatural choice between science and morality.
The dire economic situation had placed the prime minister on the horns of a dilemma.
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình huống mà bạn phải lựa chọn giữa những điều khó chịu như nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to become smaller, weaker, etc.; to make something become smaller, weaker, etc.
examples: SYNONYM decrease
The world's resources are rapidly diminishing.
His influence has diminished with time.
The new law is expected to diminish the government's chances.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên nhỏ hơn, yếu hơn, v.v.; làm cho cái gì đó trở nên nhỏ hơn, yếu hơn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make somebody/something seem less important than they really are
examples: I don't wish to diminish the importance of their contribution.
The trial has aged and diminished him.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai/cái gì có vẻ kém quan trọng hơn thực tế

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to refer to a point at which you start achieving less than the value of the time or money you put into something
examples: Our efforts were producing diminishing returns.
In general, the more exercise you take, the greater the health benefit; but beyond a certain level you get diminishing returns.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ thời điểm mà bạn bắt đầu đạt được ít hơn giá trị thời gian hoặc tiền bạc bạn bỏ ra vào việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with managing relations between countries (= diplomacy)
examples: a diplomatic crisis
Attempts are being made to settle the dispute by diplomatic means.
to break off/establish/restore diplomatic relations with a country
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với việc quản lý quan hệ giữa các quốc gia (= ngoại giao)

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having or showing skill in dealing with people in difficult situations
examples: SYNONYM tactful
a diplomatic answer

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition: the people in a society or a profession who have influence and power and who usually do not support change
examples: the medical/military/political, etc. establishment
young people rebelling against the Establishment
The members were drawn from the ranks of the Establishment.
orthodox Establishment views
definitions.definition_vi: những người trong xã hội hoặc một nghề nghiệp có ảnh hưởng và quyền lực và thường không ủng hộ sự thay đổi

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of starting or creating something that is meant to last for a long time
examples: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.
His visit facilitated the establishment of diplomatic relations between the countries.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động bắt đầu hoặc tạo ra một cái gì đó nhằm mục đích tồn tại lâu dài

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: without an end; existing or continuing forever
examples: the promise of eternal life in heaven
She's an eternal optimist (= she always expects that the best will happen).
eternal truths (= ideas that are always true and never change)
You have my eternal gratitude (= very great gratitude).
To his eternal credit (= very great credit), he never gave up.
Newspapers are simply responding to the eternal fascination of their readers with the private lives of the rich and famous.
definitions.definition_vi: không có hồi kết; tồn tại hoặc tiếp tục mãi mãi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: happening often and seeming never to stop
examples: SYNONYM constant
I'm tired of your eternal arguments.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra thường xuyên và dường như không bao giờ dừng lại

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: people never stop hopingWord Origin
examples: late Middle English: via Old French from late Latin aeternalis, from Latin aeternus, from aevum ‘age’.
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người không bao giờ ngừng hy vọngWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: moral principles that control or influence a person’s behaviour
examples: professional/business/medical ethics
to draw up a code of ethics
He began to question the ethics of his position.
definitions.definition_vi: nguyên tắc đạo đức kiểm soát hoặc ảnh hưởng đến hành vi của một người

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a system of moral principles or rules of behaviour
examples: SEE ALSO Protestant ethic
The ethic of personal achievement is very strong in western societies.
definitions.definition_vi: một hệ thống các nguyên tắc đạo đức hoặc quy tắc ứng xử

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the branch of philosophy that deals with moral principlesWord Origin
examples: late Middle English (denoting ethics or moral philosophy; also used attributively): from Old French éthique, from Latin ethice, from Greek (hē) ēthikē (tekhnē) ‘(the science of) morals’, based on ēthos ‘nature, disposition’, (plural) ‘customs’.
definitions.definition_vi: nhánh triết học liên quan đến các nguyên tắc đạo đứcNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the unit of money of some countries of the European Union
examples: I paid five euros for it.
10 million euro
The price is given in euros.
a 30-million-euro deal
A half-kilo pack of pasta costs around 70 euro cents.
definitions.definition_vi: đơn vị tiền của một số nước thuộc Liên minh Châu Âu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: euros as as a system of money; the value of the euro compared with the value of the money of other countries
examples: What if the UK had joined the Euro in 1999?
the value of the euro against the dollar
definitions.definition_vi: euro như một hệ thống tiền tệ; giá trị của đồng euro so với giá trị tiền của các nước khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to form an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
examples: SYNONYM assess
The trial will evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
Researchers evaluated teaching performance by comparing students' exam results.
The study will critically evaluate whether this technology is useful.
We need to evaluate how well the policy is working.
The cheeses are evaluated for flavour, texture and colour.
Candidates are evaluated on their ability to think independently.
definitions.definition_vi: hình thành ý kiến ​​về số lượng, giá trị hoặc chất lượng của một cái gì đó sau khi suy nghĩ cẩn thận về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising
examples: She didn't even call to say she wasn't coming.
He never even opened the letter (= so he certainly didn't read it).
It wouldn't have been possible 30 years ago, maybe even 20.
It was cold there even in summer (= so it must have been very cold in winter).
Even a child can understand it (= so adults certainly can).
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một cái gì đó bất ngờ hoặc đáng ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used when you are comparing things, to make the comparison stronger
examples: You know even less about it than I do.
She's even more intelligent than her sister.
The Second World War made things even worse.
We face an even greater challenge today.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang so sánh sự vật, để làm cho sự so sánh mạnh mẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to introduce a more exact description of somebody/something
examples: It's an unattractive building, ugly even.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một mô tả chính xác hơn về ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: just at the same time as somebody does something or as something else happens
examples: Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded.
definitions.definition_vi: ngay lúc ai đó làm điều gì đó hoặc khi điều gì đó khác xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: despite the possibility that; no matter whether
examples: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp khả năng đó; dù có hay không

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: despite the fact that; even though
examples: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù thực tế là vậy; mặc dù

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: despite what has/had happened
examples: I've shown him the photographs but even now he won't believe me.
Even then she would not admit her mistake.
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp những gì đã/đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: at this or that exact moment
examples: The troops are even now preparing to march into the city.
definitions.definition_vi: vào đúng thời điểm này hoặc thời điểm đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: despite that
examples: There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: despite the fact that
examples: I like her, even though she can be annoying at times.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù thực tế là

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed
examples: SEE ALSO good evening
Remember to call me this evening.
We haven't spoken to him since yesterday evening.
I'll see you tomorrow evening.
Come over on Thursday evening.
What do you usually do in the evening?
Mosquitoes usually bite in the early evening.
She's going to her sister's for the evening.
on the evening of May 15
He hardly spoke throughout the evening.
We spent many enjoyable summer evenings together.
I found it in the pocket of the jacket I had been wearing the previous evening.
The evening meal is served at 7 p.m.
She watched the evening news at 6 p.m. as usual.
As the evening wore on, Sam became more and more unhappy.
Jim's comedy routine was the highlight of the evening's entertainment.
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian trong ngày từ buổi chiều đến lúc bạn đi ngủ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an event of a particular type happening in the evening
examples: a musical evening at school (= when music is performed)
the school parents' evening (= when parents are invited to talk to teachers about their children's progress)
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện thuộc một loại cụ thể xảy ra vào buổi tối

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: all things
examples: Everything had gone.
When we confronted him, he denied everything.
Take this bag, and leave everything else to me.
She seemed to have everything—looks, money, intelligence.
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả mọi thứ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the situation now; life generally
examples: Everything in the capital is now quiet.
‘How's everything with you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
definitions.definition_vi: tình hình bây giờ; cuộc sống nói chung

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the most important thing
examples: Money isn't everything.
My family means everything to me.
definitions.definition_vi: điều quan trọng nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: and so on; and other similar things
examples: Have you got his name and address and everything?
She told me about the baby and everything.
definitions.definition_vi: vân vân; và những thứ tương tự khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: enjoying harming others; morally bad and cruel
examples: Police described the killer as ‘a desperate and evil man’.
an evil genius/dictator
President Reagan referred to the Soviet Union as the ‘evil empire’.
an evil grin
Her face was full of evil intent.
definitions.definition_vi: thích làm hại người khác; đạo đức tồi tệ và tàn nhẫn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having a harmful effect on people; morally bad
examples: evil deeds
In his speech he described the evil effects of racism.
definitions.definition_vi: có tác dụng có hại cho con người; tệ về mặt đạo đức

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: connected with the devil and with what is bad in the world
examples: It was an ancient charm to ward off evil spirits.
She had been deceived by an evil demon.
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với ma quỷ và với những gì xấu trên thế giới

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: extremely unpleasant
examples: The rubbish bin was giving off an evil smell.
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the time when you have to do something difficult or unpleasant
examples: I’d better go and see the dentist—I can’t put off the evil hour any longer.
If you keep on borrowing, you are only postponing the evil day when you have to pay it all back.
definitions.definition_vi: thời điểm bạn phải làm điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a person or spirit who is thought to have a good/bad influence over you
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc tinh thần được cho là có ảnh hưởng tốt/xấu đến bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: an unpleasant drink that is a mixture of different thingsWord Origin
examples: Old English yfel, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch euvel and German Übel.
definitions.definition_vi: một thức uống khó chịu là sự kết hợp của nhiều thứ khác nhau. Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment
examples: the evolution of the human species
Darwin’s theory of evolution
Finally it was legal to teach evolution everywhere in America.
definitions.definition_vi: sự phát triển chậm rãi, ổn định của thực vật, động vật, v.v. trong suốt lịch sử của trái đất, khi chúng thích nghi với những thay đổi của môi trường

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the slow steady development of something
examples: In politics Britain has preferred evolution to revolution (= slow steady development to sudden violent change)
cultural trends and evolutions
definitions.definition_vi: sự phát triển chậm và ổn định của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way
examples: The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.
The company has evolved into a major chemical manufacturer.
Each school must evolve its own way of working.
definitions.definition_vi: phát triển dần dần, nhất là từ dạng đơn giản đến dạng phức tạp hơn; để phát triển một cái gì đó theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to develop over time, often many generations, into forms that are better adapted to survive changes in their environment
examples: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.
The dolphin has evolved a highly developed jaw.
definitions.definition_vi: phát triển theo thời gian, thường là qua nhiều thế hệ, thành những dạng có khả năng thích nghi tốt hơn để tồn tại trước những thay đổi của môi trường

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: correct in every detail
examples: SYNONYM precise
The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
It is an exact copy of the original document.
The model is exact in every detail.
For now they are keeping the exact date and location of the wedding a secret.
The exact nature of her illness (= precisely what her illness is) has not been made public.
Her second husband was the exact opposite of her first (= completely different).
The colours were an almost exact match.
She's in her mid-thirties—thirty-six to be exact.
I had the exact same problem as you when I first started.
What were his exact words?
A clear definition requires very exact wording.
Nobody knows the exact number of people affected, but it is over 10 000.
He started to phone me at the exact moment I started to phone him (= at the same time).
definitions.definition_vi: chính xác đến từng chi tiết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: very accurate and careful about details
examples: SYNONYM meticulous
He was very exact about everything he did.
definitions.definition_vi: rất chính xác và cẩn thận về chi tiết

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: using accurate measurements and following set rules
examples: SYNONYM precise
Assessing insurance risk can never be an exact science.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng các phép đo chính xác và tuân theo các quy tắc đã đặt ra

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail
examples: SYNONYM precisely
It's exactly nine o'clock.
It happened almost exactly a year ago.
Your answer is exactly right.
It was a warm day, if not exactly hot.
I know exactly how she felt.
It's impossible to say exactly what happened.
Do exactly as I tell you.
You haven't changed at all—you still look exactly the same.
His words had exactly the opposite effect.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một cái gì đó là đúng trong mọi cách hoặc trong mọi chi tiết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to ask for more information about something
examples: Where exactly did you stay in France?
Exactly what are you trying to tell me?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để hỏi thêm thông tin về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used as a reply, agreeing with what somebody has just said, or emphasizing that it is correct
examples: ‘You mean somebody in this room must be the murderer?’ ‘Exactly.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để trả lời, đồng ý với điều ai đó vừa nói hoặc nhấn mạnh rằng điều đó đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used when you are saying the opposite of what you really mean
examples: He wasn't exactly pleased to see us—in fact he refused to open the door.
It's not exactly beautiful, is it? (= it's ugly)
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nói điều ngược lại với những gì bạn thực sự muốn nói

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used when you are correcting something that somebody has said
examples: ‘So he told you you'd got the job?’ ‘Not exactly, but he said they were impressed with me.’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang sửa lại điều gì đó mà ai đó đã nói

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say
examples: Let me give you an example.
It is important to cite examples to support your argument.
to provide/offer an example
I shall take four different examples from contemporary literature to illustrate my point.
Can you show me an example of what you mean?
This dictionary has many examples of how words are used.
Just to give you an example of his generosity—he gave me his old car and wouldn't take any money for it.
The progress the students have made serves as an example of the benefit of small class sizes.
By way of example, we'll look at our most recent advertising campaign.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó chẳng hạn như một đồ vật, một sự việc hoặc một tình huống thể hiện, giải thích hoặc hỗ trợ những gì bạn nói

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a thing that is typical of or represents a particular group or set
examples: This is a good example of the artist's early work.
It is a perfect example of this type of architecture.
Japan is often quoted as the prime example of a modern industrial nation.
It is a classic example of how not to design a new city centre.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều đó là điển hình hoặc đại diện cho một nhóm hoặc tập hợp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or their behaviour that is thought to be a good model for others to copy
examples: Her courage is an example to us all.
He sets an example for the other students.
She is a shining example of what people with disabilities can achieve.
He is a captain who leads by example.
Top management should be seen to lead by example.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc hành vi của họ được coi là hình mẫu tốt để người khác noi theo

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person’s behaviour, either good or bad, that other people copy
examples: It would be a mistake to follow his example.
They started to plan protests, inspired by the example of their neighbours.
definitions.definition_vi: hành vi của một người, dù tốt hay xấu, mà người khác sao chép

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something that explains or supports what you are saying; used to give an example of what you are saying
examples: There is a similar word in many languages, for example in French and Italian.
The report is incomplete; it does not include sales in France, for example.
It is possible to combine computer science with other subjects, for example physics.
An athlete, for example, might turn the pedals 80 times a minute.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó nhằm giải thích hoặc hỗ trợ điều bạn đang nói; được sử dụng để đưa ra một ví dụ về những gì bạn đang nói

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to punish somebody as a warning to others not to do the same thing
examples: The teacher made an example of him by suspending him from school.
definitions.definition_vi: trừng phạt ai đó như một lời cảnh báo cho người khác không làm điều tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be greater than a particular number or amount
examples: The price will not exceed £100.
definitions.definition_vi: lớn hơn một số lượng hoặc số lượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to do more than the law or an order, etc. allows you to do
examples: SEE ALSO excess
She was exceeding the speed limit (= driving faster than is allowed).
The officers had exceeded their authority.
definitions.definition_vi: làm nhiều hơn luật pháp hoặc mệnh lệnh, v.v. cho phép bạn làm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be better than expected
examples: SYNONYM surpass
His achievements have exceeded expectations.
The amount raised has far exceeded our wildest expectations.
definitions.definition_vi: sẽ tốt hơn mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the quality of being extremely good
examples: SEE ALSO par excellence
a reputation for academic excellence
The hospital is recognized as a centre of excellence in research and teaching.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng cực kỳ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
examples: SYNONYM apart from
We work every day except Sunday.
They all came except Matt.
I had nothing on except for my socks.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước khi bạn đề cập đến điều duy nhất hoặc người mà tuyên bố đó không đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 1
examples: There are only eleven of these rare animals left.
eleven of Sweden’s top financial experts
Twenty people were invited but only eleven turned up.
Can you lend me eleven dollars?
an eleven-month contract
Look at page eleven.
Eleven and two is thirteen.
Two elevens are twenty-two.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be an eleven?
The bulbs are planted in sevens or elevens (= groups of seven or eleven).
We moved to America when I was eleven (= eleven years old).
Shall we meet at eleven (= at eleven o'clock), then?

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a team of eleven players for football (soccer), cricket or hockey
examples: She was chosen for the first eleven.
definitions.definition_vi: một đội gồm mười một cầu thủ chơi bóng đá (bóng đá), cricket hoặc khúc côn cầu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: belonging to a group of people in society that is small in number but powerful and with a lot of influence, because they are rich, intelligent, etc.
examples: an elite group of senior officials
an elite military academy
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc một nhóm người trong xã hội tuy số lượng ít nhưng có thế lực và có nhiều ảnh hưởng, vì họ giàu có, thông minh, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having or showing the greatest ability at the highest level of competition
examples: an elite athlete/swimmer/runner
the world of elite sports
definitions.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện khả năng lớn nhất ở mức độ cạnh tranh cao nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to express or represent an idea or a quality
examples: SYNONYM represent
