definitions.definition: a large area of land, usually in the country, that is owned by one person or family
examples: a 3 000-acre estate
The poet's childhood was spent on a country estate.
She receives rent from all the people whose cottages are on estate land.
definitions.definition_vi: một vùng đất rộng lớn, thường là ở nông thôn, thuộc sở hữu của một người hoặc một gia đình

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: all the money and property that a person owns, especially everything that is left when they die
examples: Her estate was left to her daughter.
He left estate valued at a million dollars.
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả tiền bạc và tài sản mà một người sở hữu, đặc biệt là tất cả những gì còn lại khi họ chết

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a car with a lot of space behind the back seats and a door at the back for loading large itemsWord Origin
examples: Middle English (in the sense ‘state or condition’): from Old French estat, from Latin status ‘state, condition’, from stare ‘to stand’.
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc xe có nhiều không gian phía sau hàng ghế sau và có cửa ở phía sau để chất đồ lớnWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at the end of a period of time or a series of events
examples: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
I'll get round to mending it eventually.
She hopes eventually to attend medical school and become a doctor.
definitions.definition_vi: vào cuối một khoảng thời gian hoặc một loạt các sự kiện

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean ‘at any time’
examples: Nothing ever happens here.
Don't you ever get tired?
If you're ever in Miami, come and see us.
‘Have you ever been to Rome?’ ‘Yes, I have, actually. Not long ago.’
‘Have you ever thought of changing your job?’ ‘No, never/No I haven’t.’
She hardly ever (= almost never) goes out.
We've only ever talked on the phone.
I don't think I ever really thanked you properly.
He wondered whether it would ever actually happen.
We see them very seldom, if ever.
I'll never ever do that again!
I'm never speaking to you ever again!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trong câu phủ định và câu hỏi, hoặc câu có if mang nghĩa 'bất cứ lúc nào'

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used for emphasis when you are comparing things
examples: SEE ALSO first-ever
It was raining harder than ever.
Consumers today have more choices than ever before.
It's my best ever score.
It's the worst film I've ever seen.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh khi bạn đang so sánh mọi thứ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: all the time or every time; always
examples: SEE ALSO forever
Paul, ever the optimist, agreed to try again.
She married the prince and they lived happily ever after.
He said he would love her for ever (and ever).
Their debts grew ever larger (= kept increasing).
the ever-growing problem
an ever-present danger
definitions.definition_vi: mọi lúc hoặc mọi lúc; luôn luôn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used after when, why, etc. to show that you are surprised or shocked
examples: Why ever did you agree?
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau khi nào, tại sao, v.v. để thể hiện rằng bạn ngạc nhiên hoặc bị sốc

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that somebody does the same thing very often, usually in an annoying way
examples: All he ever does is grumble about things.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó làm điều tương tự rất thường xuyên, thường là một cách khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show that you are surprised or shocked
examples: Did you ever hear anything like it?
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn đang ngạc nhiên hoặc bị sốc

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: continuously since the time mentioned
examples: He's had a car ever since he was 18.
I was bitten by a dog once and I've been afraid of them ever since.
definitions.definition_vi: liên tục kể từ thời điểm được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: very; really
examples: He looks ever so smart.
She's ever such a nice woman.
It's ever so easy.
definitions.definition_vi: rất; Thực ra

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that something is certainly true
examples: That was a disaster if ever there was one!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something you are talking about
examples: ‘You must have been upset by that.’ ‘Was I ever!’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó bạn đang nói đến

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: sometimes used at the end of an informal letter, before you write your nameWord Origin
examples: Old English ǣfre, of unknown origin.
definitions.definition_vi: đôi khi được sử dụng ở cuối một lá thư thân mật, trước khi bạn viết tên của mìnhWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: every person; all people
examples: COMPARE anybody
Everybody knows Tom.
Have you asked everybody?
Didn't you like it? Everybody else did.
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người; tất cả mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in, to or at every place; all places
examples: I've looked everywhere.
He follows me everywhere.
We'll have to eat here—everywhere else is full.
Everywhere we went was full of tourists.
definitions.definition_vi: trong, tới hoặc ở mọi nơi; tất cả các nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: extremely good
examples: SEE ALSO xlnt
an excellent book/article
excellent results/work
The meal looked and tasted excellent.
Both the food and the service were truly excellent.
The performances of the cast are uniformly excellent throughout.
She has done an excellent job of adapting the novel for the screen.
It is an excellent example of how a farm can work in harmony with nature.
The party provided an excellent opportunity to meet new people.
The apartment is in excellent condition and is ready to move into.
He was great at sport and excellent at art.
Our staff are excellent at advising small businesses.
The experience was excellent for students' self-confidence.
Ferns are excellent for planting in shady parts of the garden.
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to show that you are very pleased about something or that you approve of something
examples: You can all come? Excellent!
It's excellent to see so many people at today's event!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn rất hài lòng về điều gì đó hoặc bạn tán thành điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
examples: SYNONYM apart from
We work every day except Sunday.
They all came except Matt.
I had nothing on except for my socks.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước khi bạn đề cập đến điều duy nhất hoặc người mà tuyên bố đó không đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: unusually good
examples: SYNONYM outstanding
At the age of five he showed exceptional talent as a musician.
The quality of the recording is quite exceptional.
definitions.definition_vi: tốt bất thường

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: very unusual
examples: OPPOSITE unexceptional
This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
definitions.definition_vi: rất bất thường

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to remove or get rid of something
examples: Credit cards eliminate the need to carry a lot of cash.
This diet claims to eliminate toxins from the body.
definitions.definition_vi: loại bỏ hoặc loại bỏ cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to stop considering that somebody/something might be responsible for something or chosen for something
examples: The police have eliminated two suspects from their investigation.
Malaria was eliminated as a cause of death.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng xem xét rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có thể chịu trách nhiệm cho việc gì đó hoặc được chọn cho việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to defeat a person or a team so that they no longer take part in a competition, etc.
examples: SYNONYM knock out
All the English teams were eliminated in the early stages of the competition.
She was eliminated from the tournament in the first round.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh bại một người hoặc một đội để họ không còn tham gia vào một cuộc thi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to kill somebody, especially an enemy or opponent
examples: Most of the regime's left-wing opponents were eliminated.
They attempted to eliminate him as a political rival.
definitions.definition_vi: giết ai đó, đặc biệt là kẻ thù hoặc đối thủ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in addition to something already mentioned
examples: What else did he say?
I don't want anything else, thanks.
I'm taking a few clothes and some books, not much else.
definitions.definition_vi: ngoài một cái gì đó đã được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: different
examples: Ask somebody else to help you.
Haven't you got anything else to wear?
Why didn't you come? Everybody else was there.
Yes I did give it to her. What else could I do?
definitions.definition_vi: khác biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: if not
examples: SYNONYM or else
Keep your mouth shut, else we'll be in trouble.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu không

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: if not
examples: SYNONYM otherwise
Hurry up or else you'll be late.
They can't be coming or else they'd have called.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu không

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to introduce the second of two possibilities
examples: He either forgot or else decided not to come.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu khả năng thứ hai trong hai khả năng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to threaten or warn somebody
examples: Just shut up, or else!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đe dọa hoặc cảnh báo ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: shy, uncomfortable or guilty feelings; a feeling of being embarrassed
examples: I nearly died of embarrassment when he said that.
I'm glad you offered—it saved me the embarrassment of having to ask.
Much to her embarrassment, she realized that everybody had been listening to her singing.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác ngại ngùng, khó chịu hoặc tội lỗi; một cảm giác xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a situation that causes problems for somebody
examples: Her resignation will be a severe embarrassment to the party.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống gây ra vấn đề cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person who causes problems for another person or other people and makes them feel embarrassed
examples: Poor Lucy! He's such an embarrassment to her.
definitions.definition_vi: người gây ra vấn đề cho người khác hoặc người khác và khiến họ cảm thấy xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: so many good things that it is difficult to choose just one
examples: Stratford has an embarrassment of riches, really, what with three theatres and lovely countryside, too.
definitions.definition_vi: rất nhiều điều tốt đến nỗi thật khó để chọn chỉ một

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a group of officials led by an ambassador who represent their government in a foreign country
examples: embassy officials
to inform the embassy of the situation
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm quan chức dẫn đầu bởi một đại sứ đại diện cho chính phủ của họ ở nước ngoài

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the building in which an embassy works
examples: a demonstration outside the Russian Embassy
definitions.definition_vi: tòa nhà nơi đại sứ quán làm việc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to give special importance to something
examples: His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.
The report emphasizes the need for economic stability.
She emphasized the point in an interview at the weekend.
She emphasized that their plan would mean sacrifices and hard work.
He emphasized how little was known about the disease.
It should be emphasized that this is only one possible explanation.
‘This must be our top priority,’ he emphasized.
definitions.definition_vi: để dành tầm quan trọng đặc biệt cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make something easier to notice
examples: She swept her hair back from her face to emphasize her high cheekbones.
The rising tone of his voice emphasized his panic.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó dễ dàng hơn để nhận thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to give extra force to a word or phrase when you are speaking, especially to show that it is important
examples: ‘Let nothing… nothing,’ he emphasized the word, ‘tempt you.’
definitions.definition_vi: tăng thêm sức mạnh cho một từ hoặc cụm từ khi bạn đang nói, đặc biệt là để cho thấy rằng nó quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed
examples: full-time/part-time employment
people seeking employment
They are finding it more and more difficult to find employment.
The steelworks provided employment for thousands of people.
He took up employment with the company in May 2015.
She hoped to secure employment in the IT sector.
Most of last year's graduates are now in paid employment.
There are limited employment opportunities here.
Such clauses in employment contracts are common in many states.
a specialist in employment law
conditions/terms of employment
Please list any pension entitlement you have from previous employments.
definitions.definition_vi: làm việc, đặc biệt là khi nó được thực hiện để kiếm tiền; tình trạng được tuyển dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the situation in which people have work
examples: OPPOSITE unemployment
The government is aiming at full employment.
Changes in farming methods have badly affected employment in the area.
definitions.definition_vi: tình hình trong đó mọi người có việc làm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of employing somebody
examples: The law prevented the employment of children under ten in the cotton mills.
The company's employment practices have been widely criticized.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động tuyển dụng ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the use of something
examples: the employment of artillery in the capture of the town
definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the final part of a period of time, an event, an activity or a story
examples: SEE ALSO back end (1)
It's the end of an era.
the end of the book
at the end of the week
There’ll be a chance to ask questions at the end.
He wants the reports by the end of the month.
She remained active as an artist to the end of her life.
I was getting bored towards the end of the talk.
We didn't leave until the very end.
I'm staying until the end of this week.
We had to hear about the whole journey from beginning to end.
He is nearing the end of his career.
Our end-of-season sale starts next week.
definitions.definition_vi: phần cuối cùng của một khoảng thời gian, một sự kiện, một hoạt động hoặc một câu chuyện

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a situation in which something does not exist any more
examples: It was the end of all his dreams.
That was by no means the end of the matter.
The war was finally at an end.
The meeting came to an end (= finished).
The coup brought his corrupt regime to an end.
This latest attack could spell the end of the peace process.
They have called for an end to violence.
an end to the conflict/war
Let’s put an end to (= stop) these rumours once and for all.
There's no end in sight to the present crisis.
Cheap air travel marked the end of the golden age of the British seaside holiday.
The release of ‘The Jazz Singer’ signalled the end of the silent movie era.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống trong đó một cái gì đó không còn tồn tại nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the part of an object or a place that is the furthest away from its centre
examples: SEE ALSO big end
I joined the end of the queue.
Go to the end of the line!
Turn right at the end of the road.
His office is the room at the other end of the corridor.
That's his wife sitting at the far end of the table.
You've got something on the end of your nose.
Tie the ends of the string together.
the front/rear end of a cow/tractor
These two products are from opposite ends of the price range.
We've travelled from one end of Mexico to the other.
They live in the end house.
definitions.definition_vi: phần của một vật thể hoặc một nơi ở xa trung tâm của nó nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an aim or a purpose
examples: They are prepared to use violence in pursuit of their ends.
She is exploiting the current situation for her own ends.
He joined the society for political ends.
With this end in view (= in order to achieve this) they employed 50 new staff.
We are willing to make any concessions necessary to this end (= in order to achieve this).
They are working towards common ends.
definitions.definition_vi: một mục đích hoặc một mục đích

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a part of an activity with which somebody is involved, especially in business
examples: SEE ALSO business end (2)
We need somebody to handle the marketing end of the business.
Are there any problems at your end?
I have kept my end of the bargain.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của hoạt động mà ai đó tham gia, đặc biệt là trong kinh doanh

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: either of two places connected by a phone call, journey, etc.
examples: I answered the phone but there was no one at the other end.
Jean is going to meet me at the other end.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai địa điểm được kết nối bằng một cuộc gọi điện thoại, hành trình, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: one of the two halves of a sports field
examples: The teams changed ends at half-time.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai nửa của sân thể thao

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a small piece that is left after something has been used
examples: SEE ALSO bin-end
a cigarette end
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh nhỏ còn lại sau khi một cái gì đó đã được sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a person’s death. People say ‘end’ to avoid saying ‘death’.
examples: She came to an untimely end (= died young).
I was with him at the end (= when he died).
He met his end (= died) at the Battle of Waterloo.
definitions.definition_vi: cái chết của một người Người ta nói ‘kết thúc’ để tránh nói ‘chết’.

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: a lineman who is nearest to the side of the field
examples: SEE ALSO tight end
a defensive end
He does as good a job as any end in football at helping his teammates.
definitions.definition_vi: trọng tài ở gần mép sân nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to introduce the most important fact after everything has been considered
examples: At the end of the day, he'll still have to make his own decision.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu sự thật quan trọng nhất sau khi mọi thứ đã được xem xét

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: having nothing to do and not knowing what you want to do
examples: Come and see us, if you're at a loose end.
definitions.definition_vi: không có gì để làm và không biết bạn muốn làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: something unpleasant that happens to somebody, for example punishment or a violent death, usually because of their own actions
examples: He'll come to a sticky end one of these days if he carries on like that.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó khó chịu xảy ra với ai đó, ví dụ như sự trừng phạt hoặc cái chết bạo lực, thường là do hành động của chính họ

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to have almost nothing left of something
examples: I'm at the end of my patience.
They are at the end of their food supply.
definitions.definition_vi: hầu như không còn gì của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to feel that you cannot deal with a difficult situation any more because you are too tired, worried, etc.
examples: You’d better let her know you’re safe. She’s at the end of her tether.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy rằng bạn không thể đối phó với một tình huống khó khăn nữa vì bạn quá mệt mỏi, lo lắng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be the person that an action, etc. is directed at, especially an unpleasant one
examples: She found herself on the receiving end of a great deal of criticism.
definitions.definition_vi: là người mà một hành động, v.v. hướng tới, đặc biệt là một hành động khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to be so worried by a problem that you do not know what to do next
examples: She was at her wits’ end wondering how she’d manage it all in the time.
I'm at my wits' end trying to cope with his moods.
definitions.definition_vi: quá lo lắng về một vấn đề nào đó đến mức bạn không biết phải làm gì tiếp theo

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: when you say that people or situations are the end, you mean that you are annoyed with them
definitions.definition_vi: Khi bạn nói rằng mọi người hoặc tình huống là kết thúc, bạn có nghĩa là bạn khó chịu với họ

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: the first sign of something ending
examples: The scandal was the beginning of the end of his career as a politician.
definitions.definition_vi: dấu hiệu đầu tiên của một cái gì đó kết thúc

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to become very tired by trying to do too many things and going to bed late and getting up early
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên rất mệt mỏi do cố gắng làm quá nhiều việc và đi ngủ muộn và dậy sớm

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: a thing that is itself important and not just a part of something more important
examples: For her, shopping had become an end in itself.
For her, travelling had become an end in itself rather than a means of seeing new places.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều mà bản thân nó là quan trọng và không chỉ là một phần của một cái gì đó quan trọng hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: bad or unfair methods of doing something are acceptable if the result of that action is good or positive
examples: He defended a morality in which the end justifies the means.
That's only OK if you believe that the end justifies the means.
definitions.definition_vi: phương pháp làm việc xấu hoặc không công bằng được chấp nhận nếu kết quả của hành động đó là tốt hoặc tích cực

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: (to reach) the point at which something can no longer continue in the same way
examples: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
The loss of this contract could signal the end of the line for the shipyard.
This latest disagreement could mean the end of the road for the band.
definitions.definition_vi: (đạt đến) điểm mà tại đó điều gì đó không thể tiếp tục như cũ được nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said or done about something
examples: If she doesn’t agree, I won’t go ahead. End of story.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nói rằng không thể nói hay làm gì hơn về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 25

definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện rất nhiều hứng thú và quan tâm đến ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.definition_vi: để cho ai đó quyền có hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện, một tình huống hoặc một khoảng thời gian trong cuộc đời của ai đó, một cuốn tiểu thuyết, v.v. điều đó quan trọng hoặc thú vị theo một cách nào đó

definitions.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà ai đó bị ảnh hưởng bởi một căn bệnh cụ thể hoặc một giai đoạn cụ thể của một căn bệnh lâu dài hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: giống nhau về kích thước, số lượng, giá trị, v.v. như một thứ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2

examples: I believe everyone is born equal.
a society where women and men are equal partners
definitions.definition_vi: có các quyền giống nhau hoặc được đối xử giống như những người khác, không có sự khác biệt như chủng tộc, tôn giáo hay giới tính được xem xét

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: giving people the same rights and opportunities, without differences such as race, religion or sex being considered

the desire for a more equal society (= in which everyone has the same rights and chances)

the principles of equal treatment and non-discrimination
definitions.definition_vi: mang lại cho mọi người những quyền và cơ hội như nhau, không xem xét đến sự khác biệt như chủng tộc, tôn giáo hay giới tính

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: having the necessary strength, courage and ability to deal with something successfully
examples: I hope that he proves equal to the challenge.
definitions.definition_vi: có sức mạnh, lòng can đảm và khả năng cần thiết để giải quyết thành công việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: if the conditions stay the same; if other conditions are the same

definitions.definition_vi: nếu các điều kiện vẫn giữ nguyên; nếu các điều kiện khác giống nhau

definitions.definition_vi: có những ưu điểm và nhược điểm giống như người khác

definitions.definition_vi: để thoát khỏi hoặc tránh một cái gì đó khó chịu hoặc nguy hiểm

definitions.definition: used to introduce a more exact description of somebody/something
examples: It's an unattractive building, ugly even.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một mô tả chính xác hơn về ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: just at the same time as somebody does something or as something else happens
examples: Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded.
definitions.definition_vi: ngay lúc ai đó làm điều gì đó hoặc khi điều gì đó khác xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: despite the possibility that; no matter whether
examples: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp khả năng đó; dù có hay không

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: despite the fact that; even though
examples: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù thực tế là vậy; mặc dù

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: despite what has/had happened
examples: I've shown him the photographs but even now he won't believe me.
Even then she would not admit her mistake.
definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp những gì đã/đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: at this or that exact moment
examples: The troops are even now preparing to march into the city.
definitions.definition_vi: vào đúng thời điểm này hoặc thời điểm đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: despite that
examples: There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: despite the fact that
examples: I like her, even though she can be annoying at times.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù thực tế là

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
examples: She knows every student in the school.
I could hear every word they said.
We enjoyed every minute of our stay.
I go to the gym every day.
every week/month/year
I get that wrong every single time.
I read every last article in the newspaper (= all of them).
They were watching her every movement.
Every one of their songs has been a hit.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ số ít để chỉ tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm đồ vật hoặc người

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say how often something happens or is done
examples: The buses go every 10 minutes.
We had to stop every few miles.
One in every three marriages ends in divorce.
He has every third day off (= he works for two days, then has one day off, then works for two days and so on).
We see each other every now and again.
Every now and then he regretted his decision.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói tần suất một việc gì đó xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: all possible
examples: We wish you every success.
He had every reason to be angry.
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: every single one
examples: I look forward to seeing each and every one of you as we celebrate our 50th year.
definitions.definition_vi: từng cái một

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: each alternate one (= the first, third, fifth, etc. one, but not the second, fourth, sixth, etc.)
examples: They visit us every other week.
definitions.definition_vi: mỗi cái thay thế (= cái thứ nhất, thứ ba, thứ năm, v.v., nhưng không phải cái thứ hai, thứ tư, thứ sáu, v.v.)

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: every person; all people
examples: Everyone cheered and clapped.
Everyone has a chance to win.
Everyone brought their partner to the party.
Everyone brought his or her partner to the party.
The police questioned everyone in the room.
The teacher commented on everyone's work.
Everyone else was there.
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người; tất cả mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true
examples: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
There is a growing body of evidence for the existence of black holes that are ten times as massive as the Sun.
There is not a shred of evidence that the meeting actually took place.
Have you any evidence to support this allegation?
The study provides empirical evidence (= based on experiments or experience) to prove that the drug has no long-term side effects.
Anecdotal evidence (= based on personal accounts) suggests that drivers over the age of 70 find it difficult to get insurance.
On the evidence of their recent matches, it is unlikely the Spanish team will win.
In the absence of evidence to the contrary, it should be assumed that proper procedures were followed.
definitions.definition_vi: sự thật, dấu hiệu hoặc đồ vật khiến bạn tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the information that is used in court to try to prove something
examples: SEE ALSO circumstantial
I was asked to give evidence (= to say what I knew, describe what I had seen, etc.) at the trial.
The defence accused the prosecution of withholding several key pieces of evidence.
circumstantial/forensic evidence
Despite a lack of evidence against him, Burton will appear in court next week.
He was released when the judge ruled there was no evidence against him.
The emails were presented as evidence of his involvement in the fraud.
The police officer took a statement which was later used in evidence.
definitions.definition_vi: thông tin được sử dụng tại tòa án để cố gắng chứng minh điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: (considering) the evidence on both sides of an argument, to find the most likely reason for or result of something
examples: The balance of evidence suggests the Liberal party's decline began before the First World War.
The coroner thought that on the balance of probabilities, the pilot had suffered a stroke just before the crash.
definitions.definition_vi: (xem xét) bằng chứng của cả hai phía của một lập luận, để tìm ra lý do hoặc kết quả có khả năng xảy ra nhất của điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: (to be) present and clearly seen
examples: The police were much in evidence at today's demonstration.
a trend that has been much in evidence in recent years
definitions.definition_vi: (được) hiện diện và được nhìn thấy rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: clear; easily seen
examples: SYNONYM obvious
The orchestra played with evident enjoyment.
It has now become evident to us that a mistake has been made.
The growing interest in history is clearly evident in the number of people visiting museums and country houses.
definitions.definition_vi: thông thoáng; dễ dàng nhìn thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
examples: The music evoked memories of her youth.
His case is unlikely to evoke public sympathy.
definitions.definition_vi: mang lại một cảm giác, một kỷ niệm hoặc một hình ảnh vào tâm trí bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
examples: SEE ALSO exit exam
to take an exam
to pass/fail an exam
I hate doing exams.
to sit an exam
to mark an exam
to grade an exam
I failed the college entrance exam (= to get a place at college).
Every term we would have exams in maths, English, French, etc.
She did well in her exams.
She did well on her exams.
an exam paper
I got my exam results today.
A lot of students suffer from exam nerves.
definitions.definition_vi: một bài kiểm tra viết, nói hoặc thực hành chính thức, đặc biệt là ở trường học hoặc đại học, để xem bạn biết bao nhiêu về một chủ đề hoặc bạn có thể làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a medical test of a particular part of the body
examples: an eye exam
definitions.definition_vi: một xét nghiệm y tế của một bộ phận cụ thể của cơ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
examples: successful candidates in GCSE examinations
to sit an examination in mathematics
In 1864 he passed the examination for the Indian Civil Service.
Applicants are selected for jobs on the results of a competitive examination.
definitions.definition_vi: một bài kiểm tra viết, nói hoặc thực hành chính thức, đặc biệt là ở trường học hoặc đại học, để xem bạn biết bao nhiêu về một chủ đề hoặc bạn có thể làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of looking at or considering something very carefully
examples: Careful examination of the ruins revealed an even earlier temple.
The issue needs further examination.
The review is the most detailed examination of policing since 1992.
The chapter concludes with a brief examination of some of the factors causing family break-up.
After a thorough examination, they announced that the suspicious device was harmless.
On closer examination it was found that the signature was not genuine.
Your proposals are still under examination.
The party would open up the issue to examination by a Senate Committee.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động nhìn vào hoặc xem xét một cái gì đó rất cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a close look at something/somebody, especially to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem
examples: SEE ALSO cross-examination
a medical/physical examination
a post-mortem/forensic examination
Regular breast examination is advised.
A specialist should carry out an examination of the patient.
Diagnosis can be made only by direct examination of affected brain tissue.
Further examination by an orthopaedic surgeon will be needed today.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ vào cái gì/ai đó, đặc biệt là để xem có điều gì không ổn hoặc tìm ra nguyên nhân của vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
examples: Most of the buildings in the town are modern, but the church is an exception.
With very few exceptions, private schools get the best exam results.
Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật không được bao gồm trong một tuyên bố chung

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a thing that does not follow a rule
examples: Good writing is unfortunately the exception rather than the rule (= it is unusual).
There are always a lot of exceptions to grammar rules.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều không tuân theo một quy tắc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: people say that something is the exception that proves the rule when they are stating something that seems to be different from the normal situation, but they mean that the normal situation remains true in general
examples: Most electronics companies have not done well this year, but ours is the exception that proves the rule.
definitions.definition_vi: Mọi người nói rằng điều gì đó là ngoại lệ chứng minh quy luật khi họ phát biểu điều gì đó có vẻ khác với tình huống bình thường, nhưng điều đó có nghĩa là tình huống bình thường nói chung vẫn đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to allow somebody not to follow the usual rule on one occasion or for one particular reason
examples: Children are not usually allowed in, but I'm prepared to make an exception in this case.
No parking is allowed, but an exception is made for disabled drivers.
We are making a special exception for Emma because of her condition.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó không làm theo quy tắc thông thường vào một dịp nào đó hoặc vì một lý do cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to object strongly to something; to be angry about something
examples: I take great exception to the fact that you told my wife before you told me.
No one could possibly take exception to his comments.
definitions.definition_vi: phản đối mạnh mẽ điều gì đó; tức giận về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: except; not including
examples: All his novels are set in Italy with the exception of his last.
The whole of the island was flooded with the exception of a small area in the north.
definitions.definition_vi: ngoại trừ; không bao gồm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included
examples: All students without exception must take the English examination.
Without exception, all employees must carry their identity card with them at all times.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng câu nói bạn đang đưa ra luôn đúng và mọi người hoặc mọi thứ đều được bao gồm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate
examples: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
The amounts she borrowed were not excessive.
Excessive drinking can lead to stomach disorders.
He claimed that the police had used excessive force.
definitions.definition_vi: lớn hơn những gì có vẻ hợp lý hoặc phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an act of giving something to somebody or doing something for somebody and receiving something in return
examples: SEE ALSO bill of exchange
The exchange of prisoners took place this morning.
We need to promote an open exchange of ideas and information.
an exchange of glances/insults
an exchange of fire (= between enemy soldiers)
I buy you lunch and you fix my computer. Is that a fair exchange?
Wool and timber were sent to Egypt in exchange for linen or papyrus.
I'll type your report if you'll babysit in exchange.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động đưa cái gì đó cho ai đó hoặc làm điều gì đó cho ai đó và nhận lại cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the process of changing an amount of one currency for an equal value of another
examples: SEE ALSO foreign exchange
currency exchange facilities
Where can I find the best exchange rate/rate of exchange?
definitions.definition_vi: quá trình thay đổi một lượng tiền tệ này lấy giá trị tương đương của một loại tiền tệ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an arrangement when two people or groups from different countries visit each other’s homes or do each other’s jobs for a short time
examples: Our school does an exchange with a school in France.
trade and cultural exchanges with China
Nick went on the French exchange.
definitions.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp khi hai người hoặc nhóm từ các quốc gia khác nhau đến thăm nhà nhau hoặc làm công việc của nhau trong một thời gian ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a conversation or an argument
examples: There was only time for a brief exchange.
The prime minister was involved in a heated exchange with Opposition MPs.
There was an angry exchange between the two players.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc trò chuyện hoặc một cuộc tranh luận

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a building where business people met in the past to buy and sell a particular type of goods
examples: SEE ALSO corn exchange
the old Corn Exchange
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà nơi các doanh nhân gặp nhau trong quá khứ để mua và bán một loại hàng hóa cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a place where phone calls are connected so that people can speak to each otherWord Origin
examples: late Middle English: from Old French eschange (noun), eschangier (verb), based on changer, from late Latin cambiare, from Latin cambire ‘barter’. The spelling was influenced by Latin ex- ‘out, utterly’ (see ex-).
definitions.definition_vi: nơi kết nối các cuộc gọi điện thoại để mọi người có thể nói chuyện với nhau Word Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: only to be used by one particular person or group; only given to one particular person or group
examples: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.
exclusive rights to televise the World Cup
His mother has told ‘The Times’ about his death in an exclusive interview (= not given to any other newspaper).
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ được sử dụng bởi một người hoặc một nhóm cụ thể; chỉ được trao cho một người hoặc một nhóm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not very willing to allow new people to become members, especially if they are from a lower social class
examples: He belongs to an exclusive club.
His clientele was exclusive and wealthy.
definitions.definition_vi: không sẵn lòng cho phép những người mới trở thành thành viên, đặc biệt nếu họ thuộc tầng lớp xã hội thấp hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: of a high quality and expensive and therefore not often bought or used by most people
examples: an exclusive hotel
exclusive designer clothes
definitions.definition_vi: có chất lượng cao và đắt tiền và do đó không được hầu hết mọi người mua hoặc sử dụng thường xuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not including anything else
examples: He had an exclusive focus on success and making money.
This list is not exclusive.
definitions.definition_vi: không bao gồm bất cứ điều gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not including somebody/something
examples: OPPOSITE inclusive
The price is for accommodation only, exclusive of meals.
definitions.definition_vi: không bao gồm ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: not able to exist or be a true statement at the same time as something else
examples: The two options are not mutually exclusive (= you can have them both).
definitions.definition_vi: không thể tồn tại hoặc là một tuyên bố đúng cùng lúc với cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to kill somebody, especially as a legal punishment
examples: He was executed for treason.
The prisoners were executed by firing squad.
definitions.definition_vi: giết ai đó, đặc biệt là như một hình phạt pháp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to do a piece of work, perform a duty, put a plan into action, etc.
examples: They drew up and executed a plan to reduce fuel consumption.
The crime was very cleverly executed.
Check that the computer has executed your commands.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện một công việc, thực hiện một nhiệm vụ, thực hiện một kế hoạch, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to successfully perform an action or movement that requires skill
examples: The pilot executed a perfect landing.
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện thành công một hành động hoặc phong trào đòi hỏi kỹ năng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to make or produce a work of art
examples: Picasso also executed several landscapes at Horta de San Juan.
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện hoặc sản xuất một tác phẩm nghệ thuật

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to follow the instructions in a legal document; to make a document legally acceptable
examples: His will was executed by his lawyers in 2008.
The agreement had been duly executed.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện theo hướng dẫn của văn bản quy phạm pháp luật; để làm cho một tài liệu được chấp nhận về mặt pháp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of killing somebody, especially as a legal punishment
examples: He faced execution by hanging for murder.
Over 200 executions were carried out last year.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động giết ai đó, đặc biệt là một hình phạt pháp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of doing a piece of work, performing a duty, or putting a plan into action
examples: He had failed in the execution of his duty.
The idea was good, but the execution was poor.
The company is liable for any damage caused by faulty execution of the building work.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động thực hiện một công việc, thực hiện một nhiệm vụ hoặc thực hiện một kế hoạch

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: skill in performing or making something, such as a piece of music or work of art
examples: Her execution of the piano piece was perfect.
the poor execution of the film
definitions.definition_vi: kỹ năng biểu diễn hoặc làm một cái gì đó, chẳng hạn như một bản nhạc hoặc tác phẩm nghệ thuật

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the act of following the instructions in a legal document, especially those in somebody’s will
examples: The solicitors are proceeding with the execution of her mother’s will.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động làm theo hướng dẫn trong một văn bản pháp luật, đặc biệt là những hướng dẫn trong di chúc của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a delay in following the order of a court
examples: to grant a stay of execution
There will be no stay of execution and few mourners for this concrete tower block, due to be demolished next month.
definitions.definition_vi: sự chậm trễ trong việc tuân theo lệnh của tòa án

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who has an important job as a manager of a company or an organization
examples: SEE ALSO account executive
company/corporate/business/industry executives
marketing/advertising executives
a senior/top executive in a computer firm
a junior executive at an ad agency
definitions.definition_vi: một người có một công việc quan trọng là người quản lý của một công ty hoặc một tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a group of people who run a company or an organization
examples: The union’s executive has/have yet to reach a decision.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người điều hành một công ty hoặc một tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the part of a government responsible for putting laws into effect
examples: COMPARE judiciary
Conservatives are by tradition believers in a strong executive.
Parliament's ability to control the executive
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của chính phủ chịu trách nhiệm đưa luật pháp có hiệu lực

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be real; to be present in a place or situation
examples: SEE ALSO pre-exist
Does life exist on other planets?
Few of these monkeys still exist in the wild.
Major differences continue to exist between the two countries.
A solution has been found and the problem no longer exists.
On his retirement the post will cease to exist.
Adequate facilities already exist to serve the needs of people visting the town.
It is an art gallery that exists only on the internet.
Evidence of their relationship exists in the form of a series of letters.
I didn't think people like that existed any more.
The charity exists to support victims of crime.
definitions.definition_vi: là có thật; có mặt ở một nơi hoặc một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to live, especially in a difficult situation or with very little money
examples: We existed on a diet of rice.
They can't exist on the money he's earning.
definitions.definition_vi: sống, đặc biệt là trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc với rất ít tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the state or fact of being real or living or of being present
examples: OPPOSITE non-existence
I was unaware of his existence until today.
to believe in the existence of God
the mystery of human existence
The continued existence of the industry depends on the investment of public money.
The peasants depend on a good harvest for their very existence (= in order to continue to live).
The mere existence of these strange creatures fascinated him.
Some groups in the industry seek to deny the existence of a global warming problem.
The school owed its existence to the generosity of one man.
Internet shopping constitutes a threat to the existence of high-street shops.
The company has been in existence since 1924.
This is the oldest Hebrew manuscript in existence.
Pakistan came into existence as an independent country in 1947.
The book acknowledges the existence of graffiti as an art form.
Several species are in danger of being hunted out of existence.
There was a fear that the club might go out of existence for lack of support.
definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái hoặc thực tế là có thật hoặc sống hoặc hiện diện

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a way of living, especially when this is difficult or boring
examples: The family endured a miserable existence in a cramped apartment.
They eke out a precarious existence (= they have hardly enough money to live on).
He lives a hand-to-mouth existence (= he has only enough money for basic needs such as food).
definitions.definition_vi: một cách sống, đặc biệt là khi điều này khó khăn hoặc nhàm chán

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: from or in another country, especially a tropical one; seeming exciting and unusual because it seems to be connected with foreign countries
examples: brightly-coloured exotic flowers/plants/birds
She travels to all kinds of exotic locations all over the world.
The fruits sound exotic. Do they taste good?
definitions.definition_vi: từ hoặc ở một quốc gia khác, đặc biệt là một quốc gia nhiệt đới; có vẻ thú vị và khác thường vì nó dường như được kết nối với nước ngoài

There are no plans to expand the local airport.
The short film is being expanded into a full-length documentary.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn về quy mô, số lượng hoặc tầm quan trọng; làm cho cái gì đó lớn hơn về kích thước, số lượng hoặc tầm quan trọng

definitions.definition_vi: nếu một doanh nghiệp mở rộng hoặc mở rộng, các chi nhánh mới được mở, nó kiếm được nhiều tiền hơn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to talk more; to add details to what you are saying
examples: I repeated the question and waited for her to expand.
definitions.definition_vi: nói chuyện nhiều hơn; để thêm chi tiết vào những gì bạn đang nói

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of spending or using money; an amount of money spent
examples: a reduction in public/government/military expenditure
plans to increase expenditure on health

Savings have been disposed of in order to meet the growing gap between income and expenditure.
definitions.definition_vi: hành vi chi tiêu hoặc sử dụng tiền; một số tiền chi tiêu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the use of energy, time, materials, etc.

definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng năng lượng, thời gian, vật liệu, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the knowledge and skill that you have gained through doing something for a period of time; the process of gaining this

This new approach draws on years of experience of teaching children to read.
a doctor with experience in dealing with patients suffering from stress
He gained extensive experience in the field of artificial intelligence whilst working on the project.
I have over ten years’ experience as a teacher.
The course provides hands-on experience with various systems.

We all learn by experience.
The new player will bring a wealth of experience to the team.
definitions.definition_vi: kiến thức và kỹ năng bạn đạt được sau khi làm việc gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian; quá trình đạt được điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the things that have happened to you that influence the way you think and behave
examples: Experience has taught me that life can be very unfair.
Experience shows that this strategy does not always work.
The book is based on personal experience.
It is important to try and learn from experience.
She knew from past experience that Ann would not give up easily.
In my experience, very few people really understand the problem.
He had first-hand experience of poverty.
the collective experience of everyday life
definitions.definition_vi: những điều đã xảy ra với bạn ảnh hưởng đến cách bạn suy nghĩ và hành xử

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an event or activity that affects you in some way
examples: SEE ALSO near-death experience
a unique/positive/wonderful experience
Share your experiences of parenthood by emailing the address below.
We aim to give our guests the experience of a lifetime.
It was her first experience of living alone.
The play is based loosely on his own life experiences.
He found the whole experience traumatic.
Losing four matches in a row proved a valuable learning experience (= it showed the players what they need to improve).
Living in Africa was very different from home and quite an experience (= unusual for us).
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện hoặc hoạt động ảnh hưởng đến bạn một cách nào đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: what it is like for somebody to use a service, do an activity, attend an event, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO user experience
We are continually looking for ways to improve the customer experience.
Enjoy a fine dining experience with quality service.
definitions.definition_vi: việc ai đó sử dụng một dịch vụ, thực hiện một hoạt động, tham dự một sự kiện, v.v. sẽ như thế nào.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: events or knowledge shared by all the members of a particular group in society, that influences the way they think and behave
examples: musical forms like jazz that emerged out of the Black American experience
definitions.definition_vi: sự kiện hoặc kiến ​​thức được chia sẻ bởi tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm cụ thể trong xã hội, ảnh hưởng đến cách họ suy nghĩ và hành xử

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody should think of a failure as being something that they can learn from
examples: We lost a lot of money, but we just put it down to experience.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng ai đó nên coi thất bại là điều gì đó mà họ có thể học hỏi từ đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity

definitions.definition_vi: có kiến ​​thức hoặc kỹ năng trong một công việc hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having knowledge as a result of doing something for a long time, or having had a lot of different experiences
examples: She's very young and not very experienced.
an experienced traveller (= somebody who has travelled a lot)
She was more mature, more experienced.
definitions.definition_vi: có kiến ​​thức nhờ làm việc gì đó trong thời gian dài hoặc có nhiều kinh nghiệm khác nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the selling and transporting of goods to another country

export earnings/subsidies
an export licence

definitions.definition_vi: việc bán và vận chuyển hàng hóa sang một nước khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a product that is sold to another country
examples: the country’s major exports
a fall in the value of exports

exports from the United States to the European Union
definitions.definition_vi: một sản phẩm được bán cho một quốc gia khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1

Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.

definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị một cái gì đó thường được ẩn

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: nói lên sự thật về một người hoặc một tình huống và cho thấy rằng/điều đó là không trung thực, bất hợp pháp, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to put somebody/something in a place or situation where they are not protected from something harmful or unpleasant

Do not expose babies to strong sunlight.

The roof collapsed, exposing the timbers to the elements.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt ai/cái gì vào một nơi hoặc tình huống mà họ không được bảo vệ khỏi điều gì có hại hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to let somebody find out about something by giving them experience of it or showing them what it is like
examples: We want to expose the kids to as much art and culture as possible.

definitions.definition_vi: để ai đó tìm hiểu về điều gì đó bằng cách cho họ trải nghiệm về nó hoặc cho họ thấy nó như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to allow light into a camera when taking a photograph
definitions.definition_vi: để cho ánh sáng vào máy ảnh khi chụp ảnh

definitions.label: Meaning 6

examples: his exposure as a liar and a fraud

definitions.definition_vi: sự thật về ai đó/điều gì đó được tiết lộ sau khi chúng bị che giấu vì chúng xấu, không trung thực hoặc bất hợp pháp

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the fact of being discussed or mentioned on television, in newspapers, etc.

definitions.definition_vi: thực tế được thảo luận hoặc đề cập trên truyền hình, trên báo chí, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8

definitions.definition_vi: hành động hiển thị một cái gì đó thường được ẩn giấu

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make an action or a process possible or easier

definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện một hành động hoặc một quá trình có thể hoặc dễ dàng hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: things that are true rather than things that have been invented

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề cập đến một tình huống cụ thể tồn tại

definitions.definition_vi: thông tin chính xác và chi tiết

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì là đúng trong một tình huống

examples: As soon as we arrived on the island we were eager to explore.
They explored the land to the south of the Murray River.
The city is best explored on foot.
Westerners did not set out to explore the world until the fifteenth century.
Bears will sometimes explore urban areas for food.
companies exploring for (= searching for) oil
definitions.definition_vi: đi du lịch đến hoặc xung quanh một khu vực hoặc một quốc gia để tìm hiểu về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to examine a subject or a possibility completely or carefully in order to find out more about it
examples: SYNONYM analyse
to explore a theme/an issue
We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.
to explore the possibilities/options
The firm will explore possible joint development projects.
A team was brought in to explore ways to create the most profit for shareholders.
He intends to explore the relationship between economic class and career choice.
a series of programmes in which she explores the world of ballet
definitions.definition_vi: để kiểm tra một chủ đề hoặc một khả năng hoàn toàn hoặc cẩn thận để tìm hiểu thêm về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to feel something with your hands or another part of the body
examples: She explored the sand with her toes.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm nhận điều gì đó bằng tay hoặc bộ phận khác của cơ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a word or phrase
examples: What's the meaning of the expression ‘on cloud nine’?
She uses a lot of slang expressions that I've never heard before.
Keep a list of useful words and expressions.
He's a pain in the butt, if you'll pardon the expression.
definitions.definition_vi: một từ hoặc cụm từ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: things that people say, write or do in order to show their feelings, opinions and ideas
examples: SEE ALSO self-expression
Freedom of expression (= freedom to say what you think) is a basic human right.
The poet's anger finds expression in (= is shown in) the last verse of the poem.
Only in his dreams does he give expression to his fears.
He describes drawing as a very personal form of artistic expression.
Words, as a means of expression, can be limiting.
the expression of emotion/feelings
expressions of concern/sympathy/support
We are calling for expressions of interest from people wanting to take part in the project.
laws which aim to restrict free expression of opinion
definitions.definition_vi: những điều mà mọi người nói, viết hoặc làm để thể hiện cảm xúc, ý kiến ​​và ý tưởng của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a look on a person’s face that shows their thoughts or feelings
examples: SYNONYM look
The actors' gestures and facial expressions are perfect.
He had a pained expression on his face.
The blank expression in her eyes showed that she hadn't understood.
He looked down at the tiny child and his expression softened.
His expression changed from surprise to one of amusement.
Her expression betrayed nothing of her thoughts.
She wore an expression of anger.
definitions.definition_vi: vẻ mặt của một người thể hiện suy nghĩ hoặc cảm xúc của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a strong show of feeling when you are playing music, speaking, acting, etc.
examples: Try to put a little more expression into it!
She plays the violin with great expression.
definitions.definition_vi: sự thể hiện cảm xúc mạnh mẽ khi bạn chơi nhạc, diễn thuyết, diễn xuất, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a group of signs that represent an idea or a quantityWord Origin
examples: late Middle English: from Latin expressio(n-), from exprimere ‘press out, express’. Compare with express(verb).
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm các dấu hiệu đại diện cho một ý tưởng hoặc một số lượngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: how large, important, serious, etc. something is

She was exaggerating the true extent of the problem.
They have launched an investigation to determine the extent of police misconduct in this case.
We don't know the extent of his injuries at this point.
I was amazed at the extent of his knowledge.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó lớn lao, quan trọng, nghiêm túc, v.v. như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the physical size of an area
examples: You can't see the full extent of the beach from here.
The island is 300 square kilometres in extent.
definitions.definition_vi: kích thước vật lý của một khu vực

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to show how far something is true or how great an effect it has
examples: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.
He had changed to such an extent (= so much) that I no longer recognized him.
To some extent what she argues is true.
The pollution of the forest has seriously affected plant life and, to a lesser extent, wildlife.
To what extent is this true of all schools?
The book discusses the extent to which (= how much) family life has changed over the past 50 years.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy điều gì đó đúng đến mức nào hoặc nó có tác dụng lớn như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: more than is usual, expected, or than exists already

extra money/cash/funding
Breakfast is provided at no extra charge.
plans to offer increased broadband speeds at no extra cost
Employees are expected to put in extra hours without pay.
The DVD comes with lots of extra features.
extra help for single parents
a diet that can help you lose that extra weight

The government has promised an extra £1 billion for healthcare.
Take extra care on the roads this evening.
definitions.definition_vi: nhiều hơn mức bình thường, dự kiến ​​hoặc hơn mức đã tồn tại

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a short passage from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea of what the whole thing is like
examples: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
definitions.definition_vi: một đoạn văn ngắn từ một cuốn sách, một bản nhạc, v.v. cho bạn ý tưởng về toàn bộ sự việc như thế nào

definitions.definition: a substance that has been obtained from something else using a particular process
examples: SEE ALSO essence
yeast extract
face cream containing natural plant extracts
vanilla extract
extract of apricot
definitions.definition_vi: một chất thu được từ một thứ khác bằng cách sử dụng một quy trình cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to a very high degree
examples: It is extremely important to follow the directions exactly.
extremely useful/valuable
extremely dangerous/serious/complex
extremely popular/successful
She found it extremely difficult to get a job.
It's still an extremely rare occurrence.
The risks involved are extremely high.
extremely low temperatures
I would be extremely grateful if you could have a word with her.
Their new tablet is selling extremely well.
He works extremely hard.
definitions.definition_vi: ở mức độ rất cao

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: material made by weaving wool, cotton, silk, etc., used for making clothes, curtains, etc. and for covering furniture
examples: They sell a wide variety of printed cotton fabric.
furnishing fabrics
definitions.definition_vi: vật liệu được làm bằng cách dệt len, bông, lụa, v.v., được sử dụng để làm quần áo, rèm cửa, v.v. và để bọc đồ nội thất

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the basic structure of a society, an organization, etc. that enables it to function successfully
examples: a trend which threatens the very fabric of society
definitions.definition_vi: cấu trúc cơ bản của một xã hội, một tổ chức, v.v. cho phép nó hoạt động thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the basic structure of a building, such as the walls, floor and roof
examples: The city retains much of its historic fabric.
definitions.definition_vi: cấu trúc cơ bản của một tòa nhà, chẳng hạn như tường, sàn và mái

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the front part of the head, where the eyes, nose and mouth are
examples: SEE ALSO full face
a pretty/pale/round face
He buried his face in his hands.
to hide/cover your face
You should have seen the look on her face when I told her!
The expression on his face never changed.
She was red in the face with embarrassment.
At that time, her face was on the covers of all the magazines.
definitions.definition_vi: phần phía trước của đầu, nơi có mắt, mũi và miệng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an expression that is shown on somebody’s face
examples: SEE ALSO game face
a smiling/happy/sad face
Her face lit up (= showed happiness) when she spoke of the past.
His face fell (= showed disappointment, sadness, etc.) when he read the headlines.
I could tell by his face it hadn't gone well.
Sue's face was a picture (= she looked very surprised, angry, etc.) as she listened to her husband's speech.
definitions.definition_vi: một biểu hiện được thể hiện trên khuôn mặt của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to refer to a person of the type mentioned
examples: She looked around for a familiar face.
He's a fresh face (= somebody new) at the company.
It's nice to see some new faces here this evening.
The movie is full of famous faces.
a well-known face on our television screens
I'm tired of seeing the same old faces every time we go out!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một người thuộc loại được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: having the type of face or expression mentioned
examples: SEE ALSO baby-faced
pale-faced
a freckle-faced boy
grim-faced
a sad-faced woman
definitions.definition_vi: có kiểu khuôn mặt hoặc biểu cảm được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a side or surface of something
examples: SEE ALSO coalface
the north face of the mountain
the dark face of the moon
A steep path zigzags down the cliff face.
We could see tiny figures climbing the rock face.
Ivy covered the front face of the house.
A banner hung across the face of the building.
How many faces does a cube have?
definitions.definition_vi: một bên hoặc bề mặt của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the front part of a clock or watch
examples: a dial like the face of a clock
definitions.definition_vi: phần trước của đồng hồ hoặc đồng hồ đeo tay

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the particular character of something
examples: the changing face of Britain
This discovery changed the whole face of science.
bureaucracy with a human face
definitions.definition_vi: tính cách đặc biệt của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a particular aspect of something
examples: Social deprivation is the unacceptable face of capitalism.
He has become the public face of the company.
definitions.definition_vi: một khía cạnh cụ thể của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to describe something that you have failed to see, even though it was obvious and should have been easy to see
examples: The answer was staring us in the face but we never saw it until it was too late.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một cái gì đó mà bạn không nhìn thấy được, mặc dù nó rõ ràng và đáng lẽ phải dễ dàng nhìn thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be certain to happen
examples: Defeat was staring them in the face.
definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be unable to avoid something
examples: They were staring defeat in the face.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể tránh được điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face
examples: Guilt was written all over his face.
definitions.definition_vi: rất rõ ràng đối với người khác qua biểu cảm trên khuôn mặt của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: if a plan, etc. blows up in your face, it goes badly wrong in a way that causes you damage or makes you feel embarrassed
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một kế hoạch, v.v. đập thẳng vào mặt bạn, nó sẽ trở nên sai lầm nghiêm trọng theo cách khiến bạn bị tổn hại hoặc khiến bạn cảm thấy xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to do something when you are angry that is meant to harm somebody else but that also harms you
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó khi bạn tức giận có nghĩa là làm hại người khác nhưng điều đó cũng làm hại bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to disappear completely
examples: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.
definitions.definition_vi: biến mất hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to try to do something as hard and as long as you possibly can but without success
examples: You can argue till you're blue in the face, but you won't change my mind.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng làm điều gì đó khó khăn và lâu nhất có thể nhưng không thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody will/will not get a particular job or position because they have/do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important
examples: If your face fits, you'll get the job.
It doesn't matter how well qualified you are; if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó sẽ/sẽ không nhận được một công việc hoặc vị trí cụ thể nào đó vì họ có/không có ngoại hình, tính cách, v.v. mà nhà tuyển dụng mong muốn, ngay cả khi điều này không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: somebody looks very angry
examples: Mr Hibbs came in with a face like thunder.
definitions.definition_vi: ai đó trông rất tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: close to and looking at somebody
examples: The two have never met face to face before.

definitions.definition_vi: đến gần và nhìn ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: in a situation where you have to accept that something is true and deal with it
examples: She was at an early age brought face to face with the horrors of war.
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình huống mà bạn phải chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng và giải quyết nó

definitions.label: Meaning 21

definitions.definition_vi: với mặt và bụng hướng lên trên/xuống dưới

definitions.label: Meaning 22

definitions.definition_vi: với phần hoặc bề mặt phía trước hướng lên trên/xuống dưới

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to fall so that you are lying on your front
definitions.definition_vi: ngã đến mức bạn nằm ngửa

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to fail completely, usually in an embarrassing way
examples: His next television venture fell flat on its face.
definitions.definition_vi: thất bại hoàn toàn, thường là một cách đáng xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to eat a lot of food or too much food
definitions.definition_vi: ăn nhiều thức ăn hoặc quá nhiều thức ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to oppose or be the opposite of something that is usual or expected
examples: Such a proposal is flying in the face of common sense.
definitions.definition_vi: phản đối hoặc trái ngược với điều gì đó bình thường hoặc được mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 27

definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó mà người khác cho là thô lỗ hoặc thể hiện sự thiếu tôn trọng mà không cảm thấy xấu hổ hay xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to be made to look stupid
examples: They were left with egg on their faces when only ten people showed up.
definitions.definition_vi: bị làm cho trông thật ngu ngốc

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: annoying somebody by criticizing them or telling them what to do all the time
examples: Why are you always in my face?
definitions.definition_vi: làm phiền ai đó bằng cách chỉ trích họ hoặc luôn bảo họ phải làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: despite problems, difficulties, etc.
examples: She showed great courage in the face of danger.

definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp những vấn đề, khó khăn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: as a result of something
examples: He was unable to deny the charges in the face of new evidence.
definitions.definition_vi: là kết quả của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 32
definitions.definition: to show in a very obvious way that you have no respect for somebody
definitions.definition_vi: để thể hiện một cách rất rõ ràng rằng bạn không tôn trọng ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 33
definitions.definition: to be forced to change from feeling pleased or satisfied to feeling disappointed or annoyed
examples: He’ll be laughing on the other side of his face when he reads my letter.
definitions.definition_vi: bị buộc phải thay đổi từ cảm giác hài lòng hoặc hài lòng sang cảm thấy thất vọng hoặc khó chịu

definitions.definition: (to have) an unhappy or disappointed expression
examples: He took one look at her long face and said ‘What’s wrong?’

definitions.definition_vi: (có) biểu hiện không vui hoặc thất vọng

definitions.label: Meaning 35
definitions.definition: to look straight at somebody without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
examples: Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying?

I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn thẳng vào ai đó mà không cảm thấy xấu hổ hay xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 36
definitions.definition: to be less respected or look stupid because of something you have done
examples: Many leaders don't want to lose face by admitting failures.
definitions.definition_vi: ít được tôn trọng hoặc trông ngu ngốc vì điều gì đó bạn đã làm

definitions.label: Meaning 37
definitions.definition: the state of being less respected by other people or looking stupid because of something you have done
examples: Failure to pass the exams means a massive loss of face for the students and their parents.
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng ít được người khác tôn trọng hoặc trông ngu ngốc vì điều gì đó bạn đã làm

definitions.label: Meaning 38
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that you have particular skills or qualities
examples: ‘I didn't know you could play the piano.’ ‘I'm not just a pretty face, you know!’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn có kỹ năng hoặc phẩm chất đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 39
definitions.definition: used to say that something seems to be good, true, etc. but that this opinion may need to be changed when you know more about it
examples: On the face of it, it seems like a great deal.
