definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có vẻ tốt, đúng, v.v. nhưng quan điểm này có thể cần phải thay đổi khi bạn biết nhiều hơn về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 40
definitions.definition: very obvious
definitions.definition_vi: rất rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 41
definitions.definition: to produce an expression on your face to show that you do not like somebody/something or in order to make somebody laugh
examples: What are you pulling a face at now?
Do you think it’s funny to make faces behind my back?
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra một biểu cảm trên khuôn mặt để thể hiện rằng bạn không thích ai đó/cái gì đó hoặc để làm ai đó cười

definitions.label: Meaning 42
definitions.definition: to put on make-up
definitions.definition_vi: trang điểm

definitions.label: Meaning 43
definitions.definition: to pretend that you feel confident and happy when you do not
examples: I had to put on a brave face and try to show him that I wasn’t worried.
She put a brave face on her illness.
definitions.definition_vi: giả vờ rằng bạn cảm thấy tự tin và hạnh phúc khi thực tế không phải vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 44
definitions.definition: to avoid or help somebody avoid being embarrassed
examples: She was fired, but she saved face by telling everyone she'd resigned.
definitions.definition_vi: tránh hoặc giúp ai đó tránh bị xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 45
definitions.definition: to be determined to oppose somebody/something
examples: Her father had set his face against the marriage.
definitions.definition_vi: quyết tâm chống lại ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 46
definitions.definition: to appear among your friends or in public
examples: She stayed at home, afraid to show her face.
definitions.definition_vi: xuất hiện giữa bạn bè của bạn hoặc ở nơi công cộng

definitions.label: Meaning 47
definitions.definition: to shut a door hard when somebody is trying to come in
definitions.definition_vi: đóng cửa thật mạnh khi có ai đó đang cố gắng bước vào

definitions.label: Meaning 48
definitions.definition: to refuse to talk to somebody or meet them, in a rude way
definitions.definition_vi: từ chối nói chuyện với ai đó hoặc gặp họ, một cách thô lỗ

definitions.label: Meaning 49
definitions.definition: a rude way of telling somebody to be quiet or stop talking
definitions.definition_vi: một cách thô lỗ để bảo ai đó im lặng hoặc ngừng nói chuyện

definitions.label: Meaning 50
definitions.definition: an action that seems to be intended as a deliberate way of offending and showing lack of respect for somebody
examples: The closure of the school is a slap in the face to the local community.
definitions.definition_vi: một hành động dường như nhằm mục đích xúc phạm và thể hiện sự thiếu tôn trọng đối với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 51
definitions.definition: if you keep a straight face, you do not laugh or smile, although you find something funny
examples: SEE ALSO straight-faced
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn giữ vẻ mặt nghiêm túc, bạn không cười hay mỉm cười, mặc dù bạn thấy điều gì đó buồn cười

definitions.label: Meaning 52
definitions.definition: if you say something to somebody’s face, you say it to them directly rather than to other people

definitions.label: Meaning 2

a common fault with this type of machine

definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó sai hoặc không hoàn hảo; điều gì đó không ổn với máy móc hoặc hệ thống khiến nó không hoạt động bình thường

definitions.definition_vi: một sai lầm mắc phải khi phục vụ

He felt a hand touching his shoulder.

I was OK after my run, but I'll feel it tomorrow.

definitions.definition_vi: trải nghiệm những tác động hoặc kết quả của một cái gì đó, thường mạnh mẽ

If you feel under the desk you'll find a hook.

definitions.definition_vi: để tìm kiếm cái gì đó bằng tay, chân, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: bị hoặc cảm thấy bị đối xử bất công

definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy tự hào và hạnh phúc

definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn về điều gì đó mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng trực tiếp nào và không thể giải thích tại sao bạn chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to want to have or do something
examples: I feel like a drink.
We all felt like celebrating.
He felt like bursting into tears.
We'll go for a walk if you feel like it.
definitions.definition_vi: muốn có hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to not have enough money
examples: Lots of people who have lost their jobs are starting to feel the pinch.
definitions.definition_vi: không có đủ tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển cẩn thận, ví dụ khi trời tối, bằng cách chạm vào tường, đồ vật, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with
examples: She was new in the job, still feeling her way.
definitions.definition_vi: cẩn thận về cách bạn làm mọi việc, thường là vì bạn đang ở trong một tình huống mà bạn không quen thuộc

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to feel that you must do something because of your sense of moral duty
examples: COMPARE duty-bound
She felt honour-bound to attend as she had promised to.
He felt honour bound to help her.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy rằng bạn phải làm điều gì đó vì ý thức trách nhiệm đạo đức của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to look or feel very ill or tired
definitions.definition_vi: trông hoặc cảm thấy rất ốm yếu hoặc mệt mỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to look/feel extremely good
examples: Wow, you look like a million dollars.
definitions.definition_vi: trông/cảm thấy cực kỳ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to look or feel stupid, weak, ashamed, etc.
examples: There’s no need to make me look small in front of all these people.
I felt really small when I realized how much time he’d spent on it.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn hoặc cảm thấy ngu ngốc, yếu đuối, xấu hổ, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to do something to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation
examples: She’s only been here a couple of weeks but she is already making her presence felt.
She certainly made her presence felt in the boardroom.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để mọi người nhận thức rõ ràng rằng bạn đang ở đó; có ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ đến một nhóm người hoặc một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: not to feel as well or lively as usual
examples: I’m not feeling up to the mark at the moment.
definitions.definition_vi: không cảm thấy khỏe hay sống động như thường lệ

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to not feel healthy and well
examples: I’m not quite feeling myself today.
definitions.definition_vi: không cảm thấy khỏe mạnh và tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a series of performances of music, plays, films, etc., usually organized in the same place once a year; a series of public events connected with a particular activity or idea
examples: a film/music festival
the Edinburgh Festival
the Cannes Film Festival
The pub is holding its annual beer festival later this week.
a rock festival (= where bands perform, often outdoors and over a period of several days)
definitions.definition_vi: chuỗi biểu diễn ca nhạc, kịch, phim... thường được tổ chức tại cùng một địa điểm mỗi năm một lần; một loạt các sự kiện công cộng kết nối với một hoạt động hoặc ý tưởng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a day or period of the year when people stop working to celebrate a special event, often a religious one
examples: The family always celebrates the Jewish festivals.
the pilgrims who arrived on major festivals
festivals held in honour of local saints
Holi, the Hindu festival to welcome spring
definitions.definition_vi: ngày hoặc khoảng thời gian trong năm khi mọi người ngừng làm việc để kỷ niệm một sự kiện đặc biệt, thường là một sự kiện tôn giáo

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a type of literature that describes imaginary people and events, not real ones
examples: OPPOSITE non-fiction
a work of popular fiction
historical/romantic/crime fiction
to write/read fiction
a crime fiction writer
definitions.definition_vi: một loại văn học mô tả những người và sự kiện tưởng tượng, không có thật

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a thing that is invented or imagined and is not true
examples: Don't believe what she says—it's pure fiction!
For years he managed to keep up the fiction that he was not married.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều được phát minh hoặc tưởng tượng và không đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to say that things that actually happen are often more surprising than stories that are inventedWord Origin
examples: late Middle English (in the sense ‘invented statement’): via Old French from Latin fictio(n-), from fingere ‘form, contrive’. Compare with feign and figment.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng những điều thực sự xảy ra thường đáng ngạc nhiên hơn những câu chuyện được bịa raNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: numbers, years or temperatures from 50 to 59
examples: She was born in the fifties.
definitions.definition_vi: số, năm hoặc nhiệt độ từ 50 đến 59

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: between the ages of 50 and 59
examples: He retired in his fifties.
definitions.definition_vi: trong độ tuổi từ 50 đến 59

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the activity of being involved in a battle against an enemy
examples: Fighting broke out in three districts of the city last night.
The island was the scene of heavy fighting during World War II.
At least 50 were killed in fierce fighting with local militia.
The fighting between the rebels and our troops continues.
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động tham gia vào trận chiến chống lại kẻ thù

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a physical struggle with somebody
examples: outbreaks of street fighting
definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc đấu tranh thể chất với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an argument or arguments with somebody about something
examples: He hated all the fighting at home.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc tranh luận hoặc tranh luận với ai đó về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the activity of trying very hard to get something or achieve something
examples: years of fighting against the policy
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động cố gắng hết sức để có được cái gì đó hoặc đạt được cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the activity of taking part in a boxing match
examples: SEE ALSO cage fighting
prize fighting (= matches for money)
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động tham gia một trận đấu quyền anh

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a small chance of being successful if a great effort is made
examples: We still have a fighting chance of beating them and winning the Cup.
If you win this round then you still have a fighting chance.
definitions.definition_vi: một cơ hội nhỏ để thành công nếu nỗ lực rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: extremely fit or healthy
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ phù hợp hoặc khỏe mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a feeling that you are ready to fight very hard for something or to try something difficult
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng bạn sẵn sàng chiến đấu hết mình vì điều gì đó hoặc thử điều gì đó khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: comments or remarks that show that you are ready to fight very hard for something
examples: What we want from the management is fighting talk.
definitions.definition_vi: những bình luận hoặc nhận xét cho thấy bạn sẵn sàng chiến đấu hết mình vì điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a box or folded piece of card for keeping loose papers together and in order
examples: a box file
A stack of files awaited me on my desk.
I keep paper copies of all my invoices in this file.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái hộp hoặc một mảnh thẻ gấp để giữ các giấy tờ rời rạc lại với nhau và theo thứ tự

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a collection of information stored together in a computer, under a particular name
examples: SEE ALSO PDF
to create/delete/download/upload a file
to open/access/copy/save a file
a/an PDF/audio/text/image file
The service converts video files from one format to another.
You can transfer and edit files on your smartphone.
The media player supports a wide variety of file formats.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp thông tin được lưu trữ cùng nhau trong máy tính, dưới một cái tên cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a file and the information it contains, for example about a particular person or subject
examples: The film is based on real FBI case files.
secret police files
I made a note in his personeel file.
Your application will be kept on file (= in a file, to be used later).
to have/open/keep a confidential file on somebody
Police have reopened the file (= have started collecting information again) on the missing girl.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập tin và thông tin chứa trong đó, ví dụ về một người hoặc chủ đề cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a number of issues and responsibilities connected with a particular government policy area
examples: The politician's handling of flood, infrastructure and education files has been questioned.
definitions.definition_vi: một số vấn đề và trách nhiệm liên quan đến một lĩnh vực chính sách cụ thể của chính phủ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a metal tool with a rough surface for cutting or shaping hard substances or for making them smooth
examples: SEE ALSO nail file
Use a file to smooth the edge.
definitions.definition_vi: một dụng cụ kim loại có bề mặt nhám để cắt hoặc tạo hình các chất cứng hoặc làm cho chúng mịn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a line of people or things, one behind the other
examples: SEE ALSO rank and file
They set off in file behind the teacher.
definitions.definition_vi: một dòng người hoặc đồ vật, cái này nối tiếp cái kia

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: (in) one line, one behind the other
examples: They made their way in single file along the cliff path.
definitions.definition_vi: (trong) một dòng, dòng này nối tiếp dòng kia

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a device containing paper, sand, chemicals, etc. that a liquid or gas is passed through in order to remove any materials that are not wanted
examples: an air/oil filter
a coffee/water filter
filter paper for the coffee machine
He smokes cigarettes without filters.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị chứa giấy, cát, hóa chất, v.v. mà chất lỏng hoặc khí được truyền qua để loại bỏ bất kỳ vật liệu nào không cần thiết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a device that allows only particular types of light or sound to pass through it
examples: The camera has an anti-glare filter.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị chỉ cho phép một số loại ánh sáng hoặc âm thanh nhất định đi qua nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a program that processes information to leave out the types that are not wanted, or that stops particular types of electronic information, email, etc. from being sent to a computer
examples: Spam filters block out almost all threats.
definitions.definition_vi: một chương trình xử lý thông tin để loại bỏ những loại không mong muốn hoặc ngăn các loại thông tin điện tử, email, v.v. cụ thể được gửi đến máy tính

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a light on a set of traffic lights showing that traffic can turn left (or right) while traffic that wants to go straight ahead or turn right (or left) must wait
examples: a filter lane
definitions.definition_vi: đèn trên bộ đèn giao thông báo hiệu xe có thể rẽ trái (hoặc phải) trong khi xe muốn đi thẳng hoặc rẽ phải (hoặc trái) phải chờ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: being or happening at the end of a series of events, actions, statements, etc.
examples: his final act as party leader
Jamie is in his final year at Stirling University.
the final week/day/minutes of something
The referee blew the final whistle.
The project is in its final stages.
The final round of voting takes place on Sunday.
They find each other in the final chapter of the book.
I'd like to return to the final point you made.
definitions.definition_vi: đang hoặc xảy ra ở phần cuối của một chuỗi các sự kiện, hành động, tuyên bố, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: being the result of a particular process
examples: I think you will be satisfied with the final product.
The final election results have not been announced.
No one could have predicted the final outcome.
The panel will complete its work with a final report.
definitions.definition_vi: là kết quả của một quá trình cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: that cannot be argued with or changed
examples: The judge's decision is final.
Who has the final say around here?
I'll give you $500 for it, and that's my final offer!
I'm not coming, and that's final! (= I will not change my mind)
definitions.definition_vi: điều đó không thể tranh cãi hoặc thay đổi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to say what is most important after everything has been discussed, or considered
examples: In the final analysis, it's a matter of personal choice.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì là quan trọng nhất sau khi mọi việc đã được thảo luận hoặc cân nhắc

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
definitions.definition_vi: sự việc cuối cùng trong một chuỗi sự kiện tồi tệ, v.v. khiến bạn không thể chấp nhận một tình huống nào nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the last comment or decision about something
examples: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
I’m willing to wait one more week, and that’s my final word on the subject.
The Chairman always has the last word on financial decisions.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận xét hoặc quyết định cuối cùng về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in good health
examples: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
I was feeling fine when I got up this morning.
‘How’s your throat?’ ‘It’s fine as long as I don’t cough.’
definitions.definition_vi: sức khỏe tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: of high quality; good
examples: a very fine performance
fine clothes/wines/workmanship
It's a particularly fine example of Saxon architecture.
the finest collection of paintings in Europe
She's a fine actor and an even finer dancer.
Jim has made a fine job of the garden.
people who enjoy the finer things in life (= for example art, good food, etc.)
It was his finest hour (= most successful period) as manager of the England team.
This movie features some of her finest work.
He tried to appeal to their finer feelings (= feelings of duty, love, etc.)
definitions.definition_vi: có chất lượng cao; Tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody that an action, a suggestion or a decision is acceptable
examples: ‘I'll leave this here, OK?’ ‘Fine.’
‘Bob wants to know if he can come too.’ ‘That's fine by me.’
If you don't agree, that's fine with him.
She has been virtually ignoring me but I'm fine with that.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng một hành động, một đề nghị hay một quyết định có thể chấp nhận được

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to say you are satisfied with something
examples: Don't worry. Your speech was fine.
Other than a few damp spots, the place looked fine.
to sound/seem fine
You go on without me. I'll be fine.
‘Can I get you another drink?’ ‘No, thanks. I'm fine.’
Never mind, Jake. Everything will be just fine.
Your hair is perfectly fine the way it is.
This paper's not very good quality, but it's fine for rough work.
You're a fine one to talk! (= you are not in a position to criticize, give advice, etc.)
This is a fine (= terrible) mess we're in!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn hài lòng với điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: bright and not raining
examples: a fine day/evening
I hope it stays fine for the picnic.
It was a fine sunny morning.
That summer saw weeks of fine dry weather.
definitions.definition_vi: sáng sủa và không mưa

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: pleasant to look at
examples: a fine view
a fine-looking woman
a fine figure of a man
The boy looks mighty fine in a uniform.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ chịu khi nhìn vào

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: fine sand

The top 8 inches of earth is very fine, made up of river sediment.
Dip in beaten egg then fine dry breadcrumbs before frying in olive oil.
definitions.definition_vi: làm từ những hạt rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: attractive and small or thin
examples: SYNONYM delicate
fine bone china
She has inherited her mother's fine features (= a small nose, mouth, etc.).
definitions.definition_vi: hấp dẫn và nhỏ hoặc mỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: very thin or narrow; made of very thin or narrow wires or threads
examples: His fine blond hair came down almost to his shoulders.
a fine thread
I need a brush with a fine tip.
a fine sieve/mesh
definitions.definition_vi: rất mỏng hoặc hẹp; làm bằng dây hoặc sợi rất mỏng hoặc hẹp

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: difficult to see or describe
examples: SYNONYM subtle
You really need a magnifying glass to appreciate all the fine detail.
There's no need to make such fine distinctions.
There's a fine line between love and hate (= it is easy for one to become the other).
We still have to iron out the finer details.
definitions.definition_vi: khó nhìn thấy hoặc mô tả

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: that you have a lot of respect for
examples: He was a fine man.
definitions.definition_vi: rằng bạn rất tôn trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: sounding important and impressive but unlikely to have any effect
examples: His speech was full of fine words which meant nothing.
definitions.definition_vi: nghe có vẻ quan trọng và ấn tượng nhưng dường như không có tác dụng gì

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: containing only a particular metal and no other substances that reduce the quality
examples: fine gold
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ chứa một kim loại cụ thể và không có chất nào khác làm giảm chất lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that somebody has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người nói rằng cơ hội sẽ là một điều tốt để chứng tỏ rằng họ muốn làm hoặc có được thứ mà ai đó đã đề cập, nhưng họ không nghĩ rằng điều đó rất có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: the more complicated or detailed aspects of something
examples: She seems at ease discussing the finer points of foreign policy.
He learnt the finer points of cricket during a trip to London.
definitions.definition_vi: các khía cạnh phức tạp hoặc chi tiết hơn của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: healthy; in good condition
examples: The team is in fine fettle.
Park Foods is in fine fettle after selling off all non-core businesses.
definitions.definition_vi: khỏe mạnh; trong tình trạng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism
examples: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một cái gì đó được thể hiện rõ ràng và trực tiếp, đặc biệt là một lời chỉ trích

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
examples: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm mà bạn có thể dễ dàng phạm sai lầm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included)
examples: SEE ALSO butterfingers
She ran her fingers through her hair.
Hold the material between finger and thumb.
He was about to speak but she raised a finger to her lips.
The old man wagged his finger at the youths.
Tina curled her slender fingers into a fist.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong bốn phần mỏng dài nhô ra khỏi bàn tay (hoặc năm phần, nếu bao gồm cả ngón tay cái)

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having the type of fingers mentioned; having or using the number of fingers mentioned
examples: SEE ALSO light-fingered
long-fingered
nimble-fingered
a four-fingered chord
definitions.definition_vi: có loại ngón tay được đề cập; có hoặc sử dụng số lượng ngón tay được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the part of a glove that covers the finger
definitions.definition_vi: phần của chiếc găng tay che ngón tay

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a long narrow piece of bread, cake, land, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO fish finger
chocolate fingers
a finger of toast
a narrow finger of land pointing out into the sea
definitions.definition_vi: một miếng bánh mì, bánh ngọt, đất dài, hẹp, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to say that the total number of somebody/something is very small
examples: She could count on the fingers of one hand the people she actually enjoyed being with.
Although she knew lots of people, she could count her friends on the fingers of one hand.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng tổng số lượng ai đó/cái gì đó rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to be awkward with your hands so that you drop things or are unable to do something
definitions.definition_vi: lúng túng với bàn tay của bạn đến mức bạn đánh rơi đồ vật hoặc không thể làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to suffer as a result of doing something without realizing the possible bad results, especially in business
examples: He got his fingers badly burnt dabbling in the stock market.
definitions.definition_vi: chịu đựng hậu quả của việc làm gì đó mà không nhận ra những kết quả xấu có thể xảy ra, đặc biệt là trong kinh doanh

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to hope that your plans will be successful (sometimes putting one finger across another as a sign of hoping for good luck)
examples: I'm crossing my fingers that my proposal will be accepted.
Keep your fingers crossed!
definitions.definition_vi: hy vọng kế hoạch của bạn sẽ thành công (đôi khi đặt ngón tay này lên ngón tay khác như một dấu hiệu hy vọng may mắn)

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to refer to an estimate or method of doing something that is not very accurate or scientific and partly based on guessing
examples: It isn’t an exact science—it’s a kind of finger in the air thing.
‘It’s all a bit finger in the air,’ admitted a spokesman.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ sự ước tính hoặc phương pháp làm việc gì đó không chính xác hoặc không khoa học và một phần dựa trên sự phỏng đoán

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: if the finger of blame/suspicion points or is pointed at somebody, they are suspected of having committed a crime, being responsible for something, etc.
examples: The inquiry pointed the finger of blame at the driver of the crashed coach.
The finger of suspicion was pointed at the chicken served for lunch.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu ngón tay đổ lỗi/nghi ngờ chỉ vào ai đó, họ bị nghi ngờ đã phạm tội, phải chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to start doing some work or making an effort
examples: You're going to have to pull your finger out if you want to pass this exam.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó bắt đầu làm một số công việc hoặc nỗ lực

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to raise your middle finger in the air with the back part of your hand facing somebody, done to be rude to somebody or to show them that you are angry
definitions.definition_vi: giơ ngón giữa lên trời với phần sau của bàn tay hướng về phía ai đó, thể hiện sự thô lỗ với ai đó hoặc để cho họ thấy rằng bạn đang tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be involved in a lot of different activities and have influence over them, especially when other people think that this is annoying
definitions.definition_vi: tham gia vào nhiều hoạt động khác nhau và có ảnh hưởng đến họ, đặc biệt khi người khác nghĩ rằng điều này thật khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to always be aware of the most recent developments in a particular situation
definitions.definition_vi: luôn luôn nhận thức được những phát triển gần đây nhất trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to be stealing money from the place where you work
definitions.definition_vi: ăn trộm tiền ở nơi bạn làm việc

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be likely to steal something
definitions.definition_vi: có khả năng ăn cắp một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to touch somebody with the intention of hurting them physically
examples: I never laid a finger on her.
If you lay a finger on me, I’ll call the police.
definitions.definition_vi: chạm vào ai đó với ý định làm tổn thương họ về mặt thể chất

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to miss or fail to use an opportunity
examples: Don't let the chance to work abroad slip through your fingers.
definitions.definition_vi: bỏ lỡ hoặc không tận dụng được cơ hội

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to do nothing to help somebody
examples: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.
definitions.definition_vi: không làm gì để giúp đỡ ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to accuse somebody of doing something
examples: RELATED NOUN finger-pointing
The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc tội ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to (not) be able to identify what is wrong or different about a particular situation
examples: There was something odd about him but I couldn't put my finger on it.
You've put your finger on something there—we'll need to investigate that.
definitions.definition_vi: (không) có thể xác định điều gì sai hoặc khác biệt trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to form the shape of a V with the two fingers nearest your thumb and raise your hand in the air with the back part of it facing somebody, done to be rude to them or to show them that you are angry
examples: SEE ALSO V-sign
She enjoys sticking two fingers up to convention.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo thành hình chữ V với hai ngón tay gần ngón cái nhất của bạn và giơ tay lên trời với phần sau của nó hướng về phía ai đó, được thực hiện để tỏ ra thô lỗ với họ hoặc để cho họ thấy rằng bạn đang tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to make a sharp noise by moving your second or third finger quickly against your thumb, to attract somebody’s attention, or to mark the beat of music, for example
examples: He snapped his fingers for the waiter to bring more wine.
He snapped his fingers and the waiter came running.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra âm thanh sắc nét bằng cách di chuyển nhanh ngón tay thứ hai hoặc thứ ba của bạn so với ngón tay cái của bạn, để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó hoặc để đánh dấu nhịp điệu của âm nhạc chẳng hạn

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to work very hardWord Origin
examples: Old English, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch vinger and German Finger.
definitions.definition_vi: làm việc rất chăm chỉWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to stop doing something or making something because it is complete
examples: Haven't you finished your homework yet?
She finished law school last year.
You only get points if you finish the race.
I thought you'd never finish!
We've just finished the project.
Let me just finish what I'm doing.
Be quiet! He hasn't finished speaking.
He finished by telling us about his trip to Spain.
‘And that was all,’ she finished.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng làm việc gì đó hoặc làm việc gì đó vì nó đã hoàn thành

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to come to an end; to bring something to an end
examples: The play finished at 10.30.
The symphony finishes with a flourish.
The evening finished with a few songs.
A cup of coffee finished the meal perfectly.
definitions.definition_vi: đi đến kết thúc; để kết thúc một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to eat, drink or use what remains of something
examples: I quickly finished my tea.
He finished off his drink with one large gulp.
We might as well finish up the cake.
definitions.definition_vi: ăn, uống hoặc sử dụng những gì còn lại của cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be in a particular state or position at the end of a race or a competition
examples: She was delighted to finish second.
He finished 12 seconds outside the world record.
The team finished the season in ninth position.
The dollar finished the day slightly down.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong một trạng thái hoặc vị trí cụ thể khi kết thúc một cuộc đua hoặc một cuộc thi

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to make somebody so tired or impatient that they cannot do any more
examples: Climbing that hill really finished me off.
A lecture from my parents now would just finish me.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó quá mệt mỏi hoặc thiếu kiên nhẫn đến mức họ không thể làm gì được nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the flames, light and heat, and often smoke, that are produced when something burns
examples: Most animals are afraid of fire.
When did people start to cook with fire?
definitions.definition_vi: ngọn lửa, ánh sáng, nhiệt và thường là khói được tạo ra khi vật gì đó cháy

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: flames that are out of control and destroy buildings, trees, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO bush fire
Several youths had set fire to the police car (= had made it start burning).
The car was on fire.
A candle had set the curtains on fire.
These thatched roofs frequently catch fire (= start to burn).
Forest fires raged all over Australia.
Five people died in a house fire.
Fires were breaking out everywhere.
A fire had started in the kitchen.
He was accused of deliberately starting a fire.
Fire can spread very quickly.
The fire burned for three days before it was finally contained.
The warehouse was destroyed by fire.
It took two hours to put out the fire (= stop it burning).
Fire crews arrived and began to fight the flames.
We have to comply with fire safety regulations.
definitions.definition_vi: ngọn lửa ngoài tầm kiểm soát và phá hủy các tòa nhà, cây cối, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a pile of burning fuel, such as wood or coal, used for cooking food or heating a room
examples: SEE ALSO bonfire
They cook on an open fire.
a log/coal/wood fire
Sam had lit a fire to welcome us home.
to make/build a fire
Come and get warm by the fire.
We sat in front of a roaring fire.
definitions.definition_vi: một đống nhiên liệu đốt, chẳng hạn như gỗ hoặc than, được sử dụng để nấu thức ăn hoặc sưởi ấm căn phòng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a piece of equipment for heating a room
examples: SEE ALSO heater
a gas/an electric fire
Shall I put the fire on?
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị để sưởi ấm căn phòng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: shots from guns
examples: SEE ALSO friendly fire
The gunmen opened fire on (= started shooting at) the police.
Their vehicle came under fire (= was being shot at).
The men were under heavy fire (= being shot at many times).
He was hit by enemy fire.
a burst of machine-gun fire
artillery/rocket/mortar fire
to return fire (= to fire back at somebody who is shooting at you)
He ordered his men to hold their fire (= not to shoot).
Protesters exchanged fire with the guards (= they shot at each another).
A young girl was in the line of fire (= between the person shooting and what he/she was shooting at).
I’ll give you covering fire while you try to escape.
definitions.definition_vi: phát súng từ súng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: strong criticism
examples: She directed her fire against the new education policy.
The health minister has come under fire from all sides.
definitions.definition_vi: sự chỉ trích mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: very strong emotion, especially anger or enthusiasm
examples: Her eyes were full of fire.
The fire seemed to die in him when his wife died.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm xúc rất mạnh mẽ, đặc biệt là sự tức giận hoặc nhiệt tình

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a person who is full of energy and enthusiasm
definitions.definition_vi: một người tràn đầy năng lượng và nhiệt huyết

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a difficult introduction to a new job or activity
definitions.definition_vi: một lời giới thiệu khó khăn về một công việc hoặc hoạt động mới

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to make somebody direct their anger, criticism, etc. at you, so that others do not have to face it
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hướng sự tức giận, chỉ trích, v.v. vào bạn, để người khác không phải đối mặt với điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to use similar methods in a fight or an argument to those your opponent is using
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng các phương pháp tương tự trong một cuộc chiến hoặc tranh luận với những phương pháp mà đối thủ của bạn đang sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: a very strong desire to achieve something
examples: You need fire in your belly if you want to make it in the music business.
definitions.definition_vi: một mong muốn rất mạnh mẽ để đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to become friends quickly and have a very friendly relationship
definitions.definition_vi: để nhanh chóng trở thành bạn bè và có một mối quan hệ rất thân thiện

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to delay or be delayed in taking action
examples: The project had hung fire for several years for lack of funds.
definitions.definition_vi: trì hoãn hoặc trì hoãn thực hiện hành động

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to be involved in several activities or areas of business at the same time, hoping that at least one will be successful
definitions.definition_vi: tham gia vào một số hoạt động hoặc lĩnh vực kinh doanh cùng một lúc, hy vọng rằng ít nhất một hoạt động sẽ thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: if something bad is being said about somebody/something, it usually has some truth in it
definitions.definition_vi: nếu có điều gì xấu được nói về ai đó/điều gì đó, nó thường có một phần sự thật trong đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: giving you a painful burning feeling
examples: He couldn't breathe. His chest was on fire.
definitions.definition_vi: mang đến cho bạn cảm giác đau rát

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: from a bad situation to one that is worse
definitions.definition_vi: từ một tình huống xấu đến một tình huống tồi tệ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to act in a way that is not sensible and take dangerous risks
definitions.definition_vi: hành động một cách không hợp lý và chấp nhận rủi ro nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to be very successful and admired by other people
examples: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.
definitions.definition_vi: rất thành công và được người khác ngưỡng mộ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a gun that can be carried
examples: The police were issued with firearms.
definitions.definition_vi: một khẩu súng có thể được mang theo

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small device containing powder that burns or explodes and produces bright coloured lights and loud noises, used especially at celebrations
examples: to let off a few fireworks
to set off a few fireworks
a firework(s) display
The firework spluttered and went out.
They set off fireworks in their back garden.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị nhỏ chứa bột có khả năng cháy hoặc nổ và tạo ra ánh sáng màu rực rỡ và tiếng ồn lớn, đặc biệt được sử dụng trong các lễ kỷ niệm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a display of fireworks
examples: When do the fireworks start?
Thousands of people jammed into People’s Square to watch the fireworks.
definitions.definition_vi: một màn trình diễn pháo hoa

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: strong or angry words; exciting actions
examples: There'll be fireworks when he finds out!
definitions.definition_vi: lời nói mạnh mẽ hoặc giận dữ; hành động thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a business or company
examples: a law/consulting/research firm
an accounting/investment firm
They hired an engineering firm to produce a model of their device.
a firm of solicitors/accountants/architects
She works for a firm of management consultants based in London.
definitions.definition_vi: một doanh nghiệp hoặc công ty

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: happening or coming before all other similar things or people; 1st
examples: his first wife
the first turning on the right
I didn't take the first bus.
It was the first time they had ever met.
It's always exciting to visit a country for the first time.
students in their first year at college
First impressions can be misleading.
She resolved to do it at the first (= earliest) opportunity.
King Edward I (= pronounced ‘King Edward the First’)
the first of May/May 1st
His second book is better than his first.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc đến trước tất cả những sự vật hoặc con người tương tự khác; thứ nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the most important or best
examples: Your first duty is to your family.
She won first prize in the competition.
an issue of the first importance
definitions.definition_vi: điều quan trọng nhất hoặc tốt nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: happening or coming before all other similar things or people; 1st
examples: his first wife
the first turning on the right
I didn't take the first bus.
It was the first time they had ever met.
It's always exciting to visit a country for the first time.
students in their first year at college
First impressions can be misleading.
She resolved to do it at the first (= earliest) opportunity.
King Edward I (= pronounced ‘King Edward the First’)
the first of May/May 1st
His second book is better than his first.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc đến trước tất cả những sự vật hoặc con người tương tự khác; thứ nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the most important or best
examples: Your first duty is to your family.
She won first prize in the competition.
an issue of the first importance
definitions.definition_vi: điều quan trọng nhất hoặc tốt nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be the right shape and size for somebody/something
examples: I tried the dress on but it didn't fit.
That jacket fits well.
My shoes fit perfectly.
a close-fitting dress
I can't find clothes to fit me.
The key doesn't fit the lock.
definitions.definition_vi: có hình dạng và kích thước phù hợp với ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be of the right size, type or number to go somewhere
examples: I'd like to have a desk in the room but it won't fit.
All the kids will fit in the back of the car.
This device is small enough to fit in a pocket.
His arms fitted snugly around me.
definitions.definition_vi: đúng kích cỡ, chủng loại hoặc số lượng để đi đâu đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to put clothes on somebody and make them the right size and shape
examples: I'm going to be fitted for my wedding dress today.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc quần áo cho ai đó và làm cho chúng có kích thước và hình dạng phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to put or fix something somewhere
examples: They fitted a smoke alarm to the ceiling.
uPVC windows have been fitted throughout the house.
The rooms were all fitted with smoke alarms.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt hoặc sửa cái gì đó ở đâu đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to put or join something in the right place
examples: The glass fits on top of the jug to form a lid.
How do these two parts fit together?
We fitted together the pieces of the puzzle.
If the top of the box fits badly, the contents will spill out.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt hoặc tham gia cái gì đó vào đúng nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to agree with, match or be suitable for something; to make something do this
examples: Something doesn't quite fit here.
His pictures don't fit into any category.
The words fit perfectly with the music.
The facts certainly fit your theory.
to fit a description/profile
The punishment ought to fit the crime.
We tailor our programs to fit their needs.
Most organizations do not fit this model.
We should fit the punishment to the crime.
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý, phù hợp hoặc phù hợp với điều gì đó; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to make somebody/something suitable for a particular job or situation
examples: His experience fitted him perfectly for the job.
She was well fitted to the role of tragic heroine.
His experience fitted him to do the job.
Natural selection will see to it that animals are well fitted to survive in their environment.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai/cái gì phù hợp với một công việc hoặc tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be like a particular person or thing
examples: A child answering the description of the missing boy was found safe and well in London yesterday.
We're all looking for quick, healthy meals, and pasta this fits this description.
definitions.definition_vi: giống như một người hoặc vật cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody will/will not get a particular job or position because they have/do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important
examples: If your face fits, you'll get the job.
It doesn't matter how well qualified you are; if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó sẽ/sẽ không nhận được một công việc hoặc vị trí cụ thể nào đó vì họ có/không có ngoại hình, tính cách, v.v. mà nhà tuyển dụng mong muốn, ngay cả khi điều này không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be what is needed in a particular situation or for a particular purpose
examples: On paper, several of the applicants fit the bill.
definitions.definition_vi: là những gì cần thiết trong một tình huống cụ thể hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to try to find a way to become rich, especially by going to another place
examples: Many emigrated to Australia to seek their fortune.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng tìm cách trở nên giàu có, đặc biệt bằng cách đi đến nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: towards a place or position that is in front
examples: OPPOSITE back
She leaned forward and kissed him on the cheek.
He took two steps forwards.
They ran forward to welcome her.
The procession slowly moved forward.
Turn your wrists so that your palms face forward.
He stands by the fire, rocking backward and forward.
definitions.definition_vi: hướng tới một địa điểm hoặc vị trí ở phía trước

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: towards the future; ahead in time
examples: SEE ALSO flash-forward
Looking forward, we hope to expand our operations in several of our overseas branches.
The next scene takes the story forwards five years.
The series moves back and forward through time.
from this day forward
definitions.definition_vi: hướng tới tương lai; đi trước thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: towards a good result
examples: OPPOSITE backwards
We consider this agreement to be an important step forward.
Cutting our costs is the only way forward.
We are not getting any further forward with the discussion.
The project will go forward (= continue) as planned.
The 21st century has seen trade between the two countries leap forward.
definitions.definition_vi: hướng tới một kết quả tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: earlier; sooner
examples: It was decided to bring the meeting forward two weeks.
definitions.definition_vi: sớm hơn; sớm hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in or towards the front part of a ship or plane
examples: The main cabin is situated forward of (= in front of) the mast.
definitions.definition_vi: trong hoặc về phía trước của một con tàu hoặc máy bay

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: from one place or position to another and back again many times
examples: She rocked backwards and forwards on her chair.
The film skips backwards and forwards through time.
definitions.definition_vi: từ nơi này hoặc vị trí này đến nơi khác và quay lại nhiều lần

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: in the future, starting from now
examples: We have a very solid financial position going forward.
The strategy going forward is still undecided.
Moving forward, we need to have a real plan.
definitions.definition_vi: trong tương lai, bắt đầu từ bây giờ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to make a great effort to do something, especially if it is difficult or you are feeling tired
definitions.definition_vi: nỗ lực hết sức để làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt nếu việc đó khó khăn hoặc bạn cảm thấy mệt mỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to change the time shown by clocks, usually by one hour, when the time changes officially, for example at the beginning and end of summer
examples: Remember to put your clocks back tonight.
definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi thời gian hiển thị trên đồng hồ, thường là một giờ, khi thời gian thay đổi chính thức, ví dụ vào đầu và cuối mùa hè

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to encourage something to develop
examples: SYNONYM encourage
The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.
definitions.definition_vi: để khuyến khích một cái gì đó để phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take another person’s child into your home for a period of time, without becoming his or her legal parents
examples: COMPARE adopt
They have fostered over 60 children during the past ten years.
We couldn't adopt a child, so we decided to foster.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa con của người khác về nhà mình trong một thời gian mà không trở thành cha mẹ hợp pháp của người đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small part or amount of something
examples: Only a small fraction of a bank's total deposits will be withdrawn at any one time.
She hesitated for the merest fraction of a second.
He raised his voice a fraction.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần nhỏ hoặc số lượng của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a division of a number, for example ⅝
examples: SYNONYM rational number
How do you express 25% as a fraction?
definitions.definition_vi: phép chia của một số, ví dụ ⅝

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a quantity of liquid that has been collected as a result of a process that separates the parts of a liquid mixture
examples: The third fraction contains alchohols with boiling points of 120–130℃.
definitions.definition_vi: một lượng chất lỏng được thu thập do quá trình tách các phần của hỗn hợp chất lỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: easily broken or damaged
examples: fragile china/glass/bones
Be careful not to drop it; it’s very fragile.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ dàng bị hỏng hoặc hư hỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: weak and uncertain; easy to destroy or harm
examples: a fragile alliance/ceasefire/relationship
The economy remains extremely fragile.
In her job she was used to dealing with actors’ fragile egos.
fragile habitats threatened by pollution
definitions.definition_vi: yếu đuối và không chắc chắn; dễ bị phá hủy hoặc gây hại

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: thin or light and often beautiful
examples: fragile beauty
The woman's fragile face broke into a smile.
definitions.definition_vi: mỏng hoặc nhẹ và thường đẹp

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not strong and likely to become ill
examples: Her father is now 86 and in fragile health.
I'm feeling a bit fragile after last night (= not well, perhaps because of drinking too much alcohol).
definitions.definition_vi: không khỏe và có khả năng bị bệnh

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger
examples: Police found fragments of glass near the scene.
The shattered vase lay in fragments on the floor.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần nhỏ của một cái gì đó đã bị vỡ ra hoặc đến từ một cái gì đó lớn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a single part of something; a part that is not complete
examples: I overheard a fragment of their conversation.
She could recall only fragments of his poetry.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần duy nhất của một cái gì đó; một phần chưa hoàn chỉnh

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: without particular plans or arrangements; not busy
examples: Are you free on Saturday? We're having a barbecue.
We try to keep Sundays free.
If Sarah is free for lunch I'll take her out.
Keep Friday night free for my party.
What do you like to do in your free time (= when you are not working)?
definitions.definition_vi: không có kế hoạch hoặc sự sắp xếp cụ thể; không bận

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not being used
examples: He held out his free hand and I took it.
Is this seat free?
definitions.definition_vi: không được sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: costing nothing
examples: Admission is free.
free software/tickets
We even offer a free web design service.
We''ll give you a fabulous free gift with each copy you buy.
Use of the pool is free to members.
Updates are free for registered users.
You can't expect people to work for free (= without payment).
definitions.definition_vi: không tốn kém gì

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not under the control or in the power of somebody else; able to do what you want
examples: I have no ambitions other than to have a happy life and be free.
Students have a free choice of modules in their final year.
You are free to leave at any time.
The government wants to leave companies free to make their own decisions.
The organization wants to remain free from government control.
We want an independent state free of foreign interference.
‘Can I sit here?’ ‘Please, feel free (= of course you can).’
Feel free to email me if you have any questions.
definitions.definition_vi: không chịu sự kiểm soát hoặc quyền lực của người khác; có thể làm những gì bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not limited or controlled by anyone else
examples: A true democracy needs free speech and a free press.
He called for free and fair elections.
They gave me free access to all the files.
definitions.definition_vi: không bị giới hạn hoặc kiểm soát bởi bất cứ ai khác

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: not a prisoner or slave
examples: He walked out of jail a free man.
The hostages were all set free.
The hacker is currently free on bail.
definitions.definition_vi: không phải là tù nhân hay nô lệ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: not tied up or in a cage
examples: The researchers set the birds free.
Our livestock is free to roam.
definitions.definition_vi: không bị trói hoặc nhốt trong lồng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: clear; not blocked
examples: Ensure there is a free flow of air around the machine.
the free movement of traffic
definitions.definition_vi: thông thoáng; không bị chặn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: not containing or affected by something harmful or unpleasant
examples: free from artificial colours and flavourings
Everyone deserves to live free from fear.
free of defects/problems/symptoms
Beef producers want their herds free of disease.
It was several weeks before he was completely free of pain.
We've managed to keep the garden free of weeds this year.
definitions.definition_vi: không chứa hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi một cái gì đó có hại hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: without the thing mentioned
examples: SEE ALSO duty-free
pure, additive-free ingredients
a trouble-free life
After six months of treatment he is cancer-free.
definitions.definition_vi: không có điều được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: not attached to something; not stuck somewhere and unable to move
examples: Pull gently on the free end of the rope.
She finally managed to pull herself free.
They tied him up but he managed to get free.
They had to be cut free from their car after the accident.
The boat had broken free of its moorings.
They swam free of the wreckage.
definitions.definition_vi: không gắn bó với cái gì đó; không bị mắc kẹt ở đâu đó và không thể di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: ready to give something, especially when it is not wanted
examples: He's too free with his opinions.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng cho đi một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi nó không được mong muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: a free translation is not exact but gives the general meaning
examples: COMPARE literal
definitions.definition_vi: bản dịch tự do không chính xác nhưng mang lại ý nghĩa chung

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to have done something successfully, especially when it was difficult
examples: I could see the finish line and thought I was home free.
definitions.definition_vi: làm việc gì đó thành công, đặc biệt là khi gặp khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: informal; relaxed
examples: Life was never going to be so free and easy again.
definitions.definition_vi: không chính thức; thư giãn

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: if you give somebody a free pass or somebody gets a free pass, they are not punished for something bad they have done, or they are given permission to do something bad
examples: This time he gets a free pass but if he does it again, he’ll be sent to jail.
Just because someone has expensive designer gear, it doesn't mean they have a free pass to be mean to my staff.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn cho ai đó một tấm vé miễn phí hoặc ai đó được một tấm vé miễn phí, họ sẽ không bị trừng phạt vì điều xấu họ đã làm hoặc họ được phép làm điều gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions
examples: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được, có, vv cơ hội để làm những gì bạn muốn làm và đưa ra quyết định của riêng bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to get or take something without paying because somebody else is paying for it
definitions.definition_vi: lấy hoặc lấy thứ gì đó mà không phải trả tiền vì có người khác đang trả tiền cho nó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely
examples: The designer was given free rein.
The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.
definitions.definition_vi: trao cho ai đó quyền tự do hành động hoàn toàn; để cho phép một cảm giác được thể hiện một cách tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: used as a reply when somebody suggests that you should not do something, or when somebody has asked permission or said they are going to do something
examples: It's a free country; I'll say what I like!
Wear what you like. It's a free country.
‘It's a free country!’ he shouted. ‘I can do what I like!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để trả lời khi ai đó gợi ý rằng bạn không nên làm điều gì đó hoặc khi ai đó xin phép hoặc nói rằng họ sẽ làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: used to say that it is not possible to get something for nothing
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không thể có được thứ gì đó mà không mất gì

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to be allowed to leave court, etc., without receiving any punishment
examples: She was acquitted and walked free from court.
definitions.definition_vi: được phép rời khỏi tòa án, v.v., mà không phải nhận bất kỳ hình phạt nào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the power or right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you
examples: to defend/protect academic freedom
Press freedom is under attack.
All groups enjoyed religious freedom.
As a society we value personal freedom and privacy.
We just want freedom of choice.
Everyone has the right to freedom of expression.
freedom of conscience/thought/worship
The government continues to restrict freedom of movement.
Enjoy the freedom of the outdoors (= where you can do what you want).
rights and freedoms guaranteed by the constitution
complete freedom to do as you wish
These proposals would give health authorities greater freedom in deciding how to spend their money.
definitions.definition_vi: sức mạnh hoặc quyền làm hoặc nói những gì bạn muốn mà không có ai ngăn cản bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the state of not being a prisoner or slave
examples: He finally won his freedom after twenty years in jail.
Many slaves who gained their freedom lost it again after the war.
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng không phải là tù nhân hay nô lệ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the state of not being ruled by a foreign or cruel government
examples: We believe in freedom and democracy.
He was a champion of Irish freedom.
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng không bị cai trị bởi một chính phủ nước ngoài hoặc độc ác

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the state of being able to move easily
examples: The skirt has a side split for freedom of movement.
Free-range hens have greater freedom to move about.
definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái có thể di chuyển dễ dàng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the state of not being affected by the thing mentioned
examples: All people should be guaranteed freedom from fear.
freedom from discrimination based on gender or ethnicity
freedom from pain and disease
definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái không bị ảnh hưởng bởi điều được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: permission to use something without limits
examples: I was given the freedom of the whole house.
definitions.definition_vi: quyền sử dụng một cái gì đó không có giới hạn

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: Small farmers have limited room for manoeuvre.
definitions.definition_vi: cơ hội để thay đổi cách một điều gì đó xảy ra và ảnh hưởng đến các quyết định được đưa ra

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to repair or correct something
examples: The car won't start—can you fix it?
I've fixed the problem.

examples: What are you giving your father for his birthday?
She was given a huge bunch of flowers.
Did you give the waiter a tip?
She gave a couple of pounds to the beggar.
We all agreed not to give presents this year.
They say it's better to give than to receive.
definitions.definition_vi: trao cái gì đó cho ai đó như một món quà; để cho phép ai đó có một cái gì đó như một món quà

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to provide somebody with something
examples: They were all thirsty so I gave them a drink.
Give me your name and address.
We've been given a 2 per cent pay increase.
I was hoping you would give me a job.
He was given a new heart in a five-hour operation.
Give me some time to decide.
We should at least give him the opportunity to explain why he did this.
This should give you some idea of the extent of the problem.
Can you give us some sense of exactly what is at stake here?
We'll give you all the help we can.
She wants a job that gives her more responsibility.
Can I give you a ride to the station?
I'll give you (= allow you to have) ten minutes to prepare your answer.
Don't give me any of that backchat (= don't be rude).
He gives Italian lessons to his colleagues.
The reforms should give a better chance to the less able children.
She gave some helpful advice.
She gives the impression of being very busy.
I was asked to give evidence at the trial.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to pay money to a charity, etc., to help people
examples: We need your help—please give generously.
They both gave regularly to charity.
I gave a small donation.
A lot of people give money to good causes.
definitions.definition_vi: để trả tiền cho một tổ chức từ thiện, vv, để giúp đỡ mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to pay in order to have or do something
examples: I'll give you £100 and not a penny more!
How much will you give me for the car?
I'd give anything to see him again.
I gave £50 for the lot.
definitions.definition_vi: trả tiền để có hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used with a noun to describe a particular action, giving the same meaning as the related verb
examples: She gave a shrug of her shoulders (= shrugged).
He turned to us and gave a big smile (= smiled broadly).
She looked up from her work and gave a yawn (= yawned).
He gave a loud cry (= cried out loudly) and fell to the floor.
Her work has given pleasure to (= pleased) millions of readers.
He gave her a kiss (= kissed her).
I have to admit that the news gave us a shock (= shocked us).
He gave me a suspicious look (= looked at me suspiciously).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với một danh từ để mô tả một hành động cụ thể, mang ý nghĩa tương tự như động từ liên quan

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to produce a particular feeling in somebody
examples: All that driving has given me a headache.
Go for a walk. It'll give you an appetite.
definitions.definition_vi: để tạo ra một cảm giác đặc biệt ở ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to make a phone call to somebody
examples: Give me a call tomorrow.
I'll give you a ring.
definitions.definition_vi: gọi điện thoại cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to judge somebody/something to be of a particular standard
examples: She had given the assignment an A.
I give it ten out of ten for originality.
He virtually never gives a grade of less than C.
I gave top marks to her essay.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh giá ai/cái gì theo một tiêu chuẩn cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to pass an illness onto somebody and make them ill
examples: You've given me your cold.
She'd given the bug to all her colleagues.
definitions.definition_vi: truyền bệnh cho ai đó và làm cho họ bị bệnh

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to make somebody suffer a particular punishment
examples: The judge gave him a nine-month suspended sentence.
We discussed what punishment should be given to the boys.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó phải chịu một hình phạt cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: if you give a party, you organize it and invite people
examples: We're giving a party to celebrate our silver wedding.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn tổ chức một bữa tiệc, bạn sẽ tổ chức nó và mời mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to perform something in public
examples: He gave a rousing performance of the Bob Marley song.
She gave a reading from her latest volume of poetry.
The President will be giving a press conference this afternoon.
She gave a fine speech to the waiting crowd.
definitions.definition_vi: biểu diễn cái gì đó ở nơi công cộng

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to use time, energy, etc. for somebody/something
examples: I gave the matter a lot of thought.
I gave a lot of thought to the matter.
The government has given top priority to reforming the tax system.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng thời gian, sức lực, v.v. cho ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to predict that something will last a particular length of time

definitions.definition_vi: để dự đoán rằng một cái gì đó sẽ kéo dài một khoảng thời gian cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to say that a player or the ball is in a particular position or that a goal has been scored
examples: The umpire gave the ball out.
The ref gave the goal.
definitions.definition_vi: để nói rằng một cầu thủ hoặc quả bóng đang ở một vị trí cụ thể hoặc một bàn thắng đã được ghi

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to bend or stretch under pressure
examples: The branch began to give under his weight.
We can't go on like this—something's got to give.
definitions.definition_vi: uốn cong hoặc kéo dài dưới áp lực

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to agree to change your mind or give up some of your demands
examples: You're going to have to give a little.
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý thay đổi ý định hoặc từ bỏ một số yêu cầu của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody that you do not accept what they say
examples: ‘I didn't have time to do it.’ ‘Oh, don't give me that!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn không chấp nhận điều họ nói

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to be willing, in a relationship, to accept what somebody else wants and to give up some of what you want
examples: You're going to have to learn to give and take.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng, trong một mối quan hệ, chấp nhận những gì người khác muốn và từ bỏ một số thứ bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to react with equal force when somebody attacks or criticizes you
examples: She can give as good as she gets.
definitions.definition_vi: phản ứng mạnh mẽ khi ai đó tấn công hoặc chỉ trích bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to show your approval of somebody by clapping your hands
examples: Give it up for Ed Sheeran!
definitions.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tán thành của bạn đối với ai đó bằng cách vỗ tay

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned
examples: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn thích một vật hoặc một người cụ thể nào đó hơn cái vừa được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: if something is correct give or take a particular amount, it is approximately correct
examples: It'll take about three weeks, give or take a day or so.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu điều gì đó đúng thì cho hoặc nhận một số tiền cụ thể, thì nó gần đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to make somebody believe/understand something
examples: I was given to understand that she had resigned.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó tin/hiểu điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to severely punish or criticize somebody for doing something wrong
examples: My son was rude to my friends so I gave him what for.
definitions.definition_vi: trừng phạt nghiêm khắc hoặc chỉ trích ai đó vì đã làm điều gì sai

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: used to ask people to drink a toast to somebody
examples: Ladies and gentlemen, I give you Geoff Ogilby!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu mọi người nâng ly chúc mừng ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: used when you are admitting that something is true
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: what is happening?; what is the news?Word Origin
examples: Old English giefan, gefan, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch geven and German geben.
definitions.definition_vi: chuyện gì đang xảy ra vậy?; tin tức là gì? Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to look quickly at something/somebody
examples: She glanced at her watch.
He glanced around the room.
I glanced up quickly to see who had come in.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn nhanh vào cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to read something quickly and not carefully or completely
examples: SYNONYM scan
I only had time to glance at my emails.
He glanced briefly down the list of names.
She glanced through the report.
definitions.definition_vi: đọc một cái gì đó một cách nhanh chóng và không cẩn thận hoặc hoàn toàn

This is a glorious chapter in our country's history.
The film looks back at Spain’s glorious past.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: very beautiful and impressive

We sat on the beach and gazed at the glorious sunset.
Both her daughters have glorious red hair.
definitions.definition_vi: rất đẹp và ấn tượng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: hot, with the sun shining
examples: They had three weeks of glorious sunshine.
definitions.definition_vi: nóng bức, có ánh nắng chiếu rọi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: extremely pleasant
examples: SYNONYM wonderful
a glorious trip to Rome
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ dễ chịu

definitions.definition: a piece of clothing for the hand, made of wool, leather, etc. with separate parts for each finger and the thumb
examples: COMPARE mitten
a pair of gloves
rubber/latex gloves
gardening/boxing gloves

She peeled off her glove to reveal a wedding ring.
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh quần áo cho bàn tay, làm bằng len, da, v.v. với các bộ phận riêng biệt cho mỗi ngón tay và ngón cái

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be the perfect size or shape for somebody
examples: The dress fits me like a glove.
definitions.definition_vi: là kích thước hoặc hình dạng hoàn hảo cho ai đó

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó đã sẵn sàng đánh nhau hoặc tranh cãi

definitions.definition: to deal with somebody in a very careful way so that you do not offend or upset them

definitions.definition: if you use the words an iron fist/hand when describing the way that somebody behaves, you mean that they treat people severely. This treatment may be hidden behind a kind appearance (the velvet glove).
examples: They promised that the army would strike with an iron fist at any resistance.

definitions.label: Meaning 1

Water freezes at 0°C.
It's so cold that even the river has frozen.
The cold weather had frozen the ground.
The clothes froze solid on the washing line.
The frost had frozen the ground hard.
Last year's cold spell froze the lake solid.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên cứng và thường biến thành băng do quá lạnh; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 2

examples: The pipes have frozen, so we've got no water.
I kept the car running to stop the engine freezing up.
Ten degrees of frost had frozen the lock on the car.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một đường ống, ổ khóa hoặc máy bị đóng băng hoặc có thứ gì đó đóng băng nó, nó sẽ bị tắc do chất lỏng đông lạnh và do đó không thể sử dụng được

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: when it freezes, the weather is at or below 0° Celsius
examples: It may freeze tonight, so bring those plants inside.
definitions.definition_vi: khi trời đóng băng, thời tiết ở mức bằng hoặc dưới 0°C

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be very cold; to be so cold that you die

Two men were frozen to death on the mountain.
definitions.definition_vi: rất lạnh; lạnh đến mức bạn chết

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to keep something, especially food, at a very low temperature in order to preserve it
examples: Can you freeze this cake?

definitions.definition_vi: để có thể được giữ ở nhiệt độ rất thấp

He was so surprised he froze to the spot.

She froze with horror when she saw the body.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng di chuyển đột ngột vì sợ hãi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: when a computer screen freezes, you cannot move any of the images, etc. on it, because there is a problem with the system
definitions.definition_vi: Khi màn hình máy tính bị treo, bạn không thể di chuyển bất kỳ hình ảnh nào, v.v. trên đó do hệ thống có vấn đề

definitions.definition_vi: dừng một bộ phim hoặc video để xem một hình ảnh cụ thể

Prices have been frozen at this level for over a year now.
definitions.definition_vi: để giữ tiền lương, giá cả, vv ở một mức cố định trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn việc sử dụng tiền, tài khoản ngân hàng, v.v. bằng cách nhận được lệnh cấm của tòa án

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to make you extremely frightened or shocked

definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột khiến ai đó dừng lại bằng cách khiến họ sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên; đột ngột dừng lại vì điều gì đó làm bạn sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên

a society with a high/low frequency (= happening often/not very often) of stable marriages

The program can show us word frequency (= how often words occur in a language).
