definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the fact of something happening often

Facebook friends

examples: SYNONYM Quaker

definitions.definition_vi: trở thành bạn của ai đó

examples: They went for two weeks without receiving any news.
definitions.definition_vi: dành một khoảng thời gian theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to not be noticed, reported, etc.
examples: Pippa's absence went unnoticed.
Police are worried that many crimes go unreported.
In these traditional stories, no crime goes unpunished.
Customer service calls went unanswered.
definitions.definition_vi: để không được chú ý, báo cáo, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to make a particular sound or movement
examples: The gun went ‘bang’.
She went like this with her hand.
definitions.definition_vi: để tạo ra một âm thanh hoặc chuyển động cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to be sounded as a signal or warning
examples: The whistle went for the end of the game.
definitions.definition_vi: được phát ra như một tín hiệu hoặc cảnh báo

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: if a number will go into another number, it is contained in that number an exact number of times
examples: 3 into 12 goes 4 times.
7 into 15 won’t go.
7 into 15 doesn’t go.
7 won’t go into 15.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một số sẽ đi vào một số khác, thì nó được chứa trong số đó một số lần chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to combine well with something
examples: SYNONYM match
Does this jacket go with this skirt?
Those colours don’t really go (together).
definitions.definition_vi: kết hợp tốt với cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: used to talk about what tune or words a song or poem has or what happens in a story
examples: How does that song go?
I forget how the next line goes.
The story goes that she's been married five times.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói về giai điệu hoặc từ ngữ của một bài hát hoặc bài thơ hoặc những gì xảy ra trong một câu chuyện

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: to say
examples: I asked ‘How much?’ and he goes, ‘Fifty’ and I go, ‘Fifty? You must be joking!’
definitions.definition_vi: để nói

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to start an activity
examples: I'll say ‘One, two, three, go!’ as a signal for you to start.
As soon as he gets here we're ready to go.
definitions.definition_vi: để bắt đầu một hoạt động

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: if a machine goes, it works
examples: This clock doesn't go.
What makes it go?
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một cái máy chạy, nó sẽ hoạt động

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: used to talk about wanting to get rid of somebody/something
examples: The old sofa will have to go.
He's useless—he'll have to go.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói về việc muốn loại bỏ ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: to get worse; to become damaged or stop working correctly
examples: Her sight is beginning to go.
His mind is going (= he is losing his mental powers).
I was driving home when my brakes went.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên tồi tệ hơn; bị hư hỏng hoặc ngừng hoạt động bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 32
definitions.definition: to die. People say ‘go’ to avoid saying ‘die’.
examples: You can't take your money with you when you go.
definitions.definition_vi: chết. Người ta nói ‘đi’ để tránh nói ‘chết’.

definitions.label: Meaning 33
definitions.definition: when money goes, it is spent or used for something
examples: I don't know where the money goes!
Most of my salary goes on the rent.
The money will go to finance a new community centre.
definitions.definition_vi: khi tiền đi, nó được chi tiêu hoặc sử dụng cho việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 34
definitions.definition: to be sold
examples: We won't let the house go for less than $200 000.
There was usually some bread going cheap (= being sold cheaply) at the end of the day.
definitions.definition_vi: được bán

definitions.label: Meaning 35
definitions.definition: to be willing to pay a particular amount of money for something
examples: He's offered £3 000 for the car and I don't think he'll go any higher.
I'll go to $1 000 but that's my limit.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng trả một số tiền cụ thể cho cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 36
definitions.definition: to help; to play a part in doing something
examples: This all goes to prove my theory.
It (= what has just happened) just goes to show you can't always tell how people are going to react.
definitions.definition_vi: để giúp đỡ; đóng một vai trò trong việc làm gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 37
definitions.definition: to be available
examples: There just aren't any jobs going in this area.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng

definitions.label: Meaning 38
definitions.definition: to use a toilet
examples: Do you need to go, Billy?
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng nhà vệ sinh

definitions.label: Meaning 39
definitions.definition: anything that somebody says or does is accepted or allowed, even if it shocks or surprises people
examples: Almost anything goes these days.
definitions.definition_vi: bất cứ điều gì ai đó nói hoặc làm đều được chấp nhận hoặc cho phép, ngay cả khi điều đó gây sốc hoặc làm mọi người ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 40
definitions.definition: in comparison with the average person, thing, etc.
examples: As teachers go, he's not bad.
definitions.definition_vi: so với người, vật bình thường, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 41
definitions.definition: to be nearly a particular age, time or number
examples: It was going on (for) midnight.
definitions.definition_vi: gần như một độ tuổi, thời gian hoặc số lượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 42
definitions.definition: used to show what somebody intends to do in the future
examples: We're going to buy a house when we've saved enough money.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện điều ai đó dự định làm trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 43
definitions.definition: used to show that something is likely to happen very soon or in the future
examples: I think I'm going to faint.
If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó có thể sẽ xảy ra rất sớm hoặc trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 44
definitions.definition: used to tell or warn somebody not to do something
examples: Don't go getting yourself into trouble.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo hoặc cảnh báo ai đó đừng làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 45
definitions.definition: something that is enough for a short time
examples: £50 should be enough to be going on with.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó là đủ trong một thời gian ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 46
definitions.definition: to make a very great effort to get something or do something
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện một nỗ lực rất lớn để có được một cái gì đó hoặc làm một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 47
definitions.definition: used to show that you are angry or annoyed that somebody has done something stupid
examples: Trust him to go and mess things up!
Why did you have to go and upset your mother like that?
You've really gone and done it (= done something very stupid) now!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện rằng bạn đang tức giận hoặc khó chịu vì ai đó đã làm điều gì đó ngu ngốc

definitions.label: Meaning 48
definitions.definition: to suddenly become very angry
examples: Now and again she really goes off on one.
definitions.definition_vi: đột nhiên trở nên rất tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 49
definitions.definition: used to express the fact that you do not believe something, or that you think something is bad
examples: Go on with you—you’re never forty. You don’t look a day over thirty.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự thật rằng bạn không tin điều gì đó hoặc bạn nghĩ điều gì đó là xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 50
definitions.definition: (to have) many/not many advantages
examples: You're young, intelligent, attractive—you have a lot going for you!
definitions.definition_vi: (có) nhiều/không nhiều lợi thế

definitions.label: Meaning 51
definitions.definition: not possible or allowed
examples: SEE ALSO no-go area
If the bank won't lend us the money it's no go, I'm afraid.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể hoặc được phép

definitions.label: Meaning 52
definitions.definition: used to say that you do not want to talk about something in any more detail because you do not even want to think about it
examples: Don't ask me to choose. I don't want to go there.
‘There was a problem with his parents, wasn't there?’ ‘Don't even go there!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn không muốn nói về điều gì đó chi tiết hơn bởi vì bạn thậm chí không muốn nghĩ về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 53
definitions.definition: what you say to tell people to start a race
definitions.definition_vi: những gì bạn nói để bảo mọi người bắt đầu một cuộc đua

definitions.label: Meaning 54
definitions.definition: to start with; for now
examples: ‘One slice or two?’ ‘Just one to be going on with.’
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu với; bây giờ

definitions.label: Meaning 55
definitions.definition: that remains; still left
examples: I only have one exam to go.
definitions.definition_vi: cái đó còn lại; vẫn còn lại

definitions.label: Meaning 56
definitions.definition: if you buy cooked food to go in a restaurant or shop, you buy it to take away and eat somewhere else
examples: Two pizzas to go.
definitions.definition_vi: Nếu bạn mua đồ ăn đã nấu chín để đi vào nhà hàng hoặc cửa hàng, bạn mua mang đi và ăn ở nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 57
definitions.definition: the way somebody behaves towards other people will affect the way those people behave towards them in the future
definitions.definition_vi: cách ai đó cư xử với người khác sẽ ảnh hưởng đến cách những người đó cư xử với họ trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 58
definitions.definition: something that is not fashionable now will become fashionable again in the future
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó không hợp thời bây giờ sẽ trở thành hợp thời trang trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 59
definitions.definition: used to ask what action somebody should take, especially in order to improve the difficult situation that they are in
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để hỏi ai đó nên làm gì, đặc biệt là để cải thiện tình hình khó khăn mà họ đang gặp phải

definitions.label: Meaning 60
definitions.definition: used by a soldier who is guarding a place to order somebody to say who they are
examples: Halt, who goes there?
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng bởi một người lính đang canh gác một nơi để ra lệnh cho ai đó nói họ là ai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday
examples: SEE ALSO Black Friday
It's Friday today, isn't it?
She went to dance class last Friday.
Are you busy next Friday?
Friday morning/afternoon/evening
We'll discuss this at Friday's meeting.
I work Friday to Tuesday.
I work Fridays to Tuesdays.
We'll meet on Friday (= next Friday).
We met on Friday (= last Friday).
We'll meet Friday.
The museum is closed on Fridays (= every Friday).
The museum is closed Fridays.
He was born on a Friday.
I always do yoga on a Friday (= every Friday).
I went to Nairobi on Monday, and came back the following Friday.
‘When did the accident happen?’ ‘It was the Friday (= the Friday of the week we are talking about).’
Come back Friday week (= a week after next Friday).
definitions.definition_vi: ngày trong tuần sau thứ năm và trước thứ bảy

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a character in Daniel Defoe's novel Robinson Crusoe. He becomes Crusoe's faithful servant after Crusoe saves him from being eaten by cannibals. The phrase Man Friday or Girl Friday was sometimes used to describe an assistant who did many different jobs in an office, but is now quite old-fashioned.
examples: SEE ALSO girl Friday
definitions.definition_vi: một nhân vật trong tiểu thuyết Robinson Crusoe của Daniel Defoe. Anh trở thành người hầu trung thành của Crusoe sau khi Crusoe cứu anh khỏi bị ăn thịt người. Cụm từ Man Friday hay Girl Friday đôi khi được dùng để miêu tả một trợ lý đảm nhiệm nhiều công việc khác nhau trong văn phòng nhưng hiện nay đã khá lỗi thời.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make somebody suddenly feel afraid
examples: Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
He used to frighten me to death (= a lot), zooming about on his go-cart.
She's not easily frightened.
She doesn't frighten easily (= it is not easy to make her afraid).
It really frightens me to think how this might have ended.
It frightened him that she could see so easily into his private thoughts.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó đột nhiên cảm thấy sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to frighten somebody very much
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ hãi rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to frighten somebody very much
examples: You scared the life out of me coming in so suddenly like that.
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ hãi rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to frighten somebody very much
examples: Spiders frighten him to death.
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ hãi rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: causing you to feel annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
examples: It's frustrating to have to wait so long.
The frustrating thing is, they probably won’t even be in when we get there.
definitions.definition_vi: khiến bạn cảm thấy khó chịu và mất kiên nhẫn vì không thể làm được hoặc đạt được điều mình mong muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to do or achieve what was hoped for or expected
examples: to fulfil your dream/ambition/potential
definitions.definition_vi: để làm hoặc đạt được những gì đã được hy vọng hoặc mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to do or have what is required or necessary
examples: to fulfil a duty/an obligation/a promise
to fulfil the terms/conditions of an agreement
No candidate fulfils all the criteria for this position.
He had fulfilled his promise to his father.
Once they had fulfilled their obligations, they were allowed to go.
Failure to fulfil the terms of the agreements may result in legal action.
Work permits are only given to people who fulfil certain criteria.
definitions.definition_vi: làm hoặc có những gì được yêu cầu hoặc cần thiết

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to have a particular role or purpose
examples: Nursery schools should fulfil the function of preparing children for school.
definitions.definition_vi: có một vai trò hoặc mục đích cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to make somebody feel happy and satisfied with what they are doing or have done
examples: I need a job that really fulfils me.
He was able to fulfil himself through his painting.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hạnh phúc và hài lòng với những gì họ đang làm hoặc đã làm

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to pack and send something that a customer has ordered
examples: We aim to fulfil all orders within seven days.
Huge demand led to customers waiting weeks to see their orders finally fulfilled.
definitions.definition_vi: đóng gói và gửi thứ gì đó mà khách hàng đã đặt hàng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the end of a sports game
examples: COMPARE half-time
The referee blew his whistle for full time.
The full-time score was 1–1.
definitions.definition_vi: sự kết thúc của một trò chơi thể thao

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the end of a sports game
examples: COMPARE half-time
The referee blew his whistle for full time.
The full-time score was 1–1.
definitions.definition_vi: sự kết thúc của một trò chơi thể thao

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: more; additional
examples: Cook for a further 2 minutes.
For further details call this number.
Can you give me any further information?
further investigation/research/study/analysis
This week provided further evidence of an unfolding global energy crisis.
No further developments have been reported.
We have decided to take no further action.
The museum is closed until further notice (= until we say that it is open again).
definitions.definition_vi: hơn; thêm vào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the time that will come after the present or the events that will happen then
examples: We need to plan for the future.
The movie is set in the future.
at some point/time in the future
I don't expect any of these things to happen in the near future (= soon).
Things will continue as they are for the foreseeable future.
the immediate/not-too-distant/long-term/distant future
Nobody can predict the future.
What does the future hold?
What will the cities of the future look like?
Kevin talked about his hopes for the future.
definitions.definition_vi: thời gian sẽ đến sau hiện tại hoặc những sự kiện sẽ xảy ra sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: what will happen to somebody/something at a later time
examples: The company faces a very uncertain future.
We must seize the opportunity to shape our future.
This deal could secure the futures of 2  000 employees.
to decide/determine the future of somebody/something
Recent events throw doubt on the president’s political future.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì sẽ xảy ra với ai/cái gì sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the possibility of being successful or surviving at a later time
examples: They have a bright future ahead of them.
I can't see any future in this relationship.
There's no future in mining in this country.
Children are the future of this country (= the country's future depends on children).
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng thành công hoặc sống sót sau này

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: goods or shares that are bought at agreed prices but that will be delivered and paid for at a later time
examples: oil futures
the futures market
definitions.definition_vi: hàng hóa hoặc cổ phiếu được mua theo giá thỏa thuận nhưng sẽ được giao và thanh toán sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the form of a verb that expresses what will happen after the present
definitions.definition_vi: dạng của động từ diễn tả điều gì sẽ xảy ra sau hiện tại

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: for/in the period of time when you can predict what is going to happen, based on the present circumstances
examples: The statue will remain in the museum for the foreseeable future.
It's unlikely that the hospital will be closed in the foreseeable future (= soon).
definitions.definition_vi: trong/trong khoảng thời gian mà bạn có thể dự đoán điều gì sẽ xảy ra, dựa trên hoàn cảnh hiện tại

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: from now on
examples: Please be more careful in future.
In future, make sure the door is never left unlocked.
definitions.definition_vi: kể từ bây giờ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: not a long time in the future but fairly soon
examples: I hope we’ll see each other again in the not too distant future.
definitions.definition_vi: tương lai không lâu nhưng khá sớm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want
examples: They managed to gain access to secret files.
How did the thieves gain entry?
The country gained its independence ten years ago.
The party gained over 50 per cent of the vote.
Police officers quickly gained control of the situation.
Labour finally gained power in 1997.
I gained an insight into the work of a journalist.
He has gained a reputation for unpredictable behaviour.
Her unusual talent gained her worldwide recognition.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được hoặc giành được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một cái gì đó mà bạn cần hoặc muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to obtain an advantage or benefit from something or from doing something
examples: The firm is hoping to gain an advantage over its competitors.
What do you hope to gain by this?
There is nothing to be gained from delaying the decision.
Consumers have gained from the increased competition.
If the proposal goes ahead, we all stand to gain.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được một lợi thế hoặc lợi ích từ một cái gì đó hoặc từ việc làm một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to gradually get more of something
examples: As you gain experience, you will grow in confidence.
I've gained weight recently.
The campaign continues to gain momentum.
to gain understanding/knowledge
He has gained support from major figures in the industry.
to gain popularity/acceptance
definitions.definition_vi: dần dần có được nhiều thứ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to go too fast (by a particular amount of time)
examples: OPPOSITE lose
My watch gains two minutes every 24 hours.
definitions.definition_vi: đi quá nhanh (trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể)

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện điều ai đó dự định làm trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 58

definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó không hợp thời bây giờ sẽ trở thành hợp thời trang trong tương lai

definitions.definition: to give somebody support in a difficult situation
examples: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp cho ai đó sự hỗ trợ trong một tình huống khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 56
definitions.definition: to admit that you have made a mistake or are responsible for something bad
examples: I have to hold my hands up and admit that some of the problems have been all my own fault.
The solicitor confirmed that his clients were holding their hands up to the offences.
definitions.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng bạn đã phạm sai lầm hoặc chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 57
definitions.definition: being taken care of or dealt with by somebody that you think you can rely on

He retired feeling confident that his company was in safe hands.

She completed the first part of the exam with over an hour in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn có thời gian hoặc tiền bạc trong tay, nó sẽ sẵn sàng để sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 59
definitions.definition: if you have a particular situation in hand, you are in control of it

definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn có một tình huống cụ thể trong tay, bạn có thể kiểm soát nó

definitions.label: Meaning 60
definitions.definition: the job, question, etc. in hand is the one that you are dealing with
examples: Please confine your comments to the topic in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: công việc, câu hỏi, v.v. trong tay là công việc mà bạn đang giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 61
definitions.definition: if somebody works a week, month, etc. in hand, they are paid for the work a week, etc. after they have completed it
definitions.definition_vi: nếu ai đó làm việc một tuần, một tháng, v.v., thì họ được trả lương cho công việc một tuần, v.v. sau khi hoàn thành công việc đó

definitions.label: Meaning 62
definitions.definition: being taken care of or controlled by somebody
examples: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
definitions.definition_vi: được chăm sóc hoặc kiểm soát bởi ai đó

Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
definitions.definition_vi: được ai đó chăm sóc chu đáo

The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.

definitions.label: Meaning 65
definitions.definition: used to say that you are too busy to do anything else
definitions.definition_vi: từng nói rằng bạn quá bận để làm bất cứ điều gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 66

definitions.definition_vi: hợp tác cùng nhau để làm việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 69

definitions.definition_vi: để tìm hoặc nhận được một cái gì đó

definitions.definition_vi: bạn không còn phải chịu trách nhiệm nữa

definitions.definition_vi: ở cả hai/tất cả các bên; theo cả hai/tất cả các hướng

definitions.label: Meaning 80

definitions.definition_vi: có sẵn, đặc biệt là để giúp đỡ

definitions.label: Meaning 85

definitions.definition_vi: bạn không còn phải chịu trách nhiệm nữa

definitions.definition_vi: có nguy cơ bị giết

definitions.definition_vi: mà bạn có thể tiếp cận hoặc có được dễ dàng

definitions.label: Meaning 110

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc một con vật khó kiểm soát

Jim grabbed a cake from the plate.
Don't grab—there's plenty for everyone.

definitions.definition_vi: thông minh, v.v. theo cách khiến bạn khó chịu hoặc khiến bạn không tin tưởng ai đó/thứ gì đóWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: either of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided
examples: SEE ALSO halve
two and a half kilos (= 2½)
One and a half hours are allowed for the exam.
An hour and a half is allowed for the exam.
in the first half of the 20th century
The second half of the book is more exciting.
The two halves of the city were reunited in 1990.
the left half of the brain
the lower half of the window
the northern half of the country
I've divided the money in half.
We'll need to reduce the weight by half.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai phần bằng nhau mà một cái gì đó được hoặc có thể được chia

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: either of two periods of time into which a sports game, concert, etc. is divided
examples: No goals were scored in the first half.
She played well in the second half of the match.
He made two superb saves in the first two minutes of the half.
We had a few chances to score in both halves.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai khoảng thời gian trong đó một trận đấu thể thao, buổi hòa nhạc, v.v. được chia ra

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: one of the defending players in hockey or rugby whose position is between those who play at the front of a team and those who play at the back
examples: SEE ALSO scrum half
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những cầu thủ phòng ngự trong môn khúc côn cầu hoặc bóng bầu dục có vị trí nằm giữa những người chơi ở phía trước của một đội và những người chơi ở phía sau

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: one of the two attacking players in american football whose position is behind the quarterback and next to the full backs
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai cầu thủ tấn công của bóng đá Mỹ có vị trí đứng sau tiền vệ và bên cạnh hậu vệ cánh

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the position a half back plays at (also called a tailback in american football)
definitions.definition_vi: vị trí mà một hậu vệ cánh chơi ở (còn gọi là hậu vệ cánh trong bóng đá Mỹ)

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: half a pint (= 0.568 of a litre in the UK and some other countries, and 0.473 of a litre in the US) of beer or a similar drink
examples: Two halves of bitter, please.
definitions.definition_vi: nửa pint (= 0,568 lít ở Anh và một số quốc gia khác, và 0,473 lít ở Mỹ) bia hoặc đồ uống tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: bigger, better, more important, etc. than usual
examples: That was a game and a half!
definitions.definition_vi: lớn hơn, tốt hơn, quan trọng hơn, v.v. hơn bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to do whatever you do completely and to the greatest possible degree
examples: You're expecting twins? Well, you never did do anything by halves.
definitions.definition_vi: làm bất cứ điều gì bạn làm một cách trọn vẹn và ở mức độ lớn nhất có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to share the cost of something equally with somebody
examples: We go halves on all the bills.
definitions.definition_vi: chia sẻ chi phí của một cái gì đó một cách bình đẳng với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used in negative sentences to say that a situation is worse or more complicated than somebody thinks
examples: ‘It sounds very difficult.’ ‘You don't know the half of it.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trong câu phủ định để nói rằng một tình huống tồi tệ hơn hoặc phức tạp hơn ai đó nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say that you think you will do something, although you are not sure
examples: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ bạn sẽ làm điều gì đó mặc dù bạn không chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that you think that what somebody has done is bad and should do something about it, although you probably will not
examples: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ rằng điều ai đó đã làm là xấu và nên làm điều gì đó về việc đó, mặc dù có thể bạn sẽ không làm như vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: the way of life of a different social group, especially one much richer than you
definitions.definition_vi: lối sống của một nhóm xã hội khác, đặc biệt là một nhóm giàu hơn bạn nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: used to say that there is not much real difference between two possible choices
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không có nhiều sự khác biệt thực sự giữa hai lựa chọn có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: one and a half times the usual rate of pay
examples: SEE ALSO double time
We get time and a half on Sundays.
definitions.definition_vi: gấp rưỡi mức lương thông thường

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a space or passage inside the entrance or front door of a building
examples: SEE ALSO entrance hall
Her brother was standing in the front hall.
She ran into the hall and up the stairs.
definitions.definition_vi: một không gian hoặc lối đi bên trong lối vào hoặc cửa trước của một tòa nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a passage in a building with rooms down either side
examples: SYNONYM corridor
I headed for Scott's office down the hall.
the room across the hall
definitions.definition_vi: một lối đi trong một tòa nhà có các phòng ở hai bên

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a building or large room for public meetings, meals, concerts, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO city hall
a concert/sports hall
a banqueting/conference hall
an exhibition hall
There are three dining halls on campus.
the Royal Albert Hall
The next meeting is in the community hall on Tuesday.
A jumble sale will be held in the village hall on Saturday.
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc căn phòng lớn dành cho các cuộc họp công cộng, bữa ăn, buổi hòa nhạc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a building for university or college students to live in
examples: She's living in hall(s).
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà dành cho sinh viên đại học hoặc cao đẳng ở

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a large country house
examples: Haddon Hall
Berrington Hall was built in the late 18th century.
definitions.definition_vi: một ngôi nhà nông thôn rộng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to stop; to make somebody/something stop
examples: She walked towards him and then halted.
‘Halt!’ the Major ordered (= used as a command to soldiers).
The police were halting traffic on the parade route.
The trial was halted after the first week.
definitions.definition_vi: dừng lại; làm cho ai/cái gì dừng lại

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to suddenly make somebody stop by frightening or surprising them; to suddenly stop because something has frightened or surprised you
examples: The question stopped Alice in her tracks.
Suddenly he stopped dead in his tracks: what was he doing?
The disease was stopped in its tracks by immunization programmes.
definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột khiến ai đó dừng lại bằng cách khiến họ sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên; đột ngột dừng lại vì điều gì đó làm bạn sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to deal with a situation, a person, an area of work or a strong emotion
examples: A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.
She's very good at handling her patients.
to handle a situation/case
He decided to handle things himself.
This matter has been handled very badly.
The sale was handled by Adams Commercial.
We can handle up to 500 calls an hour at our new offices.
We all have to learn to handle stress.
‘Any problems?’ ‘Nothing I can't handle.’
I've got to go. I can't handle it any more (= deal with a difficult situation).
You have to know how to handle yourself in this business (= know the right way to behave).
definitions.definition_vi: để giải quyết một tình huống, một con người, một lĩnh vực công việc hoặc một cảm xúc mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to touch, hold or move something with your hands
examples: Our cat hates being handled.
The label on the box said: ‘Fragile. Handle with care.’
definitions.definition_vi: chạm, giữ hoặc di chuyển một cái gì đó bằng tay của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to control a vehicle, an animal, a tool, etc.
examples: I wasn't sure if I could handle such a powerful car.
She's a difficult horse to handle.
definitions.definition_vi: để điều khiển một chiếc xe, một con vật, một công cụ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be easy/difficult to drive or control
examples: The car handles well in any weather.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ/khó lái hoặc điều khiển

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to buy or sell something
examples: SYNONYM deal in
They were arrested for handling stolen goods.
definitions.definition_vi: để mua hoặc bán một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to attach something, or to be attached, at the top so that the lower part is free or loose
examples: Hang your coat on the hook.
Activists hung a banner from the roof of the building.
Shall I hang your coat up?
Have you hung out the washing?
Have you hung the wash?
There were several expensive suits hanging in the wardrobe.
Clothes hung from hooks on the walls.
His school bag was still hanging on the back of the door.
definitions.definition_vi: gắn một cái gì đó, hoặc được gắn vào, ở phía trên để phần dưới được tự do hoặc lỏng lẻo

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: when something hangs in a particular way, it falls in that way
examples: Her hair hung down to her waist.
He had lost weight and the suit hung loosely on him.
definitions.definition_vi: khi một cái gì đó treo theo một cách cụ thể, nó rơi theo cách đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to bend or let something bend downwards
examples: The dog's tongue was hanging out.
Children hung (= were leaning) over the gate.
A cigarette hung from her lips.
She hung her head in shame.
definitions.definition_vi: uốn cong hoặc để một cái gì đó uốn cong xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to kill somebody, usually as a punishment, by tying a rope around their neck and allowing them to drop; to be killed in this way
examples: He was the last man to be hanged for murder in this country.
She had committed suicide by hanging herself from a beam.
At that time you could hang for stealing.
definitions.definition_vi: giết ai đó, thường là để trừng phạt, bằng cách buộc một sợi dây quanh cổ họ và để họ rơi xuống; bị giết theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to spend time relaxing or enjoying yourself
examples: ‘What are you all doing?’ ‘Just hanging.’
Do you wanna come hang with us?
definitions.definition_vi: dành thời gian thư giãn hoặc tận hưởng chính mình

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to attach something, especially a picture, to a hook (= a curved piece of metal) on a wall; to be attached in this way
examples: We hung her portrait above the fireplace.
Several of his paintings hang in the Tate Gallery.
definitions.definition_vi: gắn cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một bức tranh, vào một cái móc (= một miếng kim loại cong) trên tường; được gắn kết theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to decorate a place by placing paintings, etc. on a wall
examples: The rooms were hung with tapestries.
definitions.definition_vi: trang trí một nơi bằng cách đặt những bức tranh, v.v. trên tường

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to stick wallpaper to a wall
definitions.definition_vi: để dán giấy dán tường lên tường

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to attach a door or gate to a post so that it moves freely
definitions.definition_vi: gắn một cánh cửa hoặc cổng vào một cột để nó di chuyển tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to stay in the air
examples: Smoke hung in the air above the city.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong không khí

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say that you are not going to worry about something
examples: Oh, let's get two and hang the expense!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn sẽ không lo lắng về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be in great danger
definitions.definition_vi: đang gặp nguy hiểm lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to delay or be delayed in taking action
examples: The project had hung fire for several years for lack of funds.
definitions.definition_vi: trì hoãn hoặc trì hoãn thực hiện hành động

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to live in a particular place
examples: These multimillion-dollar homes are more than just a place to hang your hat.
definitions.definition_vi: sống ở một nơi cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to depend or rely on something
examples: The research is interesting, but you cannot hang your hat on it.
definitions.definition_vi: phụ thuộc hoặc dựa vào cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be very easy to notice in a particular place in a way that is unpleasant
examples: Smoke lay heavy on the far side of the water.
Despair hangs heavy in the stifling air.
definitions.definition_vi: rất dễ bị chú ý ở một nơi cụ thể theo cách khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to cause somebody/something to feel uncomfortable or anxious
examples: The crime lay heavy on her conscience.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai/cái gì cảm thấy khó chịu hoặc lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to remain determined to succeed even when a situation is difficult
definitions.definition_vi: vẫn quyết tâm thành công ngay cả khi hoàn cảnh khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to take a left/right turn
definitions.definition_vi: rẽ trái/phải

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to remain calm; to not worry
examples: It's OK—hang loose and stay cool.
definitions.definition_vi: giữ bình tĩnh; đừng lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to hold somebody/something very tightly or keep something in a very determined way because you are afraid
examples: You get a job, then you get a mortgage and then you hang on like grim death to your job to pay off the mortgage.
definitions.definition_vi: giữ ai/cái gì thật chặt hoặc giữ cái gì đó một cách rất kiên quyết vì bạn sợ

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to listen with great attention to somebody you admire
examples: The journalists hung on his every word as he spoke of his ordeal.
definitions.definition_vi: lắng nghe một cách hết sức chú ý tới người mà bạn ngưỡng mộ

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to put somebody in a difficult situation
examples: She is being hung out to dry for one silly mistake.
definitions.definition_vi: đẩy ai đó vào tình thế khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to be determined and refuse to change your attitude or ideas
definitions.definition_vi: quyết tâm và từ chối thay đổi thái độ hoặc ý tưởng của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 25

definitions.definition_vi: nếu tương lai của cái gì/ai đó, hoặc kết quả của cái gì đó bị/treo trong thế cân bằng thì điều đó không chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to express your feelings freely
definitions.definition_vi: để bày tỏ cảm xúc của bạn một cách tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 27

definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn sắp bị trừng phạt vì làm điều gì đó sai trái, dù đó là việc lớn hay nhỏ, bạn cũng có thể làm việc lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: something that gives you an excuse or opportunity to discuss or explain something
examples: The character provides a peg to hang the writer’s political ideas on.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó mang lại cho bạn một cái cớ hoặc cơ hội để thảo luận hoặc giải thích điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a chemical element. Gold is a yellow precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO fool’s gold
gold coins/jewellery
He always wore a gold chain.
a gold ring/watch/necklace/bracelet
a fall in the gold price
The rubies were set in 18-carat gold.
made of solid/pure gold

definitions.definition: money, jewellery, etc. that is made of gold

falling government gold stocks
definitions.definition_vi: tiền, đồ trang sức, vv được làm bằng vàng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a medal made of gold that is given to the winner of a race or competition

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the colour of gold
examples: a sunset of burnished gold
His hair was a pale gold.
I love the reds and golds of autumn.
definitions.definition_vi: màu vàng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not everything that seems good, attractive, etc. is actually good, etc.
definitions.definition_vi: không phải mọi thứ có vẻ tốt, hấp dẫn, v.v. đều thực sự tốt, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a large prize or reward that somebody hopes for but is unlikely to get
definitions.definition_vi: một giải thưởng hoặc phần thưởng lớn mà ai đó hy vọng nhưng khó có thể nhận được

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: behaving in a way that other people approve of
examples: The kids have been as good as gold all day.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách mà người khác chấp nhận

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be a very kind person
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một người rất tốt bụng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say that it seems easy to make money in a place
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng kiếm tiền ở một nơi có vẻ dễ dàng

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to find or do something that brings you a lot of success or money
examples: He has struck gold with his latest novel.
definitions.definition_vi: tìm kiếm hoặc làm điều gì đó mang lại cho bạn nhiều thành công hoặc tiền bạc

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: very useful or valuable
examples: A good mechanic is worth his weight in gold.
definitions.definition_vi: rất hữu ích hoặc có giá trị

definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai cầu thủ tấn công của bóng đá Mỹ có vị trí đứng sau tiền vệ và bên cạnh hậu vệ cánh

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the position a half back plays at (also called a tailback in american football)
definitions.definition_vi: vị trí mà một hậu vệ cánh chơi ở (còn gọi là hậu vệ cánh trong bóng đá Mỹ)

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: half a pint (= 0.568 of a litre in the UK and some other countries, and 0.473 of a litre in the US) of beer or a similar drink
examples: Two halves of bitter, please.
definitions.definition_vi: nửa pint (= 0,568 lít ở Anh và một số quốc gia khác, và 0,473 lít ở Mỹ) bia hoặc đồ uống tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: bigger, better, more important, etc. than usual
examples: That was a game and a half!
definitions.definition_vi: lớn hơn, tốt hơn, quan trọng hơn, v.v. hơn bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to do whatever you do completely and to the greatest possible degree
examples: You're expecting twins? Well, you never did do anything by halves.
definitions.definition_vi: làm bất cứ điều gì bạn làm một cách trọn vẹn và ở mức độ lớn nhất có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to share the cost of something equally with somebody
examples: We go halves on all the bills.
definitions.definition_vi: chia sẻ chi phí của một cái gì đó một cách bình đẳng với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used in negative sentences to say that a situation is worse or more complicated than somebody thinks
examples: ‘It sounds very difficult.’ ‘You don't know the half of it.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trong câu phủ định để nói rằng một tình huống tồi tệ hơn hoặc phức tạp hơn ai đó nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say that you think you will do something, although you are not sure
examples: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ bạn sẽ làm điều gì đó mặc dù bạn không chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that you think that what somebody has done is bad and should do something about it, although you probably will not
examples: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ rằng điều ai đó đã làm là xấu và nên làm điều gì đó về việc đó, mặc dù có thể bạn sẽ không làm như vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: the way of life of a different social group, especially one much richer than you
definitions.definition_vi: lối sống của một nhóm xã hội khác, đặc biệt là một nhóm giàu hơn bạn nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: used to say that there is not much real difference between two possible choices
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không có nhiều sự khác biệt thực sự giữa hai lựa chọn có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: one and a half times the usual rate of pay
examples: SEE ALSO double time
We get time and a half on Sundays.
definitions.definition_vi: gấp rưỡi mức lương thông thường

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: clever, etc. in a way that annoys you or makes you not trust somebody/somethingWord Origin
examples: Old English half, healf, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch half and German halb (adjectives). The earliest meaning of the Germanic base was ‘side’, also a noun sense in Old English.
definitions.definition_vi: thông minh, v.v. theo cách khiến bạn khó chịu hoặc khiến bạn không tin tưởng ai đó/thứ gì đóWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at an equal distance between two points; in the middle of a period of time
examples: I got the ball on the halfway line.
definitions.definition_vi: ở khoảng cách bằng nhau giữa hai điểm; ở giữa một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: part of the way towards doing or achieving something
examples: the halfway point/stage
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của con đường hướng tới việc làm hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the part of the body at the end of the arm, including the fingers and thumb
examples: SEE ALSO hot hand
Ian placed a hand on her shoulder.
Keep both hands on the steering wheel at all times.
She had a large diamond on the ring finger of her left hand.
He was holding a large mug of coffee in his right hand.
Put your hand up if you know the answer.
She was on (her) hands and knees (= crawling on the floor) looking for an earring.
Couples strolled past holding hands.
She introduced us and we shook hands.
Give me your hand (= hold my hand) while we cross the road.
The crowd threw up their hands (= lifted them into the air) in dismay.
He killed the snake with his bare hands (= using only his hands).
a hand gesture/signal
a hand towel (= a small towel for drying your hands on)
a hand drill (= one that is used by turning a handle rather than powered by electricity)
definitions.definition_vi: phần cơ thể ở cuối cánh tay, bao gồm các ngón tay và ngón cái

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: using the hand or number of hands mentioned
examples: a one-handed catch
left-handed scissors (= intended to be held in your left hand)
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng bàn tay hoặc số bàn tay được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: help in doing something
examples: The neighbours are always willing to lend a hand.
Let me give you a hand with those bags (= help you to carry them).
Do you need a hand with those invoices?
definitions.definition_vi: giúp đỡ trong việc làm một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the part or role that somebody/something plays in a particular situation; somebody’s influence in a situation
examples: Early reports suggest the hand of rebel forces in the bombings.
Several of his colleagues had a hand in his downfall.
This appointment was an attempt to strengthen her hand in policy discussions.
definitions.definition_vi: phần hoặc vai trò của ai đó/cái gì đó trong một tình huống cụ thể; ảnh hưởng của ai đó trong một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a part of a clock or watch that points to the numbers
examples: SEE ALSO hour hand
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của đồng hồ hoặc đồng hồ chỉ vào các con số

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a person who does physical work on a farm or in a factory
examples: SEE ALSO chargehand
The farmer would bring in hired hands to help him harvest the crop.
definitions.definition_vi: người làm công việc thể chất ở trang trại hoặc nhà máy

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a sailor on a ship
examples: SEE ALSO deckhand
All hands on deck!
definitions.definition_vi: một thủy thủ trên một con tàu

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: by a person rather than a machine
examples: SEE ALSO handmade
hand-painted pottery
hand-knitted
This item should be hand-washed.
Mail for hand delivery is put in a separate tray.
definitions.definition_vi: bởi một người chứ không phải là một cỗ máy

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a set of playing cards given to one player in a game
examples: to be dealt a good/bad hand
She felt that life had dealt her a bad hand.
definitions.definition_vi: một bộ bài được trao cho một người chơi trong trò chơi

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: one stage of a game of cards
examples: SEE ALSO nap hand
I'll have to leave after this hand.
Who dealt the last hand?
definitions.definition_vi: một giai đoạn của trò chơi bài

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: a particular style of writing
examples: SEE ALSO freehand
definitions.definition_vi: một phong cách viết cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: a unit for measuring the height of a horse, equal to 4 inches or 10.16 centimetres
definitions.definition_vi: đơn vị đo chiều cao của ngựa, bằng 4 inch hoặc 10,16 cm

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: everyone helps or must help, especially in a difficult situation
examples: There are 30 people coming to dinner tonight, so it's all hands on deck.
definitions.definition_vi: mọi người đều giúp đỡ hoặc phải giúp đỡ, đặc biệt trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: close to you in time or distance
examples: Help was at hand.
The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
definitions.definition_vi: gần bạn về thời gian hoặc khoảng cách

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: if you experience something at the hands of somebody, they are the cause of it
examples: They suffered years of repression at the hands of the old regime.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn trải nghiệm điều gì đó trong tay ai đó, họ là nguyên nhân của điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to show skill at making or doing things with your hands
definitions.definition_vi: để thể hiện kỹ năng làm hoặc làm việc gì đó bằng tay của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to tie somebody’s hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
definitions.definition_vi: trói tay và chân của ai lại với nhau để họ không thể di chuyển hoặc trốn thoát

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to prevent somebody from doing what they want by creating rules, limits, etc.
definitions.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn ai đó làm những gì họ muốn bằng cách tạo ra các quy tắc, giới hạn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: it is better to keep something that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
definitions.definition_vi: thà giữ lại thứ bạn đã có còn hơn là mạo hiểm đánh mất nó bằng cách cố gắng có được nhiều hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to harm somebody who has helped you or supported you
definitions.definition_vi: làm hại ai đó đã giúp đỡ bạn hoặc hỗ trợ bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: by a person rather than a machine
examples: The fabric was painted by hand.
Delicate clothes should be washed by hand.
We can apply the power of computational tools in solving mathematical problems that cannot be solved by hand.
definitions.definition_vi: bởi một người chứ không phải là một cỗ máy

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: if a letter is delivered by hand, it is delivered by the person who wrote it, or somebody who is sent by them, rather than by post
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một lá thư được gửi bằng tay, nó sẽ được gửi bởi người viết nó hoặc ai đó được họ gửi chứ không phải qua đường bưu điện

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: if you pay for goods and services cash in hand, you pay in cash, especially so that the person being paid can avoid paying tax on the amount
examples: a cash-in-hand payment of £20
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn trả tiền mặt cho hàng hóa và dịch vụ, bạn sẽ trả bằng tiền mặt, đặc biệt để người được thanh toán có thể tránh phải trả thuế cho số tiền đó

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to pass to a different owner
examples: The house has changed hands several times.
definitions.definition_vi: để chuyển cho một chủ sở hữu khác

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: near; in a place where somebody/something can be reached easily
examples: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
definitions.definition_vi: gần; ở một nơi mà ai đó/cái gì đó có thể dễ dàng tiếp cận được

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: an influence that controls or limits something
examples: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
definitions.definition_vi: một ảnh hưởng kiểm soát hoặc hạn chế một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong
examples: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. ‘The devil makes work for idle hands,’ she would say.
definitions.definition_vi: những người không có đủ việc để làm thường bắt đầu làm sai

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to trust somebody and be willing to do what they say
examples: She'll have them eating out of her hand in no time.
definitions.definition_vi: tin tưởng ai đó và sẵn sàng làm theo những gì họ nói

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: to become controlled by somebody
examples: The town fell into enemy hands.
We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
After the war, the hotel fell into the hands of an American consortium.
definitions.definition_vi: bị ai đó kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: strong control or discipline
examples: Those children need a firm hand to make them behave.
definitions.definition_vi: kiểm soát hoặc kỷ luật mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: by experiencing, seeing, etc. something yourself rather than being told about it by somebody else
examples: The President visited the area to see the devastation at first hand.
definitions.definition_vi: bằng cách tự mình trải nghiệm, nhìn thấy, v.v. điều gì đó thay vì được người khác kể về điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 32
definitions.definition: to bring or hold your hands together
examples: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
definitions.definition_vi: mang hoặc nắm tay của bạn lại với nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 33
definitions.definition: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended
examples: They decided to strike to force the management’s hand.
definitions.definition_vi: khiến ai đó làm điều gì đó mà họ không muốn làm hoặc khiến họ làm việc đó sớm hơn dự định

definitions.label: Meaning 34
definitions.definition: to get an advantage over somebody so that you are in control of a particular situation
definitions.definition_vi: để có được lợi thế hơn ai đó để bạn có thể kiểm soát một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 35
definitions.definition: to do physical work
examples: He's not frightened of getting his hands dirty.
definitions.definition_vi: làm công việc thể chất

definitions.label: Meaning 36
definitions.definition: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions
examples: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được, có, vv cơ hội để làm những gì bạn muốn làm và đưa ra quyết định của riêng bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 37
definitions.definition: to show your approval of somebody by clapping your hands; to be applauded in this way
examples: Ladies and gentlemen, let’s give a big hand to our special guests tonight.
definitions.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tán thành của bạn đối với ai đó bằng cách vỗ tay; được hoan nghênh theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 38
definitions.definition: to help somebody
definitions.definition_vi: để giúp đỡ ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 39
definitions.definition: to ask somebody for something, especially money, in a very polite way that makes you seem less important
examples: There’s no way he’ll go cap in hand to his brother.
definitions.definition_vi: yêu cầu ai đó một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là tiền, một cách rất lịch sự làm cho bạn có vẻ ít quan trọng hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 40
definitions.definition: permission to marry somebody, especially a woman
examples: He asked the general for his daughter's hand in marriage.
definitions.definition_vi: phép kết hôn với ai đó, đặc biệt là một người phụ nữ

definitions.label: Meaning 41
definitions.definition: working closely with somebody, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
definitions.definition_vi: hợp tác chặt chẽ với ai đó, đặc biệt là theo cách bí mật và/hoặc bất hợp pháp

definitions.label: Meaning 42
definitions.definition: if two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other’s hand
examples: They walked through the park hand in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu hai người tay trong tay nghĩa là họ đang nắm tay nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 43
definitions.definition: if two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other
examples: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu hai thứ đi đôi với nhau thì chúng có mối liên hệ chặt chẽ với nhau và thứ này gây ra thứ kia

definitions.label: Meaning 44
definitions.definition: easily and without any doubt
examples: SEE ALSO hands-down
They won hands down.
It is hands down the best movie this year.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách dễ dàng và không có nghi ngờ gì

definitions.label: Meaning 45
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody not to touch something/somebody
examples: Get your hands off my wife!
Hey, hands off! That's my drink!
She warned her brother to keep his hands off her bag.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó đừng chạm vào cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 46
definitions.definition: used to tell a group of people to raise one hand in the air if they know the answer to a question, etc.
examples: Hands up all those who want to go swimming.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu một nhóm người giơ tay lên nếu họ biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 47
definitions.definition: used by somebody who is threatening people with a gun to tell them to raise both hands in the air
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng bởi ai đó đang đe dọa mọi người bằng súng để bảo họ giơ cả hai tay lên trời

definitions.label: Meaning 48
definitions.definition: to be responsible for somebody’s death
examples: a dictator with the blood of thousands on his hands
definitions.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về cái chết của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 49
definitions.definition: to be very busy or too busy to do something else
examples: She certainly has her hands full with four kids in the house.
definitions.definition_vi: rất bận hoặc quá bận để làm việc khác

definitions.label: Meaning 50
definitions.definition: to be unable to do what you want to do because of rules, promises, etc.
examples: I really wish I could help but my hands are tied.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể làm những gì bạn muốn làm vì các quy tắc, lời hứa, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 51
definitions.definition: to have complete control or influence over somebody
examples: Even before he plays a note, he has the audience in the palm of his hand.
definitions.definition_vi: có toàn quyền kiểm soát hoặc ảnh hưởng đến ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 52
definitions.definition: to have nothing to do or not be busy
definitions.definition_vi: không có gì để làm hoặc không bận rộn

definitions.label: Meaning 53
definitions.definition: to be in a position where you have power or control over somebody/something
examples: She had the whip hand and it was useless to resist.
definitions.definition_vi: ở vị trí mà bạn có quyền lực hoặc kiểm soát ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 54
definitions.definition: a way of doing something or of treating people that is much stronger and less sensitive than it needs to be
examples: the heavy hand of management
definitions.definition_vi: một cách làm điều gì đó hoặc đối xử với mọi người mạnh mẽ hơn và ít nhạy cảm hơn mức cần thiết

definitions.label: Meaning 55
definitions.definition: to give somebody support in a difficult situation
examples: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp cho ai đó sự hỗ trợ trong một tình huống khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 56
definitions.definition: to admit that you have made a mistake or are responsible for something bad
examples: I have to hold my hands up and admit that some of the problems have been all my own fault.
The solicitor confirmed that his clients were holding their hands up to the offences.
definitions.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng bạn đã phạm sai lầm hoặc chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 57
definitions.definition: being taken care of or dealt with by somebody that you think you can rely on
examples: Can I leave these queries in your capable hands?
He retired feeling confident that his company was in safe hands.
definitions.definition_vi: được chăm sóc hoặc xử lý bởi ai đó mà bạn nghĩ bạn có thể tin cậy

definitions.label: Meaning 58
definitions.definition: if you have time or money in hand, it is left and available to be used
examples: We managed to redecorate the house and still have some savings in hand.
She completed the first part of the exam with over an hour in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn có thời gian hoặc tiền bạc trong tay, nó sẽ sẵn sàng để sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 59
definitions.definition: if you have a particular situation in hand, you are in control of it
examples: Don’t worry about the travel arrangements—everything is in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn có một tình huống cụ thể trong tay, bạn có thể kiểm soát nó

definitions.label: Meaning 60
definitions.definition: the job, question, etc. in hand is the one that you are dealing with
examples: Please confine your comments to the topic in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: công việc, câu hỏi, v.v. trong tay là công việc mà bạn đang giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 61
definitions.definition: if somebody works a week, month, etc. in hand, they are paid for the work a week, etc. after they have completed it
definitions.definition_vi: nếu ai đó làm việc một tuần, một tháng, v.v., thì họ được trả lương cho công việc một tuần, v.v. sau khi hoàn thành công việc đó

definitions.label: Meaning 62
definitions.definition: being taken care of or controlled by somebody
examples: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
definitions.definition_vi: được chăm sóc hoặc kiểm soát bởi ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 63
definitions.definition: being taken care of well by somebody
examples: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
definitions.definition_vi: được ai đó chăm sóc chu đáo

definitions.label: Meaning 64
definitions.definition: if you use the words an iron fist/hand when describing the way that somebody behaves, you mean that they treat people severely. This treatment may be hidden behind a kind appearance (the velvet glove).
examples: They promised that the army would strike with an iron fist at any resistance.
The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.

definitions.label: Meaning 65
