definitions.definition: a pattern of straight lines, usually crossing each other to form squares
examples: New York’s grid of streets
definitions.definition_vi: một mẫu các đường thẳng, thường giao nhau để tạo thành hình vuông

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a frame of metal or wooden bars that are parallel or cross each other
examples: SEE ALSO cattle grid
definitions.definition_vi: một khung gồm các thanh kim loại hoặc gỗ song song hoặc chéo nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a pattern of squares on a map that are marked with letters or numbers to help you find the exact position of a place
examples: The grid reference is C8.
definitions.definition_vi: mẫu hình vuông trên bản đồ được đánh dấu bằng chữ cái hoặc số để giúp bạn tìm vị trí chính xác của một địa điểm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a system of electric wires or pipes carrying gas, for sending power over a large area
examples: SEE ALSO national grid
the national grid (= the electricity supply in a country)
the development of the country’s electricity grid
Power can be fed from wind generators into the electricity grid system.
definitions.definition_vi: hệ thống dây điện hoặc ống dẫn khí đốt để truyền tải điện trên một khu vực rộng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a pattern of lines marking the starting positions for the racing cars
examples: The 20-year-old didn't get the best of starts off the grid.
definitions.definition_vi: mẫu các đường đánh dấu vị trí xuất phát của xe đua

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a number of computers that are linked together using the internet so that they can share power, data, etc. in order to work on difficult problems
definitions.definition_vi: một số máy tính được liên kết với nhau bằng internet để chúng có thể chia sẻ nguồn điện, dữ liệu, v.v. để giải quyết các vấn đề khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: not using the public supplies of electricity, gas, water, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO off-the-grid
The mountain cabin is entirely off the grid.
You can produce your own power and live off the grid.
definitions.definition_vi: không sử dụng các nguồn cung cấp công cộng như điện, ga, nước...

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a very sad feeling, especially when somebody dies
examples: She was overcome with grief when her husband died.
They were able to share their common joys and griefs.
her grief for her dead husband
grief over the loss of friends
He could not hide his grief at her death.
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác rất buồn, đặc biệt là khi ai đó chết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that makes you feel very sad
examples: It was a grief to them that they had no children.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó khiến bạn cảm thấy rất buồn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: problems and worry
examples: He caused his parents a lot of grief.
Such behaviour can cause considerable grief.
definitions.definition_vi: vấn đề và lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to end in total failure
examples: All his schemes for making money seem to come to grief.
definitions.definition_vi: kết thúc trong thất bại hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to be harmed in an accident
examples: Several pedestrians came to grief on the icy pavement.
definitions.definition_vi: bị tổn hại trong một tai nạn

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to be annoyed with somebody and criticize their behaviour
definitions.definition_vi: khó chịu với ai đó và chỉ trích hành vi của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to express surprise or shock
examples: Good grief! What a mess!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to smile widely
examples: They grinned with delight when they heard our news.
Stop grinning and tell me what happened!
She grinned amiably at us.
He grinned a wide grin.
definitions.definition_vi: cười rộng rãi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to accept pain or bad luck without complaining
examples: There's nothing we can do about it. We'll just have to grin and bear it.
definitions.definition_vi: chấp nhận nỗi đau hay vận rủi mà không phàn nàn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be smiling, etc. a lot because you are very pleased about something
examples: He was beaming from ear to ear.
definitions.definition_vi: mỉm cười, v.v. rất nhiều vì bạn rất hài lòng về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to increase in size, number, strength or quality
examples: PAST PARTICIPLE OF grow
The sector is growing at a phenomenal rate.
The performance improved as their confidence grew.
Opposition to the latest proposals is growing steadily.
The market is growing rapidly.
Sales are growing fast.
The business has grown exponentially over the past ten years.
Fears are growing for the safety of a teenager who disappeared a week ago.
The economy is growing by roughly 2 per cent a year.
The company profits frew by 5 per cent last year.
The family has grown in size recently.
This approach is growing in popularity.
She is growing in confidence all the time.
Her media empire grew from quite small beginnings.
That number will grow to two billion users in 2025.
The city's population has grown from about 50 000 to over a million in 20 years.
to grow larger/stronger
The company is growing bigger all the time.
definitions.definition_vi: để tăng kích thước, số lượng, sức mạnh hoặc chất lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to become bigger or taller and develop into an adult
examples: You've grown since the last time I saw you!
The puppies grow quickly during the first six months.
Nick's grown almost an inch in the last month.
to grow bigger/taller/older
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn hoặc cao hơn và phát triển thành người lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to exist and develop in a particular place; to make plants grow
examples: SEE ALSO home-grown
The region is too dry for plants to grow.
Tomatoes grow best in direct sunlight.
These roses grow to a height of 6 feet.
This is a tree that grows well from cuttings.
The land is used to grow crops.
We need to grow our food more efficiently.
I didn't know they grew rice in France.
The plants were grown in controlled conditions.
I grew all these flowers from one packet of seeds.
definitions.definition_vi: tồn tại và phát triển ở một nơi cụ thể; để làm cho cây cối phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to become longer; to allow something to become longer by not cutting it
examples: I've decided to let my hair grow.
I've decided to grow my hair.
I didn't recognize him—he's grown a beard.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên dài hơn; để cho phép một cái gì đó trở nên dài hơn bằng cách không cắt nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to begin to have a particular quality or feeling over a period of time
examples: He had grown old and fat.
They were growing tired of her unreasonable behaviour.
My eyes soon grew accustomed to the darkness.
Mark and Jenny were growing closer every day.
As time went on he grew more and more impatient.
The skies grew dark and it began to rain.
She grew braver with time.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu có một chất lượng hoặc cảm giác cụ thể trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to gradually begin to do something
examples: I'm sure you'll grow to like her in time.
He grew to understand her reasons for leaving.
definitions.definition_vi: dần dần bắt đầu làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to develop and improve particular qualities or skills
examples: She continues to grow as an artist.
A secure background will help a child to grow emotionally.
definitions.definition_vi: để phát triển và cải thiện những phẩm chất hoặc kỹ năng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to increase the size, quality or number of something
examples: We are trying to grow the business.
definitions.definition_vi: để tăng kích thước, chất lượng hoặc số lượng của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say that when you are away from somebody that you love, you love them even more
definitions.definition_vi: người ta thường nói rằng khi bạn xa người bạn yêu, bạn lại càng yêu họ nhiều hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó lớn lao và thành công thường bắt đầu từ việc rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody not to use something or spend money carelessly because you do not have a lot of it
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó đừng sử dụng thứ gì đó hoặc tiêu tiền một cách bất cẩn vì bạn không có nhiều tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to not delay in getting things doneWord Origin
examples: Old English grōwan (originally referring chiefly to plants), of Germanic origin; related to Dutch groeien, also to grass and green.
definitions.definition_vi: không chậm trễ trong việc hoàn thành công việcWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping
examples: COMPARE warder
prison/border guards
The building is protected by armed guards.
The prisoner slipped past the guards on the gate and escaped.
A guard was posted outside the building.
definitions.definition_vi: một người, chẳng hạn như một người lính, một sĩ quan cảnh sát hoặc một sĩ quan nhà tù, người bảo vệ một địa điểm hoặc con người, hoặc ngăn chặn tù nhân trốn thoát

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act or duty of protecting property, places or people from attack or danger; the act or duty of preventing prisoners from escaping
examples: a sentry on guard (= at his or her post, on duty)
to be on guard duty
The escaped prisoner was brought back under armed guard.
The terrorist was kept under police guard.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động hoặc nghĩa vụ bảo vệ tài sản, địa điểm hoặc con người khỏi bị tấn công hoặc nguy hiểm; hành động hoặc nhiệm vụ ngăn chặn tù nhân trốn thoát

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a group of people, such as soldiers or police officers, who protect somebody/something
examples: SEE ALSO advance guard
the captain of the guard
the changing of the guard (= when one group replaces another)
The guard is/are being inspected today.
Fellow airmen provided a guard of honour at his wedding.
The president always travels with an armed guard.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người, chẳng hạn như binh lính hoặc cảnh sát, bảo vệ ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: (in the UK and some other countries) special regiments of soldiers whose original duty was to protect the king or queen
examples: the Scots Guards
a Guards officer
definitions.definition_vi: (ở Anh và một số nước khác) các trung đoàn lính đặc biệt có nhiệm vụ ban đầu là bảo vệ nhà vua hoặc hoàng hậu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: something that covers a part of a person’s body or a dangerous part of a machine to prevent injury
examples: SEE ALSO fireguard
All players wear helmets and face guards.
Ensure the guard is in place before operating the machine.
definitions.definition_vi: thứ gì đó che phủ một phần cơ thể của một người hoặc một bộ phận nguy hiểm của máy để ngăn ngừa thương tích

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: conductor (= a person who is in charge of a train and travels with it, but does not drive it)
definitions.definition_vi: người soát vé (= người phụ trách một đoàn tàu và di chuyển cùng với nó nhưng không lái nó)

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a position you take to defend yourself, especially in a sport such as boxing or fencing
examples: to drop/keep up your guard
In spite of the awkward questions the minister never let his guard fall for a moment.
definitions.definition_vi: một vị trí bạn đảm nhận để bảo vệ chính mình, đặc biệt là trong một môn thể thao như đấm bốc hoặc đấu kiếm

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: one of the two players on a basketball team who are mainly responsible for staying close to players of the other team to stop them from scoring
examples: SEE ALSO point guard
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai cầu thủ của một đội bóng rổ chịu trách nhiệm chính trong việc ở gần các cầu thủ của đội kia để ngăn họ ghi bàn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: one of the two players on an American football team who play either side of the centre forward
examples: SEE ALSO pulling guard
definitions.definition_vi: một trong hai cầu thủ của đội bóng đá Mỹ chơi ở hai bên tiền đạo trung tâm

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be very careful and prepared for something difficult or dangerous
examples: He was always on his guard against moneymaking schemes.
definitions.definition_vi: phải rất cẩn thận và chuẩn bị cho một cái gì đó khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to stop being careful and preparing yourself for possible danger or difficulty
examples: You can never drop your guard with a two-year-old.
Even when he's winning, he never drops his guard.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng cẩn thận và chuẩn bị cho mình những nguy hiểm hoặc khó khăn có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to watch or protect somebody/something
examples: Four soldiers stood guard over the coffin.
One of the men kept guard, while the other broke into the house.
definitions.definition_vi: trông chừng hoặc bảo vệ ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: not careful or prepared for something difficult or dangerous
examples: The lawyer’s apparently innocent question was designed to catch the witness off (his) guard.
definitions.definition_vi: không cẩn thận hoặc chuẩn bị cho điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about something without being sure of all the facts
examples: I don't really know. I'm just guessing.
We can only guess at her reasons for leaving.
He guessed right/wrong.
I'd guess that she's about 30.
Can you guess where I've been?
Can you guess his age?
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng đưa ra câu trả lời hoặc đưa ra đánh giá về điều gì đó mà không chắc chắn về tất cả sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to find the right answer to a question or the truth without knowing all the facts
examples: SEE ALSO second-guess
She guessed the answer straight away.
You'll never guess what she told me.
You would never guess (that) she had problems. She’s always so cheerful.
So it was Rob who broke the window? I might have guessed!
If I had to guess, I'd say she was the one responsible for this.
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm câu trả lời đúng cho một câu hỏi hoặc sự thật mà không biết tất cả sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to show that you are going to say something surprising or exciting
examples: Guess what! He's asked me out!
Guess who I've just seen!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn sẽ nói điều gì đó đáng ngạc nhiên hoặc thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to suppose that something is true or likely
examples: I guess (that) you’ll be looking for a new job now.
I guess I'm just lucky.
He didn't see me, I guess.
‘Are you ready to go?’ ‘Yeah, I guess so.’
‘They aren't coming, then?’ ‘I guess not.’
definitions.definition_vi: cho rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc có khả năng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to not tell somebody about your plans or what is going to happen next
examples: It's the kind of book that keeps you guessing right to the end.
definitions.definition_vi: không nói cho ai biết về kế hoạch của bạn hoặc những gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who shows other people the way to a place, especially somebody employed to show tourists around interesting places
examples: Our tour guide showed us around the old town.
We hired a local guide to get us across the mountains.
definitions.definition_vi: người chỉ đường cho người khác đến một nơi, đặc biệt là người được thuê để chỉ cho khách du lịch những địa điểm thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who advises you on how to live and behave
examples: A guru is the spiritual guide of his students.
His elder sister had been his guide, counsellor and friend.
definitions.definition_vi: người cho bạn lời khuyên về cách sống và cách cư xử

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a book, magazine, app, etc. that gives you information, help or instructions about something
examples: Let's have a look at the TV guide and see what's on.
a Guide to Family Health
a step-by-step guide to creating your own website
study guides for mathematics and physics
an essential guide for every new parent
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách, tạp chí, ứng dụng, v.v. cung cấp cho bạn thông tin, trợ giúp hoặc hướng dẫn về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a book that gives information about a place for travellers or tourists
examples: SEE ALSO audio guide
He has written a number of travel guides.
I consulted my guide as I walked around the cathedral.
a guide to Italy
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách cung cấp thông tin về một địa điểm cho khách du lịch hoặc khách du lịch

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: something that gives you enough information to be able to make a decision about something or form an opinion
examples: As a rough guide, allow half a cup of rice per person.
I let my feelings be my guide.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó cung cấp cho bạn đủ thông tin để có thể đưa ra quyết định về điều gì đó hoặc đưa ra ý kiến

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to try to prevent or avoid loss or damage when it is already too late to do so

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: ăn nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: given by somebody who is directly involved and therefore likely to be accurate
definitions.definition_vi: được đưa ra bởi ai đó có liên quan trực tiếp và do đó có khả năng chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 14

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng họ nên đợi một lát và đừng quá hào hứng đến mức hành động mà không suy nghĩ trước

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: the act of matching people with suitable jobs or tasks
definitions.definition_vi: hành động kết nối mọi người với công việc hoặc nhiệm vụ phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 16

definitions.definition_vi: mong muốn một cái gì đó không làm cho nó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 17

definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc thi hoặc một cuộc bầu cử trong đó chỉ có một, hai, v.v. đội hoặc ứng cử viên có cơ hội chiến thắng

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to put or do things in the wrong order
definitions.definition_vi: đặt hoặc làm việc gì đó không đúng thứ tự

definitions.label: Meaning 21

examples: Old English hors, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch ros and German Ross.

Sonja stayed with an Argentine host family.
definitions.definition_vi: người mời khách đến ăn, dự tiệc, v.v. hoặc người có người ở lại nhà mình

definitions.label: Meaning 2

The wonderful city of Melbourne is host to this event.
definitions.definition_vi: một quốc gia, một thành phố hoặc một tổ chức tổ chức và sắp xếp một sự kiện đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person who introduces a television or radio show, and talks to guests
examples: SYNONYM compère
a radio/TV host
The event will be opened by television host Bill Punter.
definitions.definition_vi: người giới thiệu một chương trình truyền hình hoặc đài phát thanh và nói chuyện với khách

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an animal or a plant on which another animal or plant lives and feeds
definitions.definition_vi: động vật hoặc thực vật mà động vật hoặc thực vật khác sống và kiếm ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn người hoặc vật

examples: transferring files from the host to your local computer
definitions.definition_vi: máy tính chính trong mạng điều khiển hoặc cung cấp thông tin cho các máy tính khác được kết nối với nó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the bread that is used in the Christian service of communion, after it has been blessed
definitions.definition_vi: bánh được sử dụng trong nghi lễ hiệp thông của Kitô giáo, sau khi đã được làm phép

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be a place where a particular plant, animal or feature is found
examples: Australia is host to some of the world's most dangerous animals.
The acre of garden is host to a splendid bank of rhododendrons.
The park is host to a beautiful ornamental lake.
definitions.definition_vi: là nơi tìm thấy một loài thực vật, động vật hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a building where people stay, usually for a short time, paying for their rooms and meals

a two-star/five-star, etc. hotel
a luxury/boutique hotel
a new resort hotel and conference centre
We stayed in a friendly family-run hotel.
hotel rooms/guests
online hotel booking sites
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà nơi mọi người ở lại, thường là trong một thời gian ngắn, trả tiền phòng và bữa ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a pub
definitions.definition_vi: một quán rượu

examples: mid 18th cent.: from French hôtel, from Old French hostel, from medieval Latin hospitale, neuter of Latin hospitalis ‘hospitable’, from hospes, hospit- ‘host, guest’.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhà hàngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a building for people to live in, usually for one family
examples: SEE ALSO Buck House
We live in a two-bedroom house.
It was so hot outside we stayed in the house.
He went into the house.
I had to get out of the house.
A light was on inside the house.
There was a police van parked outside the house.
Let's have a party at my house.
We need to build more houses in a way that respects the needs of the environment.
Investors were buying houses to rent them out.
What time do you leave the house in the morning (= to go to work)?
We're moving house (= leaving our house and going to live in a different one).
House prices (= prices of houses and flats) in London are still rising.
We went on a tour of the house and grounds (= for example, at a country house, open to the public).
They went from house to house, begging for food.
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà để mọi người ở, thường là cho một gia đình

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: all the people living in a house
examples: SYNONYM household
Be quiet or you'll wake the whole house!
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả những người sống trong một ngôi nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a building used for a particular purpose, for example for holding meetings in or keeping animals or goods in
examples: SEE ALSO doghouse
an opera house
a henhouse
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà được sử dụng cho một mục đích cụ thể, ví dụ như để tổ chức các cuộc họp hoặc giữ động vật hoặc hàng hóa trong đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used in the names of office buildings
examples: SEE ALSO Bush House
Their offices are on the second floor of Chester House.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của các tòa nhà văn phòng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a company involved in a particular kind of business; an institution of a particular kind
examples: SEE ALSO clearing house
a fashion/banking/publishing house
a religious house (= a convent or a monastery)
definitions.definition_vi: một công ty tham gia vào một loại hình kinh doanh cụ thể; một tổ chức thuộc một loại hình cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a restaurant
examples: SEE ALSO free house
a steakhouse
a coffee house
a bottle of house wine (= the cheapest wine available in a particular restaurant, sometimes not listed by name)
definitions.definition_vi: một nhà hàng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a group of people who meet to discuss and make the laws of a country
examples: SEE ALSO lower house
Legislation requires approval by both houses of parliament.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người gặp nhau để thảo luận và đưa ra luật pháp của một quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the House of Commons or the House of Lords in the UK; the House of Representatives in the US
definitions.definition_vi: Hạ viện hoặc Hạ viện ở Anh; Hạ viện ở Mỹ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a group of people discussing something in a formal debate
examples: I urge the house to vote against the motion.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người đang thảo luận về điều gì đó trong một cuộc tranh luận chính thức

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the part of a theatre where the audience sits; the audience at a particular performance
examples: SEE ALSO front of house
playing to a full/packed/empty house (= to a large/small audience)
The spotlight faded and the house lights came up.
definitions.definition_vi: phần rạp hát nơi khán giả ngồi; khán giả tại một buổi biểu diễn cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: (in some British schools) an organized group of students of different ages who compete against other groups in sports competitions, etc. and who may, in boarding schools, live together in one building
definitions.definition_vi: (ở một số trường học ở Anh) một nhóm học sinh có tổ chức ở các độ tuổi khác nhau thi đấu với các nhóm khác trong các cuộc thi thể thao, v.v. và những người có thể, ở các trường nội trú, sống cùng nhau trong một tòa nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: an old and famous family
examples: the House of Windsor (= the British royal family)
definitions.definition_vi: một gia đình lâu đời và nổi tiếng

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: a type of electronic dance music with a fast beat
definitions.definition_vi: một loại nhạc dance điện tử có nhịp nhanh

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to make everyone laugh or cheer, especially at a performance in the theatre
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người cười hoặc cổ vũ, đặc biệt là tại buổi biểu diễn ở nhà hát

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted
examples: The new manager said he wanted to clean house.
definitions.definition_vi: loại bỏ những người hoặc những thứ không cần thiết hoặc không mong muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to make your house clean
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho ngôi nhà của bạn sạch sẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to eat a lot of somebody else’s food
examples: How much longer is he staying? He’s eating us out of house and home.
definitions.definition_vi: ăn nhiều đồ ăn của người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to become friends quickly and have a very friendly relationship
definitions.definition_vi: để nhanh chóng trở thành bạn bè và có một mối quan hệ rất thân thiện

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to do something or ask a question in a very complicated way instead of in a simple, direct way
examples: You did go all round the houses didn’t you? Why not get straight to the point?
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó hoặc đặt câu hỏi một cách rất phức tạp thay vì một cách đơn giản, trực tiếp

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to cook, clean and do all the other jobs around the house
examples: She kept house for her elderly parents.
definitions.definition_vi: nấu ăn, dọn dẹp và làm tất cả các công việc khác trong nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: used to say that everyone was very emotional about something
examples: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng mọi người đều rất xúc động về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: drinks or meals that are on the house are provided free by the pub or restaurant and you do not have to pay
examples: Have a drink on the house.
definitions.definition_vi: đồ uống hoặc bữa ăn tại nhà được quán rượu hoặc nhà hàng cung cấp miễn phí và bạn không phải trả tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: you should not criticize other people, because they will easily find ways of criticizing you
definitions.definition_vi: bạn không nên chỉ trích người khác, vì họ sẽ dễ dàng tìm cách chỉ trích bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to play at being a family in its home
examples: The children were playing house, giving dinner to their dolls.
definitions.definition_vi: chơi trò trở thành một gia đình trong nhà của nó

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to organize your own business or improve your own behaviour before you try to criticize somebody else
definitions.definition_vi: tổ chức công việc kinh doanh của riêng bạn hoặc cải thiện hành vi của chính bạn trước khi bạn cố gắng chỉ trích người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: very safe
definitions.definition_vi: rất an toàn

examples: They set up house together in a small flat in Brighton.

definitions.definition: one of the things from which something is made, especially one of the foods that are used together to make a particular dish
examples: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.
Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.
The only active ingredient in this medicine is aspirin.
Avocado is the main ingredient of the Mexican dish.
Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những thứ mà từ đó một cái gì đó được tạo ra, đặc biệt là một trong những loại thực phẩm được sử dụng cùng nhau để tạo nên một món ăn cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: one of the things or qualities that are necessary to make something successful
examples: It has all the ingredients of a good mystery story.
An effective exercise programme has three key ingredients—intensity, frequency and duration.
Determination is one of the essential ingredients for success.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những điều hoặc phẩm chất cần thiết để làm nên thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to receive money, property, etc. from somebody when they die
examples: COMPARE disinherit
She inherited a fortune from her father.
He will inherit the title on the death of his uncle.
Does he know that she stands to inherit?
definitions.definition_vi: nhận tiền, tài sản, v.v. từ ai đó khi họ chết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to have qualities, physical features, etc. that are similar to those of your parents, grandparents, etc.
examples: He has inherited his mother's patience.
Is this an inherited disease?
How many of these traits are genetically inherited?
She inherited a passion for music from her grandfather.
definitions.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất, đặc điểm thể chất, v.v. giống với cha mẹ, ông bà của bạn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: if you inherit a particular situation from somebody, you are now responsible for dealing with it, especially because you have replaced that person in their job
examples: policies inherited from the previous administration
I inherited a number of problems from my predecessor.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn kế thừa một tình huống cụ thể từ ai đó, thì bây giờ bạn phải chịu trách nhiệm giải quyết nó, đặc biệt là vì bạn đã thay thế người đó trong công việc của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make something begin
examples: SYNONYM set/put in motion
to initiate legal proceedings against somebody
The government has initiated a programme of economic reform.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó bắt đầu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to explain something to somebody and/or make them experience it for the first time
examples: Many of them had been initiated into drug use at an early age.
His uncle initiated him into the pleasures of sailing.
definitions.definition_vi: giải thích điều gì đó cho ai đó và/hoặc khiến họ trải nghiệm điều đó lần đầu tiên

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to make somebody a member of a particular group, especially as part of a secret ceremony
examples: Hundreds are initiated into the sect each year.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó trở thành thành viên của một nhóm cụ thể, đặc biệt là một phần của buổi lễ bí mật

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: on or to the inner part of something/somebody; within something/somebody
examples: OPPOSITE outside
Go inside the house.
Inside the box was a gold watch.
For years we had little knowledge of what life was like inside China.
You'll feel better with a good meal inside you.
Inside most of us is a small child screaming for attention.
definitions.definition_vi: trên hoặc vào phần bên trong của cái gì/ai đó; bên trong cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: in less than the amount of time mentioned
examples: COMPARE outside (4)
The job is unlikely to be finished inside (of) a year.
definitions.definition_vi: trong ít hơn khoảng thời gian được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to demand that something happen or that somebody agree to do something
examples: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.
Stay and have lunch. I insist!
‘Please come with us.’ ‘Very well then, if you insist.’
She insisted on him wearing a suit
She insisted on his wearing a suit
He insists that she come.
He insists that she should come.

definitions.label: Meaning 2

examples: He insisted on his innocence.

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: SYNONYM examine

The plants are regularly inspected for disease.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ vào cái gì/ai đó, đặc biệt là để kiểm tra xem mọi thứ có đúng như vậy không

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to officially visit a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable

definitions.definition_vi: chính thức đến thăm một trường học, nhà máy, v.v. để kiểm tra xem các quy tắc có được tuân thủ và các tiêu chuẩn đó có được chấp nhận hay không

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: Regular inspections are carried out at the prison.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of looking closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is as it should be
examples: SYNONYM examination

definitions.definition_vi: hành động nhìn kỹ vào cái gì đó/ai đó, đặc biệt là để kiểm tra xem mọi thứ có đúng như vậy không

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the process that takes place when somebody sees or hears something that causes them to have exciting new ideas or makes them want to create something, especially in art, music or literature
examples: Dreams can be a rich source of inspiration for an artist.
Both poets drew their inspiration from the countryside.
Her work lacks inspiration (= it does not contain any exciting new ideas).
Looking for inspiration for a new dessert? Try this recipe.
She had the time and the inspiration to develop her talent.
definitions.definition_vi: quá trình diễn ra khi ai đó nhìn hoặc nghe thấy điều gì đó khiến họ nảy ra những ý tưởng mới thú vị hoặc khiến họ muốn tạo ra thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là trong nghệ thuật, âm nhạc hoặc văn học

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is the reason why somebody creates or does something
examples: He says my sister was the inspiration for his heroine.

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật đó là lý do tại sao ai đó tạo ra hoặc làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or thing that makes you want to be better, more successful, etc.
examples: Her charity work is an inspiration to us all.

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật khiến bạn muốn trở nên tốt hơn, thành công hơn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a sudden good idea
examples: He had an inspiration: he'd give her a dog for her birthday.

definitions.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hay đột ngột

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to fix equipment or furniture into position so that it can be used

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition_vi: hành động cố định thiết bị hoặc đồ đạc vào đúng vị trí để có thể sử dụng được

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: hành động đưa một chương trình mới vào máy tính

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: You've just missed her.
They just made it, boarding the aircraft minutes before take-off.
I only just caught the train.
Inflation fell to just over 4 per cent.
The painting sold for just under £6 million.
I got here just after nine.
They must have got there just before I did.
He visited Guatemala just prior to his death.
They're now the largest party, through just short of an overall majority.
definitions.definition_vi: bằng một lượng nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to say that you/somebody did something or something happened very recently
examples: I've just heard the news.
When you arrived, he had only just left.
She has just been telling us about her trip to Rome.
I just saw him a moment ago.
She was just here.
Just last week it was snowing and now it's 25 degrees.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn/ai đó đã làm điều gì đó hoặc điều gì đó đã xảy ra rất gần đây

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: at this/that moment; now

I was just beginning to enjoy myself when we had to leave.
I'm just off (= I am leaving now).
definitions.definition_vi: vào thời điểm này/thời điểm đó; Hiện nay

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: exactly
examples: This jacket is just my size.
With him, everything always has to to be just right.
This gadget is just the thing for getting those nails out.
Just my luck (= the sort of bad luck I usually have). My phone needs recharging.
You're just in time.
She looks just like her mother.
It's just what I wanted!
It's just as I thought.
It's just on six (= exactly six o'clock).
definitions.definition_vi: chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: at the same moment as
examples: The clock struck six just as I arrived.
definitions.definition_vi: cùng lúc với

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: no less than; equally
examples: She's just as smart as her sister.
You can get there just as cheaply by plane.
definitions.definition_vi: không ít hơn; bằng nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: going to do something only a few moments from now or then
examples: The water's just about to boil.
I was just going to tell you when you interrupted.
definitions.definition_vi: sẽ làm điều gì đó chỉ trong chốc lát kể từ bây giờ hoặc sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: really; completely
examples: The food was just wonderful!
The trip was just amazing!
Relax—you're doing just fine.
I can just imagine his reaction.
definitions.definition_vi: Thực ra; hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used in orders to get somebody’s attention, give permission, etc.
examples: Just listen to what I'm saying, will you!
Just help yourselves.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó, cho phép, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to make a polite request, excuse, etc.
examples: Could you just help me with this box, please?
I've just got a few things to do first.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra lời yêu cầu, xin lỗi lịch sự, v.v...

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used to show a slight possibility that something is true or will happen

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện một khả năng nhỏ rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: used to agree with somebody
examples: ‘He's very pompous.’ ‘Isn't he just?’
definitions.definition_vi: từng đồng ý với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: used to say that you/somebody would have been in the same position if you had done something else, because you got little benefit or pleasure from what you did do

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn/ai đó sẽ rơi vào hoàn cảnh tương tự nếu bạn làm việc khác, bởi vì bạn nhận được rất ít lợi ích hoặc niềm vui từ việc bạn đã làm

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: because of the possibility of something happening
examples: You'd better take the keys in case I'm out.
You probably won't need to call—but take my number, just in case.

definitions.definition_vi: vì có khả năng xảy ra chuyện gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17

examples: It is just as well that we didn't leave any later or we'd have missed him.
definitions.definition_vi: đó là một điều tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 18

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn cũng muốn làm điều gì đó cũng như làm điều gì đó khác đã được gợi ý

definitions.label: Meaning 19

definitions.definition_vi: khoảng

definitions.label: Meaning 21

definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột, không có cảnh báo hay giải thích

definitions.label: Meaning 22

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó đợi một lát

definitions.label: Meaning 23

definitions.definition_vi: vào lúc này

definitions.label: Meaning 24

definitions.definition_vi: trong giai đoạn hiện nay

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: only a short time ago
examples: I saw her just now.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ một thời gian ngắn trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 26

definitions.definition_vi: sau đó; trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: done or arranged very accurately or carefully
examples: He liked polishing the furniture and making everything just so.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện hoặc sắp xếp rất chính xác hoặc cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 28

definitions.definition_vi: vào lúc đó

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: exactly what is needed in a particular situation
examples: That cup of tea was just the ticket.
definitions.definition_vi: chính xác những gì cần thiết trong một tình huống cụ thể

examples: I can't give you the money just yet.
definitions.definition_vi: không phải bây giờ nhưng có lẽ sẽ sớm thôi

definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục có cái gì đó và không trả lại hoặc vứt nó đi

I could not keep silent any longer.

Winning the contract means they can now keep the factory open.

Keep your PIN safe.
He kept his coat on.
Don't keep us in suspense—what happened next?
She had trouble keeping her balance.
I'm very sorry to keep you waiting.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to continue doing something; to do something repeatedly

Why does everyone keep saying that?
Things just keep getting worse.
Don't keep on interrupting me!
definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục làm điều gì đó; làm điều gì đó nhiều lần

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to know something and not tell it to anyone

definitions.definition_vi: biết điều gì đó và không nói với ai

Residents are not allowed to keep pets.

definitions.definition_vi: sở hữu và quản lý một cửa hàng hoặc nhà hàng

definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ hoặc bảo vệ khung thành hoặc khung thành

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to make an effort to live normally when you are in a difficult situation or when you have experienced great pain and difficulty

examples: Keep going, Sarah, you're nearly there.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để khuyến khích ai tiếp tục làm việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19

examples: Have an apple to keep you going till dinner time.
definitions.definition_vi: là đủ cho ai đó cho đến khi họ có được thứ họ đang chờ đợi

the car keys

definitions.definition: a set of answers to exercises or problems
examples: Check your answers in the key at the back of the book.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các câu trả lời cho bài tập hoặc vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: You can find the symbols in the key at the bottom of the page.

definitions.definition_vi: để thành công hoặc giành chiến thắng một cách ấn tượng

definitions.definition_vi: trừng phạt hoặc đánh bại ai đó

definitions.definition_vi: đưa ai đó đi bất hợp pháp và giữ họ như một tù nhân, đặc biệt là để lấy tiền hoặc thứ gì khác để trả lại họ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a room in which meals are cooked or prepared
examples: SEE ALSO soup kitchen
We ate at the kitchen table.
the kitchen floor/window/door
a stainless steel kitchen sink
He stabbed her with a kitchen knife.
The house has a fully fitted kitchen with custom-built units.
definitions.definition_vi: một căn phòng trong đó bữa ăn được nấu hoặc chuẩn bị

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a very large number of things, probably more than is necessary
examples: We seem to take everything but the kitchen sink when we go camping.
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng rất lớn các thứ, có lẽ nhiều hơn mức cần thiết

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to stop trying to do something if they find it too difficult, especially in order to suggest that they are less able than other peopleWord Origin
examples: Old English cycene, of West Germanic origin; related to Dutch keuken and German Küche, based on Latin coquere ‘to cook’.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó ngừng cố gắng làm điều gì đó nếu họ cảm thấy nó quá khó khăn, đặc biệt là để gợi ý rằng họ kém khả năng hơn người khácNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to hit a door, etc. in order to attract attention
examples: SYNONYM rap
He knocked three times and waited.
I knocked on the door and went straight in.
Somebody was knocking on the window.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh vào một cánh cửa, v.v. để thu hút sự chú ý

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to hit something hard, often by accident
examples: Be careful you don't knock your head on this low beam.
Her hand knocked against the glass.
She dropped the pile of books when he accidentally knocked her shoulder.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh cái gì đó cứng, thường là do tai nạn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to hit something so that it moves or breaks
examples: He'd knocked over a glass of water.
I knocked the nail into the wall.
They had to knock the door down to get in.
He had knocked one of the pictures off the wall.
The boys were knocking (= kicking) a ball around in the back yard.
The criticism had knocked (= damaged) her self-esteem.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh cái gì đó để nó di chuyển hoặc phá vỡ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to put somebody/something into a particular state by hitting them/it
examples: The blow knocked me flat.
He was knocked senseless by the blow.
She knocked my drink flying.
The two rooms had been knocked into one (= the wall between them had been knocked down).
definitions.definition_vi: đẩy ai/cái gì vào một trạng thái cụ thể bằng cách đánh họ/nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to make a hole in something by hitting it hard
examples: They managed to knock a hole in the wall.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo một lỗ trên cái gì đó bằng cách đánh mạnh vào nó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: if your heart knocks, it beats hard; if your knees knock, they shake, for example from fear
examples: My heart was knocking wildly.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu tim bạn gõ, nó đập mạnh; nếu đầu gối của bạn va vào nhau, chúng sẽ rung chuyển, ví dụ như vì sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to make a regular sound of metal hitting metal, especially because there is something wrong
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra âm thanh đều đặn của kim loại va vào kim loại, đặc biệt là vì có gì đó không ổn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to criticize somebody/something, especially when it happens unfairly
examples: The newspapers are always knocking the England team.
It may sound pretty childish, but don't knock it until you've tried it.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ trích ai/cái gì, đặc biệt là khi nó xảy ra không công bằng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to force people to stop arguing and behave in a sensible way
definitions.definition_vi: để buộc mọi người ngừng tranh cãi và cư xử một cách hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to hit somebody very hard several times and hurt them very much
examples: Get out or I’ll beat the living daylights out of you!
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai đó rất mạnh nhiều lần và làm họ tổn thương rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to hit somebody/something very hard
examples: He was a dirty player and loved to kick hell out of the opposition.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai/cái gì rất mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to surprise or impress somebody very much
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó ngạc nhiên hoặc ấn tượng rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to train somebody so that they do a particular job, task, etc. well
examples: It took him just two weeks to knock the new recruits into shape.
Leave the boy with me—I'll soon knock him into shape!
definitions.definition_vi: đào tạo ai đó để họ làm một công việc, nhiệm vụ cụ thể, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to make something more acceptable, organized or successful
examples: I've got all the information together but it still needs knocking into shape.
It shouldn’t take long to get the company back into shape.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó dễ chấp nhận hơn, có tổ chức hoặc thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to affect somebody very deeply
examples: The business over the lawsuit had really knocked her for six.
definitions.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến ai đó rất sâu sắc

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: used to threaten somebody that you will hit them
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đe dọa ai đó rằng bạn sẽ đánh họ

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to impress somebody very much
examples: You look fabulous—you'll knock 'em dead tonight.
definitions.definition_vi: gây ấn tượng với ai đó rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to be very much better than somebody/something
examples: She knocks the rest of the cast into a cocked hat.
definitions.definition_vi: tốt hơn rất nhiều so với ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to stop making a noise, annoying you, etc.
examples: Knock it off, kids—I’m trying to work.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó ngừng gây ồn ào, làm phiền bạn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to make somebody lose their position as somebody/something successful or admired
examples: A lot of teams are looking to knock us off our perch.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó mất đi vị trí của họ như một ai đó/cái gì đó thành công hoặc được ngưỡng mộ

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to stop something from happening; to stop doing something
examples: The recession knocked on the head any idea of expanding the company.
By eleven o’clock we were all tired so we knocked it on the head.
definitions.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn một cái gì đó xảy ra; ngừng làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: used when talking about your previous good luck or your hopes for the future, to avoid bringing bad luck
examples: I've been driving for over 20 years and never had an accident—knock on wood!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi nói về sự may mắn trước đây của bạn hoặc hy vọng của bạn cho tương lai, để tránh mang lại điều xui xẻo

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to surprise or shock somebody so much that they are unable to react immediately
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc đến mức họ không thể phản ứng ngay lập tức

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to try and persuade somebody to stop behaving in a stupid way, sometimes using rough or violent methods
examples: Try and talk some sense into her before she makes the wrong decision.
Where would I be without you to knock some sense into my head?
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng thuyết phục ai đó ngừng hành xử một cách ngu ngốc, đôi khi sử dụng các phương pháp thô bạo hoặc bạo lực

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to be very much better than somebody/something
examples: She knocks spots off all the other candidates.
definitions.definition_vi: tốt hơn rất nhiều so với ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to make somebody lose their confidence and enthusiasm
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó mất đi sự tự tin và nhiệt tình của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: used to express surpriseWord Origin
examples: Old English cnocian, of imitative origin.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiênNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with or involving two or more countries
examples: international trade/law
national and international affairs
the international community
an international organization/institution/agency
In crucial areas of international relations the nation state still dominates.
Japan's crime rate is still low by international standards.
an international conference on global trade
a drop in prices on the international markets
an international treaty/agreement
an international airport/school/company
He plays international rugby.
a pianist with an international reputation
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với hoặc liên quan đến hai hoặc nhiều quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used by people of many different countries
examples: large international hotels
London is a truly international city.
definitions.definition_vi: được người dân ở nhiều quốc gia khác nhau sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an international computer network connecting other networks and computers from companies, universities, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO intranet
to surf/browse/access the internet
I looked it up on the internet.
She likes to go on the internet in the evenings.
We have kept in touch via the internet.
You can view the video feed over the internet.
All the rooms have access to the internet/internet access.
I couldn't get an internet connection.
internet users
an internet cafe (= a cafe where you pay to use a computer to access the internet)
The payment can be made through internet banking.
definitions.definition_vi: một mạng máy tính quốc tế kết nối các mạng và máy tính khác từ các công ty, trường đại học, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the particular way in which something is understood or explained
examples: Her evidence suggests a different interpretation of the events.
It is not possible for everyone to put their own interpretation on the law.
Dreams are open to interpretation (= they can be explained in different ways).
definitions.definition_vi: cách cụ thể mà một cái gì đó được hiểu hoặc giải thích

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the particular way in which somebody chooses to perform a piece of music, a role in a play, etc.
examples: a modern interpretation of ‘King Lear’
definitions.definition_vi: cách cụ thể mà ai đó chọn để biểu diễn một bản nhạc, một vai trong một vở kịch, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: very interesting because of being unusual or not having an obvious answer
examples: These discoveries raise intriguing questions.
an intriguing possibility
He found her intriguing.
It all sounds very intriguing.
definitions.definition_vi: rất thú vị vì khác thường hoặc không có câu trả lời rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the first part of a book or speech that gives a general idea of what is to follow
examples: COMPARE preface
a book with an excellent introduction and notes
Can you write a brief introduction to the text?
The English edition has an introduction by Herbert Read.
His mother is mentioned in the introduction.
By way of introduction, let me give you the background to the story.
definitions.definition_vi: phần đầu tiên của cuốn sách hoặc bài phát biểu đưa ra ý tưởng chung về những gì sẽ tiếp theo

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of making one person formally known to another or a group of others, in which you tell them the person's name
examples: Introductions were made and the conversation started to flow.
Our speaker today needs no introduction (= is already well known).
I was hoping to get an introduction to his good-looking colleague.
a letter of introduction (= a letter which tells somebody who you are, written by somebody who knows both you and the person reading the letter)
definitions.definition_vi: hành động làm cho một người được người khác hoặc một nhóm người khác biết đến một cách chính thức, trong đó bạn cho họ biết tên của người đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of bringing something into use or existence for the first time, or of bringing something to a place for the first time
examples: the introduction of new manufacturing methods
the introduction of compulsory military service
the 1 000th anniversary of the introduction of Christianity to Russia
We can now begin commercial introduction of the product into the United States.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động đưa thứ gì đó vào sử dụng hoặc tồn tại lần đầu tiên hoặc mang thứ gì đó đến một nơi lần đầu tiên

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a thing that is brought into use or introduced to a place for the first time
examples: The book lists plants suitable for the British flower garden, among them many new introductions.
definitions.definition_vi: một vật được đưa vào sử dụng hoặc đưa vào một nơi nào đó lần đầu tiên

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a person’s first experience of something
examples: This album was my first introduction to modern jazz.
definitions.definition_vi: trải nghiệm đầu tiên của một người về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a book or course for people beginning to study a subject
examples: ‘Global Politics: An Introduction’
It's a useful introduction to an extremely complex subject.
‘An Introduction to Astronomy’
The course provides a brief introduction to philosophy.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuốn sách hoặc khóa học dành cho những người bắt đầu nghiên cứu một chủ đề

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a short section at the beginning of a piece of music
examples: an eight-bar introduction
After a lengthy musical introduction, the dancers finally appear.
definitions.definition_vi: một đoạn ngắn ở đầu bản nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to enter a country, town, etc. using military force in order to take control of it
examples: Troops invaded on August 9th that year.
When did the Romans invade Britain?
definitions.definition_vi: vào một đất nước, thị trấn, vv sử dụng lực lượng quân sự để kiểm soát nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to enter a place in large numbers, especially in a way that causes damage or problems
examples: Demonstrators invaded the government buildings.
As the final whistle blew, fans began invading the field.
The cancer cells may invade other parts of the body.
definitions.definition_vi: vào một nơi với số lượng lớn, đặc biệt là theo cách gây ra thiệt hại hoặc vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to affect something in an unpleasant or annoying way
examples: Do the press have the right to invade her privacy in this way?
You feel tense with worrying thoughts constantly invading your sleep.
definitions.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến cái gì đó một cách khó chịu hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it
examples: the German invasion of Poland in 1939
the threat of invasion
an invasion force/fleet
definitions.definition_vi: hành động của một đội quân tiến vào một quốc gia khác bằng vũ lực để kiểm soát quốc gia đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the fact of a large number of people or things arriving somewhere, especially people or things that are unpleasant
examples: SEE ALSO pitch invasion
the annual tourist invasion

definitions.definition_vi: nơi hai hoặc nhiều đường bộ hoặc tuyến đường sắt gặp nhau

the junction between nerves and muscles
definitions.definition_vi: nơi hai hoặc nhiều dây cáp, sông hoặc những thứ khác gặp nhau hoặc nối với nhau

This essay is just not good enough.

Just because you're older than me doesn't mean you know everything.
It just kind of happened.
If she doesn't like, that's just too bad.

definitions.definition_vi: đơn giản

definitions.definition_vi: bằng một lượng nhỏ

She has just been telling us about her trip to Rome.
I just saw him a moment ago.
She was just here.
Just last week it was snowing and now it's 25 degrees.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn/ai đó đã làm điều gì đó hoặc điều gì đó đã xảy ra rất gần đây

definitions.definition: at this/that moment; now
examples: I'm just finishing my book.
I was just beginning to enjoy myself when we had to leave.
I'm just off (= I am leaving now).
definitions.definition_vi: vào thời điểm này/thời điểm đó; Hiện nay

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: exactly
examples: This jacket is just my size.
With him, everything always has to to be just right.
This gadget is just the thing for getting those nails out.

You're just in time.

It's just what I wanted!
It's just as I thought.
It's just on six (= exactly six o'clock).
definitions.definition_vi: chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: at the same moment as
examples: The clock struck six just as I arrived.
definitions.definition_vi: cùng lúc với

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: no less than; equally
examples: She's just as smart as her sister.

definitions.definition: going to do something only a few moments from now or then
examples: The water's just about to boil.

definitions.definition_vi: sẽ làm điều gì đó chỉ trong chốc lát kể từ bây giờ hoặc sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10

examples: The food was just wonderful!

Relax—you're doing just fine.

definitions.definition_vi: Thực ra; hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used in orders to get somebody’s attention, give permission, etc.
examples: Just listen to what I'm saying, will you!
Just help yourselves.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó, cho phép, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to make a polite request, excuse, etc.
examples: Could you just help me with this box, please?
I've just got a few things to do first.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra lời yêu cầu, xin lỗi lịch sự, v.v...

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used to show a slight possibility that something is true or will happen
examples: Try asking Mike—he might just know the answer.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện một khả năng nhỏ rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 14

examples: ‘He's very pompous.’ ‘Isn't he just?’
definitions.definition_vi: từng đồng ý với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: because of the possibility of something happening
examples: You'd better take the keys in case I'm out.
You probably won't need to call—but take my number, just in case.
In case (= if it is true that) you’re wondering why Jo’s here—let me explain…
definitions.definition_vi: vì có khả năng xảy ra chuyện gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: it is a good thing
examples: It is just as well that we didn't leave any later or we'd have missed him.
definitions.definition_vi: đó là một điều tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: used to say that you would equally well like to do something as do something else that has been suggested
examples: I'd just as soon stay at home as go out tonight.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn cũng muốn làm điều gì đó cũng như làm điều gì đó khác đã được gợi ý

definitions.definition_vi: hầu hết; rất gần

definitions.label: Meaning 20

definitions.definition_vi: khoảng

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: suddenly, without warning or explanation
definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột, không có cảnh báo hay giải thích

definitions.label: Meaning 22

definitions.label: Meaning 23

examples: Come and see me later—I'm busy just now.
definitions.definition_vi: vào lúc này

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: during this present period
examples: Business is good just now.
definitions.definition_vi: trong giai đoạn hiện nay

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: only a short time ago
examples: I saw her just now.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ một thời gian ngắn trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 26

definitions.definition_vi: sau đó; trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn

definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện hoặc sắp xếp rất chính xác hoặc cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 28

definitions.definition_vi: vào lúc đó

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: not now but probably quite soon
examples: I can't give you the money just yet.
definitions.definition_vi: không phải bây giờ nhưng có lẽ sẽ sớm thôi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a piece of metal with a special shape used for locking a door, starting a car, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO Allen key™
to put/turn the key in the lock
He inserted the key in the lock and let himself into the house.
the car keys
a set/bunch of keys
the spare key to the front door
We'll have a duplicate key cut (= made).
Luckily Dad has keys for my house.
There's a special key for winding up this clock.
definitions.definition_vi: một miếng kim loại có hình dạng đặc biệt dùng để khóa cửa, khởi động ô tô, v.v.

definitions.definition: a thing that makes you able to understand or achieve something
examples: SYNONYM secret
Persistence is the key if you want to get a job.
The key to success is preparation.
First-time voters could hold the key to the election result.
The driver of the car probably holds the key to solving the crime.

definitions.definition: any of the buttons that you press to operate a computer, phone or typewriter
examples: SEE ALSO Alt key

You can use the arrow keys on the keyboard instead.
He began tapping on the keys of his laptop.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ nút nào bạn nhấn để vận hành máy tính, điện thoại hoặc máy đánh chữ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: any of the wooden or metal parts that you press to play a piano and some other musical instruments
examples: His hands flew over the piano keys.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ bộ phận bằng gỗ hoặc kim loại nào bạn nhấn để chơi piano và một số nhạc cụ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a set of related notes, based on a particular note. Pieces of music are usually written mainly using a particular key.
examples: COMPARE scale
a sonata in the key of E flat major
This piece changes key many times.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các ghi chú liên quan, dựa trên một ghi chú cụ thể. Các bản nhạc thường được viết chủ yếu bằng một phím cụ thể.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a set of answers to exercises or problems
examples: Check your answers in the key at the back of the book.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các câu trả lời cho bài tập hoặc vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: an explanation of the symbols used on a map or plan
examples: You can find the symbols in the key at the bottom of the page.
definitions.definition_vi: giải thích về các ký hiệu được sử dụng trên bản đồ hoặc kế hoạch

the legitimate government of the country
Is his business strictly legitimate?

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.label: Meaning 3

examples: His simple, elegant paintings reflect his principle that less is more.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ bao gồm những gì thiết yếu có thể tạo ra sản phẩm hoặc kết quả hiệu quả hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to suggest that something is surprising or impressive

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize a large amount
examples: The guide contains details of no less than 115 hiking routes.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một lượng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a period of time in which somebody is taught something
examples: COMPARE class
She gives piano lessons.
I’m having driving lessons.

Beethoven's lessons with Haydn continued until 1794.
His parents paid for lessons from local dance teachers.
Lessons for beginners can be arranged.
Our first lesson on Tuesdays is French.
What did we do last lesson?
definitions.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian trong đó ai đó được dạy điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition: an experience, especially an unpleasant one, that somebody can learn from so that it does not happen again in the future

Their openness was a terrific lesson to me.
The film offers an important lesson on the value of friendship.
That's one of the lessons about being in a relationship that I hope not to forget.
He said that the election results were a lesson in humility for the party.

The lesson for the leaders of Western governments is clear.
definitions.definition_vi: một trải nghiệm, đặc biệt là một trải nghiệm khó chịu, mà ai đó có thể rút kinh nghiệm để nó không xảy ra lần nữa trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition: causing or able to cause death

The river has fallen to its lowest level since 2012.

The tables are not on a level (= the same height).

definitions.definition: the amount of something that exists in a particular situation at a particular time

definitions.definition: a particular standard or quality

He studied French to degree level.

Both players are on a level (= of the same standard).

definitions.definition_vi: một tiêu chuẩn hoặc chất lượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a position or rank in a scale of size or importance

the upper levels of government

definitions.definition_vi: thông tin trực tuyến hoặc trên báo hoặc tạp chí về những bộ phim, vở kịch, v.v. đang được chiếu ở một thị trấn hoặc thành phố cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a position or an item on a list
examples: The company is seeking a stock exchange listing (= for trading shares).
definitions.definition_vi: một vị trí hoặc một mục trong danh sách

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the ability to read and write
examples: OPPOSITE illiteracy
a campaign to promote adult literacy
basic literacy skills
Most of the students here need help with literacy and numeracy.
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng đọc và viết

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: knowledge or skills in a specific area
examples: SEE ALSO computer literacy
financial/health literacy
We’re looking to hire an assistant with a high level of digital literacy.
definitions.definition_vi: kiến thức hoặc kỹ năng trong một lĩnh vực cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not big; small; smaller than others
examples: a little house
a little group of tourists
a little old lady
We passed through several nice little towns.
It was a tiny little room.
‘Which do you want?’ ‘I'll take the little one.’
She gave a little laugh.
We should manage, with a little bit of luck.
Here's a little something (= a small present) for your birthday.
definitions.definition_vi: không lớn; bé nhỏ; nhỏ hơn những người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: young
examples: a little boy/girl
He's just a little kid.
my little brother/sister (= younger brother/sister)
The little ones were already in bed.
cute little baby animals
I lived in America when I was little.
He's still very little and doesn't understand yet.
definitions.definition_vi: trẻ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: short
examples: A little while later the phone rang.
Shall we walk a little way?
definitions.definition_vi: ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used after an adjective to show approval, sympathy or dislike, especially in a patronizing way (= one that suggests that you think you are better than somebody)
examples: The poor little thing! It's lost its mother.
What a nasty little man!
She's a good little worker.
He'd become quite the little gentleman.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một tính từ để thể hiện sự tán thành, thông cảm hoặc không thích, đặc biệt là theo cách trịch thượng (= một từ gợi ý rằng bạn nghĩ bạn tốt hơn ai đó)

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not important; not serious
examples: I can't remember every little detail.
Sometimes it's the little things that count.
You soon get used to the little difficulties.
definitions.definition_vi: không quan trọng; không nghiêm trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó lớn lao và thành công thường bắt đầu từ việc rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody told you something but you do not want to say who it was
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó đã nói với bạn điều gì đó nhưng bạn không muốn nói đó là ai

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: it is not surprising
examples: It is little wonder (that) she was so upset.
No wonder you're tired—you've been walking for hours.
No wonder you're still single—you never go out!
definitions.definition_vi: điều đó không có gì đáng ngạc nhiên
