definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile
examples: liver disease
He had a liver transplant at the age of 12.
a nationwide appeal for a donor liver
definitions.definition_vi: một cơ quan lớn trong cơ thể làm sạch máu và sản xuất mật

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the liver of some animals that is cooked and eaten
examples: liver and onions
chicken livers
definitions.definition_vi: gan của một số động vật được nấu chín và ăn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: alive now
examples: all living things
living organisms
the finest living pianist
The elephant is the biggest living land animal.
definitions.definition_vi: còn sống bây giờ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used for living rather than working in
examples: The workers' living quarters were cramped and uncomfortable.
a separate living space/area
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để sinh sống hơn là làm việc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used or practised now
examples: living languages (= those still spoken)
a living faith
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng hoặc thực hành bây giờ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to hit somebody very hard several times and hurt them very much
examples: Get out or I’ll beat the living daylights out of you!
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai đó rất mạnh nhiều lần và làm họ tổn thương rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to show by your actions or qualities that a particular fact is true
examples: These figures are living proof of the government's incompetence.
He is living proof that age is no barrier to new challenges.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị bằng hành động hoặc phẩm chất của bạn rằng một thực tế cụ thể là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to frighten somebody very much
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ hãi rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: at a time, or during the time, that is remembered by people still alive
examples: the coldest winter in living memory
definitions.definition_vi: tại một thời điểm, hoặc trong thời gian, được những người còn sống nhớ đến

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: something that is being carried (usually in large amounts) by a person, vehicle, etc.
examples: The trucks waited at the warehouse to pick up their loads.
The women came down the hill with their loads of firewood.
These backpacks are designed to carry a heavy load.
A lorry shed its load (= accidentally dropped its load) on the motorway.
The company's debt load could drag it into bankruptcy.
definitions.definition_vi: thứ gì đó đang được người, phương tiện, v.v. mang theo (thường với số lượng lớn).

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the total amount of something that something can carry or contain
examples: a busload of tourists
They ordered three truckloads of sand.
He put half a load of washing in the machine.
The plane took off with a full load.
Maximum load, including passengers, is 800 pounds.
definitions.definition_vi: tổng số lượng của một cái gì đó mà một cái gì đó có thể mang hoặc chứa

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the amount of weight that is pressing down on something
examples: a load-bearing wall
Modern backpacks spread the load over a wider area.
The table creaked under its heavy load.
definitions.definition_vi: khối lượng trọng lượng đang đè xuống một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a large number or amount of people or things; plenty
examples: She's got loads of friends.
He wrote loads and loads of letters to people.
Uncle Jim brought a whole load of presents for the kids.
We saw a load of houses before we bought this one.
They all had loads of fun at the park.
In my job I get the chance to meet loads of different people.
There's loads to do today.
definitions.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn hoặc số lượng người hoặc vật; nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that something is wrong, stupid, bad, etc.
examples: You're talking a load of rubbish.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng có điều gì đó không ổn, ngu ngốc, xấu, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: an amount of work that a person or machine has to do
examples: SEE ALSO caseload
Teaching loads have increased in all types of school.
Extra warmth from sunlight can put an additional load on the air-conditioning system.
We're trying to spread the load by employing more staff.
definitions.definition_vi: khối lượng công việc mà con người hoặc máy móc phải làm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a feeling of responsibility or worry that is difficult to deal with
examples: SYNONYM burden
She thought she would not be able to bear the load of bringing up her family alone.
Knowing that they had arrived safely took a load off my mind.
Many companies are burdened by high debt loads.
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác trách nhiệm hoặc lo lắng khó giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the amount of electrical power that is being supplied at a particular time
definitions.definition_vi: lượng điện năng được cung cấp tại một thời điểm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to look at or listen to somebody/something
examples: Get a load of that dress!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó hãy nhìn hoặc lắng nghe ai/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live
examples: local people/residents/businesses
members of the local community
the local police
local elections
A local man was accused of the murder.
Our children go to the local school.
a local newspaper (= one that gives local news)
decisions made at the local level
It was difficult to understand the local dialect.
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc kết nối với địa điểm hoặc khu vực cụ thể mà bạn đang nói đến hoặc với nơi bạn sống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: affecting only one part of the body
examples: Her tooth was extracted under local anaesthetic.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ ảnh hưởng đến một phần cơ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having been the particular thing mentioned for a long time
examples: his long-time colleague
definitions.definition_vi: đã là điều cụ thể được đề cập trong một thời gian dài

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to appear as a large shape that is not clear, especially in a frightening way
examples: A dark shape loomed up ahead of us.
definitions.definition_vi: xuất hiện dưới dạng một hình dạng lớn không rõ ràng, đặc biệt là một cách đáng sợ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to appear serious and and likely to happen soon
examples: There was a crisis looming.
definitions.definition_vi: có vẻ nghiêm trọng và có khả năng xảy ra sớm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be frightening and make you worried because something seems hard to avoid
examples: The prospect of war loomed large.
The issue looms large in political campaigns nationwide.
definitions.definition_vi: đáng sợ và khiến bạn lo lắng vì điều gì đó dường như khó tránh khỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be unable to find something/somebody
examples: SYNONYM mislay
I've lost my keys.
The tickets seem to have got lost.
She lost her husband in the crowd.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể tìm thấy cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to have something/somebody taken away from you, especially as a result of an accident, dying, etc.
examples: She lost a leg in a car crash.
Some families lost everything (= all they owned) in the flood.
She lost her baby (= had a miscarriage) three months into the pregnancy.
They lost both their sons (= they were killed) in the war.
The ship was lost at sea (= it sank).
Many people lost their lives (= were killed).
definitions.definition_vi: bị ai đó/cái gì đó lấy đi khỏi bạn, đặc biệt là do tai nạn, cái chết, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to have to give up something; to fail to keep something/somebody
examples: He's lost his job.
You will lose your deposit if you cancel the order.
Sit down or you'll lose your seat.
The government has lost control of the city.
We cannot afford to lose any more senior members of staff.
The average business loses 20 per cent of its customers every year.
You risk losing your house if you do not keep up the payments.
The company has lost a lot of business to its competitors.
definitions.definition_vi: phải từ bỏ điều gì đó; không giữ được cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to no longer have something, or have less of something than you had before, especially as a result of getting older
examples: to lose your hair/teeth
to lose your sight/eyesight/hearing/memory
There's new hope for people trying to lose weight.
I've lost ten pounds since I started this diet.
definitions.definition_vi: không còn có thứ gì đó hoặc có ít thứ hơn bạn có trước đây, đặc biệt là do già đi

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to have less and less of a quality or ability, especially until you no longer have any of it
examples: She seemed to have lost interest in food.
to lose faith/confidence
He lost his nerve at the last minute.
At that moment he lost his balance and fell.
The train was losing speed.
He never lost the ability to make people laugh.
definitions.definition_vi: ngày càng có ít phẩm chất hoặc khả năng, đặc biệt là cho đến khi bạn không còn có nó nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to be defeated; to fail to win a competition, a court case, an argument, etc.; to cause somebody to be defeated
examples: So far they haven't lost a game.
to lose a race/an election/a battle/a war
We lost to a stronger team.
He lost by less than 100 votes.
We lost the game by three points.
They lost on penalties to (= because they scored fewer penalties than) Spain.
Many believe the incident lost them the election.
definitions.definition_vi: bị đánh bại; không thắng được trong một cuộc thi, một vụ án, một cuộc tranh luận, v.v.; làm cho ai đó bị đánh bại

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to fail to keep something you want or need, especially money; to cause somebody to fail to keep something
examples: The business is losing money.
Poetry always loses something in translation.
You have nothing to lose by telling the truth.
What do we lose by working with them?
We lost on that deal.
The company stands to lose financially if this deal falls through.
His carelessness lost him the job.
definitions.definition_vi: không giữ được thứ bạn muốn hoặc cần, đặc biệt là tiền; làm cho ai đó không giữ được cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to fail to get, hear or understand something
examples: His words were lost (= could not be heard) in the applause.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể có được, nghe hoặc hiểu được điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be no longer understood by somebody
examples: I'm afraid you've lost me there.
definitions.definition_vi: không còn được ai đó hiểu nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to escape from somebody/something
examples: SYNONYM evade
We managed to lose our pursuers in the darkness.
definitions.definition_vi: thoát khỏi ai/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to waste time or an opportunity
examples: We lost twenty minutes changing a tyre.
Hurry—there's no time to lose!
He lost no time in setting out for London.
definitions.definition_vi: lãng phí thời gian hoặc một cơ hội

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: if a watch or clock loses or loses time, it goes too slowly or becomes a particular amount of time behind the correct time
examples: OPPOSITE gain
This clock loses two minutes a day.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một chiếc đồng hồ bị mất hoặc mất thời gian thì nó chạy quá chậm hoặc trở thành một khoảng thời gian cụ thể chậm hơn thời gian chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be unable to stop yourself from crying, laughing, etc.; to become crazy
examples: Then she just lost it and started screaming.
definitions.definition_vi: không thể ngăn mình khóc, cười, v.v.; trở nên điên rồ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: making a lot of noise
examples: loud laughter
a deafeningly loud bang
She spoke in a very loud voice.
That music's too loud—please turn it down.
I heard a loud noise that sounded like a cannon.
I was woken by a loud bang at 5.30 am.
Suddenly the footsteps grew louder.
I play loud music and dance around my house.
Eventually, the shouting got louder.
The noise was faint, but just loud enough to follow.
definitions.definition_vi: gây ra nhiều tiếng ồn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: strongly expressed
examples: There were loud protests from the food and drink industry.
definitions.definition_vi: bày tỏ mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: talking very loudly, too much and in a way that is annoying
definitions.definition_vi: nói rất to, quá nhiều và theo cách gây khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: too bright and not showing good taste
examples: SYNONYM gaudy
He wore a loud checked jacket and a green tie.
definitions.definition_vi: quá sáng và không thể hiện được hương vị tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise
examples: She screamed as loudly as she could.
About two hours into the flight, he began complaining loudly that his seat was too small.
She was loudly proclaiming her innocence.
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách gây ra nhiều tiếng ồn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a very strong feeling of liking and caring for somebody/something, especially a member of your family or a friend
examples: SEE ALSO self-love
She has earned the love and respect of many people.
a mother’s unconditional love for her children
love of your country
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác rất thích và quan tâm đến ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một thành viên trong gia đình hoặc một người bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a strong feeling of romantic attraction for somebody
examples: SEE ALSO courtly love
I'm sure you will find true love.
We're in love!
They're madly in love.
She has been in and out of love many times.
She was in love with him.
They fell in love with each other.
There wasn't anyone else in his life; he simply fell out of love with her.
They finally expressed their love for each other.
It was love at first sight (= they were attracted to each other the first time they met).
It is a story of unrequited love (= love that is not returned).
romantic/undying/passionate love
a love song/story
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác hấp dẫn lãng mạn mạnh mẽ đối với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the strong feeling of pleasure that something gives you
examples: They shared a love of learning.
her love for her garden
He's in love with his work.
I fell in love with the house.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác vui sướng mạnh mẽ mà thứ gì đó mang lại cho bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person, a thing or an activity that you like very much
examples: Take care, my love.
He was the love of my life (= the person I loved most).
I like most sports but tennis is my first love.
definitions.definition_vi: một người, một vật hoặc một hoạt động mà bạn rất thích

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a word used as a friendly way of addressing somebody
examples: COMPARE duck
Can I help you, love?
definitions.definition_vi: một từ được sử dụng như một cách thân thiện để xưng hô với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a score of zero (points or games)
examples: 40–love!
She won the first set six-love/six games to love.
definitions.definition_vi: số điểm bằng 0 (điểm hoặc trò chơi)

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: in some situations any type of behaviour is acceptable to get what you want
definitions.definition_vi: trong một số trường hợp, bất kỳ loại hành vi nào cũng được chấp nhận để đạt được điều bạn muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: love that somebody, especially a child, shows towards somebody else in order to get something
definitions.definition_vi: tình yêu mà ai đó, đặc biệt là một đứa trẻ, thể hiện với người khác để có được thứ gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: without receiving payment or any other reward
examples: They're all volunteers, working for the love of it.
definitions.definition_vi: mà không nhận được thanh toán hoặc bất kỳ phần thưởng nào khác

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used when you are expressing anger and the fact that you are impatient
examples: For the love of God, tell me what he said!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang thể hiện sự tức giận và thực tế là bạn thiếu kiên nhẫn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to send good wishes to somebody
examples: Give my love to Mary when you see her.
Bob sends his love.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp tới ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: loving somebody very much
examples: He's fallen head over heels in love with his boss.
definitions.definition_vi: yêu ai đó rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: a hard task that you do because you want to, not because it is necessary

examples: She adapted to life on the estate as if to the manner born.
definitions.definition_vi: như thể điều gì đó là tự nhiên đối với bạn và bạn đã làm điều đó nhiều lần trong quá khứ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: what kind of…
examples: What manner of man could do such a terrible thing?
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì…

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
examples: NOTE AT much
We don't have very many copies left.
You can't have one each. We haven't got many.
Many people feel that the law should be changed.
Many of those present disagreed.
How many children do you have?
There are too many mistakes in this essay.
He made ten mistakes in as many (= in ten) lines.
New drivers have twice as many accidents as experienced drivers.
Don't take so many.
I've known her for a great many (= very many) years.
Even if one person is hurt that is one too many.
It was one of my many mistakes.
a many-headed monster
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ và động từ số nhiều, đặc biệt là trong câu phủ định hoặc trong tiếng Anh trang trọng hơn, có nghĩa là 'một số lượng lớn'. Cũng được sử dụng trong các câu hỏi để hỏi về kích thước của một số và với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used with a plural verb to mean ‘most people’
examples: a government which improves conditions for the many
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với động từ số nhiều có nghĩa là ‘hầu hết mọi người’

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used with a singular noun and verb to mean ‘a large number of’
examples: Many a good man has been destroyed by drink.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ và động từ số ít có nghĩa là 'một số lượng lớn'

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to show surprise that the number of people or things involved is so large
examples: There were as many as 200 people at the lecture.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên khi số lượng người hoặc đồ vật liên quan lại quá lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to be slightly drunk
definitions.definition_vi: hơi say

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show that something happens often
examples: Many's the time I heard her use those words.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng một cái gì đó xảy ra thường xuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an object or a sign that shows the position of something
examples: SEE ALSO discourse marker
a boundary marker
He placed a marker where the ball had landed.
definitions.definition_vi: một vật thể hoặc một dấu hiệu cho thấy vị trí của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sign that something exists or that shows what it is like
examples: Price is not always an accurate marker of quality.
definitions.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu cho thấy một cái gì đó tồn tại hoặc cho thấy nó như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a pen with a thick felt tip
examples: SEE ALSO Magic Marker™
definitions.definition_vi: một cây bút có đầu nỉ dày

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person who marks students’ work or exam papers
definitions.definition_vi: người chấm bài hoặc bài thi của học sinh

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a player who stays close to a player on the other team in order to stop them getting the ball
definitions.definition_vi: một cầu thủ ở gần một cầu thủ của đội kia để ngăn họ lấy bóng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to do something that sets a standard for your competitors or shows what you intend to do or achieve in the future
examples: The reigning champions laid down a marker with a 36–0 defeat of their opponents.
The prime minister has put down a marker for a Washington visit in May.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó đặt ra tiêu chuẩn cho đối thủ cạnh tranh của bạn hoặc thể hiện những gì bạn dự định làm hoặc đạt được trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the activity of presenting, advertising and selling a company’s products or services in the best possible way
examples: SEE ALSO direct marketing
a marketing campaign/strategy
a marketing manager/director/department
digital/internet/online marketing
Direct marketing already provides a number of ways to target specific individuals.
They hope to creat a buzz through viral marketing.
She works in sales and marketing.
The marketing of produce by village women has brought economic benefits.
This law regulates the sale and marketing of food on a statewide basis.
Clients hired us to handle their online marketing.
Persuasion is one of the most valuable skills in marketing.
A printed newsletter is still an excellent marketing tool.
We have a different marketing plan for each of our channels.
The latest campaign is a joint marketing effort by dairy processors.
a clever marketing ploy
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động trình bày, quảng cáo và bán sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ của công ty theo cách tốt nhất có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the killing of a large number of people especially in a cruel way
examples: the bloody massacre of innocent civilians
Nobody survived the massacre.
definitions.definition_vi: việc giết hại một số lượng lớn người đặc biệt là một cách tàn nhẫn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a very big defeat in a game or competition
examples: The game was a 10–0 massacre for our team.
definitions.definition_vi: một thất bại rất lớn trong một trò chơi hoặc cuộc thi

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a man who has people working for him, often as servants in his home
examples: They lived in fear of their master.
the exploitation of slaves by their former masters
definitions.definition_vi: người đàn ông có người làm việc cho mình, thường là người hầu trong nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person who is in charge of an organization or group
examples: SEE ALSO harbour master
His political masters are all old right-wing politicians.
Many nations were trying to shake off their colonial masters.
definitions.definition_vi: một người phụ trách một tổ chức hoặc một nhóm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person who is able to control something
examples: SEE ALSO puppet master
She was no longer master of her own future.
definitions.definition_vi: một người có thể kiểm soát một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person who shows a lot of skill at something
examples: SEE ALSO grandmaster
a master of disguise
a master of her craft
a master of the serve-and-volley game
a master at managing money
definitions.definition_vi: một người thể hiện rất nhiều kỹ năng ở một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a famous painter who lived in the past
examples: SEE ALSO old master
an exhibition of work by the French master, Monet
the great masters of Impressionism
This portrait is the work of an acknowledged master.
definitions.definition_vi: một họa sĩ nổi tiếng sống trong quá khứ

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a second university degree, or, in Scotland, a first university degree, such as an MA
examples: SEE ALSO MA
He has a Master's in Business Administration.
She holds a master's degree in journalism.
definitions.definition_vi: bằng đại học thứ hai, hoặc ở Scotland, bằng đại học thứ nhất, chẳng hạn như bằng thạc sĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a person who has a master’s degree
examples: a Master of Arts/Science
definitions.definition_vi: một người có bằng thạc sĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the owner of an animal, especially a dog or horse
examples: COMPARE mistress
The dog saved its master's life.
Even the animals knew their masters were excited.
The horses watched their masters placidly.
definitions.definition_vi: chủ sở hữu của một con vật, đặc biệt là một con chó hoặc ngựa

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a male teacher at a school, especially a private school
examples: COMPARE headmaster
the physics master
He was ballet master at several dance schools.
definitions.definition_vi: một giáo viên nam tại một trường học, đặc biệt là một trường tư

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the captain of a ship that transports goods
definitions.definition_vi: thuyền trưởng của một con tàu vận chuyển hàng hóa

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: a version of a recording from which copies are made
examples: the master copy
definitions.definition_vi: một phiên bản của bản ghi mà từ đó các bản sao được tạo ra

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: a title used when speaking to or about a boy who is too young to be called Mr (also used in front of the name on an envelope, etc.)
definitions.definition_vi: một danh hiệu được sử dụng khi nói chuyện với hoặc về một cậu bé còn quá nhỏ để được gọi là Mr (cũng được sử dụng trước tên trên phong bì, v.v.)

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: (in the UK) the title of the head of some schools and university colleges
examples: the Master of Wolfson College
definitions.definition_vi: (ở Anh) chức danh người đứng đầu một số trường học và cao đẳng đại học

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: a title used for speaking to or about some religious teachers or leaders
definitions.definition_vi: một danh hiệu được sử dụng để nói chuyện với hoặc về một số giáo viên hoặc nhà lãnh đạo tôn giáo

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to be free to make your own decisions rather than being told what to do by somebody else
definitions.definition_vi: được tự do đưa ra quyết định của riêng mình thay vì bị người khác bảo phải làm gì

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to support two different parties, principles, etc. at the same timeWord Origin
examples: Old English mæg(i)ster (later reinforced by Old French maistre), from Latin magister; probably related to magis ‘more’.
definitions.definition_vi: để hỗ trợ hai đảng, nguyên tắc, v.v. khác nhau cùng một lúc. Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used (to ask) if somebody is upset, unhappy, etc. or if there is a problem
examples: What's the matter? Is there something wrong?
Is anything the matter?
Is something the matter with Bob? He seems very down.
There's something the matter with my eyes.
‘We've bought a new TV.’ ‘What was the matter with the old one?’
What's the matter with you today (= why are you behaving like this)?
What on earth was the matter with her, she wondered. She’d come here to enjoy herself and here she was, stuck on her own in the hotel.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng (để hỏi) nếu ai đó buồn bã, không vui, v.v. hoặc nếu có vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a subject or situation that you must consider or deal with
examples: SYNONYM affair
It's a private matter.
They had important matters to discuss.
She may need your help with some business matters.
financial/legal/political matters
They've agreed in theory, but now we need to discuss practical matters.
The matter should be referred to a senior manager.
Do I have any choice in the matter?
I always consulted him on matters of policy.
It's a matter for the police (= for them to deal with).
It was a matter of some concern to most of those present (= something they were worried about).
It should have been a simple matter to check.
It was no easy matter getting him to change his mind.
Let's get on with the matter in hand (= what we need to deal with now).
I wasn't prepared to let the matter drop (= stop discussing it).
We have sent these concerns to Professor Tribe, and now consider the matter closed (= it is finished).
I did not feel that we had got to the heart of the matter (= the most important part).
And that is the crux of the matter (= the most important thing about the situation).
And then there's the little matter of the fifty pounds you owe me.
definitions.definition_vi: một chủ đề hoặc tình huống mà bạn phải xem xét hoặc giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the present situation, or the situation that you are talking about
examples: SYNONYM things
Unfortunately, there is nothing we can do to improve matters.
I'd forgotten the keys, which didn't help matters.
And then, to make matters worse, his parents turned up.
I decided to take matters into my own hands (= deal with the situation myself).
Matters came to a head (= the situation became very difficult) with his resignation.
definitions.definition_vi: tình hình hiện tại, hoặc tình hình mà bạn đang nói đến

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a situation that involves something or depends on something
examples: SYNONYM question
Learning to drive is all a matter of coordination.
Some people prefer the older version to the new one. It's a matter of taste.
She resigned over a matter of principle.
The government must deal with this as a matter of urgency.
Just as a matter of interest (= because it is interesting, not because it is important), how much did you pay for it?
‘I think this is the best so far.’ ‘Well, that's a matter of opinion (= other people may think differently).
It's not pure fantasy ! It's a plain matter of fact.
Getting the effect you want is a matter of trial and error.
That's not a problem. It's simply a matter of letting people know in time.
Planning a project is just a matter of working out the right order to do things in.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống liên quan đến một cái gì đó hoặc phụ thuộc vào một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: physical substance that everything in the world is made of; not mind or spirit
examples: SEE ALSO dark matter
to study the properties of matter
This swirling mass of energy and matter is classed as a spiral galaxy.
definitions.definition_vi: chất vật chất làm nên mọi thứ trên thế giới; không phải tâm trí hay tinh thần

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a substance or things of a particular sort
examples: SEE ALSO grey matter
Add plenty of organic matter to improve the soil.
elimination of waste matter from the body
She didn't approve of their choice of reading matter.
There were small lumps of matter floating on the surface.
definitions.definition_vi: một chất hoặc những thứ thuộc một loại cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to add a comment on something that you have just said, usually adding something that you think the other person will be interested in
examples: It's a nice place. We've stayed there ourselves, as a matter of fact.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bình luận về điều gì đó bạn vừa nói, thường là thêm điều gì đó mà bạn nghĩ người khác sẽ quan tâm

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to disagree with something that somebody has just said
examples: SYNONYM actually
‘I suppose you'll be leaving soon, then?’ ‘No, as a matter of fact I'll be staying for another two years.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để không đồng ý với điều gì đó mà ai đó vừa nói

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be very different
examples: I know which area they live in, but whether I can find their house is a different matter.
That's a whole different matter.
I don't mind lizards, but snakes are a different matter.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên rất khác biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be something serious that you should not joke about
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một điều gì đó nghiêm trọng mà bạn không nên đùa giỡn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to emphasize a statement, especially one that is the opposite of what has just been mentioned
examples: A new car would be wonderful but the fact of the matter is that we can't afford one.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một tuyên bố, đặc biệt là một tuyên bố trái ngược với những gì vừa được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to add a comment on something that you have just said
examples: I didn't like it much. Nor did the kids, for that matter.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thêm nhận xét về điều bạn vừa nói

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used to say that something will definitely happen, although you are not sure when
examples: It's only a matter of time before they bring out their own version of the software.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, mặc dù bạn không chắc chắn khi nào

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: (as) the usual and correct thing to do
examples: We always check people's addresses as a matter of course.
definitions.definition_vi: (như) điều thông thường và đúng đắn để làm

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: only a few hours, minutes, etc.
examples: It was all over in a matter of minutes.
The bullet missed her by a matter of inches.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ vài giờ, vài phút, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: used to describe a situation that is very important or serious
examples: You mustn't let anyone know— it's a matter of life and death.
These talks are a matter of life or death for the factory.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một tình huống đó là rất quan trọng hoặc nghiêm trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: something that has been recorded as being true
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó đã được ghi nhận là sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: used to say that something is not important
examples: If that doesn't work out, no matter, I'll rent for another year or two.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: used to say that something is always true, whatever the situation is, or that somebody should certainly do something
examples: They don't last long no matter how careful you are.
Call me when you get there, no matter what the time is.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó luôn đúng, bất kể tình huống thế nào, hoặc ai đó chắc chắn nên làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to say that something is possible
examples: That may or may not be true.
He may have (= perhaps he has) missed his train.
They may well win.
There is a range of programs on the market which may be described as design aids.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to ask for or give permission
examples: May I come in?
You may come in if you wish.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để xin hoặc cho phép

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used when admitting that something is true before introducing another point, argument, etc.
examples: He may be a good father but he's a terrible husband.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng trước khi đưa ra quan điểm, lập luận khác, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used as a polite way of making a comment, asking a question, etc.
examples: You look lovely, if I may say so.
May I ask why you took that decision?
If I may just add one thing…
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một cách lịch sự để đưa ra nhận xét, đặt câu hỏi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to express wishes and hopes
examples: May she rest in peace.
Business has been thriving in the past year. Long may it continue to do so.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ mong muốn và hy vọng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to say what the purpose of something is
examples: There is a need for more resources so that all children may have a decent education.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói mục đích của cái gì đó là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: despite that
examples: SYNONYM nevertheless
I know that he has tried hard; be that as it may, his work is just not good enough.
definitions.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to say that something seems the best thing to do in the situation that you are in, although you may not really want to do it
examples: If no one else wants it, we might as well give it to him.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó dường như là điều tốt nhất nên làm trong tình huống hiện tại của bạn, mặc dù bạn có thể không thực sự muốn làm điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say that there is no real difference between two things that you might do
examples: If you are going to have sugar, you may as well have a bar of chocolate.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không có sự khác biệt thực sự giữa hai việc bạn có thể làm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used when you are not certain that something will happen or that something is true or is a correct number
examples: SYNONYM perhaps
Maybe he'll come, maybe he won't.
‘Are you going to sell your house?’ ‘Maybe.’
Is she right? Maybe, maybe not.
Maybe it will do me some good to go for a run.
It will cost two, maybe three hundred pounds.
We go there maybe once or twice a month.
There are two sides to every story, maybe even more in this case.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn không chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra hoặc điều gì đó là đúng hoặc là một con số chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used when making a suggestion
examples: SYNONYM perhaps
I thought maybe we could go together.
Maybe you should tell her.
Maybe we can meet for lunch next week sometime.
Maybe readers should be warned.
I've just got a new laptop, so maybe you can use my old one.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng khi đưa ra lời đề nghị

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used when replying to a question or an idea, especially when you are not sure whether to agree or disagree
examples: SYNONYM perhaps
‘I think he should resign.’ ‘Maybe.’
‘Am I nervous? Well, maybe just a little.’
‘You should stop work when you have the baby.’ ‘Maybe, but I can't afford to.’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi trả lời một câu hỏi hoặc một ý tưởng, đặc biệt là khi bạn không chắc chắn nên đồng ý hay không đồng ý

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to have something as a meaning in the same or another language
examples: What does this sentence mean?
What does ‘lark’ mean?
The word ‘Kuching’ means ‘cat’ in Malay.
Many languages use a single word to mean both music and dance.
What is meant by ‘batch processing’?
definitions.definition_vi: có ý nghĩa gì đó trong cùng một ngôn ngữ hoặc ngôn ngữ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to have something as a meaning; to represent something
examples: What do we mean by democracy?
Does the name ‘Jos Vos’ mean anything to you (= do you know who he is)?
The flashing light means (that) you must stop.
The Olympics have come to mean a wide variety of things.
definitions.definition_vi: để có một cái gì đó như một ý nghĩa; đại diện cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to intend to say something on a particular occasion
examples: What did he mean by that remark?
‘Perhaps we should try another approach.’ ‘What do you mean? (= I don't understand what you are suggesting.)’
‘What's that supposed to mean?’ demanded John.
What do you mean, you thought I wouldn't mind? (= of course I mind and I am very angry)

definitions.label: Meaning 4

a mixed woodland of ash, oak and birch
The students in the class are of mixed ability (= different levels of ability).
definitions.definition_vi: bao gồm nhiều loại khác nhau của cùng một thứ

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.definition_vi: của hoặc cho cả nam và nữ

definitions.label: Meaning 1

mobile networks/operators (= companies that provide mobile phone services)

mobile technology/broadband

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: that is not fixed in one place and can be moved easily and quickly
examples: COMPARE stationary

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: changing shape or expression easily and often
examples: His mobile features registered amusement.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hình dạng hoặc biểu hiện một cách dễ dàng và thường xuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the ability to move easily from one place, social class or job to another
examples: SEE ALSO upward mobility
social/geographical/career mobility

definitions.definition_vi: khả năng di chuyển dễ dàng từ nơi này, tầng lớp xã hội hoặc công việc đến nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the ability to move or travel around easily
examples: An electric wheelchair has given her greater mobility.
mobility training for the blind
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng di chuyển hoặc đi lại dễ dàng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a copy of something, usually smaller than the original object
examples: a working model (= one in which the parts move) of a fire engine
I used to build model aeroplanes.
The architect had produced a scale model of the proposed shopping complex.
definitions.definition_vi: một bản sao của một cái gì đó, thường nhỏ hơn đối tượng ban đầu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something such as a text or a system that can be used as an example for other people to copy
examples: Look at the writing model on page 58.
a model text/essay
The nation's constitution provided a model that other countries followed.
Different funding models are used in schools.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó chẳng hạn như một văn bản hoặc một hệ thống có thể được dùng làm ví dụ để người khác sao chép

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is considered an excellent example of something
examples: SEE ALSO role model
It was a model of clarity.
He's a model student.
a model farm (= one that has been specially designed to work well)
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật được coi là một ví dụ tuyệt vời về một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and be photographed wearing them
examples: SEE ALSO glamour model
She had a successful career as a fashion model.
He was a former male model who became a movie star.
definitions.definition_vi: một người có công việc là mặc và giới thiệu những kiểu quần áo mới và được chụp ảnh khi mặc chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a person who is employed to be painted, drawn, photographed, etc. by an artist or photographer
examples: The model sits for me for three hours every day.
definitions.definition_vi: người được một họa sĩ hoặc nhiếp ảnh gia thuê để vẽ, vẽ, chụp ảnh, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a particular design or type of product
examples: The latest models will be on display at the motor show.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết kế hoặc loại sản phẩm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a way of running a business, based on a particular way of getting the money you need and identifying and reaching your customers; a type of business model
examples: They may abandon the traditional cooperative model.
Under a subscription model, consumers will typically pay a monthly fee to access the online library.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách điều hành doanh nghiệp, dựa trên một cách cụ thể để nhận được số tiền bạn cần cũng như xác định và tiếp cận khách hàng của bạn; một loại mô hình kinh doanh

to propose/construct/test a model

a mathematical model for determining the safe level of pesticides in food

definitions.definition_vi: một mô tả đơn giản về một hệ thống, được sử dụng để giải thích cách thức hoạt động của một cái gì đó hoặc tính toán những gì có thể xảy ra, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: một vấn đề khó khăn hoặc trách nhiệm mà dường như không thể giải quyết hoặc loại bỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 14

definitions.definition_vi: một địa điểm hoặc khu vực cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 15

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật đó rất khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 16

examples: It's not a matter that I'm prepared to put my head on the block for.

definitions.label: Meaning 17

examples: I'm not going to risk my neck playing rugby with you!
definitions.definition_vi: có nguy cơ bị giết hoặc bị thương để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to rescue somebody from a very difficult situation
examples: He's out to save his own political neck.
definitions.definition_vi: giải cứu ai đó khỏi một tình huống rất khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to try to avoid death, punishment, etc., especially by leaving others in an extremely difficult situation
examples: To save his own skin, he lied and blamed the accident on his friend.
definitions.definition_vi: để cố gắng tránh cái chết, hình phạt, vv, đặc biệt là bằng cách để lại người khác trong một tình huống cực kỳ khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to do or say something when there is a risk that you may be wrong

definitions.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó khi có nguy cơ bạn có thể sai

definitions.label: Meaning 21

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: bad or harmful

The crisis had a negative effect on trade.
Government cuts will have a negative impact on public services.
The whole experience was definitely more positive than negative.
definitions.definition_vi: xấu hoặc có hại

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: containing a word such as ‘no’, ‘not’, ‘never’, etc.
examples: OPPOSITE affirmative (2)
a negative form/sentence

His response was negative.
They received a negative reply.

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.definition_vi: chứa hoặc tạo ra loại điện được mang bởi một điện tử

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: một người sống cạnh bạn hoặc gần bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a country that is next to or near another country

definitions.definition_vi: một quốc gia nằm cạnh hoặc gần một quốc gia khác

definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật đang đứng hoặc nằm cạnh người hoặc vật khác

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: We should all love our neighbours.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ con người nào khác

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: không hỗ trợ hoặc giúp đỡ một trong hai bên trong việc bất đồng, cạnh tranh, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not belonging to any of the countries that are involved in a war; not supporting any of the countries involved in a war
examples: neutral territory/waters

definitions.definition_vi: không bị ảnh hưởng bởi cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition: that you have naturally without having to learn it
examples: SYNONYM innate

definitions.definition_vi: mà bạn có một cách tự nhiên mà không cần phải học nó

definitions.definition: with a natural skill or interest in music
examples: OPPOSITE unmusical
She's very musical.
a highly musical nation
I grew up in a very musical family.
definitions.definition_vi: với một kỹ năng tự nhiên hoặc quan tâm đến âm nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: pleasant to listen to, like music
examples: a musical voice
The language often sounds musical.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ nghe, thích âm nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially as a job
examples: a jazz/rock/classical musician
She has been a professional musician for over 25 years.
The competition recognizes talented young musicians.
A group of local musicians entertained the guests.
The pipes were played by Irish musician, John Burney.
definitions.definition_vi: người chơi nhạc cụ hoặc viết nhạc, đặc biệt là trong công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to say that something is necessary or very important (sometimes involving a rule or a law)
examples: All visitors must report to reception.
Cars must not park in front of the entrance (= it is not allowed).
I must ask you not to do that again.
You mustn't say things like that.
I must go and get the kids from school.
I must admit (= I feel that I should admit) I was surprised it cost so little.
Must you always question everything I say? (= it is annoying)
‘Do we have to finish this today?’ ‘Yes, you must.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó là cần thiết hoặc rất quan trọng (đôi khi liên quan đến một quy tắc hoặc luật lệ)

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say that something is likely or logical
examples: You must be hungry after all that walking.
He must have known (= surely he knew) what she wanted.
I'm sorry, she's not here. She must have left already (= that must be the explanation).
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có thể xảy ra hoặc hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to recommend that somebody does something because you think it is a good idea
examples: You simply must read this book.
We must get together soon for lunch.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để khuyên ai đó làm điều gì đó vì bạn nghĩ đó là một ý tưởng hay

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody may do something but you do not really want them to
examples: ‘Can I smoke?’ ‘If you must.’
It's from my boyfriend, if you must know.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó có thể làm điều gì đó nhưng bạn không thực sự muốn họ làm điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to tell people that something is so good or interesting that they should see, read, get it, etc.
examples: Sydney is one of the world's must-see cities.
The magazine is a must-read in the show business world.
This is on my must-do list.
a must-have for any fan
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói với mọi người rằng điều gì đó rất hay hoặc thú vị mà họ nên xem, đọc, mua nó, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: in certain situations it is necessary for you to do something that you do not like or enjoyWord Origin
examples: Old English mōste, past tense of mōt ‘may’, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch moeten and German müssen.
definitions.definition_vi: trong một số trường hợp nhất định, bạn cần phải làm điều gì đó mà bạn không thích hoặc không thíchWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: của hoặc thuộc về người nói hoặc nhà văn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used in exclamations to express surprise, etc.
examples: My goodness! Look at the time.
Oh my! What are we going to do?
My my Megan, I do believe you 're jealous!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng trong câu cảm thán để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used when speaking to somebody, to show love
examples: my dear/darling/love
definitions.definition_vi: dùng khi nói chuyện với ai đó, để thể hiện tình yêu

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used when speaking to somebody that you consider to have a lower status than you
examples: My dear girl, you're wrong.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi nói chuyện với ai đó mà bạn cho là có địa vị thấp hơn bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used when the speaker or writer is also the person affected by an action
examples: I cut myself on a knife.
I wrote a message to myself.
I found myself unable to speak.
I haven't been feeling myself recently (= I have not felt well).
I needed space to be myself (= not influenced by other people).
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi người nói hoặc người viết cũng là người bị ảnh hưởng bởi một hành động

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to emphasize the fact that the speaker is doing something
examples: I'll speak to her myself.
I myself do not agree.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh việc người nói đang làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: alone; without anyone else
examples: I live by myself.
definitions.definition_vi: một mình; không có ai khác

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: without help
examples: I painted the room all by myself.
definitions.definition_vi: không có sự giúp đỡ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: for the speaker or writer alone to have or use; not shared
examples: I had a whole pizza to myself.
definitions.definition_vi: để người nói hoặc người viết có hoặc sử dụng; không được chia sẻ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with a particular nation; shared by a whole nation

national and international news
national and regional politics
decisions made at a local rather than national level
a national election
a coach for the national basketball team
The protection of public health is a matter of national security.
It is in the national interest to have a public enquiry.
The national average is just over two children per family.
They are afraid of losing their national identity.
These buildings are part of our national heritage.
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với một quốc gia cụ thể; được cả một dân tộc chia sẻ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: owned, controlled or paid for by the government
examples: a national airline/museum/theatre
the National Health Service
definitions.definition_vi: được chính phủ sở hữu, kiểm soát hoặc thanh toán

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: all the plants, animals and things that exist in the universe that are not made by people
examples: Take time to appreciate the beauties of nature.
man-made substances not found in nature
A lot of nature conservation is about protecting habitats.
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả thực vật, động vật và những thứ tồn tại trong vũ trụ không phải do con người tạo ra

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the way that things happen in the physical world when it is not controlled by people
examples: SEE ALSO Mother Nature
The forces of nature are constantly reshaping our world.
It is impossible to change the laws of nature.
Her illness was Nature's way of telling her to do less.
Is genius the result of nature or nurture?
definitions.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ diễn ra trong thế giới vật chất khi nó không được con người kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the usual way that a person or an animal behaves that is part of their character
examples: SEE ALSO good nature
She is very sensitive by nature.
It's not in his nature to be unkind.
It was against her nature to tell lies.
We appealed to his better nature (= his kindness).
definitions.definition_vi: cách hành xử thông thường của một người hoặc một con vật vốn là một phần tính cách của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the basic qualities of a thing
examples: the changing nature of society
It's difficult to define the exact nature of the problem.
His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.
My work is very specialized in nature.
The future by its very nature is uncertain.
definitions.definition_vi: những phẩm chất cơ bản của một sự vật

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a type or kind of something
examples: His books were mainly of a scientific nature.
Don't worry about things of that nature.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại hoặc một loại cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: having the type of character or quality mentioned
examples: a good-natured man
definitions.definition_vi: có loại tính cách hoặc chất lượng được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: not natural; not moral
examples: Murder is a crime against nature.
definitions.definition_vi: không tự nhiên; không đạo đức

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: (to return to) a simple kind of life in the country, away from cities
examples: When you’re camping, you can get back to nature.

definitions.definition_vi: (trở lại) cuộc sống giản dị ở nông thôn, xa thành phố

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: the need to go to the toilet
definitions.definition_vi: sự cần thiết phải đi vệ sinh

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: một người có cá tính rất mạnh mẽ, tràn đầy năng lượng, rất kiên quyết và khó để người khác cưỡng lại

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: the power of the wind, rain, etc., especially when it causes damage or harm
examples: They were fighting a losing battle against the forces of nature.
definitions.definition_vi: sức mạnh của gió, mưa, v.v., đặc biệt khi nó gây ra thiệt hại hoặc tổn hại

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: similar to something; a type of something; in the style of something
examples: His speech was in the nature of an apology.
definitions.definition_vi: tương tự như một cái gì đó; một loại cái gì đó; theo phong cách của cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: in the way that things usually happen
examples: In the nature of things, young people often rebel against their parents.
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách mà mọi thứ thường xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to allow natural processes to happen, without trying to stop or change them (used especially in the context of illness)
examples: The midwife must judge when to let nature take its course and when to intervene.
When the dog responded so badly to the treatment, we decided to let nature take its course.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép các quá trình tự nhiên xảy ra mà không cố gắng ngăn chặn hoặc thay đổi chúng (đặc biệt được sử dụng trong bối cảnh bệnh tật)

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: connected with the navy of a country
examples: a naval base/officer/battle
the country’s naval forces
definitions.definition_vi: kết nối với hải quân của một quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: at a short distance away from somebody/something
examples: Do you live near here?
Go and sit nearer (to) the fire.
definitions.definition_vi: ở một khoảng cách ngắn với ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a short period of time from something
examples: My birthday is very near Christmas.
I’ll think about it nearer (to) the time (= when it is just going to happen).
definitions.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian ngắn từ một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used before a number to mean ‘approximately’, ‘just below or above’
examples: Share prices are near their record high of last year.
Profits fell from $11 million to nearer $8 million.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước một số có nghĩa là 'xấp xỉ', 'ngay bên dưới hoặc bên trên'

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: similar to somebody/something in quality, size, etc.
examples: Nobody else comes near her in intellect.
He's nearer 70 than 60.
This colour is nearest (to) the original.
definitions.definition_vi: tương tự với ai/cái gì về chất lượng, kích thước, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: close to a particular state
examples: a state near (to) death
She was near to tears (= almost crying).
We came near to being killed.
definitions.definition_vi: gần với một trạng thái cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: close to you in time or distance
examples: Help was at hand.
The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
definitions.definition_vi: gần bạn về thời gian hoặc khoảng cách

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to be fairly accurate in a guess, statement, etc.
examples: Such guesses are thought to be close to the mark.
‘The Times’ was nearer the mark when it said…
definitions.definition_vi: khá chính xác trong một phỏng đoán, tuyên bố, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: having a lot of importance and interest for somebody
definitions.definition_vi: có rất nhiều tầm quan trọng và quan tâm đối với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to require something/somebody because they are essential or very important, not just because you would like to have them
examples: Do you need any help?
It's here if you need it.
Don't go—I might need you.
They badly needed a change.
We desperately need hard facts on this disease.
Food aid is urgently needed.
What do you need your own computer for? You can use ours.
She needs more time to recover.
People need income not handouts.
More new housing is needed in the city.
I don't need your comments, thank you.
I need to get some sleep.
He needs to win this game to stay in the match.
You don't need to leave yet, do you?
You need to know how toxic the product is.
This shirt needs to be washed.
This shirt needs washing.
definitions.definition_vi: yêu cầu cái gì/ai đó vì chúng cần thiết hoặc rất quan trọng, không chỉ vì bạn muốn có chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to show what you should or have to do
examples: All you need to do is complete this form.
I didn't need to go to the bank after all—Mary lent me the money.

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hiển thị những gì bạn nên hoặc phải làm

definitions.definition_vi: khi ai đó/thứ gì đó lọt qua mạng, một tổ chức hoặc hệ thống không tìm thấy chúng và xử lý chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to consider a wide range of possibilities or cover a large area, especially to try to find somebody/something
examples: They have spread their net far and wide in the search for a new team coach.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét nhiều khả năng hoặc bao trùm một khu vực rộng lớn, đặc biệt là cố gắng tìm ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to consider or include a larger range of options or possibilities, especially when searching for something
examples: It's time to widen the net in the search for a suitable candidate.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét hoặc bao gồm nhiều lựa chọn hoặc khả năng hơn, đặc biệt là khi tìm kiếm thứ gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a complicated system of roads, lines, tubes, nerves, etc. that are connected to each other and operate together
examples: a rail/road/canal network
The new rail services will form a network connecting the capital and major cities.
Europe's mobile phone networks are controlled by five dominant players.
a network of veins
an extensive network of underground tunnels
definitions.definition_vi: một hệ thống phức tạp gồm đường, đường, ống, dây thần kinh, v.v. được kết nối với nhau và hoạt động cùng nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a closely connected group of people, companies, etc. that exchange information, etc.

They have one of the most efficient distribution networks in Europe.
These corporations control TV, radio and global communications networks.
to build/create/develop a network
She has a supportive network of close friends.
Expand your network of contacts beyond your usual circles.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm người, công ty, v.v. được kết nối chặt chẽ để trao đổi thông tin, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a number of computers and other devices that are connected together so that equipment and information can be shared
examples: SEE ALSO LAN

Users can access data across a network.
The files are accessible over a network.
You can print and scan from your device via a wireless network.

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm các đài phát thanh hoặc truyền hình ở những nơi khác nhau được kết nối và phát sóng cùng một chương trình cùng một lúc

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.definition_vi: tình hình ở nhiều công ty, cơ quan chính phủ và chi nhánh của lực lượng vũ trang Anh, nơi mọi người giao việc làm cho các cựu sinh viên của trường hoặc trường đại học mà họ đã theo học

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to say that nothing is impossible
examples: Many thought the book could not become a movie, but with Hollywood never say never.
definitions.definition_vi: từng nói rằng không có gì là không thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: to buy a new car on the never-never
definitions.definition_vi: khi thuê mua (= bằng cách thanh toán trong một thời gian dài)

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to express surprise or disapproval
examples: Well, I never! Fancy getting married and not telling us!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên hoặc không đồng ý

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: despite something that you have just mentioned

Our defeat was expected but it is disappointing nevertheless.

definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp điều gì đó mà bạn vừa đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 1

We retrain staff to use the new technology.

Have you seen Danielle's new baby?

This idea isn't new.
The latest model has over 100 new features.
Check out the band's new album.
definitions.definition_vi: trước đây không tồn tại; được thực hiện gần đây, được phát minh, được giới thiệu, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: something that is new

definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mới

definitions.label: Meaning 3

The car still looks new.
They are very proud of their spanking new kitchen.
definitions.definition_vi: mới mua gần đây

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not used or owned by anyone before
examples: A second-hand car costs a fraction of a new one.
They are building 500 new houses in the town.
definitions.definition_vi: chưa từng được sử dụng hoặc sở hữu bởi bất cứ ai trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: different from the previous one
examples: I like your new hairstyle.
When do you start your new job?
He's made a lot of new friends.
Do you have her new phone number?
definitions.definition_vi: khác với cái trước

definitions.label: Meaning 6

examples: This is a new experience for me.
I'd like to learn a new language.
the discovery of a new star

Manga is drawing in a whole new generation of readers.

definitions.definition_vi: đã tồn tại nhưng chưa từng thấy, chưa từng trải qua, v.v. trước đó; không quen

New arrivals should have their passports ready for inspection.
We offer intensive training to all new recruits.
I should tell you, I'm completely new to this kind of work.
I am new to the town.
definitions.definition_vi: chưa quen với việc gì đó vì bạn chỉ mới bắt đầu, mới đến, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: just beginning or beginning again

It was a new era in the history of our country.
She went to Australia to start a new life.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ mới bắt đầu hoặc bắt đầu lại

definitions.label: Meaning 9

examples: He was enjoying his new-found freedom.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các hợp chất để mô tả một cái gì đó đã xảy ra gần đây

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: hiện đại; thuộc loại mới nhất

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: có năng lượng tươi mới, lòng can đảm hoặc sức khỏe

definitions.definition_vi: chỉ được sản xuất hoặc phát triển gần đây

definitions.label: Meaning 14

examples: SEE ALSO groundbreaking
Her architectural designs have broken new ground.
definitions.definition_vi: để thực hiện một khám phá mới hoặc làm điều gì đó chưa được thực hiện trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 15

examples: The results of their research have breathed new life into the debate.
definitions.definition_vi: để cải thiện một cái gì đó bằng cách giới thiệu những ý tưởng mới và làm cho mọi người quan tâm hơn đến nó

definitions.label: Meaning 16

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả tình huống trong đó mọi người đột nhiên nhận ra rằng họ đã sai khi tin rằng ai đó/điều gì đó rất tốt, quan trọng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: in very good condition, as it was when it was new

definitions.definition_vi: trong tình trạng rất tốt, như lúc mới

Comedy is the new rock and roll.
Fifty is the new forty.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng một cái gì đó đã trở nên rất thời trang và có thể được coi là thay thế một cái gì đó khác

definitions.label: Meaning 19

definitions.label: Meaning 20

definitions.definition_vi: một người mới bắt đầu làm việc cho một tổ chức, bộ phận, v.v., đặc biệt là ở một công việc cấp cao và có khả năng thực hiện nhiều thay đổi

definitions.definition_vi: một người mới đến một địa điểm, một tổ chức, v.v.

definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống trước đây không bình thường nhưng bây giờ lại là điều bạn nên mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: used to say that you have not heard a particular idea, piece of information, joke, etc. before
examples: ‘Have you come across this before?’ ‘No, it's a new one on me.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn chưa từng nghe một ý tưởng cụ thể nào, một mẩu thông tin, một câu chuyện đùa, v.v. trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to change the way that a situation appears
examples: What you have told us puts a different complexion on the situation.

definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi cách mà một tình huống xuất hiện

definitions.definition_vi: (bạn không thể) thành công trong việc khiến mọi người thay đổi ý tưởng, phương pháp làm việc, v.v., khi họ đã có chúng từ lâu

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: to change your way of life to become a better, more responsible person
definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi cách sống của bạn để trở thành một người tốt hơn, có trách nhiệm hơn

saddened/shocked/surprised by the news

national/international/local news
a news story/item/report
a TV/radio news bulletin
news media/coverage

breaking news (= news that is arriving about events that have just happened)

Can you put the news on?
the nine o’clock news

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition_vi: một người, vật hoặc sự kiện được coi là đủ thú vị để được đưa tin dưới dạng tin tức

definitions.definition_vi: giờ làm việc bình thường ở văn phòng

definitions.label: Meaning 7

What's that noise?

Don't make a noise.
They were making too much noise.
I was woken by the noise of a car starting up.

definitions.label: Meaning 4

definitions.definition_vi: một người quan trọng

definitions.definition_vi: phàn nàn lớn tiếng

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.definition_vi: nói một cách gián tiếp về điều gì đó mà bạn nghĩ bạn có thể làm

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.definition_vi: phàn nàn về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2

The streets were very noisy throughout the night.
The party was getting a bit noisy.
It was so noisy I couldn't hear myself speak.
definitions.definition_vi: đầy ồn ào

definitions.definition_vi: một người đã chính thức được đề nghị cho một công việc, một giải thưởng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person in whose name money is invested in a company, etc.

definitions.definition_vi: một người đứng tên tiền được đầu tư vào một công ty, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1

The book is too long but, nonetheless, informative and entertaining.

definitions.definition_vi: bất chấp sự thật này

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: 12 o’clock in the middle of the day
examples: SYNONYM midday
We should be there by noon.
The conference opens at 12 noon on Saturday.
the noon deadline for the end of hostilities
I'm leaving on the noon train.
definitions.definition_vi: 12 giờ giữa ngày

definitions.definition: at all times of the day and night (used to emphasize that something happens very often or that it happens continuously)
examples: She talks about him morning, noon and night.
The work continues morning, noon and night.
It's all she talks about, morning, noon and night.
definitions.definition_vi: vào mọi thời điểm trong ngày và đêm (dùng để nhấn mạnh việc gì đó xảy ra rất thường xuyên hoặc xảy ra liên tục)

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a situation or a pattern of behaviour that is usual or expected
examples: SYNONYM rule (4)

Older parents seem to be the norm rather than the exception nowadays.
definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống hoặc một kiểu hành vi thông thường hoặc được mong đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: standards of behaviour that are typical of or accepted within a particular group or society
examples: social/cultural norms
She considered people to be products of the values and norms of the society they lived in.
accepted norms of behaviour
definitions.definition_vi: tiêu chuẩn hành vi điển hình hoặc được chấp nhận trong một nhóm hoặc xã hội cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a required or agreed standard, amount, etc.
examples: detailed education norms for children of particular ages
The government claims that background radioactivity is well below international norms.
definitions.definition_vi: một tiêu chuẩn, số lượng được yêu cầu hoặc đồng ý, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the direction that is on your left when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
examples: COMPARE east
Which way is north?

views of distant mountains to north and south

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the northern part of a country, a region or the world
examples: birds migrating from the north

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used with uncountable nouns, especially in negative sentences to mean ‘a large amount of something’, or after ‘how’ to ask about the amount of something. It is also used with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
examples: I don't have much money with me.
‘Got any money?’ ‘Not much.’
How much water do you need?
How much is it (= What does it cost)?
Take as much time as you like.
There was so much traffic that we were an hour late.
I've got far too much to do.
I lay awake for much of the night.
There was much discussion about the reasons for the failure.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các danh từ không đếm được, đặc biệt là trong các câu phủ định có nghĩa là “một lượng lớn cái gì đó”, hoặc sau “làm thế nào” để hỏi về số lượng của một cái gì đó. Nó cũng được sử dụng với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the same
examples: Please help me get this job—you know I would do as much for you.
‘Roger stole the money.’ ‘I thought as much.’
definitions.definition_vi: giống nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to say that something is difficult to do
examples: No dessert for me, thanks. It was as much as I could do to finish the main course.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó khó thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not fair or not reasonable
examples: It's a bit much calling me at three in the morning.
The noise from next door is getting a bit much.
definitions.definition_vi: không công bằng hoặc không hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to treat something/somebody as very important
examples: He always makes much of his humble origins.
definitions.definition_vi: coi cái gì/ai đó là rất quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to say that there is little difference between two things
examples: I won, but there wasn't much in it (= our scores were nearly the same).
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng có rất ít sự khác biệt giữa hai điều

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: not a good…
examples: He's not much of a tennis player.
definitions.definition_vi: không tốt chút nào…

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to introduce something positive or definite
examples: I'll say this much for him—he never leaves a piece of work unfinished.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một cái gì đó tích cực hoặc xác định

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a situation or experience that is too difficult to deal with

definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống hoặc trải nghiệm quá khó để giải quyết
