definitions.definition_vi: phép đo số lần điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc điều gì đó thực hiện điều gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a fixed amount of money that is charged or paid for something
examples: SEE ALSO bank rate
advertising/insurance/postal rates
A rise in interest rates tends to reduce inflation.
The euro exchange rate is strengthening.
He argued for a reduction in the top tax rate.
We offer special reduced rates for students.
to cut/reduce/increase/raise interest rates
a low/high hourly rate of pay
the basic rate of tax (= the lowest amount that is paid by everyone)
We had to borrow money at a high rate of interest.
a fixed-rate mortgage (= one in which the amount of money paid back each month is fixed for a particular period)
a premium-rate phone number (= one that costs more than the usual rate to call)
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền cố định được tính phí hoặc thanh toán cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a tax paid by businesses to a local authority for land and buildings that they use
examples: SEE ALSO first-rate
definitions.definition_vi: thuế do doanh nghiệp nộp cho chính quyền địa phương đối với đất đai và nhà cửa mà họ sử dụng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future
examples: Well, that's one good piece of news at any rate.
I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng một sự thật cụ thể nào đó là đúng bất chấp những gì đã xảy ra trong quá khứ hoặc những gì có thể xảy ra trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to show that you are being more accurate about something that you have just said
examples: He said he'll be coming tomorrow. At any rate, I think that's what he said.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn đang chính xác hơn về điều gì đó mà bạn vừa nói

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say
examples: There were maybe 60 or 70 people there. At any rate, the room was packed.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện rằng điều bạn vừa nói không quan trọng bằng điều bạn sắp nói

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: very quickly
examples: She's getting through her winnings at a rate of knots.
definitions.definition_vi: rất nhanh

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to say what will happen if a particular situation continues to develop in the same way
examples: At this rate, we'll soon be bankrupt.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu một tình huống cụ thể tiếp tục phát triển theo cách tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the usual amount of money paid for goods or services at a particular time
examples: They pay slightly more than the going rate.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền thông thường được trả cho hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ tại một thời điểm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to mean ‘fairly’ or ‘to some degree’, often when you are disappointed, surprised or expressing slight criticism
examples: rather odd/strange/unusual
a rather large sum of money
A rather small number of people turned up.
They took a rather different approach.
I thought it was a rather good idea.
The instructions were rather complicated.
She fell and hurt her leg rather badly.
I didn't fail the exam; in fact I did rather well!
It was a rather difficult question.
It was rather a difficult question.
He looks rather like his father.
The patient has responded to the treatment rather better than expected.
He was conscious that he was talking rather too much.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ 'công bằng' hoặc 'ở một mức độ nào đó', thường khi bạn thất vọng, ngạc nhiên hoặc bày tỏ sự chỉ trích nhẹ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used with a verb to make a statement sound less strong
examples: I've always rather liked Charlie.
I rather suspect we're making a mistake.
We were rather hoping you'd be able to do it by Friday.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng với một động từ để làm cho một câu phát biểu nghe kém mạnh mẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to correct something you have said, or to give more accurate information
examples: She worked as a secretary, or rather, a personal assistant.
In the end he had to walk—or rather run—to the office.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để sửa lại điều gì đó bạn đã nói hoặc để cung cấp thông tin chính xác hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to introduce an idea that is different or opposite to the idea that you have stated previously
examples: The walls were not white, but rather a sort of dirty grey.
The problem is not in the whole system, but rather in one small part.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một ý tưởng khác hoặc trái ngược với ý tưởng mà bạn đã nêu trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: instead of somebody/something
examples: I think I'll have a cold drink rather than coffee.
Why didn't you ask for help, rather than trying to do it on your own?
definitions.definition_vi: thay vì ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used for saying that you would not like to do something that another person is going to do
examples: ‘I'm going climbing tomorrow.’ ‘Rather you than me!’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không muốn làm điều gì đó mà người khác sẽ làm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: would prefer to
examples: She'd rather die than give a speech.
‘Do you want to come with us?’ ‘No, I'd rather not.’
Would you rather walk or take the bus?
‘Do you mind if I smoke?’ ‘Well, I'd rather you didn't.’
Personally, I'd rather see the money and resources going into education.
I'd rather have a simple product that actually works than something fancy that's just not reliable.
definitions.definition_vi: muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the relationship between two groups of people or things that is represented by two numbers showing how much larger one group is than the other
examples: The school has a very high teacher-student ratio.
What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
The ratio of applications to available places currently stands at 100:1.
definitions.definition_vi: mối quan hệ giữa hai nhóm người hoặc đồ vật được biểu thị bằng hai con số cho thấy nhóm này lớn hơn nhóm kia bao nhiêu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to arrive at the place that you have been travelling to
examples: They didn't reach the border until after dark.
The beach can only be reached by boat.
I hope this letter reaches you.
We finally reached our destination.
definitions.definition_vi: để đến nơi mà bạn đã đi du lịch đến

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to come to somebody’s attention
examples: The rumours eventually reached the President.
definitions.definition_vi: thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to increase to a particular level, speed, etc. over a period of time
examples: The conflict has now reached a new level of intensity.
Daytime temperatures can reach 40°C.
This tree can reach a height of 24 metres.
Her popularity reached its peak in the late 1990s.
Over half the candidates failed to reach the expected standard.
definitions.definition_vi: để tăng lên một mức độ cụ thể, tốc độ, vv trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to arrive at a particular point or stage of something after a period of time
examples: We have a good chance of reaching the final.
His parents have not yet reached retirement age.
The problem has now reached crisis point.
I have reached the stage in my career where I need a change.
The negotiations have reached deadlock.
I'd just like to reach the end of the chapter.
definitions.definition_vi: đạt đến một điểm hoặc giai đoạn cụ thể của cái gì đó sau một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to achieve a particular aim
examples: SYNONYM arrive at
Politicians again failed to reach an agreement.
The two men reached the same conclusion.
They have yet to reach a decision.
In the end we reached a compromise.
The jury was unable to reach a verdict.
We will not stop until we have reached our goal.
definitions.definition_vi: để đạt được một mục tiêu cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to stretch your hand towards something in order to touch it, pick it up, etc.
examples: She reached inside her bag for a pen.
I reached out to pat the dog.
He reached into his pocket and pulled out his phone.
She reached blindly for the light switch.
He reached across the table to squeeze her hand.
He reached out his hand to touch her.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa tay về phía thứ gì đó để chạm vào nó, nhặt nó lên, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to be able to stretch your hand far enough in order to touch something, pick something up, etc.
examples: ‘Grab the end of the rope.’ ‘I can't reach that far!’
Can you reach the light switch from where you're sitting?
I can't reach the top shelf.
She had arranged her desk so that she could reach everything easily.
definitions.definition_vi: có thể duỗi tay đủ xa để chạm vào thứ gì đó, nhặt thứ gì đó lên, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to stretch your hand out or up in order to get something for somebody
examples: Can you reach that box down for me?
Can you reach me down that box?
definitions.definition_vi: đưa tay ra hoặc đưa tay lên để lấy cái gì đó cho ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be big enough, long enough, etc. to arrive at a particular point
examples: The carpet only reached halfway across the room.
His hair reached down to the middle of his back.
Is the cable long enough to reach the socket?
Her skirt almost reached the ground.
definitions.definition_vi: đủ lớn, đủ dài, v.v. để đến một điểm cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to communicate with somebody, especially by phone
examples: Do you know where I can reach him?
You can reach me at this number.
No one at the company could be reached for comment.
definitions.definition_vi: liên lạc với ai đó, đặc biệt là qua điện thoại

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be seen or heard by somebody
examples: Through the internet we are able to reach a wider audience.
definitions.definition_vi: được ai đó nhìn thấy hoặc nghe thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: somebody hears about something, especially when other people already know about it
examples: News of his affair eventually reached her ears.
definitions.definition_vi: ai đó nghe về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi người khác đã biết về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to try to be successful at something that is difficultWord Origin
examples: Old English rǣcan, of West Germanic origin; related to Dutch reiken and German reichen.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng thành công ở một việc gì đó khó khănWord Origin

examples: SEE ALSO sight-read

to read an article/a report/a letter/a blog/a review

definitions.definition_vi: nhìn vào cử động môi của ai đó để biết họ đang nói gì

examples: SYNONYM interpret

definitions.definition_vi: để hiểu một cái gì đó trong một cách cụ thể

definitions.definition_vi: có cái gì đó được viết trên đó; được viết theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.definition_vi: để tạo ấn tượng đặc biệt khi đọc

definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị một trọng lượng cụ thể, áp lực, vv.

examples: A man came to read the gas meter.
definitions.definition_vi: để lấy thông tin từ một dụng cụ đo

definitions.definition_vi: nghe và hiểu ai đó đang nói trên đài phát thanh

definitions.definition_vi: để nghiên cứu một chủ đề, đặc biệt là tại một trường đại học

to read a file into a computer
definitions.definition_vi: để lấy thông tin từ đĩa

definitions.definition_vi: để tìm kiếm hoặc khám phá một ý nghĩa trong một cái gì đó không được tuyên bố một cách công khai

Right, we're ready to go.

definitions.definition_vi: đã hoàn thành và sẵn sàng để sử dụng

definitions.definition_vi: cần một cái gì đó càng sớm càng tốt

definitions.definition_vi: nhanh chóng và thông minh

definitions.definition: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact
examples: SYNONYM approximately
He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đưa ra một con số, giá cả, v.v. để thể hiện rằng nó không chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list
examples: You can also register online.
to register a birth/marriage/death
to register a company/trademark
The site has 114 million registered users.
a registered charity
We expect about 50 per cent of registered voters to vote in the election.
The police has registered a case against the company.
The regulations require doctors and patients to register in a database.
The ship was registered in Panama.
Six other families were also registered at the same address.
to register at a hotel
She is officially registered disabled.
They encouraged all eligible citizens to register as voters.
He then registered the name as a trademark.
to register with a doctor/dentist
All childminders should be registered with the local authority.
About 700 people registered for the conference.
The drug has not been registered for use in Australia.
More than 5 000 people registered to take part in the contest.
78 per cent reported that they were registered to vote.
definitions.definition_vi: ghi tên của bạn/ai đó/cái gì đó vào danh sách chính thức

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make your opinion known officially or publicly
examples: China has registered a protest over foreign intervention.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho ý kiến ​​của bạn được biết chính thức hoặc công khai

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: if a measuring instrument registers an amount or something registers an amount on a measuring instrument, the instrument shows or records that amount
examples: The thermometer registered 32°C.
The earthquake registered 3 on the Richter scale.
The stock exchange has registered huge losses this week.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một dụng cụ đo ghi một lượng hoặc một cái gì đó ghi một lượng trên dụng cụ đo thì dụng cụ đó sẽ hiển thị hoặc ghi lại lượng đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to show or express a feeling
examples: Her face registered disapproval.
Shock registered on everyone's face.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị hoặc bày tỏ một cảm giác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to notice something and remember it; to be noticed
examples: He barely registered our presence.
I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.
He vaguely registered that the women had gone.
Slowly, my mind began to register where I was: in the hospital.
definitions.definition_vi: để ý điều gì đó và ghi nhớ nó; được chú ý

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to send something by mail, paying extra money to protect it against loss or damage
examples: Can I register this, please?
a registered letter
definitions.definition_vi: gửi cái gì đó qua đường bưu điện, trả thêm tiền để bảo vệ nó khỏi bị mất mát hoặc hư hỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to feel sorry about something you have done or about something that you have not been able to do
examples: If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.
The decision could be one he lives to regret.
I soon came to regret my action.
‘I've had a wonderful life,’ she said, ‘I don't regret a thing.’
She regretted the words the moment they were out of her mouth.
He bitterly regretted ever having mentioned it.
I never regretted dropping out of college.
I deeply regret what I said.
I regret that I never got to meet him in person.
definitions.definition_vi: Cảm thấy tiếc về điều gì đó bạn đã làm hoặc về điều gì đó mà bạn không thể làm được

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say in a polite or formal way that you are sorry or sad about a situation
examples: The airline regrets any inconvenience.
The president said that his country deeply regretted the incident.
The United States regrets the loss of innocent civilian lives.
I regret that I am unable to accept your kind invitation.
I very much regret that I cannot be with you this evening.
We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.
I regret to say that we cannot let you have the picture.
It is to be regretted that so many young people leave school without qualifications.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói một cách lịch sự hoặc trang trọng rằng bạn thấy tiếc hoặc buồn về một tình huống nào đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next
examples: OPPOSITE irregular
regular breathing
a regular pulse/heartbeat
A light flashed at regular intervals.
There is a regular bus service to the airport.
regular meetings/visits
We also hold a regular monthly meeting.
The equipment is checked on a regular basis.
She writes a regular column for a national newspaper.
a regular geometric pattern
definitions.definition_vi: tuân theo một khuôn mẫu, đặc biệt là có cùng thời gian hoặc không gian giữa mỗi thứ và thứ tiếp theo

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: done or happening often

Do you take regular exercise?
I'm still in regular contact with friends I met at university.
Domestic violence is a regular occurrence in some families.
a painter whose work is a regular feature of the Summer Exhibition
The key to good anti-virus software is regular updates.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện hoặc xảy ra thường xuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: doing the same thing or going to the same place often
examples: regular readers/customers/users
She is a regular contributor to many journals and magazines
regular offenders (= against the law)
He was a regular visitor to her house.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều tương tự hoặc thường xuyên đến cùng một nơi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: changing their form in the same way as most other verbs and nouns
examples: OPPOSITE irregular
The past participle of regular verbs ends in ‘-ed’.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hình thức của chúng giống như hầu hết các động từ và danh từ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: usual
examples: I couldn't see my regular doctor today.
On Monday he would have to return to his regular duties.
It's important to follow the regular procedure.
He was mistaken for one of the regular crew.
the last match of the regular season
definitions.definition_vi: thường

definitions.label: Meaning 6

examples: Regular or large fries?
definitions.definition_vi: có kích thước tiêu chuẩn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: ordinary; without any special or extra features
examples: Do you want regular or diet cola?
I just want to buy a regular white shirt—nothing fancy.
He's just a regular guy who loves his dog.
definitions.definition_vi: bình thường; không có bất kỳ tính năng đặc biệt hoặc bổ sung nào

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: having an even shape
examples: OPPOSITE irregular
a face with regular features
He flashed a smile, showing two rows of white, regular teeth.
Her face was perfectly regular.
definitions.definition_vi: có hình dạng đều

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: lasting or happening over a long period
examples: The need to earn a regular income restricted the time he could spend pursuing his real interests.
She couldn't find any regular employment.
definitions.definition_vi: kéo dài hoặc xảy ra trong một thời gian dài

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: belonging to or connected with the permanent armed forces or police force of a country
examples: OPPOSITE irregular
the regular army
regular soldiers
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc hoặc có liên quan đến lực lượng vũ trang thường trực hoặc lực lượng cảnh sát của một quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used for emphasis to show that somebody/something is an exact or clear example of the thing mentioned
examples: The whole thing was a regular disaster.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là một ví dụ chính xác hoặc rõ ràng về điều được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 12

examples: He is home by six every day, regular as clockwork.
definitions.definition_vi: rất thường xuyên; xảy ra cùng lúc theo cùng một cách

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
the introduction of direct, regularly scheduled flights to Beijing

definitions.definition_vi: vào những khoảng thời gian hoặc thời gian đều đặn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: often

The couple regularly attended Mass.

She appeared regularly at the Metropolitan Opera.
definitions.definition_vi: thường

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: in an even or balanced way
examples: The plants were spaced regularly, about 50 cm apart.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách đồng đều hoặc cân bằng

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: regulatory bodies/authorities/agencies
regulatory procedures
definitions.definition_vi: có quyền kiểm soát một lĩnh vực kinh doanh hoặc ngành công nghiệp và đảm bảo rằng nó hoạt động công bằng

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: thời kỳ mà một vị vua, hoàng hậu, hoàng đế, vv cai trị

definitions.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà ai đó phụ trách một tổ chức, một nhóm, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to something else
examples: relatively large/small/high/low

I found the test relatively easy.
These students had a relatively simple task.
We had relatively few applications for the job.
I have relatively little to do this afternoon.
It all happened in a relatively short period of time.
At the time, the internet was a relatively new phenomenon.
He was charged with a relatively minor offence.

definitions.definition_vi: ở một mức độ khá lớn, đặc biệt là so với cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used when you are comparing something with all similar things
examples: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang so sánh một cái gì đó với tất cả những điều tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to let somebody come out of a place where they have been kept or stuck and unable to leave or move
examples: to release a prisoner
The hostages were released unharmed.
He was released without charge after questioning by police.
You will be released on bail and a date for your hearing will be set.
to release somebody from prison/jail/hospital
Firefighters took two hours to release the driver from the wreckage.
He was later released from police custody.
Death released him from his suffering.
definitions.definition_vi: để ai đó ra khỏi nơi mà họ đã bị giữ hoặc bị mắc kẹt và không thể rời đi hoặc di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to stop holding something or stop it from being held so that it can move, fly, fall, etc. freely
examples: SYNONYM let go
He refused to release her arm.
Intense heat is released in the reaction.
10 000 balloons were released at the ceremony.
The chemical reaction releases energy in the form of light.
the need to limit the amount of greenhouse gases being released into the atmosphere
The birds were cleaned and fed and released again into the wild.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng giữ một cái gì đó hoặc ngăn nó khỏi bị giữ để nó có thể di chuyển, bay, rơi, v.v... một cách tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to express feelings such as anger or worry in order to get rid of them
examples: She burst into tears, releasing all her pent-up emotions.
She laughed, the tension inside her suddenly released.
definitions.definition_vi: để bày tỏ cảm xúc như tức giận hoặc lo lắng để thoát khỏi chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to remove something from a fixed position, allowing something else to move or function
examples: to release the clutch/handbrake/switch
Now release the clutch and move away from the kerb.
definitions.definition_vi: loại bỏ cái gì đó khỏi một vị trí cố định, cho phép cái gì đó khác di chuyển hoặc hoạt động

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to make information available to the public
examples: to release a statement/report/document/poll/study
to release figures/results/information/data
Police have released no further details about the accident.
The suspect's name has not been released to the public.
The newly released files reveal the extent of his involvement in the scandal.
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp thông tin cho công chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to make a film, recording or other product available to the public
examples: He's planning to release a solo album.
to release a film/video
They've released a new version of the original film.
There have been a lot of new products released onto the market.
The series has just recently been released on DVD.
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp phim, bản ghi âm hoặc sản phẩm khác cho công chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to make something available that had previously been limited
examples: The new building programme will go ahead as soon as the government releases the funds.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó có sẵn mà trước đây đã bị hạn chế

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to free somebody from a duty, responsibility, contract, etc.
examples: The club is releasing some of its older players.
The new law released employers from their obligation to recognize unions.
definitions.definition_vi: giải phóng ai đó khỏi nghĩa vụ, trách nhiệm, hợp đồng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to make something less tight
examples: You need to release the tension in these shoulder muscles.
to release a catch/a screw/a nut/the clutch/the brakes
definitions.definition_vi: làm cái gì bớt chặt chẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a close connection with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in
examples: OPPOSITE irrelevance (1)
I don't see the relevance of your question.
What he said has no direct relevance to the matter in hand.
definitions.definition_vi: mối liên hệ chặt chẽ với chủ đề bạn đang thảo luận hoặc tình huống bạn đang gặp phải

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the fact of being valuable and useful to people in their lives and work
examples: a classic play of contemporary relevance
definitions.definition_vi: thực tế là có giá trị và hữu ích cho mọi người trong cuộc sống và công việc của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the feeling of happiness that you have when something unpleasant stops or does not happen
examples: I felt a huge sense of relief when I heard they were all OK.
We all breathed a sigh of relief when he left.
Much to my relief the car was not damaged.
News of their safety came as a great relief.
She sighed with relief.
He smiled in relief as he saw them both.
She had gone through hell and there was no relief in sight for her.
This was a great relief to him.
It was a relief to be able to talk to someone about it.
It was a relief to her to realize that she was not the only one with this problem.
His mother spoke of her relief that he was now safely home.
It is actually a relief that it's finally happened.
She expressed relief at the outcome of the investigation.
He described his relief at securing his freedom.
What a relief!
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác hạnh phúc mà bạn có khi điều gì đó khó chịu dừng lại hoặc không xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of removing or reducing pain, worry, etc.
examples: modern methods of pain relief
the relief of symptoms/suffering/poverty/pain
The drugs only provided temporary relief from the pain.
All the tables in the shade were occupied by people seeking relief from the heat.
Massage can bring some relief from tension.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động loại bỏ hoặc giảm bớt nỗi đau, lo lắng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: food, money, medicine, etc. that is given to help people in places where there has been a war or natural disaster
examples: SYNONYM aid
disaster relief
relief efforts/operations
relief organizations/supplies/work
We raised £5 000 for famine relief.
One relief agency worker described the situation as ‘catastrophic’.
definitions.definition_vi: lương thực, tiền bạc, thuốc men... được trao tặng để giúp đỡ người dân ở những nơi có chiến tranh, thiên tai

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: financial help given by the government to people who need it
definitions.definition_vi: sự hỗ trợ tài chính của chính phủ dành cho những người cần nó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a reduction in the amount of tax you have to pay
examples: relief on mortgage interest payments
definitions.definition_vi: giảm số tiền thuế bạn phải trả

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: something that is interesting or fun that replaces something boring, difficult or unpleasant for a short period of time
examples: a few moments of light relief in an otherwise dull performance
There was little comic relief in his speech.
The calm of the countryside came as a welcome relief from the hustle and bustle of city life.
definitions.definition_vi: cái gì đó thú vị hoặc vui vẻ thay thế cái gì đó nhàm chán, khó khăn hoặc khó chịu trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a person or group of people that replaces another when they have finished working for the day or when they are sick
examples: The next crew relief comes on duty at 9 o'clock.
We have a pool of relief drivers available to us.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc một nhóm người thay thế người khác khi họ kết thúc công việc trong ngày hoặc khi họ bị ốm

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the act of freeing a town, etc. from an enemy army that has surrounded it
examples: the relief of Mafeking
definitions.definition_vi: hành động giải phóng một thị trấn, v.v. khỏi quân địch đã bao vây nó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a way of decorating wood, stone, etc. by cutting designs into the surface of it so that some parts stick out more than others; a design that is made in this way
examples: SEE ALSO bas-relief
The column was decorated in high relief (= with designs that stick out a lot) with scenes from Greek mythology.
The bronze doors are covered with sculpted reliefs.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách trang trí gỗ, đá, v.v. bằng cách cắt các họa tiết vào bề mặt của nó sao cho một số phần nhô ra hơn những phần khác; một thiết kế được thực hiện theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the effect of colours, light, etc. that makes an object easier to notice than others around it
examples: The snow-capped mountain stood out in sharp relief against the blue sky.
definitions.definition_vi: hiệu ứng của màu sắc, ánh sáng, v.v. làm cho một vật thể dễ nhận thấy hơn những vật thể khác xung quanh nó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: the quality of a particular situation, problem, etc. that makes it easier to notice than before
examples: Their differences have been thrown into sharp relief by the present crisis.
The proximity of the wealthy suburb to the squatter camp throws the plight of the squatters into even sharper relief.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng của một tình huống, vấn đề cụ thể, v.v. khiến nó dễ nhận thấy hơn trước

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the belief in the existence of a god or gods, and the activities that are connected with the worship of them, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader
examples: Is there always a conflict between science and religion?
He believed in God but had no interest in organized religion.
They are Jewish by religion.
definitions.definition_vi: niềm tin vào sự tồn tại của một vị thần hoặc các vị thần và các hoạt động liên quan đến việc thờ cúng các vị thần đó hoặc vào lời dạy của một nhà lãnh đạo tinh thần

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: one of the systems of faith that are based on the belief in the existence of a particular god or gods, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader
examples: the Jewish religion
Christianity, Islam and other world religions
The law states that everyone has the right to practise their own religion.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những hệ thống đức tin dựa trên niềm tin vào sự tồn tại của một hoặc nhiều vị thần cụ thể hoặc vào lời dạy của một nhà lãnh đạo tinh thần

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a particular interest or influence that is very important in your life

definitions.definition_vi: chứa hoặc cung cấp một lượng lớn thứ gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5

a culturally rich nation
the rich architectural heritage of India

definitions.definition_vi: rất thú vị và đa dạng

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.label: Meaning 7

a rich, well-drained soil
rich farming land
definitions.definition_vi: chứa các chất có lợi cho cây trồng trong

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: strong or deep; very beautiful or attractive

the rich sound of the organ
The wine gives the dish a wonderfully rich aroma.
definitions.definition_vi: mạnh mẽ hoặc sâu sắc; rất đẹp hoặc hấp dẫn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: expensive and beautiful
examples: SYNONYM sumptuous
The rooms were decorated with rich fabrics.
definitions.definition_vi: đắt tiền và đẹp

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used to say that a criticism somebody makes is surprising and not reasonable, because they have the same fault
examples: Me? Lazy? That's rich, coming from you!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng lời chỉ trích của ai đó là đáng ngạc nhiên và không hợp lý, bởi vì họ có lỗi giống nhau

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to get a lot of money, especially suddenly or unexpectedlyWord Origin
examples: Old English rīce ‘powerful, wealthy’, of Germanic origin, related to Dutch rijk and German reich; ultimately from Celtic; reinforced in Middle English by Old French riche ‘rich, powerful’.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được nhiều tiền, đặc biệt là đột ngột hoặc bất ngờNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the possibility of something bad happening at some time in the future; a situation that could be dangerous or have a bad result
examples: SEE ALSO high-risk
The health risks are very low.
a high risk of failure
a serious/significant risk of something
The study found a slightly increased risk of cancer in this group.
Steps have been taken to reduce the risk of any trouble.
Use filters or boil water to minimize the risk of infection.
Smoking can increase the risk of developing heart disease.
There is still a risk that the whole deal will fall through.
The chemicals pose little risk (= are not dangerous) to human health.
a calculated risk (= one that you think is small compared with the possible benefits)
Trying new things can be a gamble, but it's worth the risk.
Patients should be made aware of the risks involved with this treatment.
Make sure you understand the risks and benefits.
Cigarette smoking is a risk factor for this disease.
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng xảy ra điều gì đó tồi tệ vào một thời điểm nào đó trong tương lai; một tình huống có thể nguy hiểm hoặc có kết quả xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is likely to cause problems or danger at some time in the future
examples: SEE ALSO security risk
Those old boxes in the corridor are a fire risk.
a safety/health risk
The group was considered to be a risk to national security.
Pollutants in the river pose a real risk to the fish.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có khả năng gây ra vấn đề hoặc nguy hiểm vào một thời điểm nào đó trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or business that a bank or an insurance company is willing/unwilling to lend money or sell insurance to because they are likely/unlikely to pay back the money, etc.
examples: With five previous claims, he's now a bad insurance risk.
He's a good insurance risk.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc doanh nghiệp mà ngân hàng hoặc công ty bảo hiểm sẵn sàng/không muốn cho vay tiền hoặc bán bảo hiểm vì họ có khả năng/không có khả năng trả lại tiền, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: in danger of something unpleasant or harmful happening
examples: As with all diseases, certain groups will be more at risk than others.
If we go to war, innocent lives will be put at risk.
Journalists in the zone are at serious risk of being kidnapped.
Adults were also at risk from epidemics.
definitions.definition_vi: có nguy cơ xảy ra điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc có hại

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to introduce something that may sound stupid or may offend somebody
examples: At the risk of showing my ignorance, how exactly does the internet work?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu điều gì đó nghe có vẻ ngu ngốc hoặc có thể xúc phạm ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: with the possibility of harming yourself/somebody/something
examples: He dived in to save the dog at considerable risk to his own life.
He saved the child at considerable risk to himself.
definitions.definition_vi: với khả năng làm hại chính mình/ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to do something even though you have been warned about the possible dangers and will have to take responsibility for anything bad that happens
examples: Persons swimming beyond this point do so at their own risk (= on a notice).
Valuables are left at their owner's risk (= on a notice).
The building is unsafe—enter at your own risk.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó mặc dù bạn đã được cảnh báo về những nguy hiểm có thể xảy ra và sẽ phải chịu trách nhiệm về bất cứ điều gì xấu xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be or put yourself in a situation in which something bad could happen to you
examples: People who are overweight run a risk of a heart attack or stroke.

Investment is all about running risks.
definitions.definition_vi: ở hoặc đặt mình vào tình huống mà điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể xảy ra với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 9

definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó mặc dù bạn biết rằng điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể xảy ra

definitions.definition_vi: nếu ai đó chơi theo luật của họ hoặc bắt người khác chơi theo luật của họ, họ đặt ra điều kiện để kinh doanh hoặc có mối quan hệ

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to deal fairly and honestly with people
definitions.definition_vi: đối xử công bằng và trung thực với mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: the condition in which all members of society, including its political leaders, accept the authority of the law
examples: Democracy and the rule of law are yet to be firmly established in the country.
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng trong đó tất cả các thành viên của xã hội, bao gồm cả các nhà lãnh đạo chính trị, chấp nhận thẩm quyền của pháp luật

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: a practical method of doing or measuring something, usually based on past experience rather than on exact measurement
examples: As a rule of thumb, you should cook a chicken for 20 minutes for each pound of weight.
definitions.definition_vi: một phương pháp thực tế để làm hoặc đo lường một cái gì đó, thường dựa trên kinh nghiệm trong quá khứ hơn là đo lường chính xác

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: the standards of behaviour that most people accept or that actually operate in a particular area of life or business
definitions.definition_vi: các tiêu chuẩn hành vi mà hầu hết mọi người chấp nhận hoặc thực sự hoạt động trong một lĩnh vực cụ thể của cuộc sống hoặc kinh doanh

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to follow the rules of your job in a very strict way in order to cause delay, as a form of protest against your employer or your working conditions
examples: SEE ALSO work-to-rule
definitions.definition_vi: tuân theo các quy tắc công việc của bạn một cách rất nghiêm ngặt nhằm gây ra sự chậm trễ, như một hình thức phản đối người sử dụng lao động hoặc điều kiện làm việc của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the part of something that remains
examples: Take what you want and throw the rest away.
The country enjoys friendly relations with the rest of the world.
How would you like to spend the rest of the day?
I'm not doing this job for the rest of my life.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của cái gì đó còn lại

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the people or things that remain; the others
examples: The first question was difficult, but the rest were pretty easy.
Don't blame Alex. He's human, like the rest of us.
definitions.definition_vi: những người hoặc những thứ còn lại; những người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing after a period of activity
examples: SEE ALSO bed rest
I had a good night's rest.
We stopped for a well-earned rest.
to have/take a rest from all your hard work
Try to get some rest—you have a busy day tomorrow.
There are no matches tomorrow, which is a rest day, but the tournament resumes on Monday.
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian thư giãn, ngủ hoặc không làm gì sau một thời gian hoạt động

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an object that is used to support or hold something
examples: an armrest (= for example on a seat or chair)
definitions.definition_vi: một đối tượng được sử dụng để hỗ trợ hoặc giữ một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a period of silence between notes; a sign that shows a rest between notes
definitions.definition_vi: một khoảng im lặng giữa các nốt nhạc; một dấu hiệu cho thấy sự nghỉ ngơi giữa các nốt nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used at the end of a list to mean everything else that you might expect to be on the list
examples: He wants a big house and an expensive car and all the rest of it.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở cuối danh sách để chỉ mọi thứ khác mà bạn có thể mong đợi có trong danh sách

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that the actual amount or number of something is much higher than somebody has stated
examples: ‘It cost 250 pounds…’ ‘And the rest, and the rest!’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng số lượng hoặc số lượng thực tế của một cái gì đó cao hơn nhiều so với những gì ai đó đã tuyên bố

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: not moving
examples: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
definitions.definition_vi: không di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: dead and therefore free from trouble or worry. People say ‘at rest’ to avoid saying ‘dead’.
examples: She now lies at rest in the churchyard.
definitions.definition_vi: chết và do đó thoát khỏi rắc rối hay lo lắng. Người ta nói ‘nghỉ ngơi’ để tránh nói ‘chết’.

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to stop moving
examples: The car crashed through the barrier and came to rest in a field.
His eyes came to rest on Clara's face.
The ball rolled down the hill and came to rest against a tree.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: apart from that; considering other matters
examples: The book has some interesting passages about the author's childhood. For the rest, it is extremely dull.
definitions.definition_vi: ngoài điều đó ra; xem xét các vấn đề khác

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to stop talking about something because they are annoying you
examples: Give it a rest! You’ve been complaining all day.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó ngừng nói về điều gì đó vì họ đang làm phiền bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to stop doing something for a while
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng làm việc gì đó trong một thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to bury somebody. People say ‘to lay somebody to rest’ to avoid saying ‘to bury’ somebody.
examples: George was laid to rest beside his parents.
definitions.definition_vi: chôn cất ai đó. Người ta nói ‘đi chôn ai đó’ để tránh nói ‘chôn cất’ ai đó.

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to stop something by showing it is not true
examples: The announcement finally laid all the speculation about their future to rest.
definitions.definition_vi: ngăn chặn điều gì đó bằng cách cho thấy nó không đúng sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: used when somebody is complaining that they have a lot of work to do
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi ai đó phàn nàn rằng họ có rất nhiều việc phải làm

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to do or say something to make somebody stop worrying about something
examples: SYNONYM reassure
definitions.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để khiến ai đó ngừng lo lắng về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: used when you are telling a story to say that you do not need to tell the end of it, because everyone knows it alreadyWord Origin
examples: noun senses 3 to 5 Old English ræst, rest (noun), ræstan, restan (verb), of Germanic origin, from a root meaning ‘league’ or ‘mile’ (referring to a distance after which one rests). noun senses 1 to 2 late Middle English: from Old French reste (noun), rester (verb), from Latin restare ‘remain’, from re- ‘back’ + stare ‘to stand’.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn đang kể một câu chuyện để nói rằng bạn không cần kể phần cuối của nó, vì mọi người đều biết rồi. Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to limit the size, amount or range of something
examples: Speed is restricted to 30 mph in towns.
We restrict the number of students per class to ten.
Fog severely restricted visibility.
Having small children tends to restrict your freedom.
definitions.definition_vi: để giới hạn kích thước, số lượng hoặc phạm vi của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to stop somebody/something from moving or acting freely
examples: SYNONYM impede
The long skirt restricted her movements.
definitions.definition_vi: ngăn cản ai/cái gì di chuyển hoặc hành động tự do

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to control something with rules or laws
examples: Access to the club is restricted to members only.
definitions.definition_vi: để kiểm soát một cái gì đó với các quy tắc hoặc pháp luật

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to allow yourself or somebody to have only a limited amount of something or to do only a particular kind of activity
examples: I restrict myself to one cup of coffee a day.
Why don't you restrict yourself to setting down the facts?
I'm restricting myself to one glass of wine a day.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép bản thân hoặc ai đó chỉ có một số lượng hạn chế của một cái gì đó hoặc chỉ làm một loại hoạt động cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a thing that is caused or produced because of something else
examples: And did your intervention produce the desired result?
to yield/achieve a result
The company's failure was a direct result of bad management.
This book is the result of 25 years of research.
The end result (= the final one) of her hard work was a place at medical school.
He made one big mistake, and, as a result, lost his job.
She died as a result of her injuries.
The farm was flooded, with the result that the crop was lost.
He decided to get involved, with disastrous results.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều được gây ra hoặc được sản xuất vì cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the final score or the name of the winner in a sports event, competition, election, etc.
examples: the election results
The announcer was reading out the football results.
They will announce the result of the vote tonight.
definitions.definition_vi: tỷ số cuối cùng hoặc tên của người chiến thắng trong một sự kiện thể thao, cuộc thi, cuộc bầu cử, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a victory or a success
examples: We badly need to get a result from this match.
This was a great result for us.
He left. Result! (= used when you are happy something has happened)
definitions.definition_vi: một chiến thắng hay một thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the mark or grade you get in an exam or in a number of exams
examples: Have you had your results yet?
When do you get your exam results?
definitions.definition_vi: điểm hoặc điểm bạn đạt được trong một bài kiểm tra hoặc trong một số bài kiểm tra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the information that you get from a scientific test or piece of research
examples: Other research has yielded similar results.
The doctor will explain your blood test results.
a positive/negative test result
the results of a study
The results of our experiment indicate that environmental factors play a part.
The results obtained were compared with previous results.
definitions.definition_vi: thông tin mà bạn nhận được từ một bài kiểm tra khoa học hoặc một phần nghiên cứu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the information that you get from a computer search
examples: My search produced several thousand results.
The user can control how the search results are displayed.
the first page of search results
definitions.definition_vi: thông tin bạn nhận được từ tìm kiếm trên máy tính

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: things that are achieved successfully
examples: The project is beginning to show results.
a coach who knows how to get results from his players
For best results, defrost fully before use.
definitions.definition_vi: những điều đạt được thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the amount of profit or loss made by a business over a particular period of time
examples: Companies are required by law to report their financial results on a quarterly basis.
The company will publish its interim results (= before the final results are known) on Monday.
The corporation is expected to announce improved results for the last quarter.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền lãi hoặc lỗ mà doanh nghiệp kiếm được trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: if you resume an activity, or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after being interrupted
examples: to resume talks/negotiations
She resumed her career after an interval of six years.
The noise resumed, louder than before.
There is no sign of the peace talks resuming.
He got back in the car and resumed driving.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn tiếp tục một hoạt động hoặc nếu nó tiếp tục thì nó sẽ bắt đầu lại hoặc tiếp tục sau khi bị gián đoạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to go back to the seat or place that you had before
examples: He resumed his seat opposite her.
definitions.definition_vi: quay trở lại chỗ ngồi hoặc nơi mà bạn đã có trước đây

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having retired from work
examples: a retired doctor/teacher/officer/general
He is a recently retired judge.
Dad is retired now.
definitions.definition_vi: đã nghỉ việc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to come or go back from one place to another
examples: I waited a long time for him to return.
returning emigrants/exiles/refugees (= who are coming home after being away)
She's returning to Australia tomorrow after six months in Europe.
He had recently returned to this country after living in Spain.
I had to return to the store to look for my purse.
I returned from work to find the house empty.
People were returning home for the weekend.
definitions.definition_vi: đến hoặc quay lại từ nơi này đến nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to bring, give, put or send something back to somebody/something
examples: We had to return the hairdryer to the store because it was faulty.
I must return some books to the library.
The court ordered him to return the children to their mother.
Completed questionnaires should be returned to this address.
He refused to return our money.
I returned the letter unopened.
definitions.definition_vi: mang, đưa, đặt hoặc gửi cái gì đó lại cho ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to come back again
examples: SYNONYM reappear
The following day the pain returned.
There's a chance the cancer will return.
Confidence returned and prices started to rise.
The bad weather has returned with a vengeance.
definitions.definition_vi: quay lại lần nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to start discussing a subject you were discussing earlier, or doing an activity you were doing earlier
examples: He returns to this topic later in the report.
She looked up briefly then returned to her sewing.
The doctor may allow her to return to work next week.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu thảo luận về chủ đề bạn đang thảo luận trước đó hoặc thực hiện một hoạt động bạn đang làm trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to go back to a previous state
examples: Train services have returned to normal after the strike.
The land has returned to its natural state.
Many find returning to civilian life difficult.
definitions.definition_vi: quay trở lại trạng thái trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to do or give something to somebody because they have done or given the same to you first; to have the same feeling about somebody that they have about you
examples: to return a smile/gaze/greeting
If you assist people when they ask for help, it is more likely they will return the favour.
She phoned him several times but he was too busy to return her call.
It's time we returned their invitation (= invite them to something as they invited us first).
You were both wonderful!’ ‘So were you!’ we said, returning the compliment.
to return a kiss (= to kiss somebody with the same enthusiasm with which they kiss you)
He did not return her love.
to return fire (= to shoot at somebody who is shooting at you)
definitions.definition_vi: làm hoặc đưa cái gì đó cho ai đó vì họ đã làm hoặc đưa điều tương tự cho bạn trước; có cùng cảm giác về ai đó như họ có về bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to hit the ball back to your opponent during a game
examples: to return a service/shot
definitions.definition_vi: để đánh bóng lại cho đối thủ của bạn trong một trò chơi

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to give a decision about something in court
examples: The jury returned a verdict of not guilty.
The inquest returned a verdict of accidental death.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa ra quyết định về điều gì đó tại tòa án

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to elect somebody to a political position
examples: She was returned as MP for Edgbaston in the last election.
He was returned to Parliament with an increased majority.
definitions.definition_vi: bầu ai đó vào một vị trí chính trị

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to give or produce a particular amount of money as a profit or loss
examples: to return a high rate of interest
Last year the company returned a loss of £157 million.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp hoặc tạo ra một số tiền cụ thể dưới dạng lãi hoặc lỗ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the money that a government receives from taxes or that an organization, etc. receives from its business
examples: SYNONYM receipt
The government is currently facing a shortfall in tax revenue.
Advertising revenue finances the commercial television channels.
a slump in oil revenues
The company's annual revenues rose by 30%.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền mà chính phủ nhận được từ thuế hoặc số tiền mà một tổ chức, v.v. nhận được từ hoạt động kinh doanh của mình

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to change something completely so that it is the opposite of what it was before
examples: Falling birth rates may reverse the trend towards early retirement.
to reverse a procedure/process
The government has failed to reverse the economic decline.
It is sometimes possible to arrest or reverse the disease.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi một cái gì đó hoàn toàn để nó trái ngược với những gì nó đã có trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to change a previous decision, law, etc. to the opposite one
examples: SYNONYM revoke
The Court of Appeal reversed the decision.
The policy is likely to be reversed if there is a change of government.
to reverse a judgement
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi một quyết định, luật, v.v. trước đó thành một quyết định ngược lại

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to turn something the opposite way around or change the order of something around
examples: Writing is reversed in a mirror.
You should reverse the order of these pages.
To solve the puzzle, simply reverse the order of the numbers.
definitions.definition_vi: xoay chuyển cái gì đó theo hướng ngược lại hoặc thay đổi thứ tự của cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to exchange the positions or functions of two things
examples: It felt as if we had reversed our roles of parent and child.
She used to work for me, but our situations are now reversed.
definitions.definition_vi: để trao đổi vị trí hoặc chức năng của hai điều

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to admit you were wrong or to stop having a particular position in an argument
examples: He has reversed himself on a dozen issues.
definitions.definition_vi: thừa nhận bạn đã sai hoặc ngừng có một vị trí cụ thể trong một cuộc tranh luận

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: when a vehicle or its driver reverses or the driver reverses a vehicle, the vehicle goes backwards
examples: COMPARE back
He reversed around the corner.
She reversed into a parking space.
Caution! This truck is reversing.
Now reverse the car.
definitions.definition_vi: khi xe hoặc người lái xe lùi hoặc người lái xe lùi xe thì xe đi lùi

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: correct for a particular situation or thing, or for a particular person
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
Have you got the right money (= the exact amount) for the bus fare?
What's the right way to do this?
You're not holding it the right way up.
Are you sure you've got that on the right way round?
This is a step in the right direction.
Next time we'll get it right.
She's definitely the right person for the job.
I'm glad you split up. She wasn't right for you.
I was waiting for the right moment to ask him.
I think we made the right decision.
definitions.definition_vi: đúng cho một tình huống hoặc sự việc cụ thể, hoặc cho một người cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: morally good or acceptable; correct according to law or a person’s duty
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
I hope we're doing the right thing.
I don't know, it just doesn't seem right.
On some level this just feels right.
You were quite right to criticize him.
It's only right to warn you of the risk.
It's right that he should be punished.
definitions.definition_vi: tốt về mặt đạo đức hoặc chấp nhận được; đúng theo pháp luật hoặc nghĩa vụ của một người

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in a normal or good enough condition
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
I don't feel quite right today (= I feel ill).
Things aren't right between her parents.
If only I could have helped put matters right.
That sausage doesn't smell right.
The meat doesn't taste right to me.
We talk about the reasons why something doesn't look right.
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình trạng bình thường hoặc đủ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: socially fashionable or important
examples: She knows all the right people (= for example, people who can help her in her career).
They make sure that their children go to the right schools.
I wore the best clothes and was seen in all the right places.
definitions.definition_vi: xã hội thời trang hoặc quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: of, on or towards the side of the body that is towards the east when a person faces north
examples: OPPOSITE left
your right hand/arm/foot/leg
My right eye is weaker than my left eye.
Keep on the right side of the road.
Take a right turn at the intersection.
definitions.definition_vi: của, trên hoặc về phía bên của cơ thể hướng về phía đông khi một người quay mặt về phía bắc

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something bad
examples: You made a right mess of that!
I felt a right idiot.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come
examples: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
definitions.definition_vi: biết tận dụng các cơ hội khi chúng đến

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to start a relationship well/badly
examples: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tốt/xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó hài lòng với bạn/khó chịu với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody is willing to give up a lot in order to have or do something that they really want
examples: I'd have given my right arm to have been there with them.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó sẵn sàng từ bỏ rất nhiều để có được hoặc làm điều gì đó mà họ thực sự muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be a sensible person
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một người nhạy cảm

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to have found a very good or successful way of living, doing something, etc.
examples: He's certainly got the right idea—retiring at 55.
The party had the right idea, but failed to win over the voters.
definitions.definition_vi: đã tìm ra một cách sống, làm việc gì đó rất tốt hoặc thành công, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody’s intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ý định của ai đó là tốt bụng và chân thành mặc dù đôi khi họ làm điều sai trái

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
examples: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
definitions.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp cho một dịp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: (not) mentally normal
examples: Who in their right mind would want to marry a murderer?
definitions.definition_vi: (không) tinh thần bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: having the power to do something gives you the right to do it
examples: Their foreign policy is based on the principle that ‘might is right’.
definitions.definition_vi: có sức mạnh để làm điều gì đó cho bạn quyền làm điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
definitions.definition_vi: trẻ hơn hoặc lớn hơn 40, 50, v.v. tuổi

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
examples: We haven’t found a cure yet—but we are on the right track.
The new manager successfully got the team back onto the right track.
The police were on the wrong track when they treated the case as a revenge killing.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc hành xử đúng/sai

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to do exactly the right things to please somebody
examples: a new satirical comedy show that pushes all the right buttons
definitions.definition_vi: làm chính xác những điều đúng đắn để làm hài lòng ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: in excellent health or condition
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình trạng sức khỏe hoặc tình trạng tuyệt vời

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: certainly; in a way that cannot be denied
examples: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn; theo một cách không thể phủ nhận

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: used to express strong approval or support
examples: SEE ALSO right-on
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự chấp thuận hoặc hỗ trợ mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
examples: OPPOSITE upside down
I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
definitions.definition_vi: với phần trên quay lên trên; ở đúng vị trí bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: used to say that everything will be all right, even if there is a problem now
definitions.definition_vi: từng nói rằng mọi thứ sẽ ổn thôi, ngay cả khi bây giờ có vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: used to say that there is no doubt about something
examples: ‘We need to stick together.’ ‘Too right!’
‘I'll have to do it again.’ ‘Too right you will.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng không có nghi ngờ gì về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a situation in which a group of people behave in a violent way in a public place, often as a protest
examples: SEE ALSO race riot
One prison guard was killed when a riot broke out in the jail.
He was killed in the riots.
Shortages eventually led to food riots.
definitions.definition_vi: tình huống trong đó một nhóm người cư xử một cách bạo lực ở nơi công cộng, thường là để phản đối

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a collection of a lot of different types of the same thing
examples: The garden was a riot of colour.
The market was a riot of unfamiliar sounds and smells.
A riot of emotions raged through her.
definitions.definition_vi: một bộ sưu tập của rất nhiều loại khác nhau của cùng một thứ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a person or an event that is very funny
examples: The movie is a laugh riot.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc một sự kiện rất buồn cười

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to tell somebody with force that they must not do something
definitions.definition_vi: dùng vũ lực để nói với ai đó rằng họ không được làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to behave in a way that is violent and/or not under control
examples: SYNONYM rampage
They let their kids run riot.
Local youths ran riot after the attack.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách bạo lực và/hoặc không kiểm soát được

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: if your imagination, a feeling, etc. runs riot, you allow it to develop and continue without trying to control it
examples: An artist must learn to let his imagination run riot.
These prejudices have been allowed to run riot for too long.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu trí tưởng tượng, một cảm giác, v.v. của bạn nổi loạn, bạn cho phép nó phát triển và tiếp tục mà không cố gắng kiểm soát nó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to grow and spread quicklyWord Origin
examples: Middle English (originally in the sense ‘dissolute living’): from Old French riote ‘debate’, from rioter ‘to quarrel’, of unknown ultimate origin.
definitions.definition_vi: để phát triển và lan truyền nhanh chóngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to tear something or to become torn, often suddenly or violently
examples: I ripped my jeans on the fence.
The flags had been ripped in two.
The nail ripped a hole in my jacket.
I heard the tent rip.
She ripped the letter open.
definitions.definition_vi: xé cái gì đó hoặc bị rách, thường đột ngột hoặc dữ dội

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to remove something quickly or violently, often by pulling it
examples: He ripped off his tie.
The carpet had been ripped from the stairs.
Half of the house was ripped away in the explosion.
definitions.definition_vi: loại bỏ một cái gì đó một cách nhanh chóng hoặc bạo lực, thường bằng cách kéo nó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to copy sound or video files from a website or CD on to a computer
definitions.definition_vi: để sao chép các tập tin âm thanh hoặc video từ một trang web hoặc CD vào máy tính

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to change text or images into a form in which they can be displayed on a screen or printed
definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi văn bản hoặc hình ảnh thành dạng có thể hiển thị trên màn hình hoặc in

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to go or allow something such as a car to go as fast as possible
examples: Once on the open road, he let rip.
Come on Steve—let her rip.
definitions.definition_vi: đi hoặc cho phép một cái gì đó như một chiếc xe đi càng nhanh càng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to do something or to allow something to happen as fast as possible
examples: This would cause inflation to let rip again.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó hoặc cho phép điều gì đó xảy ra càng nhanh càng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to speak or do something with great force, enthusiasm, etc. and without control
examples: When she gets angry with her boyfriend, she really lets rip at him.
The group let rip with a single from their new album.
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó với sức mạnh lớn, sự nhiệt tình, vv và không có sự kiểm soát

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to destroy something; to criticize somebody very strongly
examples: countries ripped apart by fighting
The dog had ripped a cushion to shreds.
definitions.definition_vi: phá hủy một cái gì đó; chỉ trích ai đó một cách rất mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to destroy the most important part or aspect of something
examples: Closing the factory tore the heart out of the community.
definitions.definition_vi: phá hủy phần hoặc khía cạnh quan trọng nhất của cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to attack somebody very violentlyWord Origin
examples: verb late Middle English (as a verb): of unknown origin; compare with the verb reap. The noun dates from the early 18th cent.
definitions.definition_vi: tấn công ai đó rất dữ dộiNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to come or go upwards; to reach a higher level or position
examples: The curtain rose to reveal an empty stage.
Smoke was rising from the chimney.
The river has risen by several metres.
A stream of bubbles rose to the surface.
The flood waters were rising fast.
definitions.definition_vi: đến hoặc đi lên; để đạt đến một mức độ cao hơn hoặc vị trí

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to increase in amount or number
examples: Prices are still rising.
rising fuel bills
The price of gas rose.
Gas rose in price.
The shares have risen in value.
Global temperatures could rise three degrees or more.
Unemployment rose by 3 per cent.
Interest rates rose to a six-year high.
to rise sharply/dramatically/rapidly/steeply
to rise steadily/slightly
We are seeing a rising tide of online crime (= a large increase in it).
definitions.definition_vi: tăng về số lượng hoặc số lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: when the sun, moon, etc. rises, it appears above the horizon
examples: OPPOSITE set
The sun rises in the east.
It was almost dark and the moon was just rising.
definitions.definition_vi: khi mặt trời, mặt trăng, v.v. mọc lên, nó xuất hiện phía trên đường chân trời

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to become more successful, important, powerful, etc.
examples: a rising young politician
He rose to prominence in the 90s.
to rise to fame/power
You could rise to the top if you work hard.
He rose to the rank of general.
She has risen to a position of great responsibility.
She rose through the ranks to become managing director.
definitions.definition_vi: để trở nên thành công hơn, quan trọng hơn, mạnh mẽ hơn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to get up from a lying, sitting or kneeling position
examples: SYNONYM get up
He was accustomed to rising (= getting out of bed) early.
They rose from the table.
She rose to her feet.
definitions.definition_vi: đứng dậy từ tư thế nằm, ngồi hoặc quỳ

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to end a meeting
examples: SYNONYM adjourn
The House (= members of the House of Commons) rose at 10 p.m.
definitions.definition_vi: kết thúc một cuộc họp

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: if a sound rises, it becomes louder and higher
examples: Her voice rose angrily.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu âm thanh tăng lên, nó sẽ to hơn và cao hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: if the wind rises, it begins to blow more strongly
examples: SYNONYM get up
The wind is rising—I think there's a storm coming.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu gió nổi lên thì nó bắt đầu thổi mạnh hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: if a feeling rises inside you, it begins and gets stronger
examples: He felt anger rising inside him.
Her spirits rose (= she felt happier) at the news.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một cảm giác trỗi dậy trong bạn, nó sẽ bắt đầu và trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: if your colour rises, your face becomes pink or red because you are embarrassed
definitions.definition_vi: nếu sắc mặt của bạn tăng lên, mặt bạn sẽ hồng lên hoặc đỏ bừng vì bạn xấu hổ

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: if hair rises, it stands up instead of lying flat
examples: The hair on the back of my neck rose when I heard the scream.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu tóc dựng đứng lên thay vì nằm thẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to begin to fight against your government or leader or against a foreign army
examples: The peasants rose in revolt.
He called on the people to rise up against the invaders.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu chiến đấu chống lại chính phủ hoặc lãnh đạo của bạn hoặc chống lại quân đội nước ngoài

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be able to be seen above everything that is around
examples: Mountains rose in the distance.
definitions.definition_vi: để có thể được nhìn thấy trên tất cả mọi thứ xung quanh

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: if land rises, it slopes upwards
examples: The ground rose steeply all around.
Behind the house the ground rises steeply to the north.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu đất dâng lên, nó dốc lên

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: a river rises where it begins to flow
examples: The Thames rises in the Cotswold hills.
definitions.definition_vi: một dòng sông dâng lên nơi nó bắt đầu chảy

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: when bread, cakes, etc. rise, they become larger and rounder because of the action of yeast or baking powder
definitions.definition_vi: khi bánh mì, bánh ngọt, v.v. nở ra, chúng trở nên to và tròn hơn do tác động của men hoặc bột nở

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to come to life again
examples: to rise from the dead
Can a new party rise from the ashes of the old one?
definitions.definition_vi: để sống lại

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to stand straight and tall in order to show that you are determined, powerful or important
examples: He drew himself up to his full height and glared at us.
definitions.definition_vi: đứng thẳng và cao để thể hiện rằng bạn quyết tâm, mạnh mẽ hoặc quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: somebody feels so angry about something that they feel physically sick
definitions.definition_vi: ai đó cảm thấy rất tức giận về điều gì đó mà họ cảm thấy mệt mỏi về thể xác

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to become angry
examples: Ben felt his hackles rise as the speaker continued.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: usually used in orders to tell somebody to get out of bed and be active
definitions.definition_vi: thường được sử dụng để bảo ai đó ra khỏi giường và hoạt động tích cực
