definitions.definition_vi: một buổi lễ liên quan đến việc kiểm tra chính thức binh lính, v.v. bởi một vị khách quan trọngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a thing that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, etc.
examples: a financial reward
a reward for good behaviour
You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
Winning the match was just reward for the effort the team had made.
They're playing the game more for the love of sport than for financial reward.
The company is now reaping the rewards of their investments.
Top corporate jobs are not without their rewards.
The appointment was widely seen as a reward for his loyalty.
definitions.definition_vi: một thứ mà bạn được tặng vì bạn đã làm điều gì đó tốt, làm việc chăm chỉ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an amount of money that is offered to somebody for helping the police to find a criminal or for finding something that is lost
examples: A £100 reward has been offered for the return of the necklace.
Anyone wanting to claim the reward should contact the city police.
definitions.definition_vi: một số tiền được trao cho ai đó để giúp cảnh sát tìm ra tội phạm hoặc tìm kiếm thứ gì đó bị mất

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the reward for acting in a moral or correct way is the knowledge that you have done so, and you should not expect more than this, for example praise from other people or paymentWord Origin
examples: Middle English: from Anglo-Norman French, variant of Old French reguard ‘regard, heed’, also an early sense of the English word.
definitions.definition_vi: phần thưởng cho hành động có đạo đức hoặc đúng đắn là sự hiểu biết mà bạn đã làm như vậy và bạn không nên mong đợi nhiều hơn điều này, chẳng hạn như lời khen ngợi từ người khác hoặc khoản thanh toánNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: speech or writing that is intended to influence people, but that is not completely honest or sincere
examples: the rhetoric of political slogans
Her speech was just empty rhetoric.
His speech was dismissed as mere rhetoric by the opposition.
definitions.definition_vi: lời nói hoặc văn bản nhằm mục đích gây ảnh hưởng đến mọi người nhưng không hoàn toàn trung thực hoặc chân thành

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the art of using language in speech or writing in a special way that influences or entertains people
examples: SYNONYM eloquence
definitions.definition_vi: nghệ thuật sử dụng ngôn ngữ trong lời nói hoặc viết theo cách đặc biệt để gây ảnh hưởng hoặc giải trí cho mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: short, narrow white or brown grain grown on wet land in hot countries as food; the plant that produces this grain
examples: SEE ALSO jollof rice
a grain of rice
boiled/steamed/fried rice
long-/short-grain rice
sticky/basmati/wild rice
brown rice (= without its outer layer removed)
rice paddies (= rice fields)
a spicy rice dish
rice flour/noodles/cakes
There is no need to keep the rice field flooded.
The dish is served with rice.
definitions.definition_vi: hạt ngắn, hẹp màu trắng hoặc nâu trồng trên đất ẩm ở các nước nóng để làm thực phẩm; nhà máy sản xuất loại ngũ cốc này

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be free of somebody/something that has been annoying you or that you do not want
examples: She wanted to be rid of her parents and their authority.
I was glad to be rid of the car when I finally sold it.
He was a nuisance and we're all well rid of him (= we'll be much better without him).
definitions.definition_vi: thoát khỏi ai đó/điều gì đó khiến bạn khó chịu hoặc điều gì đó mà bạn không muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make yourself free of somebody/something that is annoying you or that you do not want; to throw something away
examples: Try and get rid of your visitors before I get there.
The problem is getting rid of nuclear waste.
I can't get rid of this headache.
We got rid of all the old furniture.
definitions.definition_vi: thoát khỏi ai đó/điều gì đó làm bạn khó chịu hoặc bạn không muốn; vứt cái gì đó đi

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to want to be free of somebody/something that has been annoying you or that you do not want
examples: Are you trying to say you want rid of me?
definitions.definition_vi: muốn thoát khỏi ai đó/điều gì đó đã làm phiền bạn hoặc điều gì đó bạn không muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to sit on an animal, especially a horse, and control it as it moves
examples: PAST TENSE OF ride
I learnt to ride as a child.
They rode along narrow country lanes.
He was riding on a large black horse.
He rode fifty miles on horseback.
to ride a horse
to ride a pony/ donkey/camel
She had never ridden a horse before.
He's ridden six winners so far this year (= in horse racing).
definitions.definition_vi: ngồi trên một con vật, đặc biệt là một con ngựa, và kiểm soát nó khi nó di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to spend time riding a horse for pleasure
examples: How often do you go riding?
definitions.definition_vi: dành thời gian cưỡi ngựa cho vui

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to sit on and control a bicycle, motorcycle, etc.
examples: The boys were riding their bikes around the streets.
He rode a Harley Davidson.
It 's like riding a bicycle: one day you can't and the next day you can.
The ground there is too rough to ride over.
definitions.definition_vi: ngồi lên và điều khiển xe đạp, xe máy, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to travel in a vehicle, especially as a passenger
examples: SEE ALSO park and ride
I walked back while the others rode in the car.
to ride a train/the subway/an elevator
She rode the bus to school every day.
definitions.definition_vi: đi du lịch trong một chiếc xe, đặc biệt là một hành khách

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to float or be supported on water or air
examples: We watched the balloon riding high above the fields.
The ship was riding at anchor in the harbour.
surfers riding the waves
A large bird was riding the air currents beneath it.
definitions.definition_vi: nổi hoặc được hỗ trợ trên mặt nước hoặc không khí

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to go through or over an area on a horse, bicycle, etc.
examples: We rode the mountain trails.
definitions.definition_vi: đi qua hoặc vượt qua một khu vực bằng ngựa, xe đạp, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to criticize or tease somebody in an annoying way
examples: Why is everybody riding me today?
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ trích hoặc trêu chọc ai đó một cách khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be doing something that involves risks and that may end in disaster
definitions.definition_vi: đang làm điều gì đó có liên quan đến rủi ro và điều đó có thể kết thúc trong thảm họa

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be successful or very confident
examples: The company is riding high this year.
definitions.definition_vi: thành công hoặc rất tự tin

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: wishing for something does not make it happen
definitions.definition_vi: mong muốn một cái gì đó không làm cho nó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to decide to do nothing about a problem that you know you may have to deal with later
examples: He was rude to me but I let it ride this time.
definitions.definition_vi: quyết định không làm gì về một vấn đề mà bạn biết sau này bạn có thể phải giải quyết

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to enjoy great success or support because of a particular situation or event
examples: The band is riding the crest of its last tour.
definitions.definition_vi: để tận hưởng thành công lớn hoặc hỗ trợ vì một tình huống hoặc sự kiện cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to keep watch or control over somebody/something
examples: police riding herd on crowds of youths on the streets
definitions.definition_vi: để theo dõi hoặc kiểm soát ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to treat somebody badly and not worry about their feelings
definitions.definition_vi: đối xử tệ với ai đó và không lo lắng về cảm xúc của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to ride in the front passenger seat of a car or truck
definitions.definition_vi: ngồi ở ghế hành khách phía trước của ô tô hoặc xe tải

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to enjoy or be supported by the particular situation or quality mentioned
examples: Schools are riding a wave of renewed public interest.
definitions.definition_vi: để tận hưởng hoặc được hỗ trợ bởi tình hình hoặc chất lượng cụ thể được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: true or correct as a fact
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
Did you get the answer right?
‘What's the right time?’ ‘10.37.’
That's exactly right.
‘David, isn't it?’ ‘Yes, that's right.’
It was Monday you went to see Angie, right?
Let me get this right (= understand correctly)—you want us to do an extra ten hours' work for no extra pay?
definitions.definition_vi: đúng hoặc chính xác như một thực tế

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: correct in your opinion or judgement
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
You were quite right about the weather.
They're absolutely right to be cautious.
‘It's not easy.’ ‘Yeah, you're right.’
Am I right in thinking we've met before?
History has proved him right.
He never gets anything right.
definitions.definition_vi: đúng theo ý kiến ​​hoặc đánh giá của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: correct for a particular situation or thing, or for a particular person
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
Have you got the right money (= the exact amount) for the bus fare?
What's the right way to do this?
You're not holding it the right way up.
Are you sure you've got that on the right way round?
This is a step in the right direction.
Next time we'll get it right.
She's definitely the right person for the job.
I'm glad you split up. She wasn't right for you.
I was waiting for the right moment to ask him.
I think we made the right decision.
definitions.definition_vi: đúng cho một tình huống hoặc sự việc cụ thể, hoặc cho một người cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: morally good or acceptable; correct according to law or a person’s duty
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
I hope we're doing the right thing.
I don't know, it just doesn't seem right.
On some level this just feels right.
You were quite right to criticize him.
It's only right to warn you of the risk.
It's right that he should be punished.
definitions.definition_vi: tốt về mặt đạo đức hoặc chấp nhận được; đúng theo pháp luật hoặc nghĩa vụ của một người

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: in a normal or good enough condition
examples: OPPOSITE wrong
I don't feel quite right today (= I feel ill).
Things aren't right between her parents.
If only I could have helped put matters right.
That sausage doesn't smell right.
The meat doesn't taste right to me.
We talk about the reasons why something doesn't look right.
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình trạng bình thường hoặc đủ tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: socially fashionable or important
examples: She knows all the right people (= for example, people who can help her in her career).
They make sure that their children go to the right schools.
I wore the best clothes and was seen in all the right places.
definitions.definition_vi: xã hội thời trang hoặc quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: of, on or towards the side of the body that is towards the east when a person faces north
examples: OPPOSITE left
your right hand/arm/foot/leg
My right eye is weaker than my left eye.
Keep on the right side of the road.
Take a right turn at the intersection.
definitions.definition_vi: của, trên hoặc về phía bên của cơ thể hướng về phía đông khi một người quay mặt về phía bắc

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to emphasize something bad
examples: You made a right mess of that!
I felt a right idiot.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come
examples: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
definitions.definition_vi: biết tận dụng các cơ hội khi chúng đến

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to start a relationship well/badly
examples: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tốt/xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó hài lòng với bạn/khó chịu với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody is willing to give up a lot in order to have or do something that they really want
examples: I'd have given my right arm to have been there with them.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó sẵn sàng từ bỏ rất nhiều để có được hoặc làm điều gì đó mà họ thực sự muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to be a sensible person
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một người nhạy cảm

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to have found a very good or successful way of living, doing something, etc.
examples: He's certainly got the right idea—retiring at 55.
The party had the right idea, but failed to win over the voters.
definitions.definition_vi: đã tìm ra một cách sống, làm việc gì đó rất tốt hoặc thành công, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: used to say that somebody’s intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ý định của ai đó là tốt bụng và chân thành mặc dù đôi khi họ làm điều sai trái

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
examples: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
definitions.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp cho một dịp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: (not) mentally normal
examples: Who in their right mind would want to marry a murderer?
definitions.definition_vi: (không) tinh thần bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: having the power to do something gives you the right to do it
examples: Their foreign policy is based on the principle that ‘might is right’.
definitions.definition_vi: có sức mạnh để làm điều gì đó cho bạn quyền làm điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
definitions.definition_vi: trẻ hơn hoặc lớn hơn 40, 50, v.v. tuổi

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
examples: We haven’t found a cure yet—but we are on the right track.
The new manager successfully got the team back onto the right track.
The police were on the wrong track when they treated the case as a revenge killing.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc hành xử đúng/sai

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to do exactly the right things to please somebody
examples: a new satirical comedy show that pushes all the right buttons
definitions.definition_vi: làm chính xác những điều đúng đắn để làm hài lòng ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: in excellent health or condition
definitions.definition_vi: trong tình trạng sức khỏe hoặc tình trạng tuyệt vời

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: certainly; in a way that cannot be denied
examples: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn; theo một cách không thể phủ nhận

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: used to express strong approval or support
examples: SEE ALSO right-on
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự chấp thuận hoặc hỗ trợ mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
examples: OPPOSITE upside down
I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
definitions.definition_vi: với phần trên quay lên trên; ở đúng vị trí bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: used to say that everything will be all right, even if there is a problem now
definitions.definition_vi: từng nói rằng mọi thứ sẽ ổn thôi, ngay cả khi bây giờ có vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: used to say that there is no doubt about something
examples: ‘We need to stick together.’ ‘Too right!’
‘I'll have to do it again.’ ‘Too right you will.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng không có nghi ngờ gì về điều gì đó

definitions.definition_vi: để nói điều gì đó quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 39
definitions.definition: to refuse an offer, a suggestion, etc.
examples: If you don't invest in this, you're saying no to a potential fortune.

definitions.label: Meaning 40

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn hiểu chính xác điều ai đó muốn nói hoặc đang muốn nói, nên không cần thiết phải nói thêm gì nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 41

definitions.definition_vi: để nói chính xác những gì bạn cảm thấy hoặc suy nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 43

definitions.label: Meaning 44

definitions.definition_vi: ra lệnh; để thực hiện một yêu cầu

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để gợi ý rằng mặc dù bạn có thể nói nhiều hơn nhưng những gì bạn nói sẽ đủ để giải thích ý của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 46

definitions.definition_vi: nói cách khác

definitions.label: Meaning 47
definitions.definition: used to introduce an opinion that makes what you have just said seem less strong

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó không có gì bất thường hay đặc biệt

definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không thể đoán trước được điều gì có thể xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 52

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu thêm một sự thật hoặc sự vật ngoài những điều đã được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 53

definitions.definition_vi: Tôi đồng ý hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 54

definitions.definition_vi: bạn có muốn cái gì/làm cái gì không?

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đồng ý với đề nghị của ai đó vì bạn không muốn tranh cãi

definitions.definition_vi: một người cụ thể phải được tuân theo

definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng không ai biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi

definitions.label: Meaning 59
definitions.definition: used to disagree with a statement or an opinion
examples: Who says I can't do it?

definitions.label: Meaning 60
definitions.definition: used to say that something might happen or might have happened in a particular way, because nobody really knows
examples: Who's to say we would not have succeeded if we'd had more time?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có thể xảy ra hoặc có thể đã xảy ra theo một cách cụ thể, bởi vì không ai thực sự biết

definitions.label: Meaning 61

definitions.definition_vi: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 62
definitions.definition: used to say that you think the offer you are making is reasonable or generous

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ lời đề nghị bạn đưa ra là hợp lý hoặc hào phóng

definitions.label: Meaning 63

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 64

Come and say hello.
Please say yes!

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra một ý kiến ​​làm cho điều bạn vừa nói có vẻ kém thuyết phục hơn

To reserve a seat, visit our website.
There are no seats left on that flight.
Airlines often give great deals to fill empty seats.
We had excellent seats for the show, on the third row.
definitions.definition_vi: một nơi mà bạn phải trả tiền để ngồi trên máy bay, xe lửa, rạp hát, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5

a seat on the city council/in Parliament/in Congress
Republicans currently hold 51 seats in the Senate.
The majority of seats on the board will be held by business representatives.
The party won 32 seats in the recent elections.
Several ministers are in danger of losing their seats.
to take your seat (= to begin your duties, especially in Parliament)
One vote could make all the difference in the highly marginal seat of Crawley.
definitions.definition_vi: một vị trí chính thức như một thành viên của quốc hội, hội đồng, ủy ban, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: For the first two years of her life she lived at Ickworth, the family seat in Sussex.
definitions.definition_vi: một ngôi nhà lớn ở nông thôn thuộc về một thành viên của tầng lớp thượng lưu

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the part of the body on which a person sits
examples: SYNONYM bottom (6)
definitions.definition_vi: bộ phận cơ thể mà một người ngồi

definitions.label: Meaning 9

definitions.definition_vi: phần của chiếc quần che chỗ ngồi của một người

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to have an advantage over other people or be in control of a situation
examples: Canada is in the catbird seat as an energy powerhouse.
definitions.definition_vi: để có lợi thế hơn người khác hoặc kiểm soát được một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be the person in control of a situation
definitions.definition_vi: là người kiểm soát một tình huống

definitions.label: Meaning 12

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ số lượng người tham dự một buổi biểu diễn, buổi nói chuyện, v.v., đặc biệt khi nhấn mạnh sự cần thiết hoặc mong muốn thu hút một lượng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to act without careful thought and without a plan that you have made in advance, hoping that you will be lucky and be successful
examples: SYNONYM wing it
definitions.definition_vi: hành động mà không suy nghĩ cẩn thận và không có kế hoạch đã lập trước, hy vọng rằng mình sẽ may mắn và thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: very excited and giving your full attention to something

definitions.definition_vi: rất vui mừng và dành toàn bộ sự chú ý của bạn vào một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to allow somebody else to play a more active and important role in a particular situation than you do
examples: Many managers take a back seat and leave recruitment to specialists.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép người khác đóng vai trò tích cực và quan trọng hơn bạn trong một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1

the service/banking/manufacturing/financial sector
jobs in the agricultural sector

the privileged sectors of society
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của một lĩnh vực hoạt động, đặc biệt là nền kinh tế của một quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a part of a particular area, especially an area under military control
examples: each sector of the war zone

definitions.definition_vi: một phần của một khu vực cụ thể, đặc biệt là một khu vực dưới sự kiểm soát của quân đội

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a part of a circle lying between two straight lines drawn from the centre to the edgeWord Origin

definitions.definition_vi: một phần của vòng tròn nằm giữa hai đường thẳng vẽ từ tâm đến cạnhNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not connected with spiritual or religious matters

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: sống giữa những người bình thường hơn là trong một cộng đồng tôn giáoNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to obtain or achieve something, especially when this means using a lot of effort

She secured 2 000 votes.
The delegation has secured the promise of a ceasefire.
A production company secured the film rights to the biography.
They are contract workers unable to secure a full-time position.
Retailers will need to pay a higher price in order to secure supplies.
He secured a place for himself at law school.
He secured himself a place at law school.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi điều này có nghĩa là sử dụng rất nhiều nỗ lực

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to attach or fasten something so that it does not move
examples: She secured the rope firmly to the back of the car.
He secured the boat with a rope.
The tables on board were secured firmly to the floor.
definitions.definition_vi: gắn hoặc buộc chặt một cái gì đó để nó không di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to protect something so that it is safe and difficult to attack or damage

a savings plan that will secure your child’s future
We must all do everything we can to secure our borders.
The windows were secured with locks and bars.
definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ một cái gì đó để nó được an toàn và khó bị tấn công hoặc thiệt hại

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: a loan secured on the house
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý một cách hợp pháp để đưa cho ai đó tài sản hoặc hàng hóa có giá trị tương đương với số tiền mà bạn đã mượn từ họ, nếu bạn không thể trả lại số tiền đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the activities involved in protecting a country, building or person against attack, danger, etc.

national/homeland security (= the defence of a country)
airport security officers
The bars are to provide security against break-ins.
They carried out security checks at the airport.
Passwords are a very important security measure.
The visit took place amidst tight security (= the use of many police officers).
the security forces/services (= the police, army, etc.)
a high/maximum security prison (= for dangerous criminals)
a security alert/threat/situation
a security adviser/expert
The criminals were caught (= filmed) on a security video.
to tighten/improve/enhance security
The team abandoned its tour due to security concerns.
The two countries agreed to work together to strengthen border security.
We will protect our national security.
definitions.definition_vi: các hoạt động liên quan đến việc bảo vệ một đất nước, xây dựng hoặc con người chống lại sự tấn công, nguy hiểm, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a place at an airport where you go after your passport has been checked so that officials can find out if you are carrying illegal drugs or weapons
examples: My bag was emptied and searched when I went through security.
It took ages to clear security and reach the departure lounge.
Airport security might decide you're unfit to fly.
definitions.definition_vi: một địa điểm tại sân bay nơi bạn đến sau khi hộ chiếu của bạn đã được kiểm tra để các quan chức có thể tìm hiểu xem bạn có mang theo ma túy hoặc vũ khí bất hợp pháp hay không

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the department of a large company or organization that deals with the protection of its buildings, equipment and staff
examples: Security was/were called to the incident.
definitions.definition_vi: bộ phận của một công ty hoặc tổ chức lớn có nhiệm vụ bảo vệ các tòa nhà, thiết bị và nhân viên của mình

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: protection against something bad that might happen in the future
examples: SEE ALSO food security
financial security

This system provides basic security for employees.
definitions.definition_vi: bảo vệ chống lại điều gì đó xấu có thể xảy ra trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the state of feeling happy and safe from danger or worry
examples: the security of a loving family life

definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái cảm thấy hạnh phúc và an toàn trước nguy hiểm hoặc lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: government securities
definitions.definition_vi: tài liệu chứng minh ai đó là người sở hữu cổ phần, v.v. trong một công ty cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: SEE ALSO birdseed
a packet of wild flower seeds
sesame seeds
Sow the seeds outdoors in spring.
Plant the seeds 10cm apart.
These vegetables can be grown from seed.
seed potatoes (= used for planting)
definitions.definition_vi: phần cứng nhỏ do cây tạo ra, từ đó cây mới có thể phát triển

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: sự khởi đầu của một cảm giác hoặc sự phát triển tiếp tục phát triển

examples: The top seed won comfortably.

definitions.definition_vi: một trong những cầu thủ giỏi nhất trong một cuộc thi. Các hạt giống được xếp vào một vị trí trong danh sách để cố gắng đảm bảo rằng họ không đấu với nhau trong phần đầu của cuộc thi.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: semen
definitions.definition_vi: tinh dịch

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: all the people who are the children, grandchildren, etc. of one man
definitions.definition_vi: tất cả những người là con, cháu, v.v. của một người đàn ông

definitions.definition_vi: để sản xuất hoa và hạt cũng như lá

Strange as it may seem, exactly the same thing happened to me.
He seems a nice man.
She seems to be a smart woman.
You seem to be nervous.
People aren’t always what they seem to be.
It seemed like a good idea at the time.
It always seemed as though they would get married.
‘He'll be there, then?’ ‘So it seems (= people say so).’

It must have seemed to him that he was safe.
It seems that they know what they're doing.

definitions.label: Meaning 2

I sold James my car for £800.

They never buy more than they can sell at a good price.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa cái gì đó cho ai để đổi lấy tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: được người ta mua theo cách hoặc theo con số đã nêu; được cung cấp ở mức giá được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: You may not like it but advertising sells.

definitions.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người muốn mua cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7

examples: We were really sold on the idea.
definitions.definition_vi: rất nhiệt tình về một cái gì đó

definitions.definition: to be bought quickly or in great numbers
definitions.definition_vi: được mua nhanh chóng hoặc với số lượng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to have sex with somebody in exchange for money
definitions.definition_vi: quan hệ tình dục với ai đó để đổi lấy tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: đối xử tồi tệ hoặc không công bằng với ai đó mà bạn đã hứa sẽ giúp đỡ

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: bán tài sản của một quốc gia, chẳng hạn như đất đai hoặc tài sản, cho chủ sở hữu nước ngoài

definitions.label: Meaning 14

definitions.definition_vi: làm bất cứ điều gì, ngay cả điều gì đó thực sự tồi tệ hoặc không trung thực, để đổi lấy tiền bạc, thành công hoặc quyền lực.

definitions.label: Meaning 1

a long-distance/cross-country/marathon runner

a list of runners (= horses in a race) and riders

definitions.definition_vi: người hoặc động vật chạy, đặc biệt là người tham gia cuộc đua

a drug runner
definitions.definition_vi: người lấy hàng hóa vào hoặc ra khỏi một nơi một cách bất hợp pháp

definitions.definition_vi: người trong công ty hoặc tổ chức có nhiệm vụ đưa tin nhắn, tài liệu, v.v. từ nơi này đến nơi khác

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a shoe that is used for running or doing other sport in
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc giày được sử dụng để chạy hoặc chơi môn thể thao khác trong

examples: late Middle English: probably a blend of the synonymous dialect words scrat and cratch, both of uncertain origin; compare with Middle Low German kratsen and Old High German krazzōn.
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng nếu ai đó giúp bạn thì bạn sẽ giúp họ, ngay cả khi điều này không công bằng với người khácNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to give a loud, high shout, because you are hurt, frightened, excited, etc.
examples: SYNONYM shriek
He covered her mouth to stop her from screaming.
I wanted to run screaming from the room.
The kids were screaming with excitement.
I screamed in pain.
The man screamed in agony and collapsed.
He heard a few of the children screaming with laughter.
People ran for the exits, screaming out in terror.
The boy screamed out, as he felt a man's hand grab his arm.
The baby was screaming itself hoarse.
screaming fans
definitions.definition_vi: hét to, cao vì bạn bị tổn thương, sợ hãi, phấn khích, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to shout something in a loud, high voice because of fear, anger, etc.
examples: SYNONYM yell
‘Help!’ she screamed.
'Go away!' I screamed at the top of my voice (= as loudly as possible).
Someone was screaming for help.
He screamed at me to stop.
Everyone started screaming at each other.
She started screaming and shouting at me.
He screamed hysterically at me.
She screamed abuse at him.
She screamed out abuse at him.
I started pounding on the door screaming my lungs out (= as loud and long as possible).
He screamed his head off (= screamed very loudly and angrily) at me.
His sister screamed out that he was crazy.
definitions.definition_vi: hét to cái gì đó với giọng cao, vì sợ hãi, tức giận, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to make a loud, high noise; to move fast, making this noise
examples: SYNONYM screech
Lights flashed and sirens screamed.
The powerboat screamed out to sea.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra tiếng ồn lớn, lớn; di chuyển nhanh, tạo ra tiếng động này

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: if you drag somebody kicking and screaming to do something, they only do it with great protests because they don't really want to do it at all
examples: The president had to be dragged kicking and screaming to the signing ceremony.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn kéo ai đó đá và la hét để làm điều gì đó, họ chỉ làm điều đó với sự phản đối mạnh mẽ vì họ thực sự không muốn làm điều đó chút nào

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to scream loudly and for a long time, especially in order to protest about somethingWord Origin
examples: Middle English: origin uncertain; perhaps from Middle Dutch.
definitions.definition_vi: hét to và kéo dài, đặc biệt là để phản đối điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to fasten one thing to another or make something tight with a screw or screws
examples: COMPARE unscrew
The bookcase is screwed to the wall.
You need to screw all the parts together.
Now screw down the lid.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc chặt cái này với cái khác hoặc làm cái gì đó chặt chẽ bằng đinh vít

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to turn something round and round in order to fasten it in place
examples: COMPARE unscrew
She screwed the cap back on the jar.
Screw the bolt tight.
definitions.definition_vi: xoay cái gì đó vòng tròn để cố định nó vào đúng vị trí

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be attached by screwing
examples: The bulb should just screw into the socket.
The lid simply screws on.
definitions.definition_vi: được gắn bằng vít

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to use your hand to make something, especially a piece of paper, form a tight ball
examples: SEE ALSO screwed-up
I screwed up the letter and threw it into the fire.
Screw the foil into a little ball.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng bàn tay của bạn để làm một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một mảnh giấy, tạo thành một quả bóng chặt

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to cheat somebody, especially by making them pay too much money for something
examples: We've been screwed.
How much did they screw you for (= how much did you have to pay)?
definitions.definition_vi: lừa dối ai đó, đặc biệt là bằng cách khiến họ phải trả quá nhiều tiền cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to force somebody to give you something
examples: They screwed the money out of her by threats.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc ai đó phải đưa cho bạn cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to have sex with somebody
definitions.definition_vi: quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be a sensible person
definitions.definition_vi: trở thành một người nhạy cảm

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: an offensive way of showing that you are annoyed or do not care about somebody/something
definitions.definition_vi: một cách xúc phạm để thể hiện rằng bạn đang khó chịu hoặc không quan tâm đến ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to force yourself to be brave enough to do something
examples: I finally screwed up my courage and went to the dentist.
definitions.definition_vi: buộc bản thân phải đủ dũng cảm để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a written text of a play, film, broadcast, talk, etc.
examples: That line isn't in the original script.
a film script
to write/read a script
We're currently working on a script.
He was reading from a prepared script.
definitions.definition_vi: một văn bản bằng văn bản của một vở kịch, bộ phim, chương trình phát sóng, cuộc trò chuyện, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: writing done by hand
examples: SEE ALSO manuscript
She admired his neat script.
definitions.definition_vi: viết bằng tay

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a set of letters in which a language is written
examples: SYNONYM alphabet
a document in Cyrillic script (= used to write Russian and some other languages)
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các chữ cái trong đó một ngôn ngữ được viết

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a candidate’s written answer or answers in an exam
definitions.definition_vi: câu trả lời bằng văn bản của thí sinh hoặc các câu trả lời trong bài thi

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a series of instructions for a computer, carried out in a particular order, for example when a link in a website is clicked
examples: The bug was caused by an error in the script.
definitions.definition_vi: một loạt các hướng dẫn cho máy tính, được thực hiện theo một thứ tự cụ thể, ví dụ như khi nhấp vào một liên kết trong trang web

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: known about by only a few people; kept hidden from others
examples: SEE ALSO top secret
secret information/meetings/talks
They belong to an age-old secret society.
He tried to keep it secret from his family.
Details of the proposals remain secret.
a secret passage leading to the beach
The two candidates were chosen by a secret ballot (= in which nobody knows how you voted) of MPs.
He's a natural salesman, whose secret weapon is the sheer confidence and optimism that he exudes.
The group is on a highly secret mission.
Secret police documents were leaked to the press.
The scandal was kept secret from the French public for 18 years.
What could be so secret what it had to stay hidden?
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ được một số ít người biết tới; được giấu kín với người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to describe actions and behaviour that you do not tell other people about
examples: He's a secret drinker.
I didn't know you were a secret football fan.
her secret fears
Perhaps he has secret hopes that she'll go back to him.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả hành động và hành vi mà bạn không nói với người khác về

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: liking to have secrets that other people do not know about; showing this
examples: SYNONYM secretive
They were so secret about everything.
Jessica caught a secret smile flitting between the two of them.
definitions.definition_vi: thích có những bí mật mà người khác không biết; hiển thị cái này

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who works in an office, working for another person, dealing with mail and phone calls, keeping records, arranging meetings with people, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO executive secretary
a legal/medical secretary
the mayor's press secretary
Please contact my secretary to make an appointment.
He is secretary to the board of governors.
definitions.definition_vi: một người làm việc trong văn phòng, làm việc cho người khác, xử lý thư từ và các cuộc gọi điện thoại, lưu giữ hồ sơ, sắp xếp các cuộc họp với mọi người, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an official of a club, society, etc. who deals with mail, keeping records and making business arrangements
examples: SEE ALSO general secretary
the membership secretary
She served as club secretary for 25 years.
The union's branch secretary said he hoped a solution would be found.
secretary to the Jockey Club
definitions.definition_vi: một quan chức của một câu lạc bộ, xã hội, v.v., người xử lý thư từ, lưu giữ hồ sơ và sắp xếp công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: (in the UK) the head of an important government department
examples: SEE ALSO Foreign Secretary
definitions.definition_vi: (ở Anh) người đứng đầu một cơ quan quan trọng của chính phủ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the head of a government department, chosen by the president
examples: Secretary of the Treasury
She was deputy secretary of agriculture in the first Obama administration.
definitions.definition_vi: người đứng đầu một cơ quan chính phủ, do tổng thống lựa chọn

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: an assistant of a government minister, an ambassador, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO parliamentary secretary
Ms Watson is a former parliamentary secretary to the Minister of Education.
definitions.definition_vi: trợ lý của một bộ trưởng chính phủ, một đại sứ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to obtain or achieve something, especially when this means using a lot of effort
examples: to secure a contract/deal/funding
The team managed to secure a place in the finals.
The team were unable to secure a victory.
She secured 2 000 votes.
The delegation has secured the promise of a ceasefire.
A production company secured the film rights to the biography.
They are contract workers unable to secure a full-time position.
Retailers will need to pay a higher price in order to secure supplies.
He secured a place for himself at law school.
He secured himself a place at law school.
definitions.definition_vi: để có được hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi điều này có nghĩa là sử dụng rất nhiều nỗ lực

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to attach or fasten something so that it does not move
examples: She secured the rope firmly to the back of the car.
He secured the boat with a rope.
The tables on board were secured firmly to the floor.
definitions.definition_vi: gắn hoặc buộc chặt một cái gì đó để nó không di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to protect something so that it is safe and difficult to attack or damage
examples: to secure a property against intruders
Have you properly secured your computer from viral attack?
a savings plan that will secure your child’s future
We must all do everything we can to secure our borders.
The windows were secured with locks and bars.
definitions.definition_vi: để bảo vệ một cái gì đó để nó được an toàn và khó bị tấn công hoặc thiệt hại

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to legally agree to give somebody property or goods that are worth the same amount as the money that you have borrowed from them, if you are unable to pay the money back
examples: a loan secured on the house
definitions.definition_vi: đồng ý một cách hợp pháp để đưa cho ai đó tài sản hoặc hàng hóa có giá trị tương đương với số tiền mà bạn đã mượn từ họ, nếu bạn không thể trả lại số tiền đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to become aware of somebody/something by using your eyes
examples: PLURAL OF sea
She looked for him but couldn't see him in the crowd.
I looked out of the window but saw nothing.
The opera was the place to see and be seen (= by other important or fashionable people).
I would like to see some proof of this statement.
The divers reported seeing a lot of sharks.
He recalls seeing his father sitting at the kitchen table.
I've never seen anything like this!
He could see (that) she had been crying.
Did you see what happened?
If you watch carefully, you’ll see how it is done.
I hate to see you unhappy.
She was seen running away from the scene of the crime.
I saw you put the key in your pocket.
He was seen to enter the building about the time the crime was committed.
The government not only has to do something, it must be seen to be doing something (= people must be aware that it is doing something).
The walls were too high to see over.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận biết ai/cái gì bằng cách sử dụng đôi mắt của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to have or use the power of sight
examples: She will never see again (= she has become blind).
On a clear day you can see for miles from here.
It was getting dark and I couldn't see to read.
I could hardly see because of the smoke.
definitions.definition_vi: có hoặc sử dụng sức mạnh của thị giác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to watch a game, television programme, performance, etc.
examples: Did you see that programme on Brazil last night?
In the evening we went to see a movie.
Fifty thousand people saw the match.
I finally got to see them in concert.
I really want to see this film now.
This performance was very beautiful, like nothing I had ever seen before.
I remember seeing that movie when I was a kid.
It's not the sort of thing you see on TV that often.
This film really deserves to be seen on a big screen.
definitions.definition_vi: để xem một trò chơi, chương trình truyền hình, buổi biểu diễn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to look at something in order to find information; to go to somebody in order to ask for help or information
examples: See page 158.
If you missed the session, see a member of staff for advice.
See Table 2 for details.
See also paragraphs 6.5 to 6.9 above.
See above/below for a breakdown of the costs.
See over (= the next page) for details.
definitions.definition_vi: nhìn vào cái gì đó để tìm thông tin; đến gặp ai đó để yêu cầu giúp đỡ hoặc thông tin

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to be near and recognize somebody; to meet somebody by chance
examples: Guess who I saw at the party last night!
Aren't you pleased to see me?
It's so good to see you!
definitions.definition_vi: ở gần và nhận ra ai đó; tình cờ gặp ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to visit somebody/something
examples: Come and see us again soon.
Around 200  000 visitors each year come to see the summer palace.
definitions.definition_vi: đến thăm ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to have a meeting with somebody
examples: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
What is it you want to see me about?
I can only see you for five minutes.
definitions.definition_vi: có cuộc gặp với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to spend time with somebody
examples: Are you seeing anyone (= having a romantic relationship with anyone)?
They've been seeing a lot of each other (= spending a lot of time together) recently.
We haven't seen much of Liz lately.
He has changed since his family last saw him.
definitions.definition_vi: dành thời gian với ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to understand something
examples: ‘It opens like this.’ ‘Oh, I see.’
He didn't see the joke.
I don't think she saw the point of the story.
He changed the way we see the world around us.
to see a/the need for something
I see no need to involve the law.
I can see both sides of the argument.
They saw nothing wrong with having three cars.
Make Lydia see reason (= be sensible), will you?
Can’t you see (that) he’s taking advantage of you?
I don't see that it matters what Josh thinks.
‘It's broken.’ ‘Oh yes, I see what you mean.’
‘Can we go swimming?’ ‘I don't see why not (= yes, you can).’
They will be able to see what really happened there.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiểu điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to have an opinion of something
examples: I see things differently now.
Try to see things from her point of view.
The way I see it, you have three main problems.
As far as I can see (= in my opinion), you've done nothing wrong.
Lack of money is the main problem, as I see it (= in my opinion).
She is in love with him but Darren sees their relationship in a different light (= has a different opinion).
definitions.definition_vi: có ý kiến ​​về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to consider something as a future possibility; to imagine somebody/something as something
examples: I can't see her changing her mind.
I can't really see myself working in a lab all day.
His colleagues see him as a future director.
She was quiet and withdrawn and never saw herself as a dancer.
definitions.definition_vi: xem xét điều gì đó như một khả năng có thể xảy ra trong tương lai; tưởng tượng ai/cái gì như cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to find out something by looking, asking or waiting
examples: ‘Has the mail come yet?’ ‘I'll just go and see.’
‘Is he going to get better?’ ‘I don't know, we'll just have to wait and see.’
We'll have a great time, you'll see.
Go and see what the kids are doing, will you?
We'll have to see how it goes.
It will be interesting to see what happens.
I see (that) interest rates are going up again.
It can be seen that certain groups are more at risk than others.
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm hiểu một cái gì đó bằng cách nhìn, hỏi hoặc chờ đợi

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to find out or decide something by thinking or considering
examples: ‘Will you be able to help us?’ ‘I don't know, I'll have to see.’
‘Can I go to the party?’ ‘We'll see (= I'll decide later).’
I'll see what I can do to help.
definitions.definition_vi: để tìm ra hoặc quyết định một cái gì đó bằng cách suy nghĩ hoặc xem xét

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to make sure that you do something or that something is done
examples: See that all the doors are locked before you leave.
Could you see that the kids are in bed by 8 o'clock?
definitions.definition_vi: để đảm bảo rằng bạn làm điều gì đó hoặc điều gì đó được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to experience or suffer something
examples: He has seen a great deal in his long life.
I hope I never live to see the day when computers finally replace books.
It didn't surprise her—she had seen it all before.
definitions.definition_vi: trải nghiệm hoặc chịu đựng điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be the time when an event happens
examples: Next year sees the centenary of Saint-Saëns' death.
The twentieth century saw dramatic changes in most areas of life.
definitions.definition_vi: là thời điểm một sự kiện xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to be the place where an event happens
examples: SYNONYM witness
This stadium has seen many thrilling football games.
definitions.definition_vi: là nơi diễn ra một sự kiện

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to go with somebody to help or protect them
examples: I saw the old lady across (= helped her cross) the road.
May I see you home (= go with you as far as your house)?
My secretary will see you out (= show you the way out of the building).
definitions.definition_vi: đi cùng ai đó để giúp đỡ hoặc bảo vệ họ

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: that can be seen clearly; in a way that can be seen clearly
definitions.definition_vi: điều đó có thể được nhìn thấy rõ ràng; theo cách có thể nhìn thấy rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: used when you are thinking or trying to remember something
examples: Now let me see—how old is she now?
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang suy nghĩ hoặc cố gắng nhớ điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to realize that there is going to be a problem before it happens
examples: We should have seen it coming. There was no way he could keep going under all that pressure.
definitions.definition_vi: nhận ra rằng sẽ có một vấn đề trước khi nó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: to realize that somebody/something is not as good, pleasant, etc. as they/it seem
definitions.definition_vi: nhận ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó không tốt, dễ chịu, v.v. như họ/có vẻ như vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to find out or look at something yourself in order to be sure that what somebody is saying is true
examples: If you don't believe me, go and see for yourself!
definitions.definition_vi: tự mình tìm hiểu hoặc xem xét điều gì đó để chắc chắn rằng điều ai đó đang nói là đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: because of the fact that…
examples: Seeing that he's been off sick all week he's unlikely to come.
definitions.definition_vi: bởi vì thực tế là…

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: goodbye
examples: I'd better be going now. See you!
definitions.definition_vi: tạm biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: used when you are explaining something
examples: You see, the thing is, we won't be finished before Friday.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang giải thích điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a part of something that is separate from the other parts or can be considered separately
examples: She cleaned a small segment of the painting.
Lines divided the area into segments.
The changes will affect only a small segment of the population.
They divided the bone into equal segments.
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của cái gì đó tách biệt với những phần khác hoặc có thể được xem xét riêng biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: one of the sections of an orange, a lemon, etc.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những phần của quả cam, quả chanh, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a part of a circle separated from the rest by a single line
definitions.definition_vi: một phần của vòng tròn được ngăn cách với phần còn lại bằng một đường thẳng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the smallest speech sound that a word can be divided intoWord Origin
examples: late 16th cent. (as a term in geometry): from Latin segmentum, from secare ‘to cut’. The verb dates from the mid 19th cent.
definitions.definition_vi: âm thanh lời nói nhỏ nhất mà một từ có thể được chia thành Nguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to take somebody/something in your hand suddenly and using force
examples: SYNONYM grab
She tried to seize the gun from him.
He seized her by the arm.
She seized hold of my hand.
definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột nắm lấy ai/cái gì trong tay và dùng vũ lực

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take control of a place or situation, often suddenly and violently
examples: They seized the airport in a surprise attack.
The army has seized control of the country.
He seized power in a military coup.
definitions.definition_vi: để kiểm soát một địa điểm hoặc tình huống, thường đột ngột và dữ dội

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to arrest or capture somebody
examples: The men were seized as they left the building.

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.definition_vi: một ngôi nhà lớn ở nông thôn thuộc về một thành viên của tầng lớp thượng lưu

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ số lượng người tham dự một buổi biểu diễn, buổi nói chuyện, v.v., đặc biệt khi nhấn mạnh sự cần thiết hoặc mong muốn thu hút một lượng lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 13

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển bằng những chuyển động ngắn, nhanh từ bên này sang bên kia hoặc lên xuống

definitions.definition_vi: để di chuyển một cái gì đó theo một hướng cụ thể bằng cách lắc

definitions.definition: a person who goes to live in a new country or region
examples: Most of the settlers came from England.
definitions.definition_vi: một người đến sống ở một đất nước hoặc khu vực mới

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: numbers, years or temperatures from 70 to 79
definitions.definition_vi: số, năm hoặc nhiệt độ từ 70 đến 79

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: between the ages of 70 and 79
definitions.definition_vi: trong độ tuổi từ 70 đến 79

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: extremely bad or serious
examples: His injuries are severe.
severe pain/depression/asthma
a severe illness/disease
severe weather/storms
a severe winter (= one during which the weather conditions are extremely bad)
The fire has caused severe damage to the building.
The victim suffered severe brain damage.
a severe shortage of qualified staff
The party suffered severe losses during the last election.
severe learning difficulties
a severe case of woodworm
Strikes are causing severe disruption to all train services.
If the pain becomes severe, you may wish to contact a doctor.
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ xấu hoặc nghiêm trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: punishing somebody in an extreme way when they break a particular set of rules
examples: SYNONYM harsh
a severe punishment/sentence/penalty
The courts are becoming more severe on young offenders.
Her parents were never so severe with her older brother.
definitions.definition_vi: trừng phạt ai đó một cách cực đoan khi họ vi phạm một bộ quy tắc cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: not kind or showing sympathy; not smiling or showing approval
examples: SYNONYM stern
a severe expression
She fixed them with a very severe look.
She was a severe woman who seldom smiled.
definitions.definition_vi: không tử tế hoặc tỏ ra thông cảm; không mỉm cười hoặc thể hiện sự đồng tình

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: extremely difficult and requiring a lot of skill or ability
examples: SYNONYM stiff
The marathon is a severe test of stamina.
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ khó khăn và đòi hỏi rất nhiều kỹ năng hoặc khả năng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: extremely plain and without any decoration
examples: Modern furniture is a little too severe for my taste.
Her hair was short and severe.
She was wearing a severe dark grey jacket.
definitions.definition_vi: cực kỳ đơn giản và không có bất kỳ trang trí nào

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an area that is dark and cool under or behind something, for example a tree or building, because the sun’s light does not get to it
examples: SEE ALSO shady
The shade of the pine tree provided some protection from the sun.
The temperature can reach 40°C in the shade.
We sat down in the shade of the wall.
These plants grow well in sun or shade.
Two cows were sleeping under the shade of some trees.
The trees provide shade for the animals in the summer.
definitions.definition_vi: một khu vực tối và mát mẻ dưới hoặc phía sau một cái gì đó, ví dụ như một cái cây hoặc tòa nhà, bởi vì ánh sáng mặt trời không chiếu tới nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a thing that you use to prevent light from coming through or to make it less bright
examples: SEE ALSO lampshade
I bought a new shade for the lamp.
an eyeshade
definitions.definition_vi: một thứ mà bạn sử dụng để ngăn chặn ánh sáng đi qua hoặc làm cho nó ít sáng hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: material that covers a window, often consisting of a roll of cloth that is fixed at the top of the window and can be pulled up and down
definitions.definition_vi: vật liệu che cửa sổ, thường bao gồm một cuộn vải được cố định ở phía trên cửa sổ và có thể kéo lên xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a particular form of a colour, that is, how dark or light it is
examples: a dark/light/pale/bright shade of blue
a subtle/delicate shade of grey
His face turned an even deeper shade of red.
Cool pastel shades are just right for summer.
definitions.definition_vi: một dạng cụ thể của một màu, nghĩa là nó tối hay sáng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the dark areas in a picture, especially the use of these to produce variety
examples: The painting needs more light and shade.
definitions.definition_vi: các vùng tối trong ảnh, đặc biệt là việc sử dụng chúng để tạo ra sự đa dạng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a different kind or level of opinion, feeling, etc.
examples: politicians of all shades of opinion
The word has many shades of meaning.
reformers of all political shades
definitions.definition_vi: một loại hoặc mức độ khác nhau của ý kiến, cảm giác, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a little; slightly
examples: SYNONYM touch
He was feeling a shade disappointed.
Her skirt was a shade too short.
definitions.definition_vi: một chút; nhẹ nhàng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: sunglasses (= a pair of glasses with dark glass in them that you wear to protect your eyes from bright light from the sun)
definitions.definition_vi: kính râm (= một cặp kính có kính tối màu mà bạn đeo để bảo vệ mắt khỏi ánh sáng chói từ mặt trời)

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: the spirit of a dead person; a ghost
definitions.definition_vi: linh hồn của một người chết; một con ma

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to be much better or more impressive than somebody/something
examples: I tried hard but her work put mine in the shade.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên tốt hơn hoặc ấn tượng hơn ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used when you are referring to things that remind you of a particular person, thing or time
examples: short skirts and long boots—shades of the 1960s
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đề cập đến những thứ làm bạn nhớ đến một người, sự vật hoặc thời gian cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the dark shape that somebody/something’s form makes on a surface, for example on the ground, when they are between the light and the surface
examples: SEE ALSO 5 o'clock shadow
The children were having fun, chasing each other's shadows.
As the curtains moved in the breeze, the shadows on the floor seemed to dance.
The ship's sail cast a shadow on the water.
The shadows lengthened as the sun went down.
The man's face is hidden in a deep shadow cast by his umbrella.
They saw the shadow of a man pass by.
He didn't want to cast a shadow on (= spoil) their happiness.
definitions.definition_vi: hình dạng tối tăm mà ai đó/thứ gì đó tạo ra trên một bề mặt, ví dụ như trên mặt đất, khi chúng ở giữa ánh sáng và bề mặt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: darkness in a place or on something, especially so that you cannot easily see who or what is there
examples: I thought I saw a figure standing in the shadows.
His face was deep in shadow, turned away from her.
A man in black emerged from the shadows.
It had grown dark, and the shadows could be hiding anything.
It's a spooky story about the monsters that lurk in the shadows.
She shrank back into the shadows as the footsteps approached.
‘I'm right here,’ I said, stepping out of the shadows.
definitions.definition_vi: bóng tối ở một nơi hoặc trên một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để bạn không thể dễ dàng nhìn thấy ai hoặc cái gì ở đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a very small amount of something
examples: SYNONYM hint
A shadow of a smile touched his mouth.
She knew beyond a shadow of a doubt (= with no doubt at all) that he was lying.
definitions.definition_vi: một lượng rất nhỏ của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the strong (often bad) influence of somebody/something
examples: The new leader wants to escape from the shadow of his predecessor.
Bergman casts a long shadow over world cinema.
These people have been living for years under the shadow of fear.
definitions.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ (thường là xấu) của ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: dark areas under somebody’s eyes, because they are tired, etc.
examples: She looked pale, with deep shadows under her eyes.
definitions.definition_vi: vùng tối dưới mắt ai đó, vì họ mệt mỏi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a person or an animal that follows somebody else all the time
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc một con vật luôn đi theo người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a thing that is not real or possible to obtain
examples: You can't spend all your life chasing shadows.
definitions.definition_vi: một điều không có thật hoặc không thể có được

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be very easily frightened; to be very nervous
definitions.definition_vi: rất dễ sợ hãi; rất lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to not have the strength, influence, etc. that you used to have
examples: When his career ended, he became a shadow of his former self.
definitions.definition_vi: không có sức mạnh, ảnh hưởng, vv mà bạn đã từng có

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: very close to
examples: The new market is in the shadow of the City Hall.
definitions.definition_vi: rất gần với

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: when you say that somebody is in/under the shadow of another person, you mean that they do not receive as much attention as that person
examples: A younger son often lives in the shadow of his elder brother.
definitions.definition_vi: Khi bạn nói rằng ai đó ở trong/dưới cái bóng của người khác, bạn có nghĩa là họ không nhận được nhiều sự chú ý như người đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to move or make somebody/something move with short quick movements from side to side or up and down
examples: The whole house shakes when a train goes past.
Shake the bottle well before use.
The explosion shook windows miles from the site.
He shook her violently by the shoulders.
He knelt and gently shook her awake.
She shook her hair loose.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển bằng những chuyển động ngắn, nhanh từ bên này sang bên kia hoặc lên xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to move something in a particular direction by shaking
examples: She bent down to shake a pebble out of her shoe.
His father used to come home and shake the dust off his work clothes.
He stood up, shaking sand everywhere.
definitions.definition_vi: để di chuyển một cái gì đó theo một hướng cụ thể bằng cách lắc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to take somebody’s hand and move it up and down as a way of saying hello or to show that you agree about something
examples: Do people in Italy shake hands when they meet?
She refused to shake hands with him.
He stepped forward and shook my hand.
Our host shook each of us warmly by the hand.
They shook hands on the deal (= to show that they had reached an agreement).
They shook on the deal (= shook hands to show the deal was agreed).
Let's shake on it.
definitions.definition_vi: nắm tay ai đó và di chuyển lên xuống như một cách chào hỏi hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to turn your head from side to side as a way of saying ‘no’ or to show that you are sad, feel doubt, etc.
examples: ‘Drink?’ he offered. She shook her head.
The old man watched them walk off into the night, shaking his head sadly.
She shook her head in disbelief.
He shook his head at the thought.
definitions.definition_vi: quay đầu từ bên này sang bên kia như một cách nói 'không' hoặc để thể hiện rằng bạn đang buồn, cảm thấy nghi ngờ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to show that you are angry with somebody; to threaten somebody by shaking your fist (= closed hand)
examples: The man shook his fist at the court after he was sentenced.
definitions.definition_vi: để thể hiện rằng bạn đang tức giận với ai đó; đe dọa ai đó bằng cách lắc nắm tay của bạn (= khép tay)

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to make short quick movements that you cannot control, for example because you are cold or afraid
examples: SYNONYM tremble
Her hands had started to shake.
He was shaking with fear.
He saw his mother turn away, her shoulders shaking with laughter.
His whole body shook with rage.
I was shaking like a leaf.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện những chuyển động ngắn và nhanh mà bạn không thể kiểm soát được, ví dụ vì bạn lạnh hoặc sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to sound unsteady, usually because you are nervous, upset or angry
examples: ‘Who are you?’ he asked, his voice shaking.
Her voice shook with emotion.
definitions.definition_vi: nghe có vẻ không ổn định, thường là do bạn lo lắng, khó chịu hoặc tức giận

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to shock or upset somebody very much
examples: He was badly shaken by the news of her death.
The accident really shook her up.
Shaken up by the early goal against them, the team began to fight back.
definitions.definition_vi: gây sốc hoặc làm ai đó khó chịu rất nhiều

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to make a belief or an idea less certain
examples: The incident had shaken her faith in him.
This announcement is bound to shake the confidence of the industry.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho một niềm tin hoặc một ý tưởng kém chắc chắn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to get rid of something
examples: I can't seem to shake off this cold.
She has finally managed to shake off her old wrist injury.
He couldn't shake the feeling that there was something wrong.
She never seemed to completely shake off the dumb blonde image.
definitions.definition_vi: để thoát khỏi một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to cause people to question their basic beliefs about something
examples: This issue has shaken the foundations of French politics.
an event which rocked the foundations of British politics
The scandal rocked the legal establishment to its foundations.
definitions.definition_vi: khiến mọi người đặt câu hỏi về niềm tin cơ bản của họ về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be very frightened or nervous
definitions.definition_vi: rất sợ hãi hoặc lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to start to do something or to hurryWord Origin
examples: Old English sc(e)acan (verb), of Germanic origin.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó bắt đầu làm việc gì đó hoặc khẩn trương lên Nguồn gốc của từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the form of the outer edges or surfaces of something; an example of something that has a particular form
examples: a rectangular/spherical/cylindrical shape
geometric shapes
fantastic creatures that can change shape and be either visible or invisible
You can recognize the fish by the shape of their fins.
They have completely different body shapes.
This old T-shirt has completely lost its shape.
The island was originally circular in shape.
Several rooms are irregular in shape.
Candles come in all shapes and sizes.
Glass is blown or moulded into many shapes.
The pool was in the shape of a heart.
The government provides money in the shape of (= consisting of) grants and student loans.
definitions.definition_vi: hình dạng của các cạnh hoặc bề mặt bên ngoài của một cái gì đó; một ví dụ về một cái gì đó có hình thức cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a person or thing that is difficult to see clearly
examples: SYNONYM figure
Ghostly shapes moved around in the dark.
I could just make out a dark shape in the distance.
An enormous shape loomed up out of the mist directly in front of me.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật đó là khó nhìn thấy rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the physical condition of somebody/something
examples: What sort of shape was the car in after the accident?
He's in good shape for a man of his age.
The ship was in bad shape as a result of damage sustained in the collision.
He’s not in any shape (= not well enough) to be working.
definitions.definition_vi: tình trạng thể chất của ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the particular qualities or characteristics of something
examples: Will new technology change the shape of broadcasting?
Prices vary according to the size and shape of each project.
He did much to determine the shape of Asia's political map.
definitions.definition_vi: những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to become angry, anxious or upset
examples: Don't get bent out of shape about it. It was just a mistake!
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận, lo lắng hoặc khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to take exercise, eat healthy food, etc. in order to become physically fit
examples: I’m trying to get into shape before summer.
I need to get back into shape after the Christmas holiday.
definitions.definition_vi: tập thể dục, ăn thực phẩm lành mạnh, vv để trở nên khỏe mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to train somebody so that they do a particular job, task, etc. well
examples: It took him just two weeks to knock the new recruits into shape.
Leave the boy with me—I'll soon knock him into shape!
definitions.definition_vi: đào tạo ai đó để họ làm một công việc, nhiệm vụ cụ thể, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to make something more acceptable, organized or successful
examples: I've got all the information together but it still needs knocking into shape.
It shouldn’t take long to get the company back into shape.
definitions.definition_vi: để làm cho một cái gì đó dễ chấp nhận hơn, có tổ chức hoặc thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to express or explain a particular idea, plan, etc.
examples: Marie tried to find the right words to give shape to the confusion in her head.
definitions.definition_vi: để diễn đạt hoặc giải thích một ý tưởng, kế hoạch cụ thể, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: of any type
examples: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ loại nào

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: (to get/stay) in good physical condition
examples: You don't have to spend a fortune on gym membership to get in shape.
I like to stay in shape.
definitions.definition_vi: (có được/ở lại) trong tình trạng thể chất tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: not having the normal shape
examples: The wheel had been twisted out of shape.
The bicycle had been battered out of shape.
definitions.definition_vi: không có hình dạng bình thường

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: not in good physical condition
examples: I didn’t realize how out of shape I was!
definitions.definition_vi: không ở trong tình trạng thể chất tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: the way things are likely to develop in the future
examples: Are solar-powered cars the shape of things to come?
This new system could be the shape of things to come.
definitions.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ có thể phát triển trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to develop and become more complete or organized
examples: The garden is beginning to take shape.
A new song began to take shape in her mind.
definitions.definition_vi: để phát triển và trở nên hoàn thiện hơn hoặc có tổ chức

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to dance
examples: She spent the whole evening throwing shapes on the dance floor.
definitions.definition_vi: nhảy

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to behave in a way that makes you seem to threaten somebody, especially by standing as though you are ready to fight, without actually becoming violent
examples: I was worried he might get violent but he was just throwing shapes.
The two main investors threw some shapes during the debate.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách khiến bạn có vẻ như đang đe dọa ai đó, đặc biệt bằng cách đứng như thể bạn sẵn sàng chiến đấu mà không thực sự trở nên bạo lực

definitions.definition: a figure of a person or an animal in stone, metal, etc., usually the same size as in real life or larger
examples: a bronze/marble statue
a statue of Apollo
definitions.definition_vi: hình người hoặc động vật bằng đá, kim loại, v.v., thường có cùng kích thước với ngoài đời thực hoặc lớn hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the legal position of a person, group or country
examples: They were granted refugee status.
The party was denied legal status.
The company investigated the immigration status of its workers.
definitions.definition_vi: vị trí pháp lý của một người, một nhóm hoặc một quốc gia

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the social or professional position of somebody/something in relation to others
examples: She achieved celebrity status overnight.
Women are only asking to be given equal status with men.
to have a high social status
low status jobs
definitions.definition_vi: vị trí xã hội hoặc nghề nghiệp của ai đó/cái gì đó trong mối quan hệ với người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: high rank or social position
examples: The job brings with it status and a high income.
definitions.definition_vi: cấp bậc cao hoặc địa vị xã hội

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the level of importance that is given to something
examples: This reflects the high status accorded to science in our culture.
definitions.definition_vi: mức độ quan trọng được trao cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the situation at a particular time during a process
