She updated her Facebook status to ‘in a relationship’.
He has told family and friends of his HIV status.
definitions.definition_vi: tình huống tại một thời điểm cụ thể trong một quá trình

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the hot gas that water changes into when it boils
examples: Steam rose from the boiling kettle.
a Turkish steam bath
definitions.definition_vi: khí nóng mà nước chuyển thành khi sôi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the power that is produced from steam under pressure, used to operate engines, machines, etc.
examples: the introduction of steam in the 18th century
steam power
the steam age
a steam train/engine
The engine is driven by steam.
definitions.definition_vi: năng lượng được tạo ra từ hơi nước dưới áp suất, được sử dụng để vận hành động cơ, máy móc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: very small drops of water that form in the air or on cold surfaces when warm air suddenly cools
examples: SYNONYM condensation
She wiped the steam from her glasses.
definitions.definition_vi: những giọt nước rất nhỏ hình thành trong không khí hoặc trên bề mặt lạnh khi không khí ấm đột ngột nguội đi

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to get rid of your energy, anger or strong emotions by doing something active or noisy
examples: I went for a long walk to let off steam.
I like blowing off steam and I like saying things that shock people.
definitions.definition_vi: loại bỏ năng lượng, sự tức giận hoặc cảm xúc mạnh mẽ của bạn bằng cách làm điều gì đó năng động hoặc ồn ào

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: with as much speed or energy as possible
examples: Business picked up at the beginning of the year and now it is full steam ahead.
The team is working full steam on the next release.
All of the major players are operating at full steam.
definitions.definition_vi: với càng nhiều tốc độ hoặc năng lượng càng tốt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to go somewhere without help from other people
examples: I’ll get to the party under my own steam.
definitions.definition_vi: đi đâu đó mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to become gradually more powerful, active, etc.
examples: His election campaign is beginning to get up steam.
definitions.definition_vi: để dần dần trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn, năng động hơn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to increase speed gradually
definitions.definition_vi: để tăng tốc độ dần dần

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to lose energy and enthusiasm and stop doing something, or do it less wellWord Origin
examples: Old English stēam ‘vapour’, stēman ‘emit a scent, be exhaled’, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch stoom ‘steam’.
definitions.definition_vi: mất năng lượng và sự nhiệt tình và ngừng làm việc gì đó hoặc làm việc đó kém hiệu quả hơn.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: one of a series of things that you do in order to achieve something
examples: SEE ALSO baby step
We are taking steps to prevent pollution.
It's a big step giving up your job and moving halfway across the world.
a necessary/an important/a positive step
This was a first step towards a united Europe.
This won't solve the problem but it's a step in the right direction.
The new drug represents a major step forward in the treatment of the disease.
Closing the factory would be a retrograde step.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong một loạt những việc bạn làm để đạt được điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: one of a series of things that somebody does or that happen, which forms part of a process
examples: SYNONYM stage
Having completed the first stage, you can move on to step 2.
If you follow all the steps, nothing will go wrong.
I'd like to take this idea a step further.
This was a big step up (= to a better position) in his career.
I'll explain it to you step by step.
a step-by-step guide to building your own home
definitions.definition_vi: một trong một loạt những việc ai đó làm hoặc điều đó xảy ra, tạo thành một phần của quá trình

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the act of lifting your foot and putting it down in order to walk or move somewhere; the sound this makes
examples: SEE ALSO footstep
a baby’s first steps
He took a step towards the door.
We heard steps outside.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động nhấc chân lên và đặt xuống để đi hoặc di chuyển đi đâu đó; âm thanh này tạo ra

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the distance that you cover when you take a step
examples: It's only a few steps further.
He turned around and retraced his steps (= went back the way he had come).
She moved a step closer to me.
The hotel is only a short step (= a short distance) from the beach.
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng cách bạn đi được khi bạn bước một bước

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a surface that you put your foot on in order to walk to a higher or lower level, especially one of a series
examples: SEE ALSO doorstep
She was sitting on the bottom step of the staircase.
We walked down some stone steps to the beach.
A short flight of steps led up to the door.
definitions.definition_vi: một bề mặt mà bạn đặt chân lên để đi đến cấp độ cao hơn hoặc thấp hơn, đặc biệt là một trong một loạt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a series of movements that you make with your feet and which form a dance
examples: SEE ALSO quickstep
Do you know the steps of this dance?
definitions.definition_vi: một loạt các chuyển động mà bạn thực hiện bằng chân và tạo thành một điệu nhảy

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: the way that somebody walks
examples: He walked with a quick light step.
There was a smile on her face and a spring in her step.
definitions.definition_vi: cách ai đó bước đi

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a type of exercise that you do by stepping on and off a raised piece of equipment
examples: step aerobics
a step class
definitions.definition_vi: một loại bài tập mà bạn thực hiện bằng cách bước lên và xuống một thiết bị được nâng lên

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: a stepladder
examples: a pair of steps
We need the steps to get into the attic.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái thang

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: the interval between two notes that are next to each other in a scale
examples: COMPARE semitone
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng cách giữa hai nốt nằm cạnh nhau trong thang âm

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to change the way you are walking so that you do not walk in the same rhythm as the people you are walking or marching with
examples: The soldiers turned without once breaking step.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi cách bạn đang bước đi để bạn không bước đi cùng nhịp điệu với những người bạn đang đi bộ hoặc diễu hành cùng

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to change the way you are walking so that you start walking in the same rhythm as the person you are walking with
examples: He caught her up and fell into step beside her.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi cách bạn đang bước đi để bạn bắt đầu bước đi cùng nhịp điệu với người đang đi cùng bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: putting your feet on the ground in the right/wrong way, according to the rhythm of the music or the people you are moving with
examples: He was out of step with the music.
She had trouble keeping in step with the others.
definitions.definition_vi: đặt chân xuống đất đúng/sai, theo nhịp điệu của âm nhạc hoặc những người bạn đang di chuyển cùng

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: having ideas that are the same as or different from other people’s
examples: She was out of step with her colleagues.
definitions.definition_vi: có những ý tưởng giống hoặc khác với ý tưởng của người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to walk carefully
definitions.definition_vi: đi lại cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to behave in a careful and sensible way
examples: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
definitions.definition_vi: cư xử một cách cẩn thận và hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: used to say that every time you make progress, something bad happens that means that the situation is worse than before
definitions.definition_vi: thường nói rằng mỗi khi bạn tiến bộ thì lại có điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra, điều đó có nghĩa là tình hình còn tệ hơn trước

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: when you are one step ahead of somebody/something, you manage to avoid them or to achieve something more quickly than they do
examples: She's always one step ahead of the competition.
definitions.definition_vi: khi bạn đi trước ai đó/điều gì đó một bước, bạn cố gắng tránh được họ hoặc đạt được điều gì đó nhanh hơn họ

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: when you do something one step at a time you do it slowly and graduallyWord Origin
examples: Old English stæpe, stepe (noun), stæppan, steppan (verb), of Germanic origin; related to Dutch steppen and German stapfen.
definitions.definition_vi: khi bạn làm điều gì đó từng bước một, bạn sẽ làm nó một cách chậm rãi và dần dần.

definitions.definition: a single thin piece of thread, wire, hair, etc.
examples: He pulled at a loose strand of wool in his sweater.
a few strands of dark hair
She wore a single strand of pearls around her neck.
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh sợi, dây, tóc mỏng, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: one of the different parts of an idea, a plan, a story, etc.
examples: We heard every strand of political opinion.
The author draws the different strands of the plot together in the final chapter.
definitions.definition_vi: một trong những phần khác nhau của một ý tưởng, một kế hoạch, một câu chuyện, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the land along the edge of the sea or ocean, or of a lake or riverWord Origin
examples: noun senses 1 to 2 late 15th cent.: of unknown origin. noun sense 3 Old English (as a noun), of unknown origin. The verb dates from the early 17th cent.
definitions.definition_vi: vùng đất dọc theo rìa biển hoặc đại dương, hoặc hồ hoặc sôngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: pressure or worry caused by the problems in somebody’s life
examples: SEE ALSO post-traumatic stress disorder
emotional/mental stress
to suffer from stress
to relieve/reduce/alleviate stress
Things can easily go wrong when people are under stress.
The incident has caused enormous stress and anxiety to my family.
She failed to withstand the stresses and strains of public life.
stress-related illnesses
stress management (= dealing with stress)
The release of the stress hormone cortisol is part of the human stress response.
Stress is often a factor in the development of long-term sickness.
definitions.definition_vi: áp lực hoặc lo lắng gây ra bởi những vấn đề trong cuộc sống của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: physical pressure put on something that can damage it or make it lose its shape
examples: When you have an injury you start putting stress on other parts of your body.
Little is known about the effects of water stress on plants.
The building was condemned because of the damage caused by excessive heat stress.
Different organisms react differently to environmental stress (= damage to the environment caused by human activity or natural events).
a stress fracture of the foot (= one caused by such pressure)
definitions.definition_vi: áp lực vật lý đặt lên thứ gì đó có thể làm hỏng nó hoặc làm cho nó mất hình dạng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an extra force used when pronouncing a particular word or syllable
examples: COMPARE intonation
We worked on pronunciation, stress and intonation.
There's a stress on the second syllable.
In ‘strategic’ the stress falls on the second syllable
definitions.definition_vi: một lực bổ sung được sử dụng khi phát âm một từ hoặc âm tiết cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: special importance given to something
examples: She lays great stress on punctuality.
I think the company places too much stress on cost and not enough on quality.
definitions.definition_vi: tầm quan trọng đặc biệt được trao cho một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: extra force used when making a particular sound in music
definitions.definition_vi: lực bổ sung được sử dụng khi tạo ra một âm thanh cụ thể trong âm nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: illness caused by difficult physical conditions
examples: Those most vulnerable to heat stress are the elderly.
definitions.definition_vi: bệnh tật do điều kiện thể chất khó khăn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make something longer, wider or looser, for example by pulling it; to become longer, etc. in this way
examples: Is there any way of stretching shoes?
Stop stretching your sleeves like that!
This sweater has stretched.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó dài hơn, rộng hơn hoặc lỏng lẻo hơn, chẳng hạn bằng cách kéo nó; để trở nên dài hơn, v.v. theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to become bigger or longer when you pull it and return to its original shape when you stop
examples: The jeans stretch to provide a perfect fit.
definitions.definition_vi: trở nên to hơn hoặc dài hơn khi bạn kéo nó và trở lại hình dạng ban đầu khi bạn dừng lại

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to pull something so that it is smooth and tight
examples: Stretch the fabric tightly over the frame.
Striped awnings had been stretched across the courtyard.
Make sure that the rope is stretched tight.
definitions.definition_vi: kéo cái gì đó sao cho nó trơn tru và chặt chẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to put your arms or legs out straight and contract your muscles
examples: He stretched and yawned lazily.
Andrea turned out the light and stretched full-length on the bed.
The exercises are designed to stretch and tone your leg muscles.
It was impossible to bend or stretch my legs.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa cánh tay hoặc chân của bạn thẳng ra và co cơ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to put out an arm or a leg in order to reach something
examples: She stretched across the table for the butter.
She stretched up to reach the top shelf.
I stretched out a hand and picked up the book.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa ra một cánh tay hoặc một chân để đạt được một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to spread over an area of land
examples: SYNONYM extend
Fields and hills stretched out as far as we could see.
The traffic jam seemed to stretch for miles.
A line of cars stretched into the distance.
The flat landscape stretched to the horizon.
Beyond the mountains stretches a vast desert.
definitions.definition_vi: trải rộng trên một diện tích đất

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to continue over a period of time
examples: The town's history stretches back to before 1500.
to stretch back years/decades/generations/centuries
The training stretches over a period of 16 months.
Endless summer days stretched out before us.
The talks look set to stretch into a second week.
The future stretched out endlessly in front of me.
definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục trong một khoảng thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be enough to buy or pay for something
examples: I need a new car, but my savings won't stretch to it.
There are lots of things I’d like to buy, but our budget just won’t stretch that far.
definitions.definition_vi: đủ để mua hoặc trả tiền cho cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to make use of a lot of your money, supplies, time, etc.
examples: The influx of refugees has stretched the country's resources to the limit.
We can't take on any more work—we're fully stretched as it is.
The budget is already stretched to breaking point.
definitions.definition_vi: để tận dụng rất nhiều tiền bạc, nguồn cung cấp, thời gian, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to increase your lead over somebody in a game or competition
examples: A minute later, Kelly stretched their lead to eight points.
definitions.definition_vi: để tăng sự dẫn đầu của bạn so với ai đó trong một trò chơi hoặc cuộc thi

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to make use of all somebody’s skill, intelligence, etc.
examples: I need a job that will stretch me.
She was never really stretched at school.
The book really stretches your imagination.
definitions.definition_vi: để sử dụng tất cả các kỹ năng, trí thông minh của ai đó, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to use something in a way that would not normally be considered fair, acceptable, etc.
examples: He admitted that he had maybe stretched the truth a little (= not been completely honest).
The play's plot stretches credulity to the limit.
definitions.definition_vi: sử dụng cái gì đó theo cách mà thông thường không được coi là công bằng, có thể chấp nhận được, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to change the rules to suit a particular person or situation
examples: Couldn't they just bend the rules and let us in without a ticket?
definitions.definition_vi: để thay đổi các quy tắc cho phù hợp với một người cụ thể hoặc tình hình

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to go for a short walk after sitting for some time
examples: It was good to get out of the car and stretch our legs.
definitions.definition_vi: đi dạo một đoạn ngắn sau khi ngồi một lúc

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to allow or do something that is not usually acceptable, especially because of a particular situation
examples: I was hoping they would stretch a point and let me stay on for a while.
definitions.definition_vi: cho phép hoặc làm điều gì đó mà thường không được chấp nhận, đặc biệt là vì một tình huống cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to hit somebody/something hard or with force
examples: The ship struck a rock.
The child ran into the road and was struck by a car.
The tree was struck by lightning.
Warplanes struck several targets in the city.
He fell, striking his head on the edge of the table.
He was struck in the head by a bullet.
The stone struck her on the forehead.
The oar struck against something hard.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai/cái gì thật mạnh hoặc bằng vũ lực

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to hit somebody/something with your hand or a weapon
examples: She struck him in the face.
He struck the table with his fist.
Who struck the first blow (= started the fight)?
Did she ever strike you?
He struck her two blows on the leg.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai/cái gì bằng tay hoặc vũ khí

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to hit or kick a ball, etc.
examples: He walked up to the penalty spot and struck the ball firmly into the back of the net.
definitions.definition_vi: để đánh hoặc đá một quả bóng, vv

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to attack somebody/something, especially suddenly
examples: The lion crouched ready to strike.
Police fear that the killer may strike again.
The guerrillas struck with deadly force.
definitions.definition_vi: tấn công ai/cái gì, đặc biệt là bất ngờ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to happen suddenly and have a harmful or damaging effect on somebody/something
examples: Two days later tragedy struck.
Disaster struck again when their best player was injured.
The area was struck by an outbreak of cholera.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra bất ngờ và có tác động có hại hoặc gây tổn hại đến ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to come into somebody’s mind suddenly
examples: An awful thought has just struck me.
I was struck by her resemblance to my aunt.
One thing that really struck me was how calm he appeared.
It suddenly struck me how we could improve the situation.
definitions.definition_vi: đột nhiên xuất hiện trong tâm trí ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to give somebody a particular impression
examples: Another part of his comment struck me.
His reaction struck me as odd.
She strikes me as a very efficient person.
How does the idea strike you?
It strikes me that nobody is really in favour of the changes.
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp cho ai đó một ấn tượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to refuse to work because of an argument over pay or conditions
examples: Over 100 000 civil servants are set to strike on Tuesday.
Drivers are threatening to strike over pay.
The union has voted to strike for a pay increase of 6%.
Striking workers picketed the factory.
definitions.definition_vi: từ chối làm việc vì tranh cãi về lương hoặc điều kiện

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to fall on a surface
examples: The windows sparkled as the sun struck the glass.
definitions.definition_vi: rơi trên một bề mặt

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to put somebody suddenly into a particular state
examples: to be struck dumb/deaf/blind
definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột đưa ai đó vào một trạng thái cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to rub something such as a match against a surface so that it produces a flame; to produce a flame when rubbed against a rough surface
examples: to strike a match on a wall
The sword struck sparks off the stone floor.
The matches were damp and he couldn't make them strike.
definitions.definition_vi: chà xát một vật gì đó như que diêm lên một bề mặt để nó tạo ra ngọn lửa; tạo ra ngọn lửa khi cọ xát vào bề mặt gồ ghề

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to show the time by making a ringing noise, etc.
examples: SYNONYM chime
Did you hear the clock strike?
Four o’clock had just struck.
The clock has just struck three.
definitions.definition_vi: để hiển thị thời gian bằng cách tạo ra tiếng chuông, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to produce a musical note, sound, etc. by pressing a key or hitting something
examples: She struck a chord on the piano and the children began to sing.
definitions.definition_vi: tạo ra một nốt nhạc, âm thanh, v.v. bằng cách nhấn một phím hoặc nhấn vào vật gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to discover gold, oil, etc. by digging or drilling
examples: They had struck oil!
definitions.definition_vi: để khám phá vàng, dầu, vv bằng cách đào hoặc khoan

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to go somewhere with great energy or purpose
examples: We left the road and struck off across the fields.
He struck out (= started swimming) towards the shore.
The German army struck deep into northern France.
definitions.definition_vi: đi đâu đó với năng lượng hoặc mục đích tuyệt vời

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: to be impressed or interested by somebody/something; to like somebody/something very much
examples: I was struck by her youth and enthusiasm.
We're not very struck on that new restaurant.
definitions.definition_vi: bị ấn tượng hoặc quan tâm bởi ai đó/cái gì đó; rất thích ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: to argue in an aggressive way and force somebody to agree on the best possible price or arrangement
definitions.definition_vi: tranh luận một cách hung hăng và buộc ai đó phải đồng ý về mức giá hoặc sự sắp xếp tốt nhất có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: if a remark, etc. hits/strikes home, it has a strong effect on somebody, in a way that makes them realize what the true facts of a situation are
examples: Her face went pale as his words hit home.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một nhận xét, v.v. đánh trúng/đánh trúng đích, nó có tác động mạnh mẽ đến ai đó, theo cách khiến họ nhận ra sự thật thực sự của một tình huống là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: to suddenly be in a successful situation, especially one that makes you rich
examples: The band really hit pay dirt with their last album.
definitions.definition_vi: đột nhiên ở trong một tình huống thành công, đặc biệt là một tình huống làm cho bạn giàu có

definitions.label: Meaning 20
definitions.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
examples: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
definitions.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp cho một dịp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 21
definitions.definition: to hit the wooden frame of the goal in the game of football (soccer), instead of scoring a goal
examples: She hit the woodwork twice before scoring.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh vào khung gỗ của khung thành trong trò chơi bóng đá (bóng đá), thay vì ghi bàn thắng

definitions.label: Meaning 22
definitions.definition: an unusual or unpleasant event is not likely to happen in the same place or to the same people twice
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện bất thường hoặc khó chịu không có khả năng xảy ra hai lần ở cùng một nơi hoặc với cùng một người

definitions.label: Meaning 23
definitions.definition: to express feelings or opinions of a particular kind
examples: She sounded a note of warning in her speech.
The touch of cynicism struck a slightly sour note.
definitions.definition_vi: để bày tỏ cảm xúc hoặc ý kiến ​​của một loại cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 24
definitions.definition: to manage to find a way of being fair to two things that are opposed to each other; to find an acceptable position that is between two things
examples: We need to strike a balance between these conflicting interests.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng tìm ra cách công bằng cho hai điều đối lập nhau; để tìm một vị trí chấp nhận được đó là giữa hai điều

definitions.label: Meaning 25
definitions.definition: to make an agreement with somebody in which both sides have an advantage
examples: Perhaps we could strike a bargain.
The United States has struck a historic deal with India.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hiện một thỏa thuận với ai đó mà cả hai bên đều có lợi

definitions.label: Meaning 26
definitions.definition: to do something in support of/against a belief, principle, etc.
examples: He felt that they had struck a blow for democracy.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó ủng hộ/chống lại một niềm tin, nguyên tắc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 27
definitions.definition: to say or do something that makes people feel sympathy or enthusiasm
examples: The speaker had obviously struck a chord with his audience.
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó khiến mọi người cảm thấy thông cảm hoặc nhiệt tình

definitions.label: Meaning 28
definitions.definition: to make somebody be afraid, etc.
examples: The sound of gunfire struck fear into the hearts of the villagers.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó sợ hãi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 29
definitions.definition: to find or do something that brings you a lot of success or money
examples: He has struck gold with his latest novel.
definitions.definition_vi: tìm kiếm hoặc làm điều gì đó mang lại cho bạn nhiều thành công hoặc tiền bạc

definitions.label: Meaning 30
definitions.definition: if a remark, etc. strikes/hits home, it has a strong effect on somebody, in a way that makes them realize what the true facts of a situation are
examples: His face went pale as her words struck home.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một nhận xét, v.v. tấn công/đánh trúng đích, nó có tác động mạnh mẽ đến ai đó, theo cách khiến họ nhận ra sự thật thực sự của một tình huống là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 31
definitions.definition: to get a lot of money, especially suddenly or unexpectedly
definitions.definition_vi: để có được rất nhiều tiền, đặc biệt là đột ngột hoặc bất ngờ

definitions.label: Meaning 32
definitions.definition: to have good luck
examples: We certainly struck it lucky with the weather.
definitions.definition_vi: để gặp may mắn

definitions.label: Meaning 33
definitions.definition: to have a strong effect
examples: His work strikes a nerve with people who are attracted to nostalgia.
It seems I struck a nerve with my last post about cell phones.
Nissan may well strike a popular nerve here.
definitions.definition_vi: để có tác dụng mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 34
definitions.definition: to suddenly be in a successful situation, especially one that makes you rich
examples: The band really struck pay dirt with their last album.
definitions.definition_vi: đột nhiên ở trong một tình huống thành công, đặc biệt là một tình huống làm cho bạn giàu có

definitions.label: Meaning 35
definitions.definition: to hold your body in a particular way to create a particular impression
examples: to strike a dramatic pose
He strikes an attitude of bravery and lonely defiance.
definitions.definition_vi: giữ cơ thể của bạn theo một cách cụ thể để tạo ra một ấn tượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 36
definitions.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
examples: It is a bizarre tale and the author strikes just the right note of horror and disbelief.
definitions.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp cho một dịp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 37
definitions.definition: to make use of an opportunity immediately
definitions.definition_vi: tận dụng cơ hội ngay lập tức

definitions.label: Meaning 38
definitions.definition: near enough to be reached or attacked easily; near enough to reach or attack something easily
examples: The beach is within striking distance.
The cat was now within striking distance of the duck.
definitions.definition_vi: đủ gần để có thể tiếp cận hoặc tấn công dễ dàng; đủ gần để tiếp cận hoặc tấn công một cái gì đó một cách dễ dàng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy weights, do hard physical work, etc.
examples: He's strong enough to lift a car!
strong muscles
She wasn't a strong swimmer (= she could not swim well).
definitions.definition_vi: có nhiều sức mạnh thể chất để bạn có thể nâng tạ nặng, làm những công việc nặng nhọc, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having great power
examples: Stay indoors in the middle of the day, when the sun is strongest.
a strong wind
a strong magnet/current
definitions.definition_vi: có sức mạnh to lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: having a powerful effect on the body or mind
examples: a strong drug
His imagery made a strong impression on the critics.
definitions.definition_vi: có tác dụng mạnh mẽ lên cơ thể hoặc tâm trí

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: He had a sudden sinking feeling in the pit of his stomach.

definitions.definition_vi: đáy dạ dày nơi mọi người nói rằng họ cảm thấy cảm giác mạnh mẽ, đặc biệt là sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy rất tức giận hoặc lo lắng

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác muốn nôn

definitions.label: Meaning 12

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: kết thúc hoặc kết thúc; làm cho cái gì đó kết thúc hoặc kết thúc

There's nothing to stop you from accepting the offer.
definitions.definition_vi: ngăn cản ai đó làm việc gì đó; để ngăn chặn điều gì đó xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to end an activity for a short time in order to do something
examples: I'm hungry. Let's stop for lunch.
We stopped for the night in Port Augusta.

People just don't stop to think about the consequences.
definitions.definition_vi: kết thúc một hoạt động trong một thời gian ngắn để làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to no longer be working or functioning; to make something be no longer working or functioning
examples: Why has the engine stopped?
What time is it? My watch has stopped.
I felt as if my heart had stopped.
Can you stop the printer once it’s started?
definitions.definition_vi: không còn làm việc hoặc hoạt động nữa; làm cho cái gì đó không còn hoạt động hoặc hoạt động được nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to stay somewhere for a short time, especially at somebody’s house
examples: I'm not stopping. I just came to give you this message.

definitions.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn việc trả tiền

definitions.label: Meaning 9

definitions.label: Meaning 10

examples: She’ll stop at nothing to make money.
definitions.definition_vi: sẵn sàng làm bất cứ điều gì để đạt được điều mình muốn, ngay cả khi điều đó là không trung thực hoặc sai trái

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: ngừng đo thời gian trong một trò chơi hoặc một hoạt động có giới hạn thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to suddenly make somebody stop by frightening or surprising them; to suddenly stop because something has frightened or surprised you

definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột khiến ai đó dừng lại bằng cách khiến họ sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên; đột ngột dừng lại vì điều gì đó làm bạn sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to suddenly stop, or make somebody suddenly stop, doing something

definitions.definition_vi: đột ngột dừng lại hoặc khiến ai đó đột ngột dừng lại, đang làm việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to be unwilling to do something because it may involve a risk, but to nearly do it
examples: She stopped short of calling the president a liar.

definitions.definition_vi: không sẵn sàng làm điều gì đó vì nó có thể gây rủi ro nhưng gần như đã làm được

definitions.label: Meaning 1

a tragic love story
adventure/detective stories
a bedtime story

She writes poems and stories for children.
a story about time travel

What are the key events in the story?
definitions.definition_vi: mô tả các sự kiện và con người mà người viết hoặc người nói đã bịa ra nhằm mục đích giải trí cho mọi người

definitions.label: Meaning 2

The screenplay sticks to the original story.

definitions.definition_vi: chuỗi sự kiện trong một cuốn sách, bộ phim, vở kịch, v.v.

the story of the Beatles
the story of the building of the bridge

definitions.label: Meaning 5

a front-page story

Let's check the top stories right now.
the two biggest stories of the day

definitions.definition_vi: một báo cáo trên một tờ báo, tạp chí hoặc chương trình phát sóng tin tức

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.definition_vi: cấp độ của một tòa nhà; một tầng

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn không tin những gì ai đó đã nói

definitions.definition_vi: điều gì thường xảy ra

definitions.definition_vi: trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn

definitions.definition_vi: để tận dụng rất nhiều tiền bạc, nguồn cung cấp, thời gian, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: ở một mức độ lớn hoặc mức độ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: in a way that is easy to notice
examples: The room smelt strongly of polish.
These works are strongly reminiscent of earlier paintings.
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách dễ nhận thấy

definitions.label: Meaning 4

examples: a light shining strongly
He finished strongly in a time of 38 minutes, 44 seconds.

definitions.definition_vi: với rất nhiều quyền lực hoặc lực lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 5

examples: a strongly built boat
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách có nghĩa là một cái gì đó không thể dễ dàng bị phá vỡ hoặc hư hỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the way in which the parts of something are connected together, arranged or organized; a particular arrangement of parts
examples: the structure of the building
changes in the economic structure of society

the grammatical structures of a language
the structure of proteins/DNA
definitions.definition_vi: cách thức mà các bộ phận của một cái gì đó được kết nối, sắp xếp hoặc tổ chức với nhau; sự sắp xếp cụ thể của các bộ phận

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a thing that is made of several parts, especially a building
examples: a stone/brick/wooden structure
She used sand and rocks to build elaborate structures on the beach.
definitions.definition_vi: một thứ được làm từ nhiều bộ phận, đặc biệt là một tòa nhà

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the state of being well organized or planned with all the parts linked together; a careful plan
examples: Your essay needs (a) structure.
definitions.definition_vi: trạng thái được tổ chức hoặc lên kế hoạch tốt với tất cả các bộ phận được liên kết với nhau; một kế hoạch cẩn thận

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to refer to a substance, material, group of objects, etc. when you do not know the name, when the name is not important or when it is obvious what you are talking about
examples: SEE ALSO foodstuff
What's all that sticky stuff on the carpet?
The chairs were covered in some sort of plastic stuff.
This wine is good stuff.
I don't know how you can eat that stuff!
They sell stationery and stuff (like that).
Where's all my stuff (= my possessions)?
Could you move all that stuff off the table?
I want to buy some expensive tech stuff.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ một chất, chất liệu, nhóm đồ vật, v.v. khi bạn không biết tên, khi cái tên đó không quan trọng hoặc khi bạn đang nói về điều gì đó quá rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to refer in a general way to things that people do, say, think, etc.
examples: Peter's article had lots of interesting stuff in it.
There's still a lot of cool stuff happening in Manchester.
I've got loads of stuff to do today.
I like reading and stuff.
The band did some great stuff on their first album.
This is all good stuff. Well done!
I don't believe in all that stuff about ghosts.
What's all this ‘Mrs Smith’ stuff? Call me Anna.
He's done so much stuff and been so many interesting places.
I've read a whole bunch of stuff by different people over the past few days.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề cập một cách tổng quát đến những điều mà mọi người làm, nói, suy nghĩ, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the most important feature of something; something that something else is based on or is made from
examples: SEE ALSO hot stuff
The trip was magical; the stuff of which dreams are made.
Parades and marches were the very stuff of politics in the region.
Connor's story is the stuff of legend.
the stuff of dreams/nightmares
Let’s see what stuff you’re made of (= what sort of person you are).
definitions.definition_vi: tính năng quan trọng nhất của một cái gì đó; cái gì đó mà cái gì khác dựa vào hoặc được làm từ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to have a stronger character and to be more determined in dealing with problems than other people
examples: Many would have given up, but Tim was made of sterner stuff.
definitions.definition_vi: có tính cách mạnh mẽ hơn và quyết tâm giải quyết vấn đề hơn những người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody not to worry about small details or things that are not important
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó đừng lo lắng về những chi tiết nhỏ nhặt hoặc những điều không quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to do what you are good at or what you have been trained to do
examples: Some members of the team are just not doing their stuff (= doing as well as they should).
The medicine has clearly done its stuff.
definitions.definition_vi: làm những gì bạn giỏi hoặc những gì bạn đã được đào tạo để làm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: something that is so easy to do or understand that it is thought to be not very serious or only suitable for children
examples: That was kids' stuff compared with what lies ahead.
The movie is pure kids' stuff from beginning to end.
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó rất dễ làm hoặc dễ hiểu đến mức người ta cho rằng nó không nghiêm trọng lắm hoặc chỉ phù hợp với trẻ em

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to know a lot about a particular subject or job
definitions.definition_vi: biết nhiều về một chủ đề hoặc công việc cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to not care at all about something
definitions.definition_vi: không quan tâm chút nào đến điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10

definitions.definition_vi: để tự hào thể hiện khả năng của bạn, đặc biệt là khiêu vũ hoặc biểu diễn

You've been warned, so don't do anything stupid.

That was just plain stupid!

definitions.definition_vi: thể hiện sự thiếu suy nghĩ hoặc phán đoán tốt

definitions.definition: slow to learn or understand things; not clever or intelligent
examples: He'll manage—he isn't stupid.

definitions.definition_vi: chậm học hoặc hiểu mọi thứ; không thông minh hay thông minh

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to emphasize that you are annoyed with somebody/something
examples: I can't get the stupid thing open!

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang khó chịu với ai/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the particular way in which something is done

They want a wide range of learning resources to suit different learning styles.
a management style
a style of management
furniture to suit your style of living
His aggressive style of play sometimes gets him in trouble.
I really enjoy playing this style of music.
I like your style (= I like the way you do things).
Caution was not her style (= not the way she usually behaved).
I'm surprised he rides a motorbike—I'd have thought big cars were more his style (= what suited him).
definitions.definition_vi: cách cụ thể mà một cái gì đó được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a particular design of something, especially clothes
examples: SEE ALSO hairstyle
We stock a wide variety of styles and sizes.
Have you thought about having your hair in a shorter style?
a style that was popular in the 1950s
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết kế cụ thể của một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là quần áo

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the quality of being fashionable in the clothes that you wear
examples: style-conscious teenagers
My husband has no sense of style.

They still refer to her as a style guru and a trend-setter.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng của sự thời trang trong quần áo bạn mặc

definitions.definition: the quality of being attractive and made or done to a high standard
examples: The hotel has been redecorated but it's lost a lot of its style.
This movie is all surface style and no substance.
She does everything with style and grace.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the features of a book, painting, building, etc. that make it typical of a particular author, artist, historical period, etc.
examples: a style of architecture
a fine example of Gothic style

He developed a distinctive style of painting.
a parody written in the style of Molière
The palace was rebuilt in the same style.
definitions.definition_vi: các đặc điểm của một cuốn sách, bức tranh, tòa nhà, v.v. làm cho nó trở thành điển hình của một tác giả, nghệ sĩ, giai đoạn lịch sử cụ thể, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: the correct use of language
examples: It's not considered good style to start a sentence with ‘but’.
Please follow house style (= the rules of spelling, etc. used by a particular publishing company).
definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng ngôn ngữ đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: having the type of style mentioned
examples: SEE ALSO family-style
Italian-style gardens
a buffet-style breakfast
definitions.definition_vi: có loại phong cách được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: the long, thin part of a flower that carries the stigma
definitions.definition_vi: phần dài và mỏng của hoa mang đầu nhụy

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to stop somebody from behaving in the way they want to
examples: She didn’t want me to go with her to the party in case I cramped her style.
definitions.definition_vi: ngăn cản ai cư xử theo cách họ muốn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: in an impressive way
examples: She always celebrates her birthday in style.
He won the championship in great style.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách ấn tượng

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service, be a member of a club, support a charity or receive regular copies of a newspaper or magazine; the act of paying this money
examples: an annual subscription
a subscription to Netflix
a monthly subscription to Oxfam
to take out a subscription to ‘Newsweek’
to cancel/renew a subscription
Copies are available by subscription.
Subscriptions are due annually by the end of January.
definitions.definition_vi: số tiền bạn phải trả thường xuyên để nhận được một dịch vụ, trở thành thành viên của câu lạc bộ, hỗ trợ tổ chức từ thiện hoặc nhận bản sao thường xuyên của một tờ báo hoặc tạp chí; hành động trả số tiền này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of people paying money for something to be done
examples: A statue in his memory was erected by public subscription.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động của người trả tiền cho một cái gì đó để được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: afterwards; later; after something else has happened
examples: The original interview notes were subsequently lost.
Subsequently, new guidelines were issued to all employees.
He subsequently became chairman of the party.
definitions.definition_vi: sau đó; sau đó; sau khi chuyện khác đã xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: money that is paid by a government or an organization to reduce the costs of services or of producing goods so that their prices can be kept low
examples: agricultural subsidies
to reduce the level of subsidy
definitions.definition_vi: tiền được chính phủ hoặc tổ chức trả để giảm chi phí dịch vụ hoặc sản xuất hàng hóa để giá của chúng có thể được giữ ở mức thấp

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a type of solid, liquid or gas that has particular qualities
examples: a sticky substance
a chemical/radioactive/hazardous substance
Some frogs produce toxic substances in their skin.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại chất rắn, lỏng hoặc khí có phẩm chất đặc biệt

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a drug, especially an illegal one
examples: illegal/controlled substances
He was disqualified from competing after testing positive to a banned substance.
Adolescent substance use remains high in the United States.
definitions.definition_vi: một loại thuốc, đặc biệt là một loại bất hợp pháp

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the quality of being based on facts or the truth
examples: The commission's report gives substance to these allegations.
There is some substance in what he says.
It was malicious gossip, completely without substance.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng của việc dựa trên sự thật hoặc sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the most important or main part of something
examples: Love and guilt form the substance of his new book.
The real substance of the report was in the third part.
I agreed with what she said in substance, though not with every detail.
There seems to be no difference in substance between the two procedures.
definitions.definition_vi: phần quan trọng nhất hoặc chính của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: importance
examples: SYNONYM significance
matters of substance
Nothing of any substance was achieved in the meeting.
definitions.definition_vi: tầm quan trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a rich and powerful man or womanWord Origin
examples: Middle English (denoting the essential nature of something): from Old French, from Latin substantia ‘being, essence’, from substant- ‘standing firm’, from the verb substare.
definitions.definition_vi: một người đàn ông hay phụ nữ giàu có và quyền lựcNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person or thing that you use or have instead of the one you normally use or have
examples: a meat substitute
a substitute family
Paul's father only saw him as a substitute for his dead brother.
The course teaches you the theory but there's no substitute for practical experience.
The local bus service was a poor substitute for their car.
definitions.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà bạn sử dụng hoặc có thay vì cái bạn thường sử dụng hoặc có

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a player who replaces another player in a sports game
examples: He was brought on as (a) substitute after half-time.
definitions.definition_vi: một cầu thủ thay thế một cầu thủ khác trong một trận đấu thể thao

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used to emphasize the great degree of something
examples: This issue was of such importance that we could not afford to ignore it.
Why are you in such a hurry?
It's such a beautiful day!
Such is the elegance of this typeface that it is still a favourite of designers.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh mức độ tuyệt vời của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: of the type already mentioned
examples: They had been invited to a Hindu wedding and were not sure what happened on such occasions.
He said he didn't have time or made some such excuse.
She longed to find somebody who understood her problems, and in him she thought she had found such a person.
We were second-class citizens and they treated us as such.
Accountants were boring. Such (= that) was her opinion before meeting Ian!
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc loại đã được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: of the type that you are just going to mention
examples: There is no such thing as a free lunch.
Such advice as he was given (= it was not very much) has proved almost worthless.
The knot was fastened in such a way that it was impossible to undo.
The damage was such that it would cost thousands to repair.
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc loại mà bạn vừa đề cập đến

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: and similar things or people
examples: The centre offers activities like canoeing and sailing and such.
definitions.definition_vi: và những thứ hoặc những người tương tự

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: as the word is usually understood; in the exact sense of the word
examples: The new job is not a promotion as such, but it has good prospects.
‘Well, did they offer it to you?’ ‘No, not as such, but they said I had a good chance.’
definitions.definition_vi: như từ thường được hiểu; theo đúng nghĩa của từ này

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: for example
examples: Wild flowers such as primroses are becoming rare.
‘There are loads of things to do.’ ‘Such as?’ (= give me an example)
definitions.definition_vi: Ví dụ

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: of a kind that; like
examples: Opportunities such as this did not come every day.
definitions.definition_vi: thuộc loại đó; giống

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to say that there is not much of something or that it is of poor quality
examples: The food, such as it was, was served at nine o'clock.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng cái gì đó không có nhiều hoặc chất lượng kém

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: I suddenly realized what I had to do.
I suddenly became aware of just how late it was.

definitions.definition: a sweet substance, often in the form of white or brown crystals, made from the juices of various plants, used in cooking or to make tea, coffee, etc. sweeter
examples: SEE ALSO barley sugar
Do you take sugar (= have it in your tea, coffee, etc.)?
Serve the cake warm or cold, sprinkled with sugar.
This juice contains no added sugar.

a sugar plantation/refinery
He stirred another spoonful of sugar into his tea.

definitions.definition: the amount of sugar that a small spoon can hold or that is contained in a small cube, added to tea, coffee, etc.
examples: How many sugars do you take in coffee?
definitions.definition_vi: lượng đường mà một chiếc thìa nhỏ có thể chứa được hoặc lượng đường được chứa trong một viên nhỏ, thêm vào trà, cà phê, v.v.

definitions.definition: any of various sweet substances that are found naturally in plants, fruit, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO blood sugar
fruit sugars

definitions.definition_vi: bất kỳ chất ngọt nào được tìm thấy tự nhiên trong thực vật, trái cây, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a way of addressing somebody that you like or love
examples: See you later, sugar.
definitions.definition_vi: một cách xưng hô với ai đó mà bạn thích hoặc yêu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to put forward an idea or a plan for other people to think about
examples: SYNONYM propose
I'd like to suggest a different explanation for the company's decline.
The designer is known for suggesting innovative ideas to her clients.
He thought long and hard, but no answer suggested itself.
A solution immediately suggested itself to me (= I immediately thought of a solution).
I strongly suggest (that) you don't get involved.
I suggested going in my car.
It has been suggested that bright children take their exams early.
It has been suggested that bright children should take their exams early.
‘We could go for a drive,’ Nate suggested hopefully.
definitions.definition_vi: đưa ra một ý tưởng hoặc một kế hoạch để người khác suy nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to tell somebody about a suitable person, thing, method, etc. for a particular job or purpose
examples: SYNONYM recommend
Who would you suggest for the job?
She suggested Paris as a good place for the conference.
She suggested John as chairman.
Can you suggest a better way of doing it?
May I suggest a white wine with this dish, Sir?

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to hit somebody/something quickly and lightly
examples: Someone tapped at the door.
He was busy tapping away at his computer.
Ralph tapped me on the shoulder.
Tap the icon to open the app.
definitions.definition_vi: đánh ai/cái gì một cách nhanh chóng và nhẹ nhàng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: if you tap your fingers, feet, etc. or they tap, you hit them gently against a table, the floor, etc., for example to the rhythm of music
examples: He kept tapping his fingers on the table.
The music set everyone's feet tapping.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu bạn gõ ngón tay, bàn chân, v.v. hoặc chúng gõ, bạn gõ nhẹ chúng vào bàn, sàn nhà, v.v., chẳng hạn như theo nhịp nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 3

examples: We need to tap the expertise of the people we already have.

definitions.definition_vi: để sử dụng một nguồn năng lượng, kiến ​​thức, vv đã tồn tại

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to fit a device to a phone so that somebody’s calls can be listened to secretly

definitions.definition_vi: lắp thiết bị vào điện thoại để có thể bí mật nghe cuộc gọi của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.label: Meaning 6

definitions.definition_vi: chọn ai đó để làm một công việc cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the particular quality that different foods and drinks have that allows you to recognize them when you put them in your mouth
examples: a sweet/salty/bitter/sour taste

This dish has an unusual combination of tastes and textures.
The soup has very little taste.
definitions.definition_vi: chất lượng đặc biệt mà các loại thực phẩm và đồ uống khác nhau có cho phép bạn nhận ra chúng khi bạn cho chúng vào miệng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the sense you have that allows you to recognize different foods and drinks when you put them in your mouth
examples: I've lost my sense of taste.
definitions.definition_vi: giác quan cho phép bạn nhận biết các loại thực phẩm và đồ uống khác nhau khi bạn cho chúng vào miệng

examples: Just have a taste of this cheese.

definitions.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ thức ăn hoặc đồ uống mà bạn thử để xem nó như thế nào

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a short experience of something
examples: This was my first taste of live theatre.
Although we didn't know it, this incident was a taste of things to come.
definitions.definition_vi: một trải nghiệm ngắn về điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a person’s ability to choose things that people recognize as being of good quality or appropriate

They've got more money than taste.
She's famous for her impeccable taste and style.
definitions.definition_vi: khả năng của một người trong việc lựa chọn những thứ mà mọi người công nhận là có chất lượng tốt hoặc phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: what a person likes or prefers
examples: You can adapt the recipe to suit your personal taste.
That trip gave me a taste for foreign travel.

Modern art is not to everyone's taste.
definitions.definition_vi: những gì một người thích hoặc thích

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a thing that you do not like much at first but gradually learn to like
examples: Abstract art is an acquired taste.
definitions.definition_vi: thứ mà lúc đầu bạn không thích lắm nhưng dần dần bạn sẽ thích

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to be offensive and not at all appropriate
examples: Most of his jokes were in very poor taste.
definitions.definition_vi: mang tính xúc phạm và không phù hợp chút nào

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to be appropriate and not at all offensive
examples: The love scenes are all done in the best possible taste.
definitions.definition_vi: phải phù hợp và không hề gây khó chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to make you feel upset or ashamed afterwards
examples: The whole business left a bad taste in my mouth.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho bạn cảm thấy khó chịu hoặc xấu hổ sau đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: the same bad treatment that you have given to others
examples: Let the bully have a taste of his own medicine.
definitions.definition_vi: sự đối xử tồi tệ tương tự mà bạn đã dành cho người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say how difficult it is to understand why somebody likes somebody/something that you do not like at all
examples: She thinks he's wonderful—oh well, there's no accounting for taste.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng thật khó để hiểu tại sao ai đó lại thích ai đó/cái gì đó mà bạn không thích chút nào

definitions.label: Meaning 13

examples: Add salt and pepper to taste.

iced tea

I don't drink tea.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to take a particular direction or often have a particular quality

definitions.definition_vi: để có một hướng cụ thể hoặc thường có một chất lượng cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 3

well-tended gardens

definitions.definition_vi: quan tâm đến ai/cái gì

to do a test
to pass/fail a test
a good mark in the test

negative/positive test results

examples: SEE ALSO acid test
the results of laboratory tests
to conduct a nuclear test

I'll run a diagnostic test to determine why the server keeps crashing.
definitions.definition_vi: một thử nghiệm để khám phá xem một cái gì đó hoạt động tốt như thế nào hoặc để tìm hiểu thêm thông tin về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a situation or an event that shows how good, strong, etc. somebody/something is
examples: The local elections will be a good test of the government's popularity.

definitions.definition_vi: một tình huống hoặc một sự kiện cho thấy ai đó/cái gì đó tốt đẹp, mạnh mẽ như thế nào, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to put somebody/something in a situation that will show what their or its true qualities are
examples: His theories have never really been put to the test.

definitions.definition_vi: để chứng minh là tốt, phổ biến, vv trong một thời gian dài
