definitions.definition_vi: hình dáng bên ngoài của một người, đồ vật hoặc tình huống; những phẩm chất mà bạn nhìn thấy hoặc chú ý, không bị che giấu

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: when not thought about deeply or carefully and completely; when not looked at carefully
examples: It seems like a good idea on the surface but there are sure to be problems.
On the surface, he appeared unchanged.
On the surface his words were funny, but I detected a lot of anger behind them.
definitions.definition_vi: khi không suy nghĩ sâu sắc hoặc cẩn thận và trọn vẹn; khi không nhìn kỹ

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to deal with, understand, or find out about only a small part of a subject or problem
examples: We left feeling that we had just scratched the surface of this fascinating country.
The investigation barely scratched the surface of the city's drug problem.
definitions.definition_vi: để giải quyết, hiểu, hoặc tìm hiểu về chỉ một phần nhỏ của một chủ đề hoặc vấn đề

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a sudden increase of a strong feeling
examples: SYNONYM rush
She felt a sudden surge of anger.
a surge of excitement
definitions.definition_vi: sự gia tăng đột ngột của một cảm giác mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sudden increase in the amount or number of something
examples: SEE ALSO upsurge
a surge in consumer spending
We are having trouble keeping up with the recent surge in demand.
A last-minute surge in ticket sales saved the show from closure.
After an initial surge of interest, there has been little call for our services.
definitions.definition_vi: sự gia tăng đột ngột về số lượng hoặc số lượng của một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a sudden, strong movement forward or upwards
examples: SEE ALSO storm surge
a tidal surge
A surge of people poured through the gates.
Police struggled to control the sudden surge forward by the demonstrators.
definitions.definition_vi: một chuyển động mạnh mẽ, đột ngột về phía trước hoặc lên trên

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a sudden increase in the flow of electrical power through a system
examples: An electrical surge damaged the computer's disk drive.
The National Grid was hit by a huge power surge.
definitions.definition_vi: sự gia tăng đột ngột của dòng điện qua hệ thống

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used in or connected with surgery
examples: surgical procedures
a surgical ward (= for patients having operations)
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong hoặc kết nối với phẫu thuật

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an event, a piece of news, etc. that is unexpected or that happens suddenly
examples: What a nice surprise!
I have a surprise for you!
a surprise attack
There are few surprises in this year's budget.
It comes as no surprise to learn that they broke their promises.
Her letter came as a complete surprise.
‘The appointment came as a pleasant surprise to me,’ she says.
The announcements came as something of a surprise to them.
There are lots of surprises in store for visitors to the gallery.
He was there on a surprise visit to the troops.
Life’s full of surprises.
She likes springing surprises on people.
Visitors to the gallery are in for a few surprises.
definitions.definition_vi: một sự kiện, một tin tức, v.v. bất ngờ hoặc xảy ra đột ngột

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a feeling caused by something happening suddenly or unexpectedly
examples: a look of surprise
She looked up in surprise.
He gasped with surprise at her strength.
They couldn't conceal their surprise at seeing us together.
I got a surprise when I saw the bill.
To everyone's surprise, the plan succeeded.
Much to my surprise, I passed.
Imagine our surprise when he walked into the room!
When we went inside we got a nasty surprise.
The decision has been greeted with surprise.
They expressed surprise at the outcome.
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác gây ra bởi một cái gì đó xảy ra đột ngột hoặc bất ngờ

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the use of methods that cause feelings of surprise
examples: A successful campaign should have an element of surprise.
definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng các phương pháp gây ra cảm giác ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used to show that something is not a surprise to you, as you could easily have predicted that it would happen or be true
examples: One of the candidates was the manager's niece, and surprise, surprise, she got the job.
Bob turned up half an hour late, surprise surprise.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để cho thấy điều gì đó không gây ngạc nhiên cho bạn, vì bạn có thể dễ dàng dự đoán rằng điều đó sẽ xảy ra hoặc là sự thật

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used when giving somebody a surprise
examples: Surprise, surprise! Look who's here!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng khi làm ai đó ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to happen unexpectedly so that somebody is slightly shocked; to surprise somebody
examples: His frankness took her by surprise.
The storm took us completely by surprise.
definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra bất ngờ khiến ai đó hơi choáng váng; làm ai đó ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to attack or capture somebody/something unexpectedly or without warning
examples: The police took the burglars by surprise.
definitions.definition_vi: tấn công hoặc bắt giữ ai/cái gì một cách bất ngờ hoặc không báo trước

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: feeling or showing surprise
examples: COMPARE unsurprised
a surprised look
She looked surprised when I told her.
I was surprised at how quickly she agreed.
I'm surprised at you, behaving like that in front of the kids.
They were surprised to find that he'd already left.
You shouldn’t be surprised (that) he didn’t come.
Don't be surprised if I pretend not to recognize you.
‘Will she cancel the party?’ ‘I wouldn't be surprised.’
You’d be surprised how many people voted for him.
He was pleasantly surprised to discover that he was no longer afraid.
to be a little/a bit/quite surprised
She seemed somewhat surprised at his reaction.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác hoặc thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to be all around something/somebody
examples: Tall trees surround the lake.
the membranes surrounding the brain
The garden is surrounded by a wall.
As a child I was surrounded by love and kindness.
I loved being surrounded by enthusiastic young people.
The lake is surrounded with trees.
definitions.definition_vi: ở xung quanh cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to move into position all around somebody/something, especially so as to prevent them from escaping; to move somebody/something into position in this way
examples: Police surrounded the building.
They've surrounded the building with police.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển vào vị trí xung quanh ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để ngăn họ trốn thoát; chuyển ai/cái gì vào vị trí theo cách này

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be closely connected with something/somebody
examples: publicity surrounding the divorce
the controversy/circumstances surrounding his death
The report explores the issues surrounding the case.
definitions.definition_vi: được kết nối chặt chẽ với cái gì đó / ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to choose to have particular people or things near you all the time
examples: I like to surround myself with beautiful things.
definitions.definition_vi: chọn để có những người hoặc những thứ cụ thể ở gần bạn mọi lúc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of carefully watching a person suspected of a crime or a place where a crime may be committed
examples: SYNONYM observation
The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.
surveillance cameras/equipment
definitions.definition_vi: hành động theo dõi cẩn thận một người bị nghi ngờ phạm tội hoặc một nơi có thể xảy ra tội phạm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: an investigation of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a particular group of people, which is usually done by asking them questions
examples: A recent survey showed 75 per cent of those questioned were in favour of the plan.
The survey revealed/found that…
to conduct/carry out/do/complete a survey
According to the survey, many young adults have experimented with drugs of some kind.
Another national survey conducted last year found the same result.
Roughly half of survey respondents express strong interest in additional education.
The results of the survey come as no surprise to us.
definitions.definition_vi: một cuộc điều tra về ý kiến, hành vi, v.v. của một nhóm người cụ thể, thường được thực hiện bằng cách đặt câu hỏi cho họ

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the act of examining and recording the measurements, features, etc. of an area of land in order to make a map or plan of it
examples: an aerial survey (= made by taking photographs from an aircraft)
A geological survey revealed the presence of oil beneath the ground.
definitions.definition_vi: hành động kiểm tra và ghi lại số đo, đặc điểm, v.v. của một diện tích đất để lập bản đồ hoặc sơ đồ về vùng đất đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an examination of the condition of a house, etc., usually done for somebody who is thinking of buying it
examples: a detailed structural survey
definitions.definition_vi: việc kiểm tra tình trạng của một ngôi nhà, v.v., thường được thực hiện cho ai đó đang nghĩ đến việc mua nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a general study, view or description of something
examples: a comprehensive survey of modern music
a historical survey of children's clothing
definitions.definition_vi: một nghiên cứu chung, quan điểm hoặc mô tả về một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to continue to live or exist
examples: She was the last surviving member of the family.
Of the six people injured in the crash, only two survived.
Many of these teachers are struggling to survive financially.
He must betray his friend in order to survive.
The children had to survive by begging and stealing.
‘How are you these days?’ ‘Oh, surviving.’
Don't worry, it's only a scratch—you'll survive.
Some strange customs have survived from earlier times.
I can't survive on £40 a week (= it is not enough for my basic needs).
They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.
He survived as party leader until his second election defeat.
definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục sống hoặc tồn tại

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to continue to live or exist despite a dangerous event or time
examples: Her 5-year-old son miraculously survived the crash.
He only survived the attack because he was wearing body armour.
Many birds didn't survive the severe winter.
The company managed to survive the crisis.
Few buildings survived the war intact.
definitions.definition_vi: tiếp tục sống hoặc tồn tại bất chấp một sự kiện hoặc thời gian nguy hiểm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to live or exist longer than somebody/something
examples: SYNONYM outlive
She survived her husband by ten years.
He is survived by his wife and two sons (= he has just died but they are still alive).
definitions.definition_vi: sống hoặc tồn tại lâu hơn ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who continues to live, especially despite being nearly killed or experiencing great danger or difficulty
examples: the sole/only survivor of the massacre
The plane crashed in an area of dense jungle. There were no survivors.
There are only a few survivors from the original team (= members who remain in it while others have been replaced).
She'll cope. She's one of life's great survivors (= somebody who deals very well with difficult situations).
A movie has been made about the last remaining survivor of the tribe.
definitions.definition_vi: một người tiếp tục sống, đặc biệt là mặc dù gần như bị giết hoặc gặp nguy hiểm hoặc khó khăn lớn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to have an idea that something is probably true or likely to happen, especially something bad, but without having definite proof
examples: As I had suspected all along, he was not a real policeman.
If you suspect a gas leak, do not strike a match or even turn on an electric light.
Suspecting nothing, he walked right into the trap.
I didn’t want the neighbours suspecting anything.
I began to suspect (that) they were trying to get rid of me.
I strongly suspect (that) this whole story is fictional.
She had no reason to suspect (that) Sylvia had not been telling the truth.
I suspect (that) she might be lying.
It was suspected that the drugs had been brought into the country by boat.
She suspected him to be an impostor.
definitions.definition_vi: có ý tưởng rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng hoặc có khả năng xảy ra, đặc biệt là điều gì đó xấu, nhưng không có bằng chứng rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to have an idea that somebody is guilty of something, without having definite proof
examples: He resigned after being suspected of theft.
He is not suspected of any involvement in the recent attacks.
He was wrongly suspected of the crime.
They arrested four men suspected of links to an extremist group.
I suspected her of damaging the equipment.
The drug is suspected of causing over 200 deaths.
Whom do the police suspect?
definitions.definition_vi: có ý kiến ​​cho rằng ai đó phạm tội gì đó mà không có bằng chứng rõ ràng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to feel that something is not completely right, legal or honest, without having any proof; to not trust something
examples: I suspected her motives in offering to help.
He dealt through a broker whose honesty he had no reason to suspect.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy điều gì đó không hoàn toàn đúng, hợp pháp hoặc trung thực mà không có bất kỳ bằng chứng nào; không tin tưởng một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to hang something from something else
examples: A lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
Her body was found suspended by a rope.
A boat was suspended on wires from the rafters.
definitions.definition_vi: để treo cái gì đó từ cái gì khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to officially stop something for a time; to prevent something from being active, used, etc. for a time
examples: Production has been suspended while safety checks are carried out.
The constitution was suspended as the fighting grew worse.
In the theatre we willingly suspend disbelief (= temporarily believe that the characters, etc. are real).
definitions.definition_vi: chính thức dừng việc gì đó trong một thời gian; để ngăn chặn một cái gì đó hoạt động, sử dụng, vv trong một thời gian

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to officially delay something; to arrange for something to happen later than planned
examples: The introduction of the new system has been suspended until next year.
to suspend judgement (= delay forming or expressing an opinion)
definitions.definition_vi: chính thức trì hoãn một cái gì đó; sắp xếp để việc gì đó xảy ra muộn hơn dự định

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to officially prevent somebody from doing their job, going to school, etc. for a time, as a punishment or while a complaint against them is investigated
examples: The police officer was suspended while the complaint was investigated.
She was suspended from school for a week.
definitions.definition_vi: chính thức ngăn cản ai đó làm công việc của họ, đi học, v.v. trong một thời gian, như một hình phạt hoặc trong khi khiếu nại chống lại họ đang được điều tra

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to float in liquid or air without moving
examples: Small droplets are held suspended in the atmosphere.
definitions.definition_vi: nổi trong chất lỏng hoặc không khí mà không di chuyển

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, without having any proof
examples: They became suspicious of his behaviour and contacted the police.
a suspicious look
You have a very suspicious mind (= you always think that people are behaving in an illegal or dishonest way).
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng ai đó đã làm điều gì sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực mà không có bất kỳ bằng chứng nào

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: making you feel that something is wrong, illegal or dishonest
examples: Didn't you notice anything suspicious in his behaviour?
She died in suspicious circumstances.
Police are not treating the fire as suspicious.
It might look suspicious if we arrived together.
It was all very suspicious.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho bạn cảm thấy có điều gì đó không ổn, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: not willing or able to trust somebody/something
examples: SYNONYM sceptical
I was suspicious of his motives.
Many were suspicious of reform.
definitions.definition_vi: không sẵn lòng hoặc có thể tin tưởng ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: involving the use of natural products and energy in a way that does not harm the environment
examples: sustainable forest management
an environmentally sustainable society
This type of farming is simply not sustainable any more.
definitions.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc sử dụng các sản phẩm tự nhiên và năng lượng theo cách không gây hại cho môi trường

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: that can continue or be continued for a long time
examples: OPPOSITE unsustainable
sustainable economic growth
Unfortunately, this level of output is not sustainable.
definitions.definition_vi: điều đó có thể tiếp tục hoặc được tiếp tục trong một thời gian dài

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: containing, or tasting as if it contains, a lot of sugar
examples: OPPOSITE sour
a cup of hot sweet tea
sweet food
I had a craving for something sweet.
roast duck with a sweet and sour sauce
sweet sherry
This wine is too sweet for me.
I found the dessert a bit sweet for my taste.
definitions.definition_vi: chứa hoặc có vị như thể nó chứa rất nhiều đường

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having a pleasant smell
examples: SYNONYM fragrant
a sweet-smelling rose
The air was sweet with incense.
definitions.definition_vi: có mùi dễ chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: having a pleasant sound
examples: a sweet voice
definitions.definition_vi: có một âm thanh dễ chịu

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: pleasant and not containing any harmful substances
examples: the sweet air of a mountain village
definitions.definition_vi: dễ chịu và không chứa bất kỳ chất có hại

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: making you feel happy and/or satisfied
examples: Goodnight. Sweet dreams.
I can't tell you how sweet this victory is.
He played a sweet shot onto the final green (= in golf).
an act of sweet revenge
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho bạn cảm thấy hạnh phúc và/hoặc hài lòng

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: attractive
examples: SYNONYM cute
His sister's a sweet young thing.
You look sweet in this photograph.
We stayed in a sweet little hotel on the seafront.
definitions.definition_vi: hấp dẫn

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: having or showing a kind character
examples: She gave him her sweetest smile.
He's one of the sweetest people I know.
It was sweet of them to offer to help.
He’s not what you’d call sweet-tempered!
definitions.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện một nhân vật tốt bụng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to show that you approve of something
examples: Free tickets? Sweet!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn chấp nhận một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to like somebody very much in a romantic way
definitions.definition_vi: thích ai đó rất nhiều một cách lãng mạn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to like food that contains a lot of sugar
definitions.definition_vi: thích đồ ăn có nhiều đường

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say how pleasant your home is (especially when you really mean that it is not pleasant at all)
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ngôi nhà của bạn thật dễ chịu (đặc biệt khi bạn thực sự muốn nói rằng nó chẳng dễ chịu chút nào)

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people
examples: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
She just ignores all the criticism and continues on her own sweet way.
definitions.definition_vi: bạn muốn như thế nào và khi nào, mặc dù điều này có thể gây khó chịu cho người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to say or do pleasant things in order to keep somebody in a good mood so that they will agree to do something for you
examples: You’d better keep her sweet if you want her to lend you the money.
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm những điều dễ chịu để giữ cho ai đó có tâm trạng tốt để họ đồng ý làm điều gì đó cho bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: what is important is what people or things are, not what they are called
definitions.definition_vi: điều quan trọng là con người hay sự vật là gì, không phải chúng được gọi là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: everything is all right
definitions.definition_vi: mọi thứ đều ổn

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: pleasant but not lasting a long time
examples: We haven't much time so I'll keep it short and sweet.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ chịu nhưng không kéo dài lâu

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: nothing at all. People say ‘sweet FA’ to avoid saying ‘fuck all’.
definitions.definition_vi: không có gì cả. Người ta nói ‘FA ngọt ngào’ để tránh nói ‘chết tiệt’.

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: romantic words
examples: to whisper sweet nothings in somebody’s ear
definitions.definition_vi: lời nói lãng mạn

examples: Old English swēte, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch zoet, German süss, from an Indo-European root shared by Latin suavis and Greek hēdus.

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn chấp nhận một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to like somebody very much in a romantic way
definitions.definition_vi: thích ai đó rất nhiều một cách lãng mạn

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to like food that contains a lot of sugar
definitions.definition_vi: thích đồ ăn có nhiều đường

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to say how pleasant your home is (especially when you really mean that it is not pleasant at all)
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ngôi nhà của bạn thật dễ chịu (đặc biệt khi bạn thực sự muốn nói rằng nó chẳng dễ chịu chút nào)

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people
examples: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
She just ignores all the criticism and continues on her own sweet way.
definitions.definition_vi: bạn muốn như thế nào và khi nào, mặc dù điều này có thể gây khó chịu cho người khác

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to say or do pleasant things in order to keep somebody in a good mood so that they will agree to do something for you
examples: You’d better keep her sweet if you want her to lend you the money.
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm những điều dễ chịu để giữ cho ai đó có tâm trạng tốt để họ đồng ý làm điều gì đó cho bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: what is important is what people or things are, not what they are called
definitions.definition_vi: điều quan trọng là con người hay sự vật là gì, không phải chúng được gọi là gì

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: everything is all right
definitions.definition_vi: mọi thứ đều ổn

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: pleasant but not lasting a long time
examples: We haven't much time so I'll keep it short and sweet.
definitions.definition_vi: dễ chịu nhưng không kéo dài lâu

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: nothing at all. People say ‘sweet FA’ to avoid saying ‘fuck all’.
definitions.definition_vi: không có gì cả. Người ta nói ‘FA ngọt ngào’ để tránh nói ‘chết tiệt’.

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: romantic words
examples: to whisper sweet nothings in somebody’s ear
definitions.definition_vi: lời nói lãng mạn

definitions.label: Meaning 19
definitions.definition: the pleasant feeling of being successfulWord Origin
examples: Old English swēte, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch zoet, German süss, from an Indo-European root shared by Latin suavis and Greek hēdus.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác dễ chịu khi thành côngWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom
examples: I can't swim.
The boys swam across the lake.
We swam out (= away from land) to the yacht.
They spent the day swimming and sunbathing.
I've only just learned to swim.
I have always found it easy to swim underwater.
They are too far out to swim to shore.
Can you swim backstroke yet?
How long will it take her to swim the Channel?
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển trong nước bằng cách di chuyển tay và chân mà không chạm vào đáy

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to spend time swimming for pleasure
examples: I go swimming twice a week.
We always went swimming together in our indoor pool.
definitions.definition_vi: dành thời gian bơi lội cho vui

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to move through or across water
examples: Sharks must swim or die.
A shoal of fish swam past.
Ducks were swimming around on the river.
A beaver swam vigorously upstream.
definitions.definition_vi: để di chuyển qua hoặc trên nước

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to be covered with a lot of liquid
examples: The main course was swimming in oil.
Her eyes were swimming with tears.
definitions.definition_vi: được bao phủ bởi rất nhiều chất lỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to seem to be moving around, especially when you are ill or drunk
examples: The pages swam before her eyes.
definitions.definition_vi: dường như đang di chuyển xung quanh, đặc biệt là khi bạn bị ốm hoặc say rượu

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to feel confused and/or as if everything is turning round and round
examples: His head swam and he swayed dizzily.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy bối rối và/hoặc như thể mọi thứ đang quay vòng

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to be in a situation where you will either succeed by your own efforts or fail completely
examples: The new students were just left to sink or swim.
In a situation like this, you either sink or swim.
definitions.definition_vi: ở trong tình huống mà bạn sẽ thành công nhờ nỗ lực của chính mình hoặc thất bại hoàn toàn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to move backwards or forwards or from side to side while hanging from a fixed point; to make something do this
examples: His arms swung as he walked.
As he pushed her, she swung higher and higher (= while sitting on a swing).
A set of keys swung from her belt.
He sat on the stool, swinging his legs.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển lùi hoặc tiến hoặc từ bên này sang bên kia trong khi treo ở một điểm cố định; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to move from one place to another by holding something that is fixed and pulling yourself along, up, etc.
examples: The gunshot sent monkeys swinging away through the trees.
He swung himself out of the car.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển từ nơi này sang nơi khác bằng cách giữ một cái gì đó cố định và kéo mình theo, lên, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to move or make something move with a wide curved movement
examples: A line of cars swung out of the palace gates.
He swung his legs over the side of the bed.
The door swung open.
She let the door swing shut behind her.
She swung the door open.
definitions.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc làm cho cái gì đó di chuyển với một chuyển động cong rộng

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to change or make somebody/something change from one opinion, mood, etc. to another
examples: The state has swung from Republican to Democrat.
His emotions swung between fear and curiosity.
The game could swing either way (= either side could win it).
I managed to swing them round to my point of view.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hoặc làm cho ai/cái gì thay đổi từ quan điểm, tâm trạng này sang quan điểm khác

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to turn or change direction suddenly; to make something do this
examples: She swung back to face him.
The bus swung sharply to the left.
He swung the camera around to face the opposite direction.
definitions.definition_vi: rẽ hoặc đổi hướng đột ngột; làm cái gì đó làm điều này

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to try to hit somebody/something
examples: She swung at me with the iron bar.
He swung another punch in my direction.
definitions.definition_vi: cố gắng đánh ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to succeed in getting or achieving something, sometimes in a slightly dishonest way
examples: We're trying to swing it so that we can travel on the same flight.
Is there any chance of you swinging us a couple of tickets?
definitions.definition_vi: thành công trong việc đạt được hoặc đạt được điều gì đó, đôi khi theo một cách hơi không trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to have a strong rhythm
definitions.definition_vi: có nhịp điệu mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: if a party, etc. is swinging, there are a lot of people there having a good time
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một bữa tiệc, v.v. đang diễn ra sôi nổi, có rất nhiều người ở đó đang có khoảng thời gian vui vẻ

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: when somebody says there’s no room to swing a cat, they mean that a room is very small and that there is not enough space
definitions.definition_vi: Khi ai đó nói không có chỗ để đu mèo, điều đó có nghĩa là căn phòng đó rất nhỏ và không có đủ không gian

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to affect the result of something in one way rather than another
examples: In an interview, smart presentation can swing the balance in your favour.
New evidence swung the balance against the prosecution.
definitions.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến kết quả của một cái gì đó theo cách này chứ không phải cách khác

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to be bisexual (= sexually attracted to both men and women)
definitions.definition_vi: là người lưỡng tính (= bị hấp dẫn tình dục bởi cả nam và nữ)

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to really try to achieve something great, even when it is not reasonable to expect to be so successful
examples: entrepreneurs who think big and swing for the fences
Investors need to manage risk and not swing for the fences.
definitions.definition_vi: thực sự cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó vĩ đại, ngay cả khi việc mong đợi thành công như vậy là không hợp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to start doing something quickly and with a lot of energy
examples: The ambulance crew swung into action to resuscitate the patient.
The rescue operation swung into action immediately.
The emergency services swung into action as soon as the disaster was reported.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm việc gì đó một cách nhanh chóng và với nhiều năng lượng

definitions.label: Meaning 15

examples: I don't think there's anything wrong with her—she's just swinging the lead.
definitions.definition_vi: giả vờ bị ốm trong khi thực tế là không phải vậy, đặc biệt là để trốn tránh công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to change or make something change from one thing to another
examples: We're in the process of switching over to a new system of invoicing.
The company is offering good deals to customers who switch over from a competitor.
He switched over from acting to journalism.
If you'd like to pay monthly rather than annually, it's easy to switch over.
I found a better phone plan so I asked if I could switch.
Press these two keys to switch between documents on screen.
The meeting has been switched to next week.
It takes a few days to switch your account over from another bank.
He switched his allegiance from the British to the French.
I decided to switch my focus from swimming to cycling.
Your broadband will be switched over in less than a week.
He switched sides halfway through the debate.
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi hoặc làm cho cái gì thay đổi từ thứ này sang thứ khác

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to exchange one thing for another
examples: SYNONYM swap
The dates of the last two exams have been switched.
I see you've switched the furniture around (= changed its position).
Do you think she'll notice if I switch my glass with hers?
We asked them if they would switch places with us.
definitions.definition_vi: đổi cái này lấy cái khác

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to do somebody else’s job for a short time or work during different hours so that they can do your job or work during your usual hours
examples: SYNONYM swap
I can't work next weekend—will you switch with me?
Have you been able to switch your shift with anyone?
Can we switch our shifts around?
definitions.definition_vi: làm công việc của người khác trong một thời gian ngắn hoặc làm việc trong những giờ khác nhau để họ có thể làm công việc của bạn hoặc làm việc trong giờ bình thường của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a weapon with a long metal blade (= sharp cutting part) and a handle
examples: to draw/sheathe a sword (= to take it out of/put it into its cover)
definitions.definition_vi: vũ khí có lưỡi kim loại dài (= bộ phận cắt sắc bén) và tay cầm

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to be something that has both advantages and disadvantages
examples: Fame is a double-edged sword.
definitions.definition_vi: là một cái gì đó có cả ưu điểm và nhược điểm

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to fight or argue with somebody
definitions.definition_vi: đánh nhau hoặc tranh luận với ai

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: people who write books, poems, etc. have a greater effect on history and human affairs than soldiers and wars
definitions.definition_vi: những người viết sách, làm thơ, v.v. có ảnh hưởng lớn đến lịch sử và các vấn đề nhân loại hơn là binh lính và chiến tranh

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to kill somebody with a sword
examples: All the men were put to the sword.
definitions.definition_vi: giết ai đó bằng kiếm

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a bad or unpleasant thing that might happen to you at any time and that makes you feel worried or frightened
definitions.definition_vi: một điều tồi tệ hoặc khó chịu có thể xảy ra với bạn bất cứ lúc nào và điều đó khiến bạn cảm thấy lo lắng hoặc sợ hãi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to stop fighting and return to peaceful activitiesWord Origin
examples: Old English sw(e)ord, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch zwaard and German Schwert.
definitions.definition_vi: ngừng chiến đấu và quay trở lại hoạt động hòa bìnhNguồn gốc Lời

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person, an object, an event, etc. that represents a more general quality or situation
examples: The vase is decorated with religious symbols.
The new school stands as a symbol of hope for a better future.
Mandela became a symbol of the anti-apartheid struggle.
definitions.definition_vi: một người, một đồ vật, một sự kiện, v.v. đại diện cho một chất lượng hoặc tình huống chung hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sign, number, letter, etc. that has a fixed meaning, especially in science, mathematics and music
examples: the mathematical symbol for infinity
Hotels that display this symbol offer activities for children.
definitions.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu, con số, chữ cái, v.v. có ý nghĩa cố định, đặc biệt là trong khoa học, toán học và âm nhạc

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a change in your body or mind that shows that you are not healthy
examples: Symptoms include a headache and sore throat.
If symptoms persist, consult your doctor.
to experience symptoms of anxiety and depression
to show/develop symptoms of illness
to relieve/alleviate symptoms
definitions.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi trong cơ thể hoặc tâm trí của bạn cho thấy bạn không khỏe mạnh

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a sign that something exists, especially something bad
examples: SYNONYM indication
The rise in inflation was just one symptom of the poor state of the economy.
Their relationship was obviously failing, but they just ignored the symptoms.
definitions.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu cho thấy một cái gì đó tồn tại, đặc biệt là một cái gì đó xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a set of physical conditions that show you have a particular disease or medical problem
examples: SEE ALSO AIDS
PMS or premenstrual syndrome
This syndrome is associated with frequent coughing.
This syndrome mostly affects women in their forties.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các tình trạng thể chất cho thấy bạn mắc một căn bệnh cụ thể hoặc một vấn đề y tế

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a set of opinions or a way of behaving that is typical of a particular type of person, attitude or social problem
examples: SEE ALSO tall poppy syndrome
With teenagers, be prepared for the ‘Me, me, me!’ syndrome (= they think of themselves first).
This phenomenon has become known as the ‘Californian syndrome’.
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các ý kiến ​​hoặc một cách hành xử điển hình của một kiểu người, thái độ hoặc vấn đề xã hội cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the act of combining separate ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.; a mixture or combination of ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.
examples: the synthesis of art with everyday life
a synthesis of traditional and modern values
definitions.definition_vi: hành động kết hợp các ý tưởng, niềm tin, phong cách riêng biệt, v.v.; sự pha trộn hoặc kết hợp các ý tưởng, niềm tin, phong cách, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the natural chemical production of a substance in animals and plants
examples: protein synthesis
the synthesis of nucleic acids
definitions.definition_vi: sự sản xuất hóa học tự nhiên của một chất ở động vật và thực vật

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the artificial production of a substance that is present naturally in animals and plants
examples: the synthesis of penicillin
definitions.definition_vi: sự sản xuất nhân tạo một chất có mặt tự nhiên ở động vật và thực vật

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: the production of sounds, music or speech by electronic means
examples: SEE ALSO speech synthesis
definitions.definition_vi: sản xuất âm thanh, âm nhạc hoặc lời nói bằng phương tiện điện tử

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: done according to a system or plan, in a complete, efficient or determined way
examples: OPPOSITE unsystematic
a systematic approach to solving the problem
a systematic attempt to destroy the organization
The prisoner was subjected to systematic torture.
the systematic analysis of the risks involved
definitions.definition_vi: được thực hiện theo một hệ thống hoặc kế hoạch, một cách đầy đủ, hiệu quả hoặc được xác định

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a piece of furniture that consists of a flat top supported by legs
examples: SEE ALSO bird table
We sat at a round table in the corner.
They were sitting around the kitchen table.
She took a seat at the end of the table.
My father always sits at the head of the table.
A table for two, please (= in a restaurant).
I'd like to book a table for dinner tonight (= in a restaurant)
to set the table
to lay the table (= to put the plates, knives, etc. on it for a meal)
to clear the table (= take away the dirty plates, etc. at the end of a meal)
He questioned her next morning over the breakfast table (= during breakfast).
a pool/billiard/snooker table
definitions.definition_vi: một món đồ nội thất bao gồm một mặt phẳng được hỗ trợ bởi chân

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the people sitting at a table for a meal or to play cards, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO round-table
He kept the whole table entertained with his jokes.
definitions.definition_vi: những người ngồi ở bàn dùng bữa hoặc chơi bài, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a list of facts or numbers arranged in a special order, usually in rows and columns
examples: SEE ALSO periodic table
a table of contents (= a list of the main points or information in a book, usually at the front of the book)
The table below shows how prices have changed over the past 20 years.
He showed the price fluctuations in a statistical table.
See Table XII for population figures.
definitions.definition_vi: danh sách các sự kiện hoặc con số được sắp xếp theo thứ tự đặc biệt, thường là theo hàng và cột

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a list of sports teams, countries, schools, etc. that shows their position in a competition, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO league table
If Arsenal win this game they'll go to the top of the table.
the bottom of the table
United are second in the table.
The team will be lucky to finish the season mid-table.
definitions.definition_vi: danh sách các đội thể thao, quốc gia, trường học, v.v. thể hiện vị trí của họ trong một cuộc thi, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a list showing the results when a number is multiplied by a set of other numbers, especially 1 to 12, in turn
examples: Do you know your six times table?
definitions.definition_vi: một danh sách hiển thị kết quả khi một số được nhân với một tập hợp các số khác, đặc biệt là từ 1 đến 12, lần lượt

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to contribute something useful to a discussion, project, etc.
examples: What Hislop brought to the table was real commitment and energy.
definitions.definition_vi: để đóng góp một cái gì đó hữu ích cho một cuộc thảo luận, dự án, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to join formal discussions about something
examples: Different countries come to the table with differing expectations about what they can achieve.
definitions.definition_vi: tham gia các cuộc thảo luận chính thức về một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: to drink more alcohol than somebody else without becoming as drunk as they are
definitions.definition_vi: uống nhiều rượu hơn người khác mà không say như họ

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to tell somebody honestly what your plans, ideas, etc. are
definitions.definition_vi: nói với ai đó một cách trung thực những kế hoạch, ý tưởng của bạn, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: if a topic is off the table at a formal discussion, people are not willing or allowed to discuss it
examples: Some issues were so controversial they were taken off the table.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu một chủ đề bị loại khỏi cuộc thảo luận chính thức, mọi người sẽ không sẵn lòng hoặc không được phép thảo luận về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: offered to people so that they can consider or discuss it
examples: Management have put several new proposals on the table.
definitions.definition_vi: được cung cấp cho mọi người để họ có thể xem xét hoặc thảo luận về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: not going to be discussed or considered until a future date
definitions.definition_vi: sẽ không được thảo luận hoặc xem xét cho đến một ngày trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to change a situation so that you are now in a stronger position than the person who used to be in a stronger position than you
definitions.definition_vi: thay đổi một tình huống để bây giờ bạn ở vị trí mạnh hơn người đã từng ở vị trí mạnh hơn bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: to serve food to people, for example at a formal meal
definitions.definition_vi: để phục vụ thức ăn cho mọi người, ví dụ như tại một bữa ăn trang trọng

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: to work serving food to people in a restaurantWord Origin
examples: Old English tabule ‘flat slab, inscribed tablet’, from Latin tabula ‘plank, tablet, list’, reinforced in Middle English by Old French table.
definitions.definition_vi: làm công việc phục vụ đồ ăn cho mọi người trong nhà hàng.Word Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a small piece of paper, cloth, plastic, etc. attached to something to identify it or give information about it
examples: SEE ALSO dog tag
He put name tags on all his shirts.
a gift tag (= tied to a present)
definitions.definition_vi: một mảnh giấy nhỏ, vải, nhựa, vv gắn vào một cái gì đó để xác định nó hoặc cung cấp thông tin về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an electronic device that can be attached to a person, animal or object so that police, researchers, etc. know where the person, etc. is
examples: The police use electronic tags to monitor the whereabouts of young offenders on probation.
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện tử có thể được gắn vào người, động vật hoặc đồ vật để cảnh sát, nhà nghiên cứu, v.v. biết người đó ở đâu, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a name or phrase that is used to describe a person or thing in some way
examples: They are finally ready to drop the tag ‘the new Beatles’.
The ‘lucky’ tag stuck for years.
The president made several jokes in an attempt to shake off his ‘humourless’ tag.
definitions.definition_vi: một tên hoặc cụm từ được sử dụng để mô tả một người hoặc vật theo một cách nào đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a word or phrase that is added to a sentence for emphasis, for example I do in Yes, I do
examples: SEE ALSO question tag
definitions.definition_vi: một từ hoặc cụm từ được thêm vào câu để nhấn mạnh, ví dụ I do trong Yes, I do

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: a set of letters or symbols that are put before and after a piece of text or data in order to identify it or show that it is to be treated in a particular way
definitions.definition_vi: một tập hợp các chữ cái hoặc ký hiệu được đặt trước và sau một đoạn văn bản hoặc dữ liệu để xác định nó hoặc cho thấy rằng nó cần được xử lý theo một cách cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a short quotation or saying in a foreign language
examples: the Latin tag ‘Si vis pacem, para bellum.’ (= if you want peace, prepare for war)
definitions.definition_vi: một câu trích dẫn ngắn hoặc một câu nói bằng tiếng nước ngoài

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: a children’s game in which one child runs after the others and tries to touch one of them
examples: SEE ALSO phone tag
definitions.definition_vi: một trò chơi dành cho trẻ em trong đó một đứa trẻ chạy theo những đứa trẻ khác và cố gắng chạm vào một trong số chúng

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: a symbol or name used by a graffiti writer and painted in a public placeWord Origin
examples: noun senses 1 to 5 late Middle English (denoting a narrow hanging section of a decoratively slashed garment): of unknown origin; compare with dag. The verb dates from the early 17th cent. noun sense 6 mid 18th cent.: perhaps a variant of tig.
definitions.definition_vi: một biểu tượng hoặc tên được người viết graffiti sử dụng và vẽ ở nơi công cộngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a story created using the imagination, especially one that is full of action and adventure
examples: SEE ALSO fairy tale
a coming-of-age/morality tale
The story is a classic tale of love and betrayal.
Dickens’ ‘A Tale of Two Cities’
His latest book is a delightful children’s tale about talking animals.
definitions.definition_vi: một câu chuyện được tạo ra bằng trí tưởng tượng, đặc biệt là một câu chuyện đầy hành động và phiêu lưu

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an exciting spoken description of an event, which may not be completely true
examples: I love listening to his tales of life at sea.
I've heard tales of people seeing ghosts in that house.
She regaled us with tales of her wild youth.
The team's tale of woe continued on Saturday (= they lost another match).
Her experiences provide a cautionary tale (= a warning) for us all.
definitions.definition_vi: một mô tả bằng lời nói thú vị về một sự kiện, có thể không hoàn toàn đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to survive a difficult or dangerous experience so that you can tell others what really happened
definitions.definition_vi: sống sót sau một trải nghiệm khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm để bạn có thể nói cho người khác biết điều gì đã thực sự xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: an old idea or belief that people now know is not correct
definitions.definition_vi: một ý tưởng cũ hoặc niềm tin mà mọi người bây giờ biết là không đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to give some information that is different from what you expect or have been told
examples: These drugs are widely believed to be effective medications. The data, however, tell a different story.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp một số thông tin khác với những gì bạn mong đợi hoặc đã được cho biết

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to explain itself, without needing any further explanation or comment
examples: Her face told its own story.
definitions.definition_vi: để giải thích chính nó, mà không cần bất kỳ lời giải thích hoặc bình luận thêm

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to tell somebody about something that another person has done wrong
examples: RELATED NOUN telltale
definitions.definition_vi: nói với ai đó về điều gì đó mà người khác đã làm sai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having a greater than average height
examples: OPPOSITE short
She's tall and thin.
the tallest building in the world
tall trees/chimneys
a tall glass of iced tea
He's grown taller since I last saw him.
definitions.definition_vi: có chiều cao lớn hơn mức trung bình

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to describe or ask about the height of somebody/something
examples: How tall are you?
He's six feet tall and weighs 200 pounds.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả hoặc hỏi về chiều cao của ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to be very difficult to do
definitions.definition_vi: rất khó để làm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
definitions.definition_vi: điều gì đó lớn lao và thành công thường bắt đầu từ việc rất nhỏ

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to show that you are proud and able to deal with anything
examples: Suddenly he seemed to stand taller.
definitions.definition_vi: để cho thấy rằng bạn tự hào và có thể đối phó với bất cứ điều gì

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to feel proud and confidentWord Origin
examples: late Middle English: probably from Old English getæl ‘swift, prompt’. Early senses also included ‘fine, handsome’ and ‘bold, strong, good at fighting’.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm thấy tự hào và tự tinWord Origin

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a result that you try to achieve
examples: to meet/hit a target
The firm is on track to achieve its growth target for the year.
The university will reach its target of 5 000 students next September.
The department has missed its sales target for the third month running.
Set yourself targets that you can reasonably hope to achieve.
The new sports complex is on target to open in June.
These figures are way off target.
a target date of April 2022
a target audience/market (= the particular audience, area etc. that a product, programme, etc. is aimed at)
The film's target demographic is women aged 18–49 years.
We're using social media to communicate with our target customers.
definitions.definition_vi: một kết quả mà bạn cố gắng đạt được

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: an object, a person or a place that people aim at when attacking
examples: They attacked military and civilian targets.
Doors and windows are an easy target for burglars.
The children became the target for their father’s aggressive outbursts.
It's a prime target (= an obvious target) for terrorist attacks.
He's become the target of a lot of criticism recently.
definitions.definition_vi: một đồ vật, một người hoặc một nơi mà mọi người nhắm tới khi tấn công

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: an object that people practise shooting at, especially a round board with circles on it
examples: to aim at a target
to hit/miss the target
target practice
definitions.definition_vi: một vật mà mọi người tập bắn vào, đặc biệt là một tấm bảng tròn có các vòng tròn trên đó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere. Taxis usually have meters that show how much money you have to pay.
examples: We took a taxi to the airport.
to call/hail/catch/get a taxi
I came home by taxi.
a taxi driver
a taxi ride/service
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc xe có tài xế mà bạn trả tiền để đưa bạn đi đâu đó. Taxi thường có đồng hồ tính số tiền bạn phải trả.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a small bus with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere. Taxis usually have fixed routes and stop wherever passengers need to get on or off.
examples: SEE ALSO daladala
definitions.definition_vi: một chiếc xe buýt nhỏ có tài xế mà bạn phải trả tiền để đưa bạn đi đâu đó. Taxi thường có lộ trình cố định và dừng ở bất cứ nơi nào hành khách cần lên hoặc xuống.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a person who pays tax to the government, especially on the money that they earn
examples: Hundreds of thousands of pounds of taxpayers' money (= money paid in taxes) have been spent on the project.
The proposals will be popular with higher-rate taxpayers.
definitions.definition_vi: một người nộp thuế cho chính phủ, đặc biệt là trên số tiền mà họ kiếm được

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to give lessons to students in a school, college, university, etc.; to help somebody learn something by giving information about it
examples: She teaches at our local school.
He taught for several years before becoming a writer.
I'll be teaching history and sociology next term.
to teach yoga classes
to teach school (= teach in a school)
He teaches English to advanced students.
He teaches them English.
My wife teaches undergraduate students.
Schools should teach children about healthy eating.
definitions.definition_vi: giảng dạy cho sinh viên ở trường phổ thông, cao đẳng, đại học, v.v.; để giúp ai đó học được điều gì đó bằng cách cung cấp thông tin về nó

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to show somebody how to do something so that they will be able to do it themselves
examples: Could you teach me to do that?
I'm trying to teach my daughter to behave.
My father taught me how to ride a bike.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ cho ai đó cách làm điều gì đó để họ có thể tự làm được

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to make somebody feel or think in a different way
examples: She taught me to be less critical of other people.
My parents taught me that honesty was always the best policy.
The book teaches that we shouldn't be afraid of change.
Our experience as refugees taught us many valuable lessons.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hoặc suy nghĩ theo một cách khác

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to persuade somebody not to do something again by making them suffer so much that they are afraid to do it
examples: Lost all your money? That'll teach you to gamble.
I'll teach you to call (= punish you for calling) me a liar!
The accident taught me a lesson I'll never forget.
definitions.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó không làm điều gì đó nữa bằng cách khiến họ đau khổ đến mức họ sợ phải làm điều đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to tell or show somebody how to do something that they can already do well, and probably better than you can
definitions.definition_vi: nói hoặc chỉ cho ai đó cách làm điều gì đó mà họ có thể làm tốt và có thể còn tốt hơn bạn có thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: (you cannot) successfully make people change their ideas, methods of work, etc., when they have had them for a long time
definitions.definition_vi: (bạn không thể) thành công trong việc khiến mọi người thay đổi ý tưởng, phương pháp làm việc, v.v., khi họ đã có chúng từ lâu

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to teach students only what is necessary in order to pass a particular test, rather than help them develop a range of skillsWord Origin
examples: Old English tǣcan ‘show, present, point out’, of Germanic origin; related to token, from an Indo-European root shared by Greek deiknunai ‘show’, deigma ‘sample’.
definitions.definition_vi: chỉ dạy học sinh những gì cần thiết để vượt qua một bài kiểm tra cụ thể, thay vì giúp họ phát triển một loạt kỹ năngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: in a way that lasts or is intended to last or be used only for a short time; in a way that is not permanent
examples: OPPOSITE permanently
We regret this service is temporarily unavailable.
The company announced that it would be temporarily closing the factory because of the global downturn.
definitions.definition_vi: theo cách kéo dài hoặc nhằm mục đích kéo dài hoặc chỉ được sử dụng trong một thời gian ngắn; theo cách không vĩnh viễn

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to attract somebody or make somebody want to do or have something, even if they know it is wrong
examples: I was tempted by the dessert menu.
Don't tempt thieves by leaving valuables clearly visible.
He was tempted into a life of crime.
I was tempted to take the day off.
definitions.definition_vi: thu hút ai đó hoặc khiến ai đó muốn làm hoặc có điều gì đó, ngay cả khi họ biết điều đó là sai

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to persuade or try to persuade somebody to do something that you want them to do, for example by offering them something
examples: How can we tempt young people into engineering?
Nothing would tempt me to live here.
definitions.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc cố gắng thuyết phục ai đó làm điều gì đó mà bạn muốn họ làm, ví dụ bằng cách cung cấp cho họ một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to do something too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end
examples: She felt it would be tempting fate to try the difficult climb a second time.
It would be tempting fate to say that we will definitely win the game.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó quá tự tin theo cách có thể có nghĩa là vận may của bạn sẽ chấm dứt

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: kind, gentle and loving
examples: SEE ALSO TLC
tender words
What he needs now is a lot of tender loving care (= sympathetic treatment).
definitions.definition_vi: tốt bụng, dịu dàng và yêu thương

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: easy to bite through and cut
examples: OPPOSITE tough
This meat is extremely tender.
Boil the beans until they are tender.
four large slices of tender chicken
definitions.definition_vi: dễ cắn và cắt

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: painful when you touch it
examples: SYNONYM sore
My leg is still very tender where I banged it.
The back of my neck feels very tender.
definitions.definition_vi: đau đớn khi bạn chạm vào nó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: easily hurt or damaged
examples: SYNONYM delicate
tender young plants
definitions.definition_vi: dễ dàng bị tổn thương hoặc bị hư hỏng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used in connection with somebody who is still young and does not have much experience
examples: He left home at the tender age of 15.
She shouldn't be having to deal with problems like this at such a tender age.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng liên quan đến ai đó vẫn còn trẻ và không có nhiều kinh nghiệm

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a shelter made of a large sheet of canvas, nylon, etc. that is supported by poles and ropes fixed to the ground, and is used especially for camping
examples: SEE ALSO beer tent
to put up/take down a tent
to pitch (= put up) a tent
Food will be served in the hospitality tent (= for example at an outdoor show).
Everyone was sleeping outside in tents.

definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp mọi thứ cần thiết, đặc biệt là tiền, để ai đó/cái gì đó có thể sống hoặc tồn tại

definitions.definition_vi: để giúp chứng tỏ điều gì đó là đúng

definitions.definition_vi: giữ ai/cái gì vào đúng vị trí; ngăn chặn ai/cái gì rơi xuống

definitions.label: Meaning 8

definitions.definition_vi: biểu diễn trong một buổi hòa nhạc pop hoặc rock trước người biểu diễn chính

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to allow a particular program, language or device to be used with it

definitions.definition_vi: cho phép một chương trình, ngôn ngữ hoặc thiết bị cụ thể được sử dụng với nó

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: confident that you know something or that you are right

You don't sound very sure.
I'm pretty sure (that) he'll agree.
Are you sure you don't mind?
I’m sure he’s still alive.

I'm not sure whether I should tell you this.

I like this bit, but I'm not so sure about that one.
definitions.definition_vi: tự tin rằng bạn biết điều gì đó hoặc bạn đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: certain that you will receive something or that something will happen
examples: You're always sure of a warm welcome there.

definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn rằng bạn sẽ nhận được một cái gì đó hoặc điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: certain to do something or to happen
examples: The exhibition is sure to be popular.
It's sure to rain.
You’re sure to get lost if you don’t keep to the path.
She's sure to be picked for the team.
definitions.definition_vi: chắc chắn để làm điều gì đó hoặc xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: that can be trusted or relied on
examples: It's a sure sign of economic recovery.
There's only one sure way to do it.
He is a sure bet for the presidential nomination (= certain to succeed).
I told my friends that our winning was a sure thing.
definitions.definition_vi: có thể được tin cậy hoặc dựa vào

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: steady and confident
examples: We admired her sure touch at the keyboard.
definitions.definition_vi: vững vàng và tự tin

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used to tell somebody to do something
examples: Be sure to give your family my regards.
Be sure to check out our website.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó làm gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: without doubt
examples: No one knows for sure what happened.
I think he'll be back on Monday, but I can't say for sure.
One thing is for sure—it's not going to be easy.
‘Will you be there?’ ‘For sure.’
definitions.definition_vi: không còn nghi ngờ gì nữa

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: something that is likely to happen, to succeed or to be suitable
examples: He's a good bet to earn a spot on the US team.
Clothes are a safe bet as a present for a teenager.
The movie looks like a sure bet for Best Film.
definitions.definition_vi: một cái gì đó có khả năng xảy ra, để thành công hoặc phù hợp

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to do something in order to be certain that something else happens
examples: Make sure (that) no one finds out about this.
They scored another goal and made sure of victory.
Our staff will do their best to make sure you enjoy your visit.
To make doubly sure they would not be disturbed she turned the key in the lock.
definitions.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó khác sẽ xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to check that something is true or has been done
examples: She looked around to make sure that she was alone.
I think the door's locked, but I'll just go and make sure.
definitions.definition_vi: để kiểm tra xem điều gì đó là đúng hay đã được thực hiện

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: very confident
examples: She seems very sure of herself.
definitions.definition_vi: rất tự tin

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used to say ‘yes’ to a suggestion or request
examples: ‘Are you coming?’ ‘Sure thing.’
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói ‘có’ với một đề nghị hoặc yêu cầu

definitions.label: Meaning 13

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: không nghi ngờ gì nữa; chắc chắn

definitions.label: Meaning 5

definitions.definition_vi: nơi mà bác sĩ, nha sĩ hoặc bác sĩ thú y gặp bệnh nhân

examples: morning/afternoon/evening surgery
surgery hours

definitions.definition_vi: thời gian mà bác sĩ, nha sĩ hoặc bác sĩ thú y có mặt để khám cho bệnh nhân

a surprise attack

Imagine our surprise when he walked into the room!

The decision has been greeted with surprise.

definitions.label: Meaning 3

definitions.definition_vi: việc sử dụng các phương pháp gây ra cảm giác ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 5

examples: Surprise, surprise! Look who's here!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng khi làm ai đó ngạc nhiên

definitions.definition_vi: xảy ra bất ngờ khiến ai đó hơi choáng váng; làm ai đó ngạc nhiên

definitions.label: Meaning 7

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: gây bất ngờ

definitions.definition_vi: từ bỏ cái gì/ai đó khi bạn buộc phải làm vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 1

definitions.definition_vi: hành động chính thức loại bỏ ai đó khỏi công việc, trường học, nhóm, v.v. của họ trong một khoảng thời gian, thường là một hình phạt

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.definition_vi: hành động trì hoãn việc gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian cho đến khi có quyết định

definitions.definition_vi: hệ thống lò xo, v.v... giúp xe được hỗ trợ trên các bánh xe và giúp xe di chuyển thoải mái hơn khi mặt đường không bằng phẳng

The material carried in suspension by the tide is deposited on the shore.
definitions.definition_vi: một chất lỏng có những mảnh chất rắn rất nhỏ trôi nổi trong đó; trạng thái của chất lỏng như vậy

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, even though you have no proof
examples: SEE ALSO suspect
They drove away slowly to avoid arousing suspicion.
He was arrested on suspicion of murder.
I have a sneaking suspicion that she's not telling the truth.
My suspicions were confirmed when police raided the property.
She was reluctant to voice her suspicions.
His resignation seemed only to fuel suspicions.
It’s time to confront him with our suspicions.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng ai đó đã làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a feeling or belief that something is true, even though you have no proof
examples: I have a horrible suspicion that we've come to the wrong station.
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác hoặc niềm tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: the feeling that you cannot trust somebody/something
examples: Their offer was greeted with some suspicion.
Water from shallow wells should be regarded with suspicion, as it may be contaminated.
definitions.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng bạn không thể tin tưởng ai đó/cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a small amount of something
examples: SYNONYM hint
His mouth quivered in the suspicion of a smile.
Wasn’t there even a suspicion of truth in what he said?
definitions.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ của cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: too good, honest, etc. to have done something wrong, illegal or dishonest
examples: Nobody who was near the scene of the crime is above suspicion.
They thought the head teacher was beyond suspicion.
definitions.definition_vi: quá tốt, trung thực, v.v. để làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: if the finger of blame/suspicion points or is pointed at somebody, they are suspected of having committed a crime, being responsible for something, etc.
examples: The inquiry pointed the finger of blame at the driver of the crashed coach.
The finger of suspicion was pointed at the chicken served for lunch.
definitions.definition_vi: nếu ngón tay đổ lỗi/nghi ngờ chỉ vào ai đó, họ bị nghi ngờ đã phạm tội, phải chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: suspected of doing something wrong, illegal or dishonest
examples: The whole family is currently under suspicion of her murder.
A number of doctors came under suspicion of unethical behaviour.
He fell under suspicion of tax evasion.
definitions.definition_vi: bị nghi ngờ làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to provide enough of what somebody/something needs in order to live or exist
examples: Which planets can sustain life?
I only had a little chocolate to sustain me on my walk.
The love and support of his family sustained him during his time in prison.
When she lost her job they could no longer sustain their expensive lifestyle.
The soil was so badly eroded it could no longer sustain crop production.
definitions.definition_vi: cung cấp đủ những gì ai đó/cái gì đó cần để sống hoặc tồn tại

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: to make something continue for some time without becoming less
examples: SYNONYM maintain
She managed to sustain everyone's interest until the end of her speech.
Kangaroos can sustain high speeds over long distances.
the sustaining pedal of a piano (= that allows a note to continue sounding for a long time)
This relationship would be very difficult to sustain.
definitions.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó tiếp tục trong một thời gian mà không trở nên kém đi

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: to experience something bad
examples: SYNONYM suffer
to sustain damage/an injury/a defeat
The company sustained losses of millions of dollars.
definitions.definition_vi: trải nghiệm điều gì đó tồi tệ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: to provide evidence to support an opinion, a theory, etc.
examples: SYNONYM uphold
The evidence is not detailed enough to sustain his argument.
definitions.definition_vi: để cung cấp bằng chứng để hỗ trợ một ý kiến, một lý thuyết, vv.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: to support a weight without breaking or falling
examples: SYNONYM bear
The ice will not sustain your weight.
definitions.definition_vi: để hỗ trợ một trọng lượng mà không bị gãy hoặc rơi

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to decide that a claim, etc. is true or legally valid
examples: SYNONYM uphold
The court sustained his claim that the contract was illegal.
Objection sustained! (= said by a judge when a lawyer makes an objection in court)
definitions.definition_vi: để quyết định rằng một yêu cầu bồi thường, vv là đúng hoặc có giá trị pháp lý

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: to make food, drink, etc. go down your throat into your stomach
examples: Always chew food well before swallowing it.
I had a sore throat and it hurt to swallow.
The pills should be swallowed whole.
definitions.definition_vi: làm thức ăn, đồ uống, v.v. đi xuống cổ họng vào dạ dày của bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 2

definitions.label: Meaning 1

examples: SEE ALSO search term
a technical/legal/generic term
a glossary of terms
a term of abuse
What is the meaning of the term ‘globalization’?
William Gibson coined the term (= invented the term) ‘cyberspace’ in 1984.
‘Old man’ is a slang term for ‘father’.

definitions.definition: (especially in the UK) one of the three periods in the year during which classes are held in schools, universities, etc.
examples: SEE ALSO half-term

It's nearly the end of term.
It's nearly the end of the term.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a period of time for which something lasts; a fixed or limited time
examples: SEE ALSO fixed-term

a term as president/mayor/governor/prime minister

The contract was for a fixed term of five years.

definitions.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian mà một cái gì đó kéo dài; một thời gian cố định hoặc giới hạn

examples: Such a development seems unlikely, at least in the short term (= it will not happen for quite a long time).
In the longer term, children of depressed mothers are more likely to suffer from childhood depression.
In the long term, our efforts will pay off.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả những gì sẽ xảy ra một thời gian dài, ngắn, vv trong tương lai

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: a building or set of buildings at an airport where passengers arrive and leave
examples: SEE ALSO air terminal
A second terminal was opened last year.
Your flight leaves from Terminal 3.
definitions.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc một tập hợp các tòa nhà tại sân bay nơi hành khách đến và đi

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a place, building or set of buildings where journeys by train, bus or boat begin or end
examples: a railway/bus/ferry terminal
definitions.definition_vi: một địa điểm, tòa nhà hoặc tập hợp các tòa nhà nơi bắt đầu hoặc kết thúc hành trình bằng tàu hỏa, xe buýt hoặc thuyền

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a piece of equipment, usually consisting of a keyboard and a screen that joins the user to a central computer system
examples: SEE ALSO data terminal
definitions.definition_vi: một thiết bị, thường bao gồm bàn phím và màn hình kết nối người dùng với hệ thống máy tính trung tâm

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: a point at which connections can be made in an electric circuit
examples: a positive/negative terminal
definitions.definition_vi: một điểm tại đó các kết nối có thể được thực hiện trong một mạch điện
