morning/evening worship (= a church service in the morning/evening)
The tradition of ancestor worship stretches back thousands of years.
definitions.definition_vi: thực hành thể hiện sự tôn trọng đối với Chúa hoặc một vị thần bằng cách cầu nguyện, hát với người khác, v.v.; một buổi lễ cho việc này

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: a strong feeling of love and respect for somebody/something
examples: SYNONYM adoration
What she feels for him is akin to worship.
definitions.definition_vi: một cảm giác mạnh mẽ của tình yêu và sự tôn trọng đối với ai đó / cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: a polite way of addressing or referring to a magistrate or mayorWord Origin
examples: Old English weorthscipe ‘worthiness, acknowledgement of worth’ (see worth, -ship).
definitions.definition_vi: một cách lịch sự để xưng hô hoặc đề cập đến quan tòa hoặc thị trưởngNguồn gốc từ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: important, pleasant, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on
examples: It was in aid of a worthwhile cause (= a charity, etc.)
a worthwhile discussion/job
The smile on her face made it all worthwhile.
We all felt we had done something worthwhile for the local community.
High prices in the UK make it worthwhile for buyers to look abroad.
It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
It didn't seem worthwhile writing it all out again.
definitions.definition_vi: quan trọng, dễ chịu, thú vị, v.v.; đáng để dành thời gian, tiền bạc hoặc công sức

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: having the qualities that deserve somebody/something
examples: OPPOSITE unworthy
Very few of his ideas are worthy of further attention.
A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
No composer was considered worthy of the name until he had written an opera.
a worthy champion (= one who deserved to win)
He felt he was not worthy of her.
definitions.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất xứng đáng với ai/cái gì

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: having qualities that deserve your respect or attention
examples: SYNONYM deserving
The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause.
a worthy member of the team
We thought it was a worthy enough objective.
definitions.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất đáng được bạn tôn trọng hoặc chú ý

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: having good qualities but not very interesting or exciting
examples: her worthy but dull husband
He's a very worthy man, I suppose, but he's very dull.
definitions.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất tốt nhưng không thú vị hay thú vị

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: typical of what a particular person or thing might do, give, etc.
examples: He gave a speech that was worthy of Martin Luther King.
definitions.definition_vi: điển hình về những gì một người hoặc vật cụ thể có thể làm, cho, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: deserving, or suitable for, the thing mentioned
examples: trustworthy
roadworthy
definitions.definition_vi: xứng đáng, hoặc phù hợp với, điều được đề cập

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: used in polite offers or invitations
examples: Would you like a sandwich?
Would you have dinner with me on Friday?
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong lời đề nghị hoặc lời mời lịch sự

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: used to say what you like, love, hate, etc.
examples: I'd love a coffee.
I'd be only too glad to help.
I'd hate you to think I was criticizing you.
I'd rather come with you.
I'd rather you came with us.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói những gì bạn thích, yêu, ghét, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used as the past form of will when reporting what somebody has said or thought
examples: He said he would be here at eight o'clock (= His words were: ‘I will be there at eight o'clock.’).
She asked if I would help.
They told me that they probably wouldn't come.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng như hình thức ý chí trong quá khứ khi báo cáo những gì ai đó đã nói hoặc nghĩ

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used for talking about the result of an event that you imagine
examples: She'd look better with shorter hair.
If you went to see him, he would be delighted.
Hurry up! It would be a shame to miss the beginning of the play.
She'd be a fool to accept it (= if she accepted).
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về kết quả của một sự kiện mà bạn tưởng tượng

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: used for describing a possible action or event that did not in fact happen, because something else did not happen first
examples: If I had seen the advertisement in time, I would have applied for the job.
They would never have met if she hadn't gone to Emma's party.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một hành động hoặc sự kiện có thể xảy ra nhưng thực tế không xảy ra vì một điều gì đó khác đã không xảy ra trước đó

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used for saying why somebody does something
examples: She burned the letters so that her husband would never read them.
He worked hard in order that he would pass all his exams.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói tại sao ai đó làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used for saying what you want to happen
examples: I wish that you'd be quiet for a minute.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói những gì bạn muốn xảy ra

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used to show that somebody/something was not willing or refused to do something
examples: She wouldn't change it, even though she knew it was wrong.
My car wouldn't start this morning.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó không sẵn lòng hoặc từ chối làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to ask somebody politely to do something
examples: Would you mind leaving us alone for a few minutes?
Would you open the door for me, please?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó một cách lịch sự làm việc gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: used to give opinions that you are not certain about
examples: I would imagine the job will take about two days.
I'd say he was about fifty.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra ý kiến ​​mà bạn không chắc chắn về

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: used to give advice
examples: I wouldn't have any more to drink, if I were you.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: used for talking about things that often happened in the past
examples: SYNONYM used to
When my parents were away, my grandmother would take care of me.
He'd always be the first to offer to help.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về những điều thường xảy ra trong quá khứ

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: used for talking about behaviour that you think is typical
examples: ‘She said it was your fault.’ ‘Well, she would say that, wouldn't she? She's never liked me.’
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về hành vi mà bạn nghĩ là điển hình

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: used to express a strong wish
examples: Would that he had lived to see it.
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện một mong muốn mạnh mẽ

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.
examples: Our son’s having problems with his reading and writing (= at school)
a writing case (= containing paper, pens, etc.)
Every morning the children do writing.
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động viết, trái ngược với hoạt động đọc, nói, v.v.

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: the activity of writing books, articles, etc., especially as a job
examples: SEE ALSO songwriting
Only later did she discover a talent for writing.
I wanted to try out a new style of writing.
creative writing
feminist/travel writing
He is leaving the band to concentrate on his writing.
definitions.definition_vi: hoạt động viết sách, bài báo, v.v., đặc biệt là một công việc

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: books, articles, etc. in general
examples: The review is a brilliant piece of writing.
definitions.definition_vi: sách, bài báo, v.v. nói chung

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: words that have been written or painted on something
examples: There was writing all over the desk.
definitions.definition_vi: những từ đã được viết hoặc vẽ trên một cái gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: the particular way in which somebody forms letters when they write
examples: SYNONYM handwriting
Who's this from? I don't recognize the writing.
definitions.definition_vi: cách đặc biệt mà ai đó tạo thành các chữ cái khi họ viết

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: a group of pieces of writing, especially by a particular person or on a particular subject
examples: His experiences in India influenced his later writings.
the writings of Hegel
His writings on complex subjects are clear and definitive.
definitions.definition_vi: một nhóm các bài viết, đặc biệt là bởi một người cụ thể hoặc về một chủ đề cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: in the form of a letter, document, etc. (that gives proof of something)
examples: All telephone reservations must be confirmed in writing.
Could you put your complaint in writing?
You must get it in writing.
definitions.definition_vi: dưới dạng một lá thư, tài liệu, v.v. (đưa ra bằng chứng về điều gì đó)

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used when you are describing a situation in which there are signs that something is going to have problems or that it is going to be a failure
examples: It is amazing that not one of them saw the writing on the wall.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang mô tả một tình huống trong đó có những dấu hiệu cho thấy điều gì đó sắp gặp vấn đề hoặc nó sẽ thất bại

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: expressed in writing rather than in speech
examples: Having a written record of what I've done is very valuable.
written instructions
The council is inviting written submissions from the public before June 19.
definitions.definition_vi: thể hiện bằng văn bản hơn là bằng lời nói

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: involving writing rather than speaking or practical skills
examples: a written test
Students must submit one or more pieces of written work for assessment.
written communication skills
definitions.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc viết hơn là nói hoặc kỹ năng thực tế

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: in the form of a letter, document, etc. and therefore official
examples: No portion of this site may be copied without express written consent.
You must give written permission before this information can be shared.
a written apology
a written contract
In a written statement, the government has denied the claims.
definitions.definition_vi: dưới dạng một lá thư, tài liệu, v.v. và do đó chính thức

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: language expressed in writing rather than in speech
examples: the permanence of the written word
definitions.definition_vi: ngôn ngữ được thể hiện bằng văn bản hơn là trong lời nói

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: not right or correct
examples: OPPOSITE right
I got all the answers wrong.
He was driving on the wrong side of the road.
Sorry, I must have dialled the wrong number.
You're holding the camera the wrong way up!
That picture is the wrong way round.
I soon realised I'd taken a wrong turn.
He got all his calculations wrong.
The information is just plain wrong.
definitions.definition_vi: không đúng hoặc đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: not right about something/somebody
examples: SYNONYM mistaken
I think she lives at number 44, but I could be wrong.
You were wrong about Tom; he's not married after all.
We were wrong to assume that she'd agree.
She would prove him wrong (= prove that he was wrong) whatever happened.
Correct me if I'm wrong (= I may be wrong) but didn't you say you two knew each other?
If you think I'm happy, you're dead wrong.
You think you've beaten me but that's where you're wrong.
‘I thought this might interest you because I know you like boxing.’ ‘You're not wrong (= you are absolutely right). I love boxing.’
definitions.definition_vi: không đúng về cái gì/ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: causing problems or difficulties; not as it should be
examples: Is anything wrong? You look worried.
‘What's wrong?’ ‘Oh, nothing.’
There's something wrong with the printer.
I have something wrong with my foot.
The doctor could find nothing wrong with him.
definitions.definition_vi: gây rắc rối, khó khăn; không như nó phải thế

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: not suitable, right or what you need
examples: He's the wrong person for the job.
She's simply wrong for this job.
I realized that it was the wrong thing to say.
Most people think that the country is heading in the wrong direction.
It was his bad luck to be in the wrong place at the wrong time (= so that he got involved in trouble without intending to).
We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
She's all wrong for you.
definitions.definition_vi: không phù hợp, đúng hoặc những gì bạn cần

definitions.label: Meaning 5
definitions.definition: not morally right or honest
examples: This man has done nothing wrong.
It is wrong to tell lies.
It's morally wrong to kill somebody.
It was wrong of me to get so angry.
What's wrong with eating meat?
There's nothing inherently wrong with this type of nostalgia.
It is wrong that he should not be punished for what he did.
definitions.definition_vi: không đúng về mặt đạo đức hoặc trung thực

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: to support somebody/something that is not successful
definitions.definition_vi: hỗ trợ ai/cái gì không thành công

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: to have the wrong idea about how to get or achieve something
examples: You're barking up the wrong tree if you're expecting us to lend you any money.
definitions.definition_vi: có ý tưởng sai lầm về cách đạt được hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: from or living in a poor area or part of town
definitions.definition_vi: từ hoặc sống ở một khu vực nghèo hoặc một phần của thị trấn

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: to start a relationship well/badly
examples: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
definitions.definition_vi: bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tốt/xấu

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó hài lòng với bạn/khó chịu với bạn

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
definitions.definition_vi: có tâm trạng tồi tệ cả ngày mà không có lý do cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 12
definitions.definition: to understand something in the wrong way
definitions.definition_vi: hiểu sai điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 13
definitions.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
examples: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
definitions.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp cho một dịp cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 14
definitions.definition: almost correct
examples: Your guess wasn't far out at all.
They weren't far out with their estimate of 100 000.
You're not far wrong when you say he's the richest guy in town.
definitions.definition_vi: gần đúng

definitions.label: Meaning 15
definitions.definition: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
definitions.definition_vi: trẻ hơn hoặc lớn hơn 40, 50, v.v. tuổi

definitions.label: Meaning 16
definitions.definition: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
examples: We haven’t found a cure yet—but we are on the right track.
The new manager successfully got the team back onto the right track.
The police were on the wrong track when they treated the case as a revenge killing.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc hành xử đúng/sai

definitions.label: Meaning 17
definitions.definition: in trouble with the police
definitions.definition_vi: gặp rắc rối với cảnh sát

definitions.label: Meaning 18
definitions.definition: to make somebody annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying something that offends them
examples: She tends to rub people up the wrong way.
definitions.definition_vi: làm ai đó khó chịu hoặc tức giận, thường là không cố ý, bằng cách làm hoặc nói điều gì đó xúc phạm họ

definitions.label: Meaning 19

definitions.definition_vi: bị xúc phạm bởi một nhận xét không có ý xúc phạm

definitions.label: Meaning 1

Three million tourists visit Yellowstone every year.

definitions.label: Meaning 2

They got married two years later.

Seeds can live in the soil for many years.

the pre-war/war/post-war years (= the period before/during/after the war)
I have happy memories of my years in Poland (= the time I spent there).
definitions.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mười hai tháng, được tính từ bất kỳ thời điểm cụ thể nào

definitions.label: Meaning 3

the school year

definitions.definition_vi: những năm cuối đời của ai đó

definitions.label: Meaning 11

definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn sẽ/sẽ không bao giờ làm điều gì đó

definitions.label: Meaning 12

definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong cách diễn đạt lịch sự để mô tả ai đó là 'rất già'

definitions.label: Meaning 20

definitions.definition_vi: mỗi năm, so với năm ngoái

definitions.definition: used to show that you are angry or annoyed with a particular young person
examples: I think you owe me an apology, young lady!
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng bạn đang tức giận hoặc khó chịu với một người trẻ tuổi cụ thể

definitions.label: Meaning 6
definitions.definition: used before or after a person’s name to show the difference between them and an older relative
examples: COMPARE elder
the younger Kennedy
William Pitt the younger
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước hoặc sau tên của một người để thể hiện sự khác biệt giữa họ và họ hàng lớn tuổi

definitions.label: Meaning 7
definitions.definition: used to say that people seem to be doing something at a younger age than they used to, or that they seem younger because you are now older
examples: The band's fans are getting younger.
Why do police officers seem to be getting younger?
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng mọi người dường như đang làm điều gì đó ở độ tuổi trẻ hơn trước đây hoặc họ có vẻ trẻ hơn vì bây giờ bạn đã già hơn

definitions.label: Meaning 8
definitions.definition: used when you are commenting that time is passing and that you are growing older
examples: We need to start thinking about our retirement. We’re not getting any younger, you know.
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang bình luận rằng thời gian đang trôi qua và bạn đang già đi

definitions.label: Meaning 9
definitions.definition: used to describe a young person who acts in a more sensible way than you would expect for a person of their age
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một người trẻ hành động một cách hợp lý hơn bạn mong đợi đối với một người ở độ tuổi của họ

definitions.label: Meaning 10
definitions.definition: thinking and behaving like a young person even when you are old
examples: My father is 76 but he’s still young at heart.
He's over 70, but he's young at heart.
definitions.definition_vi: suy nghĩ và cư xử như một người trẻ ngay cả khi bạn đã già

definitions.label: Meaning 11
definitions.definition: young people should enjoy themselves as much as possible, because they will have to work and worry later in their livesWord Origin
examples: Old English g(e)ong, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch jong and German jung, also to youth; from an Indo-European root shared by Latin juvenis.
definitions.definition_vi: những người trẻ nên tận hưởng bản thân nhiều nhất có thể, vì sau này họ sẽ phải làm việc và lo lắng.

definitions.label: Meaning 1
definitions.definition: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to
examples: I like your dress.
Excuse me, is this your seat?
The bank is on your right.
definitions.definition_vi: của hoặc thuộc về người hoặc những người được nói hoặc viết cho

definitions.label: Meaning 2
definitions.definition: of or belonging to people in general
examples: Dentists advise you to have your teeth checked every six months.
In Japan you are taught great respect for your elders.
definitions.definition_vi: của hoặc thuộc về mọi người nói chung

definitions.label: Meaning 3
definitions.definition: used to show that somebody/something is well known or often talked about
examples: This is your typical English pub.
You and your bright ideas!
definitions.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó được nhiều người biết đến hoặc thường được nói đến

definitions.label: Meaning 4
definitions.definition: used in some titles, especially those of royal people
examples: Your Majesty
Your Excellency
definitions.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong một số chức danh, đặc biệt là của người hoàng gia
